text: Ginpahayag man sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nga ila ginpagwa ang Circular No.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines also announced that it has issued Circular No.

text: 1198 sang Hulyo 19, 2024.
Ang circular nagarefer sa Regulatory Framework para sa Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities (MPAA).
english: The circular refers to the Regulatory Framework for Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities (MPAA).

text: Suno sa central bank, ang framework nagatuyo sa pag-establisar sang mga pamantayan kag maayo nga praktis agud maprotektahan ang pondo sang mga customer kag mga kinamatarong sang mga merchant sa pag-transaksyon sa mga operators of payment systems (OPS) nga nagahimo sang Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities.
english: According to the central bank, the framework aims to establish norms and good practice to protect customer funds and merchants’ transaction rights with operators of payment systems (OPS) engaged in Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities.

text: Gindeterminar man sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas ang Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities bilang serbisyo nga ginahatag sa mga merchant agud magbaton sang bayad kabaylo sang mga produkto kag serbisyo.
english: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas also determined Merchant Payment Acceptance Activities as services provided to merchants to receive payment in exchange for goods and services.

text: Ini nagalakip sang merchant acquisition, paghatag sang mga paagi sa pagbaton sang mga instrumento sang bayad, pag-secure, pagpadala, kag pagproseso sang impormasyon sang payments; kag paghatag sang suporta nga serbisyo may kaangtanan sa isa ka payment.
english: These include merchant acquisition, providing means to accept payment instruments, securing, transmitting, and processing payments information; and providing support services in connection with a payment.

text: Suno sa central bank, ang merchant payments naka-record sa 64.9% sang mga digital transactions sang 2023.
english: According to the central bank, merchant payments recorded at 64.9% of digital transactions in 2023.

text: Tungod sini, ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nagsiling nga ang pinakabag-o nga framework nagatuyo nga masiguro nga ang mga operators of payment systems nga nagahimo sang MPAA magpatuman sang mga istruktura sa pagdumala kag mga tikang para epektibo nga mamanehar ang mga risgo nga kaangtanan sa ila negosyo.
english: As a result, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas said the latest framework aims to ensure that operators of payment systems that undertake the MPAA implement governance structures and measures to effectively manage the risks associated with their business.

text: Sa idalum sang circular, ang OPS nga nagahimo o nagapaninguhang maghimo sang merchant acquisition kinahanglan makakuha sang lisensya gikan sa BSP.
english: Under the circular, an OPS making or seeking to make a merchant acquisition must obtain a license from the BSP.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang merchant acquisition nagarefer sa serbisyo sa pagbaton kag pagproseso sang mga bayad nga transaksyon para sa isa ka merchant sa idalum sang kasugtanan, nga nagresulta sa pagbalhin sang pondo sa merchant.
english: It is known that merchant acquisition refers to the service of receiving and processing paid transactions for a merchant under the agreement, resulting in the transfer of funds to the merchant.

text: Madamo ang nagdayaw kay Liza Soberano bangud matapos ini nagbiya sa Philippine show business, indi lamang Hollywood ang ginsulod sini kundi nakalab-ot naman sa Japan!
english: Many praised Liza Soberano because after she left the Philippine show business, she not only entered Hollywood but also reached Japan!

text: Isa ang 26-anyos nga aktres sa mga celebrities nga agaw-atensyon sa iya pagtambong sa Crunchyroll 2024 Anime Awards sa Tokyo, Japan kun sa diin isa man siya sa presenters.
english: The 26-year-old actress was one of the celebrities to grab attention when she attended the Crunchyroll 2024 Anime Awards in Tokyo, Japan where she was also one of the presenters.

text:
Si Liza ang nag-present sang winner para sa “Best Anime Song” kag ginpakilala siya bilang “isa sa pinaka-popular sa Philippine cinema, ang tingog ni Alexandra Trese sa anime series nga ‘Trese’, kag isa man sa mga bida sa Hollywood film nga Lisa Frankenstein.”

Flawless ang presentation ni Liza sa awards ceremony nga ginkabilib sang fans.
english:
Liza presented the winner for “Best Anime Song” and introduced her as “one of the most popular in Philippine cinema, the voice of Alexandra Trese in the anime series ‘Trese’, and also one of the leads in the Hollywood film Lisa Frankenstein.”

Liza's presentation at the awards ceremony was flawless.

text: Ini nga seremonya nga una nga ginhiwat sang 2017 ang gin-organisar sang anime streaming service nga Crunchyroll agud pasidunggan ang best anime productions sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This ceremony, which was first held in 2017, was organized by the anime streaming service Crunchyroll to honor the best anime productions of the previous year.

text: Lakip sa lineup sang esteemed celebrity presenters para sa pre-show kag live event amo ang sports figure nga si DeMarcus Lawrence halin sa Dallas Cowboys; wrestler kag actor nga si Mercedes Varnado; ang acclaimed Academy Award-winning duo sa likod sang “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse” nga sanday Phil Lord kag Chris Miller.
english: Included in the lineup of esteemed celebrity presenters for the pre-show and live event were sports figure DeMarcus Lawrence from the Dallas Cowboys; wrestler and actor Mercedes Varnado; the acclaimed Academy Award-winning duo behind “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse” Phil Lord and Chris Miller.

text: May isa pa ka Pinoy pride nga yara sa amo nga event sa persona sang singer-actress nga si Ylona Garcia.#
english: There was another Filipino pride present at the event in the person of singer-actress Ylona Garcia.

text: JAPAN – Ang tinda ukon merkado isa sa mga lugar nga may yara sang madamo nga tawo, naga gilinutok kag magahod apang paano kun isa ka adlaw maninda ka pero indi tawo ang makita mo, kundi isa ka penguin?
english: JAPAN – The market is one of the places where there are many people, crowded and noisy but what if one day you go shopping but you see not a person, but a penguin?

text: Huo, penguin!
english: Yes, penguins!

text: Didto sa Japan may yara sang isa ka penguin nga daw kaangay sang tawo nga nagapaninda man sang iya nga kalan-on.
english: In Japan there is a penguin that looks like a man who also sells his food.

text: Ini ang 10 ka tuig nga Penguin nga si Lala.
english: This is 10 year old Penguin Lala.

text: Si Lala ang naga istar sa balay sang pamilya Nishimodo kun sa diin may yara sya sang iya kaugalingon nga kwarto kag may aircon pa!
english: Lala lives in the Nishimodo family house where she has her own room and air conditioning!

text: Kada adlaw kaangay sang tawo nga nagapaninda si Lala ang naga padulong man sa tindahan agud maninda man sang isa nga iya kan-on sa bilog nga adlaw nga gina sulod niya sa iya backpack.
english: Every day, like a shopper, Lala goes to the store to buy something to eat all day that she puts in her backpack.

text: Suno sa pamilya Nishimodo si Lala daw bata na nila kag luyag nila nga tudluan sya nga mangin independent agud indi ini mangin kaangay sang iban nga mga sapat.
english: According to the Nishimodo family, Lala is like their child and they want to teach her to be independent so that she will not be like other animals.

text: Nangin crowd favorite si Lala sa ila nga banwa bangud maka lilingaw sya tan-awon samtang nagalakat sa dalan nga naga suksok sang iya penguin backpack nga may unod nga isda nga iya ginpaninda.
english: Lala became a crowd favorite in her town because she looked funny while walking down the street wearing her penguin backpack containing the fish she sold.

text: ARMENIA – Ang paghibi nga naga tululugay ang luha isa ka palatandaan nga tuman nga nagasubo ang isa ka tawo.
english: ARMENIA – Crying with tears in your eyes is a sign that a person is very sad.

text: Apang paano kun maghibi ka indi luha ang nagatululugay?
english: But what if you cry and it's not tears?

text: Paano kun crystal?
english: How about crystal?

text: Mangin masubo ka pa ayhan?
english: Will you still be sad?

text: Didto sa Armenia, may yara sang isa ka 22 anyos nga babayi nga ginkilala si Satenik Kazaryan nga ginapasuni nagahibi sang masobra sa 50 ka krystal kada adlaw.
english: In Armenia, there is a 22-year-old woman identified as Satenik Kazaryan who allegedly cries more than 50 crystals a day.

text: Para sa iban nga tawo isa ini ka maayo nga balita apang para kay Kazaryan isa ini ka masakit nga butang bangud sa kada hibi niya daw kaangay nga gina patay sya bangud sa tuman ini kasakit.
english: For some people this is good news but for Kazaryan it is a painful thing because every time he cries it feels like he is being killed because it hurts so much.

text: Indi naman makapati ang Opthalmologist ni Kazaryan apang sang iya na nga ginpa idalom si Kazaryan sa nagkalain-lain nga test natukiban niya nga matuod nga cystal ang naga gwa sa mata sang babayi.
english: Kazaryan's ophthalmologist could not believe it but when he subjected Kazaryan to various tests he discovered that it was a real cystal coming out of the woman's eye.

text: Suno sa Russian Opthalmologist nga si Tatyana Shilova ang formation sang crystal sa sulod sang lawas sang isa ka tawo ang theoratically posible kun maglain ang body composition sang tawo.
english: According to Russian Ophthalmologist Tatyana Shilova the formation of crystals inside a person's body is theoretically possible if the body composition of the person changes.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin sa gihapon nga misteryoso ang ginapa suni krystal nga naga gwa sa mata ni Kazaryan apang padayon man nga naga pati ang pamilya ni Kazaryan nga matuod ini.
english: At present, the alleged crystal that came out of Kazaryan's eye remains a mystery but Kazaryan's family continues to believe that it is true.

text: Duha ka lapsag ang nasapwan nga patay sa duha ka magkatuhay nga lugar.
english: Two babies were found dead in two different places.

text: Ang una nga lapsag ang nakit-an nga yara sa sulod sang maleta sa Bulan, Sorsogon.
english: The first baby was found inside a suitcase in Bulan, Sorsogon.

text: Suno sa otoridad, nakit-an sang mga ­residente ang isa ka maleta nga nagalutaw sa baybayon sang Brgy.
english: According to the authorities, residents found a suitcase floating on the beach of Brgy.

text: JP Laurel sa banwa sang Bulan.
english: JP Laurel in the town of Bulan.

text: Sang ginbuksan, didto na nakit-an ang patay nga lalaki nga lapsag.
english: When it was opened, it found a dead baby boy.

text: Ang isa pa gid ka lapsag ng nakit-an naman sa sulod sang comfort room sang grocery store sa Brgy.
english: Another baby was found inside the comfort room of a grocery store in Brgy.

text: Sulucan, East District sang Sorsogon City.
english: Sulucan, East District of Sorsogon City.

text: Napanimahuan sang isa ka gwardiya ang indi manami nga baho kag sang iya ginlantaw ang cubicle sa female comfort room, may nakit-an ini nga plastic kag sang iya ginbukad, nakit-an niy ang patay nga babaye nga fetus nga naputos sa habol.
english: A guard smelled a bad smell and when he looked in the cubicle in the female comfort room, he found a plastic bag and when he opened it, he found a dead female fetus wrapped in a blanket.

text: Ginaimbestigaran pa subong agud matumod kun sin-o ang iloy sang nasambit nga mga lapsag.
english: The mother of the babies is still being investigated.

text: Ginduso sang Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines sa gobyerno nga ipaidalom ang bilog nga Pilipinas sa state of calamity ukon emergency bangud sa liwat kag padayon nga pagsaka sang African Swine Fever (ASF).
english: The Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines has proposed to the government to place the entire Philippines under a state of calamity or emergency due to the repeated and continuous outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF).

text: Suno kay Nicanor Briones, chairperson sang Pro-Pork kag AGAP Party-list Representative, ini nga tikang amo ang magapahanugot sa gobyerno nga hulagon ang calamity funds para sa vaccination batok sa sini nga balatian sa baboy.
english: According to Nicanor Briones, chairperson of Pro-Pork and AGAP Party-list Representative, this move will allow the government to mobilize calamity funds for vaccination against this disease in pigs.

text: Pananglitan indi ini matapna subong suno kay Briones, magalapta ini, magabalatian ang mga baboy, kag magkalamatay na lang kun maatrasar pa gid ang pagbakuna.
english: If it is not stopped now, Briones said, it will spread, the pigs will get sick, and die if the vaccination is delayed.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapreparar ang Department of Agriculture sang emergency procurement sang ASF vaccines kasunod sang outbreak sa probinsya sang Batangas.
english: The Department of Agriculture is preparing for emergency procurement of ASF vaccines following the outbreak in Batangas province.

text: Walo ka mga banwa sa amo nga probinsya ang may aktibo nga kaso sang ASF kun sa diin ang Lobo kag Calatagan ang nakadeklarar na sang state of calamity.
english: Eight towns in the province have active cases of ASF with Lobo and Calatagan declared a state of calamity.

text: Ginpahayag man sang DA nga 10% sang hog population sang Pilipinas ang naghalin sa Batangas gani kinahanglan gid ini nga proteksyunan para nga masigurado ang pork supply sang pungsod.
english: The DA also said that 10% of the Philippines' hog population comes from Batangas so it must be protected to ensure the country's pork supply.

text: Sa pinakauli nga data sang DA, ang current hog population ang nagpanaog sa 9.9 million halin sa 12.7 million antes ang kaso sang ASF sang 2019.
english: According to the latest DA data, the current hog population has dropped to 9.9 million from 12.7 million before the 2019 ASF case.

text: Liwat nga gin-aresto sang Manila Police District ang drag artist nga si Pura Luka Vega bangud gihapon sa iya kontrobersyal nga performance sang “Ama Namin” sadtong Hulyo 2023.
english: The Manila Police District once again arrested drag artist Pura Luka Vega for her controversial performance of “Ama Namin” in July 2023.

text:
Gindakop si Luka paagi sa gahom sang warrant of arrest nga ginpaguwa sang Quezon City court kun sa diin may three counts ini sang gina-alegar paglapas sa Article 201 sang Revised Penal Code kun sa diin nalakip ang “immoral doctrines, obscene publications and exhibitions, kag indecent shows.”

Suno kay “Drag Den Philippines” director Rod Singh, nag-ugat ini sa reklamo halin sa tatlo ka simbahan nga naangot sa Philippines for Jesus Movement (PJM).
english:
Luka was arrested by virtue of a warrant of arrest issued by the Quezon City court where he has three counts of alleged violation of Article 201 of the Revised Penal Code which includes “immoral doctrines, obscene publications and exhibitions, and indecent shows.”

According to “Drag Den Philippines” director Rod Singh, this stemmed from a complaint from three churches affiliated with the Philippines for Jesus Movement (PJM).

text: Nagadangat sa P360,000 ang kinahanglanon nga pyansa agud nga makaguwa ang nasambit nga drag artist sa custodial facility sang Sta.
english: The bail amount of P360,000 is required for the drag artist to be released from the custodial facility of Sta.

text: Cruz Police Station.
english: Cruz Police Station.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Pebrero 26, nag-pyansa man si Luka sa Pasay City bangud sa anum ka counts sang ginapahayag nga paglapas sa Article 201 “in relation to Section 6 of R.A. 10175” nga naangot naman sa reklamo sang Kapisanan ng Social Media Broadcasters ng Pilipinas.
english: On February 26, Luka also posted bail in Pasay City for six counts of alleged violation of Article 201 “in relation to Section 6 of R.A. 10175” in connection with the complaint of the Association of Social Media Broadcasters of the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga sang Oktubre 4, 2023, naaresto man si Luka bangud sa amo man nga reklamo kun sa diin nag-absent ini sa preliminary investigations sa amo nga kaso-kriminal sa Manila.
english: It can be recalled that on October 4, 2023, Luka was also arrested on the same complaint where he was absent from the preliminary investigations in the same criminal case in Manila.

text: Naka-guwa siya paagi sa pagpyansa sang P72,000 sa bulig man sang kaangay sini nga drag artists.
english: He was released on bail of P72,000 with the help of fellow drag artists.

text: Ang ginakaugtan sang mga tagreklamo nga performance ni Luka amo ang iya nga video lip syncing sa “Ama Namin” remix samtang nga suksok sini ang panapton nga nagailog kay Hesukristo.
english: The complainants hate Luka's performance is his video lip syncing to the “Ama Namin” remix while wearing clothes that imitate Jesus Christ.

text: Magluwas nga madamo ang nagpakamalaot sa amo nga performance, gindeklarar man ang amo nga drag queen nga persona non grata sa madamo nga syudad kag probinsya sa Pilipinas.#
english: Besides being condemned by many, the drag queen was also declared persona non grata in many cities and provinces in the Philippines.

text: Mas nagabaskog pa ang kusog ni Bagyo Uwan samtang nga nagapalapit ini sa Catanduanes.
english: Typhoon Uwan is getting stronger as it approaches Catanduanes.

text: Sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang state weather bureau subong nga Domingo, Nobyembre 9, nakabutang nga nakit-an ang mata sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 195 kilometros nasidlangan sang Virac, Catanduanes.
english: The 5:00 am weather bulletin of the state weather bureau on Sunday, November 9, stated that the eye of the typhoon was spotted at a distance of 195 kilometers east of Virac, Catanduanes.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga tubtub sa 175 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 215 km/h. Namentenar man sini ang direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 35 km/h.

May mga area na sa Luzon kag Visayas nga napaidalom sa wind signal numbers 2, 3, kag 4.
english:
It brought winds of up to 175 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 215 km/h. It also maintained a westward northwesterly direction at a speed of 35 km/h.

There are areas in Luzon and Visayas that are already under wind signal numbers 2, 3, and 4.

text: Napaidalom naman sa Wind Signal No.
english: Under Wind Signal No.

text: 1 ang Guimaras, Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, kag ang Antique ukon ang bilog nga Rehiyon VI.
english: 1 Guimaras, Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, and Antique or the entire Region VI.

text: Sa Wind Signal number 1, lauman nga may mabaskog nga hangin, may warning lead time nga 36 oras, kag may dala nga minimal to minor nga peligro sa kabuhi kag sa mga propiedad.
english: Under Wind Signal number 1, strong winds are expected, with a warning lead time of 36 hours, and minimal to minor risk to life and property.

text: Suno sa weather bureau, Signal No.
english: According to the weather bureau, Signal No.

text: 5 ang pinakamataas nga wind signal nga mahimo mapaguwa samtang yari sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) si Bagyo Uwan.
english: 5 is the highest wind signal that can be issued while Typhoon Uwan is in the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Ma-eksperyensyahan man ang mamunog nga pag-ulan, mabaskog nga hangin, kag storm surge mangin sa mga lugar nga malayo sa lugar kun sa diin maga-landfall ang bagyo.
english: Heavy rains, strong winds, and storm surge will also be experienced even in areas far from the area where the typhoon will landfall.

text: Gina-forecast nga magahulag ang bagyo pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa masunod nga 24 oras ukon i-mentenar sini ang pareho nga direksyon sini subong.
english: The typhoon is forecast to move west northwest over the next 24 hours or maintain the same direction as it is now.

text: Sa track forecast, ang mata sang bagyo magalabay malapit sa Catanduanes subong nga aga kag maga-landfall sa Aurora karon sa gab-i ukon buwas sa kaagahon.
english: In the track forecast, the eye of the storm will pass near Catanduanes this morning and make landfall in Aurora tonight or tomorrow morning.

text: Bangud sa kalapiton sini, posible nga direkta ini nga mag-igu ukon mag-landfall sa Catanduanes.
english: Due to its proximity, it is likely to directly hit or landfall in Catanduanes.

text: Pagkatapos sang landfall, maga-agi ang bagyo sa kabukiran sang Northern Luzon kag magatuhaw sa Lingayen Gulf ukon sa kadagatan sang Pangasinan ukon La Union sa Lunes sang aga.
english: After landfall, the typhoon will pass through the mountains of Northern Luzon and emerge in the Lingayen Gulf or the waters of Pangasinan or La Union on Monday morning.

text: Suno pa sa weather bureau, magalab-ot si Uwan sa super typhoon category kag mahimo mag-landfall kun malapit na ukon yara na mismo sa iya nga peak lifetime intensity.
english: According to the weather bureau, Uwan will reach the super typhoon category and may landfall if it is near or at its peak lifetime intensity.

text: Ang paglabay sini sa kabukiran ang mahimo makapahina sa pwersa sini apang ginalantaw nga magapabilin ini bilang typoon samtang yara pa sa teritoryo sang Northern Luzon.#
english: Its passage through the mountains may weaken its strength but it is expected to remain as a typhoon while still in the territory of Northern Luzon.

text: PENNSYLVANIA – Ano ang mahimo mo bangud sa kaakig sa imo ex ukon kagahugma nga ginbulagan ikaw ukon ginbulagan mo?
english: PENNSYLVANIA – What can you do out of anger at your ex or resentment that you broke up with him or her?

text: Sa Pennsylvania, isa ka lalaki ang gindakop bangud sa ginhimo niya nga akto sang terorismo sa iya ex-girlfriend.
english: In Pennsylvania, a man was arrested for committing an act of terrorism against his ex-girlfriend.

text: Gindakop si Jason Muzzicato, 44, bangud sa paghulog sang eksplosibo sa balay sang anay nobya.
english: Jason Muzzicato, 44, was arrested for throwing an explosive at his ex-girlfriend's house.

text: Wala man naklaruhan ang motibo ni Muzzicato, apang suno sa mga otoridad, naggamit siya sang drone agud mahulog sang eksplosibo sa balay sang iya ex-girlfriend.
english: Muzzicato's motive is unclear, but authorities say he used a drone to drop explosives on his ex-girlfriend's house.

text: Nakuha naman sang mga imbestigador ang pito ka improvised explosive devices kag siyam ka mga firearms.
english: Investigators recovered seven improvised explosive devices and nine firearms.

text: INDIA–  Isa sa pinaka masadya nga balatyagon sa aton nga kabuhi amo ang magka bata kita.
english: INDIA – One of the happiest feelings in our lives is having a child.

text: Didto sa India may yara sang isa ka tigulang nga tuman ang nangin kasadya bangud daw sa indi sya magpati nga sa iya edad nga 78 anyos sya ang naka bun-ag pa sang isa ka bata.
english: In India there was an old man who was very happy because he could not believe that at the age of 78 years he had given birth to a child.

text: Ang tigulang ginkilala si Mangayamma sang Anthar Pradesh state sa India.
english: The elderly man was identified as Mangayamma of Anthar Pradesh state in India.

text: Si Mangayamma ang gintanyag nga oldest woman in history to give birth matapos niya nga gin bun ag ang kapid nga babayi paagi sa IVF procedure ukon ang In-virtro Fertilization.
english: Mangayamma was titled the oldest woman in history to give birth after she gave birth to a twin girl through IVF procedure or in-virtro fertilization.

text: Tuman ang nangin kasadya ni Mangayamma kag sang iya bana bangud daw kaangay nga na kompleto na ang ila 54 ka tuig nga pag updanay bangud sa pag abot sang ila kapid nga baby girl.
english: Mangayamma and her husband were overjoyed because it seemed that their 54 years of marriage had been completed with the arrival of their baby girl.

text: Apang matapos ang masadya nga natabo sa mag-asawa nga Mangayamma kag Rajarao ginsundan naman ini sang masubo nga balita sang napatay si Rajarao bangud sa stroke isa ka adlaw matapos ginbun-ag ang ila nga kapid.
english: But after the happy events of Mangayamma and Rajarao, it was followed by sad news when Rajarao died of a stroke a day after giving birth to their twins.

text: Nagturn-over liwat ang Philippine National Police–Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) sang bag-o nga batch sang mga dokumento may kaangtanan sa mga flood control projects.
english: The Philippine National Police–Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) once again turned over a new batch of documents related to flood control projects.

text: Ini angot man sa gina-imbestigarab sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) bangud sa possible nga anomalya.
english: This is also in connection with the investigation of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) due to possible anomalies.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, 95 ka mga kahon sang ebidensya nga may unod sang 28 ka ginapahayag ng ghost ukon peke nga flood control projects ang nauna na nga ginsumiter sang pulisya sa komisyon.
english: Last month, 95 boxes of evidence containing 28 alleged ghost or fake flood control projects were previously submitted by the police to the commission.

text: Suno kay ICI spokesperson Brian Hosaka, gamiton ang mga dokumento para sa case build-up samtang nagapadayon ang may lapnagon nga imbestigasyon.
english: According to ICI spokesperson Brian Hosaka, the documents will be used for case build-up while the extensive investigation continues.

text: Ginsiling man ni Hosaka nga kabug-usan 421 ang ginalantaw nga ghost projects sa subong sang ICI.
english: Hosaka also said that a total of 421 ghost projects are currently under investigation by the ICI.

text: Magluwas diri, nakatutok man ang mga imbestigador sa top 15 contractors nga una na nga gin-report nga na-flag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Investigators are also focusing on the top 15 contractors that were previously reported to have been flagged by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: bilang possible nga may kahilabtanan sa mga iregularidad.
english: as possibly related to irregularities.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Nakarekord ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sang mas madasig nga growth rate sa ikaduha nga quarter sang 2024 —nga nagamarka sang pinakamadasig nga pagsaka sa lima ka quarter— sa likod sang mabaskog nga mga consumption activities sa sulod sang amo nga period.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —The Philippine economy recorded a faster growth rate in the second quarter of 2024 —marking the fastest rise in five quarters— on the back of strong consumption activities during the period.

text: Suno kay Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief nga si Claire Dennis Mapa, ang gross domestic product (GDP) sang pungsod —ang kabug-usan nga balor sang mga balaklon kag serbisyo nga ginhimo sa isa ka period— nagtubo sang 6.3% sa Abril tubtob Hunyo 2024 nga period.
english: According to Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief Claire Dennis Mapa, the country’s gross domestic product (GDP) —the total value of goods and services produced in a given period— grew by 6.3% in the April to June 2024 period.

text: Mas madasig ini sangsa gin-revise nga growth rate sang GDP nga 5.8% sa una nga quarter sang tuig.
english: This is faster than the revised GDP growth rate of 5.8% in the first quarter of the year.

text: Amo man ini ang pinakamadasig nga growth rate sang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sa sulod sang lima ka quarter halin sang 6.4% nga growth rate nga nakita sa una nga quarter sang 2023.
english: This is also the fastest growth rate of the Philippine economy in five quarters since the 6.4% growth rate seen in the first quarter of 2023.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa mga ekonomiya sa East Asian Countries nga nagpaguwa sang mga numero sa ikaduha nga kwarter, ang Pilipinas yara sa likod sang 6.9% sang Vietnam, kag mas mataas sa 5.8% sang Malaysia, 5.0% sang Indonesia, kag 4.7% sang China.
english: It is known that among the economies in East Asian Countries that released figures in the second quarter, the Philippines is behind Vietnam's 6.9%, and above Malaysia's 5.8%, Indonesia's 5.0%, and China's 4.7%.

text: SAN FRANCISCO–  Sarang mo bala mag tinir sa tunga sang lawod sa masobra ka duha ka bulan?
english: SAN FRANCISCO – Can you stay in the middle of the sea for more than two months?

text: Pareho ka man bala sang sikat nga karakter nga si Moana nga mahuyugon magswimming kag mag tinir sa dagat?
english: Are you like the famous character Moana who loves to swim and spend time in the sea?

text: Didto sa San Francisco may yara isa ka lalaki nga daw paryente ni Moana bangud nasarangan niya nga mag tinir sa tunga sang lawod sa sulod sang 76 ka adlaw.
english: In San Francisco there is a man who seems to be a relative of Moana because he was able to stay in the middle of the sea for 76 days.

text: Ang lalaki gin kilala si Antonio De La Rosa, 50 sang Spain ang gintanyag pinaka una nga tawo nga nag stand up paddleboard halin sa California pakadto sa Hawaii nga may kaluyuon nga 2,500 miles sa sulod sang 76 ka adlaw.
english: The man identified as Antonio De La Rosa, 50 of Spain was offered the first person to stand up paddleboard from California to Hawaii with a distance of 2,500 miles in 76 days.

text: Paano ayhan nasarangan ni De la Rosa nga mag tinir sa tunga sang kalalawran.
english: How did De la Rosa manage to stay in the middle of the sea?

text: Nag trending naman ang Vlog natuhoy sa iya nangin byahe pakadto sa Hawaii nga gin post ni Antonio sa iya nga social media kun sa diin ginkabiliban man sang mga netizens ang iya kaisog kag dedikasyon.
english: A vlog about his trip to Hawaii that Antonio posted on his social media became trending where netizens also admired his courage and dedication.

text: Nangin rason sang kamatayon sang isa ka 21-anyos nga lalaki ang pagsalbar niya sa iya nga tsinelas nga ginhaboy sang iya kaupod nga obrero sa isa ka suba sa tunga sang mabaskog nga daludo sang tubig-baha sa Banayoyo, Ilocos Sur kadungan sang paglaslas sang bagyo Crising.
english: A 21-year-old man died after he rescued his slippers from a fellow worker who threw them into a river amid strong floodwaters in Banayoyo, Ilocos Sur during the onslaught of Typhoon Crising.

text: Ang biktima amo si Cean Ian Gadut.
english: The victim was identified as Cean Ian Gadut.

text: Suno sa report, natabo ang insidente matapos ginkuha sang iya kaupod ang tsinelas sang biktima kag ginhaboy sa suba.
english: According to the report, the incident occurred after his companion took the victim's slippers and threw them into the river.

text: Gilayon nga naglumpat ang biktima para makuha ang tsinelas apang gin-anod ini sang tubig-baha.
english: The victim immediately jumped to get the slippers but was washed away by the flood waters.

text: Gintinguhaan pa nga ma-rescue ang biktima apang sang nakit-an ini, wala na siya sang kabuhi.
english: Attempts were made to rescue the victim but when he was found, he was dead.

text: Ipadala sang Espanya ang tennis legend nga si Rafael Nadal kag ang bag-o lang nagkampyon sa French Open nga si Carlos Alcaraz para sa men’s doubles sa Paris Olympics.
english: Spain will send tennis legend Rafael Nadal and recent French Open champion Carlos Alcaraz for men’s doubles at the Paris Olympics.

text: 2008 sang nadag-an ni Nadal ang gold medal sa Olympiada, samtang ini naman ang una nga pagtapak sang 21-anyos nga si Alcaraz sa Olympic stage.
english: Nadal won the gold medal at the Olympics in 2008, while 21-year-old Alcaraz made his first appearance on the Olympic stage.

text: Apisar nga beterano na si Nadal nga isa man ka 14-time French Open champion, nagasuprer pa ini sa injuries, apang sandig sa anunsyo sang  Royal Spanish Tennis Federation (RFET), ginpasigurado na sang national team coach nga si David Ferrer nga nagpasugot ang 38-anyos nga tennis superstar nga makaupod si Alcaraz.
english: Although Nadal is a veteran and a 14-time French Open champion, he is still suffering from injuries, but according to the announcement of the Royal Spanish Tennis Federation (RFET), national team coach David Ferrer has assured that the 38-year-old tennis superstar has agreed to join Alcaraz.

text: “The Olympic Games are every four years and it’s a special tournament where you’re not only playing for yourself, but for a country, representing every Spaniard,” pahayag anay sang No.
english: “The Olympic Games are every four years and it’s a special tournament where you’re not only playing for yourself, but for a country, representing every Spaniard,” said the former No.

text: 2-ranked nga next gen star.
english: 2-ranked next gen star.

text:
“I think this year I’d choose Olympic gold.”

Sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw sang naghimo sang maragtas si Alcaraz bilang pinakabata nga kampyon sa French Open, kag pinakabata man nga nakadaog sa tatlo ka surfaces nga amo ang French Open, US Open, kag Wimbledon.
english:
“I think this year I’d choose Olympic gold.”

Only the other day Alcaraz made history as the youngest French Open champion, and also the youngest to win on three surfaces namely the French Open, US Open, and Wimbledon.

text: Balantayan ang Olympiada sa Hulyo 26-Agusto 11.
english: Watch the Olympiad July 26-August 11.

text: Spotted ang celebrity couple nga sanday Sam Milby kag Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray sa isa ka industry event kaupod ang abyan nga celebrity nga si Isabel Oli pila ka oras matapos nabanhaw ang espekulasyon nga madugay na sila nga nagbulaganay.
english: Celebrity couple Sam Milby and Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray were spotted at an industry event with celebrity friend Isabel Oli hours after speculation that they had long since split was resurrected.

text: Ang latest nga chika ang halin sa talent manager kag vlogger nga si Ogie Diaz, ukon ang ginatawag sang netizens nga si “St.
english: The latest gossip comes from talent manager and vlogger Ogie Diaz, or what netizens call “St.

text: Ogie Diaz – Patron ng mga Hiwalayan”.
english: Ogie Diaz – Patron of the Hiwalayan”.

text: Suno kay Ogie, may source siya nga nagsiling nga daw kaangay kanday Jericho Rosales kag Kim Jones ang estado sang relasyon sang engaged couple — bulagay na, apang mag-abyan gihapon.
english: Ogie said he had a source say the engaged couple’s relationship status is similar to Jericho Rosales and Kim Jones — separated, but still friends.

text: Sa impormasyon pa sang vlogger, sang birthday sang beauty queen sang Enero 6, break na sila ni Sam apang matandaan nga sang amo nga tion, may yara pa sang gin-organisar si Sam nga debut-inspired birthday party para kay Cat kag may yara pa sila sang sweet moments.
english: According to the vlogger, on the beauty queen's birthday on January 6, they were on a break with Sam but it can be remembered that at that time, Sam had organized a debut-inspired birthday party for Cat and they had sweet moments.

text: May isa ka chika si Ogie nga nagkit-anay sila ni Catriona sa isa ka event kag daw kaangay suno sa iya nga ginatago ang isa ka kamot sini para indi makita nga wala na sini ginasuksok ang iya nga engagement ring.
english: Ogie had a joke that he met Catriona at an event and it seemed like he was hiding one of her hands so that it wouldn't be seen that she wasn't wearing her engagement ring.

text: May source man suno sa iya nga nareyalisar ni Sam nga indi pa ini handa magpakasal, kag may yara man suno sa iya nga naka-istorya nga may yara sang na-fall out of love apang indi klaro kun sin-o sa duha.
english: He also said there is a source that Sam realized that he is not ready to get married, and he said there is also a story that someone fell out of love but it is not clear who the two.

text: Wala naman sang direkta nga kumpirmasyon gikan sa duha apang una na nga ginsiling ni Cat nga gusto nila nga lowkey kag ipabilin nga pribado ang ila nga relasyon.
english: There is no direct confirmation from the two but Cat has previously said that they want to keep their relationship lowkey and private.

text: Pebrero 2023 sang na-engage sanday Cat kag Sam kag nagaplano na nga magpakasal subong nga tuig.
english: Cat and Sam got engaged in February 2023 and are already planning to get married this year.

text: OSLO,NORWAY–  Mahuyugon ka bala nga magpasakop sa mga kompetisyon?
english: OSLO,NORWAY– Are you interested in participating in competitions?

text: Sarang mo bala nga itaya ang imo kabuhi makuha lang ang kadalag-an?
english: Would you risk your life just to win?

text: Kun huo ang sabat mo para gid sa imo ang pinasahi nga kompetisyon nga ginapatigayon sa Norway.
english: If you answered yes, then the special competition held in Norway is for you.

text: Ini ang ginatawag nila nga Death Diving world championship nga ginapatigayon kada tuig sa Norway.
english: This is what they call the Death Diving world championship which is held every year in Norway.

text: Agud magdaog sa nasambit nga kompetisyon kinahanglan mo lang maglumpat sa isa ka diving board nga may yara sang kataason nga 10-meters.
english: To win the said competition you just need to jump on a diving board with a height of 10-meters.

text: Kun luyag mo magpasikat mahimo man nga maka perform ka anay sang mga acrobratic tricks bag-o ka maglumpat sa pool.
english: If you want to be famous, you can also perform acrobratic tricks before jumping into the pool.

text: Ang Death Diving world championship na imbento sang 1960’s sa Oslo, Norway kun sa diin ang una nga nangin katuyuan sang kompetisyon amo ang magpasikat ang mga kalalakihan sa mga kababaihan paagi sa paglumpat sa tuman ka taas nga diving board.
english: The Death Diving world championship was invented in the 1960's in Oslo, Norway where the original purpose of the competition was to impress men with women by jumping on a very high diving board.

text: Sa subong isa na ang Death Diving sa pinaka sikat nga kompetisyon sa Norway.
english: Death Diving is now one of the most popular competitions in Norway.

text: Pilason ang mag-iloy matapos ginpulihan labo kag buno sang mag-amay sa Valderrama, Antique.
english: A mother and daughter were injured after being stabbed by a father in Valderrama, Antique.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday alyas Telma, 73-anyos kag iya anak nga si alyas Ryan, 35-anyos kag isa ka mangunguma.
english: The victims were identified as Telma, 73, and her son Ryan, 35, a farmer.

text: Ang mga suspek amo sanday alyas Gilbert kag si alyas Jason.
english: The suspects were identified as alias Gilbert and alias Jason.

text: Ang mga ini ang lunsay pumuluyo sang Sitio Tigmasin, Barangay Lublub sa amo nga banwa.
english: They are all residents of Sitio Tigmasin, Barangay Lublub in the same town.

text: Suno sa Valderrama PNP, sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, updanay nga nagainom ang involved nga kabataan kun sa diin ginhangkat ni Jason si Ryan sang inaway.
english: According to Valderrama PNP, according to initial investigation, the involved children were drinking together when Jason challenged Ryan to a fight.

text: Nagpauli si Ryan sa ila balay apang nagsunod ang mag-amay nga Jason kag Gilbert.
english: Ryan went home but Jason and Gilbert followed.

text: Didto na ginlabo ni Jason si Ryan nga naigo sa ulo.
english: Jason then stabbed Ryan in the head.

text: Nagtambag naman ang iloy nga si Telma apang ginbuno man ini ni Gilbert kag naigo sa abaga.
english: Mother Telma tried to get advice but Gilbert stabbed her in the shoulder.

text: Matapos ang insidente, nalagyo ang mag-amay nga suspek.
english: After the incident, the suspects fled the scene.

text: Nahingagaw naman nga madala sa ospital ang mag-iloy.
english: The mother and daughter were rushed to the hospital.

text: Natigayon naman nga madakpan sang otoridad ang mag-amay kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso.
english: Authorities arrested the father and are scheduled to face charges.

text: DAVAO–  Atensyon sa mga chocolate lover!
english: DAVAO– Attention chocolate lovers!

text: Kabalo ka bala nga ang paborito mo nga tsokolate indi lang manamit ini man ang maayo sa imo nga panit?
english: Did you know that your favorite chocolate is not only delicious but also good for your skin?

text: Didto sa Davao, may yara sang isa ka pinasahi ng klase sang spa.
english: In Davao, there is a special kind of spa.

text: Pinasahi bangud indi kaangaay sang iban nga mga SPA ang Malagos Chocolate SPA naga gamit sang tsokolate agud ma relax ang ila mga costumers.
english: Malagos Chocolate SPA is unique because unlike other SPAs, it uses chocolate to relax its customers.

text: May yara sang nagkalain-lain nga services nga gina offer ang nasambit nga SPA kaangay nalang sang 45-minute foot and leg massage kun sa diin ginabubuan sang mainit nga tsokolate ang imo nga tiil.
english: The SPA offers a variety of services such as a 45-minute foot and leg massage where hot chocolate is poured on your feet.

text: Lakip man sa mga espesyal nila nga serbisyo amo ang isa ka oras nga chocolate facial nga naga gamit sang crushed nga cacao kag saging nga may yara man sang oatmeal nga ginagamit nga facial exfoliants.
english: Among their special services is a one-hour chocolate facial using crushed cacao and banana with oatmeal used as facial exfoliants.

text: Naga gamit man sila sang tunaw nga tsokolate agud ma relax ang guya sang mga costumers.
english: They also use melted chocolate to relax the faces of costumers.

text: Kun makakadto ka gani sa Davao indi ka gid malipat nga mag kadto sa Chocolate spa agud ma eksperyensyahan mo man ang pinasahi nga serbisyo sang tsokolate.
english: If you go to Davao, don't forget to visit the Chocolate spa to experience the special chocolate service.

text: Nagnubo sang 3.3 percent ang agricultural output sa ikaduha nga quarter subong nga 2024 bangud sa pagnubo sang balor sang crops kag livestock production.
english: Agricultural output decreased by 3.3 percent in the second quarter of 2024 due to the decline in the value of crops and livestock production.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ang balor sang produksyon sa agriculture kag fisheries ang nagnubo sa P413.91 billion halin sa P427.69 billion sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the value of production in agriculture and fisheries decreased to P413.91 billion from P427.69 billion last year.

text: Ang crop production ang nagnubo sa P220.04 billion, ukon 8% nga mas manubo kun ipaanggid sa ikaduha nga quarter sang 2023.
english: Crop production decreased to P220.04 billion, or 8% lower compared to the second quarter of 2023.

text: Ginpahayag man sang ahensya nga nakarekord man sang pagnubo sa nasambit nga period ang produksyon sang humay kag mais.
english: The agency also said that rice and corn production also recorded a decline during the period.

text: Nakarekord man sang 0.3 percent nga pagnubo sa balor sang produksyon ang livestock, ukon P63.33 billion.
english: Livestock also recorded a 0.3 percent decline in production value, or P63.33 billion.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagtaas naman ang produksyon sa poultry kag fisheries sa P70.15 billion kag P60.40 billion sa ikaduha nga quarter sang 2024.
english: Meanwhile, poultry and fisheries production increased to P70.15 billion and P60.40 billion in the second quarter of 2024 respectively.

text: ENGLAND–  Kun madasig ka magluto, manamit pa ayhan ang pagkaon nga gina luto mo?
english: ENGLAND – If you cook quickly, will the food you cook taste better?

text: Sa Europa, may yara isa ka pizza chef nga tuman ka sagad kag madasig magluto rason kun ngaa wala nagaka akig ang iya mga costumer.
english: In Europe, there is a pizza chef who is very skilled and quick to cook that's why his customers don't get angry.

text: Si Zagros Jaff isa ka pizza chef sa isa sikat nga pizza shop sa Europa ang gintanyag nga Fastest Pizza Maker sa tatlo na ka sunod-sunod nga tuig.
english: Zagros Jaff, a pizza chef at a popular pizza shop in Europe, has been named Fastest Pizza Maker for three consecutive years.

text: Sarangan ni Zagros nga maka himo sang pizza sa sulod lang sang 27 ka segundo kun sa diin 133 ka pizzas ang sarang niya mahimo sa sulod sang isa ka oras.
english: Zagros can make a pizza in just 27 seconds where he can make 133 pizzas in an hour.

text: Bangud diri, nagdaog si Zagros sa Domino’s annual European Fastest Pizza Maker Competition kag sya nag nagpauli sang pinasahi nga tropeyo nga isa ka gold cast sang iya magical pizza-making hands nga inspires sa Hollywood Walk of Fame.
english: As a result, Zagros won Domino's annual European Fastest Pizza Maker Competition and took home a special trophy of a gold cast of his magical pizza-making hands that inspires the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

text: Sa subong si Zagros man sa gihapon ang record holder sang nasambit nga kompetisyon.
english: Zagros is still the record holder of the competition.

text: Nagtipon mismo ang mga artista sa plenary session sang Senado agud nga saksihan kag pasalamatan ang pagpasar sang Senate Bill No.
english: The artists themselves gathered at the plenary session of the Senate to witness and thank the passage of Senate Bill No.

text: 2505 ukon kilala nga Eddie Garcia Bill.
english: 2505 or commonly known as the Eddie Garcia Bill.

text: Ini nga hagna —nga nagatuyo nga protektahan ang mga nagatrabaho sa movie kag television industry — ang nakalusot na sa third and final reading, Pebrero 19, matapos nakabaton sang 22 affirmative, zero negative votes, kag zero abstentions.
english: This bill —which aims to protect workers in the movie and television industry — has already passed third and final reading, Feb. 19, after receiving 22 affirmative, zero negative votes, and zero abstentions.

text: Partikular nga ginaduso sang hagna ang istrikto nga implementasyon sang working hours, sweldo kag iban pa nga wage-related benefits, kag social security sa industry workers.
english: Specifically, the bill proposes strict implementation of working hours, salaries and other wage-related benefits, and social security to industry workers.

text: Kun mapirmahan na ini kag mahimo nga layi, mangin mandato na sang gobyerno nga mag-establisar sang Movie and Television Tripartite Council nga bug-usan sang mga tiglawas sang gobyerno, employers, kag mga naga-trabaho sa movie kag TV industry.
english: Once signed into law, it will be the government's mandate to establish a Movie and Television Tripartite Council composed of government representatives, employers, and those working in the movie and TV industry.

text:
Ini nga hagna ang inspired sang kamatayon sang beterano nga aktor nga si Garcia sang 2019 nga nagsuprer sang neck injury bangud nakasandad ini kag natumba kadungan sang shooting sang iya kuntani nagahilapit nga “teleserye.”

Lakip sa nagtambong sa Senate proceedings amo ang movie personalities nga sanday Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera, asawa ni Garcia nga si Lilibeth Romero, Martin Nievera, Pops Fernandez, Tirso Cruz III, Iza Calzado, Mariel Padilla, kag iban pa.
english:
The bill was inspired by the death of veteran actor Garcia in 2019 who suffered a neck injury after tripping and falling while shooting his upcoming teleserye.

Among those who attended the Senate proceedings were movie personalities Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera, Garcia's wife Lilibeth Romero, Martin Nievera, Pops Fernandez, Tirso Cruz III, Iza Calzado, Mariel Padilla, and others.

text: Ginabasol sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) si anay Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan sa ginapahayag nga himbunanay sang pila ka mga inhenyero sang DPWH kag pribado nga kontratista sa P72.4-million nga “ghost” flood control project sa Plaridel, Bulacan.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) blames former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan for the alleged collusion between some DPWH engineers and private contractors in the P72.4-million “ghost” flood control project in Plaridel, Bulacan.

text: Suno sa report sang ICI nga ginsumiter sa Office of the Ombudsman, natabo ang paggasto sang pondo sa idalom mismo sang liderato ni Bonoan.
english: According to the ICI report submitted to the Office of the Ombudsman, the spending of funds occurred under Bonoan’s own leadership.

text: Pahayag sang komisyon nga pasakaan si Bonoan sang kaso administratibo kaangay sang grave misconduct, gross dishonesty, kag paglapas sa Code of Conduct for Public Officials.
english: The commission said it will charge Bonoan with administrative charges such as grave misconduct, gross dishonesty, and violation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials.

text: Lakip man sa manabat ang anay undersecretaries sang DPWH nga sanday Roberto Bernardo kag Maria Catalina Cabral.
english: Former DPWH undersecretaries Roberto Bernardo and Maria Catalina Cabral are also among those responsible.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, nagguwa nga wala sang napatindog nga flood control structure sa lugar apisar nga nabaydan na ini sang masobra P72 million sa kontratista nga Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.
english: Investigation revealed that no flood control structure was built in the area despite paying more than P72 million to the contractor Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.

text: Suno sa ICI, ang pagpabaya ni Bonoan ang “katumbas sang pagpangdaya”.
english: The ICI said Bonoan’s negligence was “the equivalent of fraud”.

text: Ang report nga ini ang kabahin sang mas lapnagon nga imbestigasyon sa mga ginapahayag nga ghost kag overpriced projects sang DPWH nga ginsambit ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The report is part of a wider investigation into the alleged ghost and overpriced projects of the DPWH mentioned by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa iya State of the Nation Address (SONA).
english: in his State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Walo ang kumpirmado nga patay sa bungguanay sang isa ka truck kag duha ka van sa Aurora, Isabela sang Sabado, Hulyo 19, 2025.
english: Eight people were confirmed dead in a collision between a truck and two vans in Aurora, Isabela on Saturday, July 19, 2025.

text: Suno sa report, nagadalagan ang isa ka six-wheeler truck padulong sa Santiago City sang hinali lang nga naglapaw ini sa pihak nga linya kun sa diin nagasundanay ang duha ka van.
english: According to the report, a six-wheeler truck was heading towards Santiago City when it suddenly crossed the other lane where two vans were following each other.

text: Gilayon nga nabungguan ang isa ka van nga may sakay nga 16 ka pasahero.
english: A van carrying 16 passengers was immediately hit.

text: Sa kabaskog sang impact, gin-arado pa ini sang truck bag-o nag-igo sa isa pa ka van nga may sakay nga siyam ka pasahero.
english: Due to the force of the impact, the truck plowed into it before hitting another van with nine passengers.

text: Gindeklarar nga dead on arrival ang driver sang una nga van samtang pito pa ang nareport nga napatay nga mga sakay sini.
english: The driver of the first van was declared dead on arrival while seven others were reported dead.

text: May isa pa ka pasahero nga na- comatose.
english: Another passenger was in a coma.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, human error ang ginasundan nga anggulo.
english: Based on the investigation, human error is the angle being followed.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang pulis ang driver sang truck.
english: The driver of the truck is now in police custody.

text: Gin-adoptar sang Senado ang resolution nga ginduso agud nga kilalahon ang power couple nga sanday Marian Rivera kag Dingdong Dantes bangud sa ila pag-serbe nga inspirasyon ilabi na sa ila nga ulihi nga pelikula nga “Rewind”.
english: The Senate adopted a resolution proposed to recognize the power couple Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes for their inspiration especially in their latest film “Rewind”.

text: Si Senator Robin Padilla, isa man ka action star, amo ang author sang Senate Resolution 909.
english: Senator Robin Padilla, also an action star, is the author of Senate Resolution 909.

text: “Sila po ang simbolo ng makabagong pamilyang Pilipino – may pag-ibig sa Diyos, sa bayan, sa kalikasan at sa kapwa-tao kung kaya nararapat lamang po ang ating pagkilala sa kanila sa hapong ito,” kabahin sang speech ni Padilla.
english: “They are the symbol of the modern Filipino family – with love for God, the people, nature and fellow human beings so it is only right that we recognize them this afternoon,” Padilla said in part of his speech.

text: Sa atubang sang celebrity couple nga yara gid mismo sa Senado agud batunon ang kopya sang resolution, ginpasidunggan man si Director Mae Cruz-Alviar.
english: In front of the celebrity couple who were in the Senate to receive a copy of the resolution, Director Mae Cruz-Alviar was also honored.

text: Matandaan nga opisyal na nga naagaw sang Rewind ang korona sang “Hello, Love, Goodbye” nanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Alden Richards bilang highest grossing Filipino film of all time.
english: It can be recalled that Rewind has officially captured the crown of “Hello, Love, Goodbye” by Kathryn Bernardo and Alden Richards as the highest grossing Filipino film of all time.

text: Natabo ini sang Enero 26 sang nagdangat na sa P889 million ang kabug-usan nga worldwide gross sang amo nga pelikula nga entry sa 49th Metro Manila Film Festival.
english: This happened on January 26 when the total worldwide gross of the film reached P889 million entry in the 49th Metro Manila Film Festival.

text: Mas mataas ini sa P880-million nga income sang “Hello, Love, Goodbye” sang 2019.
english: This is higher than the P880-million income of “Hello, Love, Goodbye” in 2019.

text: Napaguwa ang ‘Rewind’ sa masobra 270 ka mga sinehan sa Pilipinas, United Arab Emirates, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Guam, kag Saipan.#
english: 'Rewind' was released in more than 270 theaters in the Philippines, United Arab Emirates, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Guam, and Saipan.#

text: ILOILO CITY-  Nagpatigayon sang pagsinapol ang political groups sa kamara agud suportahan ang Resolution of Both Houses No.
english: ILOILO CITY – Political groups held a meeting in the House of Representatives to support Resolution of Both Houses No.

text: 2 (RBH 2) nga nagahatag sa kongreso sang gahom agud amyendaran ang restrictive economic provisions nga nasaad sa 1987 Constitution.
english: 2 (RBH 2) which gives congress the power to amend the restrictive economic provisions set out in the 1987 Constitution.

text: Ang nasambit nga pagsinapol ang gintambungan sang mga partido kag blocs sa kamara nga ginalakipan sang PDP-Laban, Nacionalist People’s Coalition, Nacionalista Party, National Unity Party, Lakas-NUCD, Hugpong ng Pagbabago, Liberal Party, kag Party-list Coalition Foundation Inc.
english: The meeting was attended by parties and blocs in the chamber including PDP-Laban, Nacionalist People's Coalition, Nacionalista Party, National Unity Party, Lakas-NUCD, Hugpong ng Pagbabago, Liberal Party, and Party-list Coalition Foundation Inc.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay AAMBIS-OWA Partylist Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, AAMBIS-OWA Partylist Rep.

text: Sharon Garin, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang mapag-on nga consensus sa mga lideres sa kamara nga suportahan ang inisyatibo ni House Speaker Lord Allan Velasconga nagaduso sang liberalisasyon sang probisyon sa ekonomiya nga yara sa konstitusyon.
english: Sharon Garin, he said there is a strong consensus among the leaders in the chamber to support the initiative of House Speaker Lord Allan Velasconga that proposes the liberalization of the economic provisions contained in the constitution.

text: Suno kay Garin, pila sa ginatuyo nga amyendaran amo ang Article 12 (National Patrimony and Economy), Article 14 (Education, Science, Technology, Arts, Culture and Sports) kag Article 16 (General Provisions).
english: According to Garin, some of the proposed amendments are Article 12 (National Patrimony and Economy), Article 14 (Education, Science, Technology, Arts, Culture and Sports) and Article 16 (General Provisions).

text: Ginpahayag sang mamalidha nga ang tikang nagatuyo nga isal-ot ang mga tinaga nga “unless otherwise provided by law” sa pila ka seksyon sang konstitusyon nga nagadumili sang foreign ownership sa duta, mga dunang manggad, public utilities, educational institutions, media kag advertising.
english: The lawmaker said the move aims to insert the words “unless otherwise provided by law” into several sections of the constitution that prohibit foreign ownership of land, natural resources, public utilities, educational institutions, media and advertising.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, ang ginaduso nga mga amendments ang magasentro lang sa mga probisyon nga naangot sa ekonomiya bilang sabat sa epekto sang COVID-19 pandemic sa ekonomiya sang pungsod kag indi pagpahilabtan ang probisyon nga naangot sa pulitika.
english: He said the proposed amendments will focus only on economic-related provisions in response to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the country's economy and will not interfere with political-related provisions.

text: Ini ang botohan naman sang senado kag kamara sa diin 75 porsyento sang kabilugan nga boto ang kinahanglan, mahimo na nga makaproponer sang amendments sa economic provisions.
english: It will be voted on by the Senate and House of Representatives where 75 percent of the total vote is needed to propose amendments to the economic provisions.

text: Sunod nga ipaagi ini sa isa ka plebisito kag kun paboran sang publiko, magadepende na sa masunod nga liderato sang kongreso nga ipresentar ini nga mga layi sa pagbukas sang public utility ownership sa mga dumuluong.
english: Next, it will be put through a plebiscite and if the public favors it, it will be up to the next congressional leadership to present these laws to open up public utility ownership to foreigners.

text: Naglala ang inflation sang Hulyo sa tunga sang mas madasig nga pagtaas sang presyo sang mga utility, pagkaon, kag mga gasto sa transportasyon sa nasambit nga panahon.
english: Inflation worsened in July amid faster price increases for utilities, food, and transport costs over the period.

text: Suno kay National Statistician kag Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief Claire Dennis Mapa, ang inflation — nga nagatakos sa rate sang pagtaas sang presyo sang mga balaklon kag serbisyo — ang nagdasig sang 4.4% sang nagligad nga bulan, mas madasig kun ipaanggid sa 3.7% rate sang Hunyo.
english: According to National Statistician and Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) chief Claire Dennis Mapa, inflation — which measures the rate of increase in prices of goods and services — accelerated to 4.4% last month, faster compared to June’s 3.7% rate.

text: Gindala sini ang year-to-date nga inflation print nga nagdangat sa 3.7%, nga yara sa gihapon sa ceiling sang gobyerno nga 2% tubtob 4%.
english: This brought the year-to-date inflation print to 3.7%, which is still within the government’s ceiling of 2% to 4%.

text: Sulod man ini sa forecast range sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) nga 4% tubtob 4.8%.
english: This is also within the forecast range of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) of 4% to 4.8%.

text:
“Ang pangunahing dahilan ng mas mataas na antas ng inflation nitong Hulyo 2024 kaysa noong Hunyo 2024 ay mas mabilis na tumaas ang presyo ng Housing, Water, Electricity, Gas and Other Fuels sa antas na 2.3%.”

Ginpahayag sang opisyal nga ang utilities index amo ang may dako nga kontribusyon sa 70.4% sa kabug-usan nga inflation rate para sa Hulyo.
english:
“The main reason for the higher inflation rate in July 2024 than in June 2024 is the faster increase in the price of Housing, Water, Electricity, Gas and Other Fuels at a rate of 2.3%.”

The official said the utilities index contributed 70.4% to the overall inflation rate for July.

text: THAILAND–  Isa sa mga ginakabig naton nga modern heroes amo ang aton mga manunudlo bangud sa mga sakripisyo nila agud matudluan lang kita sang maayo sa eskwelahan.

text: SOUTHWEST,CHINA–  Ang tagsa ka pungsod may kina iya nga nagkalain-lain nga kapiestahan nga ginatambungan kag gina kalanghawaan sang indi lang mga residente lakip man ang mga turista.
english: SOUTHWEST, CHINA – Each country has its own unique festivals that are attended and enjoyed by not only residents but also tourists.

text: Sa Chengdu, Sichuan Province,may yara isa ka pinasahi nga kapiestahan nga ginadugukan sang madamo nga tawo bangud sa makawiwili nga tema sini.
english: In Chengdu, Sichuan Province,there is a special festival that many people flock to because of its interesting theme.

text: Ini ang Insect Culture Festival sang The Insect Society sang Sichuan Agricultural University.
english: This is the Insect Culture Festival of The Insect Society of Sichuan Agricultural University.

text: Pinasahi ini bangud sa nasambit nga kapiestahan gina serbihan nila sang buggy delicacies sang nga ginluto sang mga estudyante sang kolehiyo.
english: This is unique because during the festival they serve buggy delicacies cooked by college students.

text: Huo insakto ang nabatian mo, pagkaon nga insekto kaangay sang tanga,buyog,tibakla kag iban pa.
english: Yes you heard it right, food insects like tanga, bee, tibakla and others.

text: Ang mga insekto gina serbi sa mga bisita kag nakabutang ini sa malaba nga lamesa kun sa diin nakabutang ang nagkalain-lain nga putahe sang insekto.
english: The insects are served to the guests and are placed on a long table where various insect dishes are placed.

text: Suno sa Insect Society apisar nga magagmay ang mga insekto dako kag madamo naman ang mga nutrisyon nga dala sini kaangay sang proteins kag fat.
english: According to the Insect Society, although insects are small, they are large and contain many nutrients such as proteins and fats.

text: Nagalaom ang Insect Society nga mapakita nila sa mga nagtambong sang kapiestahan nga indi matuod nga makahaladlok ang mga insekto kundi ini ang masustansya man kag pwede man nga kan-on nga mangin source sang sustansya nga kinahanglan sang aton lawas.
english: The Insect Society hopes to show the festival attendees that insects are not only scary but also nutritious and can be eaten as a source of nutrients that our bodies need.

text: Nagpasalig ang administrasyon ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga indi lamang “gamay” nga mga personalidad ang dakpon, kundi lakip man ang “dalagko nga isda” nga ginapasuni nga sa likod sang ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects sa pungsod.

text: Liwat nga ginsulit ni Presidential Communications Secretary Dave Gomez ang nauna nga pahayag sang Presidente nga ang mga personalidad nga nalakip sa korapsiyon sa flood control projects ang gina-target nga mapriso antes mag-abot ang Paskwa.
english: Presidential Communications Secretary Dave Gomez reiterated the President's earlier statement that personalities involved in corruption in flood control projects are targeted to be imprisoned before Christmas.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang opisyal kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga anti-corruption protests sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar sa pungsod.

text: Suno kay Gomez, nagapadayon ang madalom kag masangkad nga imbestigasyon kag kinahanglan nga masiguro nga mabakod ang ebidensya sa case build-up.
english: Gomez said an in-depth and thorough investigation is ongoing and it is necessary to ensure that the evidence in the case build-up is strong.

text: Sa separado nga interview, ginpahayag man ni Gomez nga determinado ang gobyerno nga magtukod sang “airtight cases” para masiguro nga mangin mabakod ang pag-usisa kag pagpasaka sang kaso batok sa mga ginapasuni nga na-involve sa iskandalo.
english: In a separate interview, Gomez also said the government is determined to establish “airtight cases” to ensure that the investigation and prosecution of those allegedly involved in the scandal will be strong.

text: Ginpasuksok na ni Cardinal Antonio Luis Tagle nga pro-prefect sang Dicastery for Evangelization ang Fisherman’s Ring kay Pope Leo XIV.

text: Kadungan ini sang Mass of Inauguration sa Vatican subong nga hapon, Mayo 18.

text: Peter nga amo ang ginakabig nga first pope kag isa ka manugpangisda sa Galilee nga ginpili ni Hesukristo agud magpamuno sa Simbahan.
english: Peter who is considered the first pope and a fisherman in Galilee chosen by Jesus Christ to lead the Church.

text: Peter.

text:
Yari ang ginhambal ni Cardinal Tagle antes ginpasuksok ang ring:

“Most Holy Father, may Christ, the Son of the living God, the shepherd and guardian of our souls, who built his Church upon rock, grant you the ring, the seal of Peter the Fisherman, who put his hope in him on the sea of Galilee, and to whom the Lord Jesus entrusted the keys of the Kingdom of heaven.”

“Today you succeed the Blessed Apostle Peter as the Bishop of this Church which presides over the unity of charity, as the Blessed Apostle Paul has taught.
english:
Here’s what Cardinal Tagle had to say before the ring was put on:

“Most Holy Father, may Christ, the Son of the living God, the shepherd and guardian of our souls, who built his Church upon rock, granted you the ring, the seal of Peter the Fisherman, who put his hope in him on the sea of Galilee, and to whom the Lord Jesus entrusted the keys of the Kingdom of heaven.”

“Today you succeed the Blessed Apostle Peter as the Bishop of this Church which presides over the unity of charity, as the Blessed Apostle Paul has taught.

text:
May the Spirit of charity, poured into our hearts, grant you the gentleness and strength to preserve, through your ministry, all those who believe in Christ in unity and fellowship.”

Sang nagligad nga Byernes sang kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas) sang na-eleher si Pope Leo XIV sa Conclave kasunod sang kamatayon ni Pope Francis.
english:
May the Spirit of charity, poured into our hearts, grant you the gentleness and strength to preserve, through your ministry, all those who believe in Christ in unity and fellowship.”

Last Friday morning (Philippine time) when Pope Leo XIV was elected to the Conclave following the death of Pope Francis.

text: Makabulig ang pagpatuman sang withholding tax sa online sellers agud malab-ot sang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) ang target sini para sa 2025.

text: We expect that there will be a lot of transactions online, and we’ve seen that while the Bureau of Internal Revenue’s tax efficiency is improving,” suno kay Tax chief Romeo Lumagui Jr.
