text: “The collections are not as high, because many purchases have shifted from traditional to online.
english: “The collections are not as high, because many purchases have shifted from traditional to online.

text: So, there are many transactions online that the BIR isn’t capturing, that’s why we are focusing on taxing those on online platforms,” dugang sini.
english: So, there are many transactions online that the BIR isn’t capturing, that’s why we are focusing on taxing those on online platforms,” it added.

text: Base sa Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing for fiscal year 2025, may mandu sa bureau nga magkolekta sang P3.23 trillion sa masunod nga tuig nga mas mataas sa P3.05 trillion subong nga tuig.
english: Based on the Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing for fiscal year 2025, the bureau is mandated to collect P3.23 trillion next year, higher than P3.05 trillion this year.

text: Kumpyansa naman si Lumagui nga malab-ot nila ang target bangud mas madamo nga projects kag programs ang ila nahimo agud mapasaka ang revenues.
english: Lumagui is confident that they will achieve the target because they have done more projects and programs to increase revenues.

text: Matandaan nga gin-implementar sang bureau ang 1.0-percent withholding tax sa online platform providers umpisa sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: The bureau implemented a 1.0-percent withholding tax on online platform providers starting last month.

text: NEW YORK– Kun ikaw ang na stress ano masami mo gina himo agud mabuhinan ini?
english: NEW YORK – When you are stressed, what do you usually do to reduce it?

text: Naga tulog?
english: Sleeping?

text: Nagakaon?
english: Eating?

text: ukon nagalagaw?
english: or wandering?

text: Sa New York, may yara sang pinasahi nga pamagi ang mga Amerikano agud mabuhinan ang ila nga stress.
english: In New York, Americans have a special way to reduce their stress.

text: Ang Mountain House Farm sa New York may gina tanyag nga pinasahi nga stress reliever activitiy nga gina tawag Cow Cuddling.
english: Mountain House Farm in New York offers a special stress reliever activitiy called Cow Cuddling.

text: Huo insakto, agud mabuhinan ang imo stress kinahanglan mo lang kup-an ang mga baka.
english: Yes that’s right, to reduce your stress you just need to hug the cows.

text: Ang Cow Cuddling isa ka sikat nga stress relieving activity sa Europa.
english: Cow Cuddling is a popular stress relieving activity in Europe.

text: Gin dala ni Suzzane Vullers kaupod ang iya bana sa New York ang makalilingaw nga Cow Cuddling agud ipa experyensya sa mga Amerikano ang nasambit nga aktibidad .
english: Suzzane Vullers and her husband brought the fun Cow Cuddling to New York to make Americans experience the activity.

text: Suno sa mga pagpanalawsaw sa Europa, ang Cow cuddling epektibo nga stress reliever bangud ang baka ang may slower heart rate kag may yara sila sang malinong nga pang-gawi.
english: According to European research, Cow cuddling is an effective stress reliever because the cow has a slower heart rate and they have a calm demeanor.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa mahimo nga mabuhinan ang imo stress kun imo makup-an ang baka.
english: This is why you can reduce your stress if you hug the cow.

text: Sa subong may yara sang duha ka baka para sa cow cuddling activity sa Mountain House Farm nga gin kilala nga sanday Bonnie and Bella.
english: There are currently two cows for the cow cuddling activity at Mountain House Farm identified as Bonnie and Bella.

text: Kun ikaw ang may yara sang $75 ukon P3,000 mabuhinan na ang imo stress paagi sa pag kupo sa baka.
english: If you have $75 or P3,000, you can reduce your stress by hugging a cow.

text: Nagapati ang Dallas Mavericks guard nga si Kyrie Irving nga komunikasyon kag malaba nga pasensya ang kinahanglan agud makabawi kag malutos ang iya anay team nga Boston Celtics sa Game 2 sang 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals.
english: Dallas Mavericks guard Kyrie Irving believes communication and long patience will be needed to recover and beat his former team the Boston Celtics in Game 2 of the 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals.

text: Matandaan nga ginlampaso sang Boston ang Dallas, 107-89, sa Game 1 kag tuman man ka tunog ang paghikay sang fans kay Irving nga nagtapos lamang nga may 12 puntos, tatlo ka rebounds, duha ka assists, kag duha ka steals.
english: Boston beat Dallas, 107-89, in Game 1 and the fans cheered loudly for Irving, who finished with 12 points, three rebounds, two assists, and two steals.

text: Ang kalutusan sang Dallas sa Game 1 amo man ang ika-11 nga tion nga nalutos si Irving sa kamot sang Celtics sa ila 11 man ka ulihi nga sambuwa halin sang 2021 season.
english: Dallas' loss in Game 1 was also the 11th time Irving has lost at the hands of the Celtics in their last 11 meetings since the 2021 season.

text: Apang suno sa eight-time All-Star, indi ang fans sa TD Garden, Boston ang rason sang ila kalutusan kundi ang maayo gid man nga performance sang Celtics.
english: But the eight-time All-Star said it was not the fans at TD Garden, Boston who were responsible for their defeat but the Celtics' excellent performance.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi malimtan sang Celtics fans si Irving bangud anak ini sang Boston University basketball hall-of-famer nga si Drederick Irving kag nag-upod man mismo sa Celtics sang 2017.
english: Irving is the son of Boston University basketball hall-of-famer Drederick Irving and joined the Celtics in 2017.

text: Sang Oktubre 2018, nagpabutyag ini sang interes nga magpirma liwat sa Celtics kun magbukas na ang free agency window apang sang nag-abot na ang amo nga tion, wala sini gintuman ang promisa kag mas ginpili ang Brooklyn Nets sang Hunyo 2019.
english: In October 2018, he expressed interest in re-signing with the Celtics when the free agency window opened but when that time came, he broke that promise and preferred the Brooklyn Nets in June 2019.

text: Halos tunga ka dekada na ang nagligad halin sang amo nga desisyon apang matunog gihapon ang pag-boo sang Boston fans sa kada tion nga si Irving ang naga-uyat sang bola.
english: Nearly half a decade has passed since that decision but Boston fans still boo loudly every time Irving has the ball.

text: Baliskad naman ini sa mainit nga pag-abi-abi sang fans sa anay Mavericks star nga si Kristaps Porzingis nga subong big man na sang Boston kag nangin daku nga lyabe sa kadalag-an sa Game 1.
english: This is in contrast to the warm welcome fans gave to former Mavericks star Kristaps Porzingis, who is now Boston's big man and was a big key to the Game 1 victory.

text: Naka-schedule ang ikaduha nga sambuwa sang Dallas batok sa Boston 8:00 buwas sa aga (oras sa Pilipinas) sa amo gihapon nga venue sa TD Garden, Boston, Massachusetts.
english: Dallas' second game against Boston is scheduled for 8:00 am tomorrow morning (Philippine time) at the same venue at TD Garden, Boston, Massachusetts.

text: Naghatag ang American singer-songwriter nga si Taylor Swift sang $100,000 ukon ginabanta P5.60-million nga donasyon sa pamilya sang babayi nga napatay kadungan sang pagpangluthang nga natabo sa parada sang football team nga Kansas City Chiefs sa Missouri, Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift has donated $100,000 or an estimated P5.60-million to the family of the woman who was killed during the shooting that occurred during the parade of the football team Kansas City Chiefs in Missouri, United States of America.

text: Ang radio disc jockey nga si Liza Lopez-Galvan amo ang isahanon nga napatay sa amo nga insidente kun sa diin may 22 ka iban pa nga napilasan — katunga ang mga kabataan.
english: Radio disc jockey Liza Lopez-Galvan was the only one killed in the incident where 22 others were injured — half of them children.

text: Nagpadala man si Swift sang mensahe sang simpatiya sa pamilya sang biktima partikular sa bana sini kag duha ka kabataan.
english: Swift also sent a message of sympathy to the victim's family, particularly her husband and two children.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang boyfriend ni Swift nga si Travis Kelce ang kabahin sang Kansas City Chiefs nga nagkampyon sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga Super Bowl.
english: Swift's boyfriend, Travis Kelce, was part of the Kansas City Chiefs who won the recently concluded Super Bowl.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang pulis nga personal nga away ang natabo kag nag-resulta sa pagpangluthang.
english: Police previously said a personal fight broke out and led to the shooting.

text: Wala sang ebidensya nga nakit-an nga ini isa ka akto sang terorismo.
english: No evidence was found that this was an act of terrorism.

text:
Una man nga gin-report nga tatlo ka tawo ang gin-detain — duha ang menor de edad — kasunod sang amo nga hitabo.#

(Rebilas-USA TODAY Sports)
english:
It was also initially reported that three people were detained — two minors — following the incident.#

(Rebilas-USA TODAY Sports)

text: LOUISSIANA–  Isa ka bala ka beach lover?
english: LOUISSIANA– Are you a beach lover?

text: Ukon luyag mo magswimming sa mabugnaw kag matinlo nga tubig dagat?
english: Or do you want to swim in the cool, clear sea water?

text: Indi mo na kinahanglan magkadto sa beach agud ma experience lang ang summer feels bangud sa Louissiana sa Estados Unidos, may yara sang isa ka Construction company nga sarang makadala sang beach sa imo ugsaran.
english: You don't have to go to the beach just to experience the summer feels because in Louisiana in the United States, there is a Construction company that can bring the beach to your backyard.

text: Ang Zydeco Construction, isa ka construction company nga nagahimo sang swimming pools sa diin masarangan nila nga himuon nga kaangay sang isa ka matahom nga beach ang swimming pool sa imu ugsaran.
english: Zydeco Construction, a construction company that makes swimming pools where they can make the swimming pool in your yard look like a beautiful beach.

text: Diri kag imo nga maeksperyensyahan nga daw kaangay lang nga yara ka sa beach pag gwa mo sa imo balay.
english: Here you will experience that it is like being on the beach when you leave your house.

text: Matuod nga baras ang ginagamit nila kag pino pa ini kaangay sang makit-an sa Boracay bangud luyag nila nga mas mabatyagan sang ila mga costumers nga matuod gid nga yara sila sa higad sang baybay.
english: They use real reeds and they are as fine as those found in Boracay because they want their costumers to feel that they are really on the beach.

text: Kun may yara ka sang $20,000 ukon masobra isa ka milyon ka pesos, mahimo kana mag angkon sang kaugalingon nga beach sa sulod sang imo ugsaran.
english: If you have $20,000 or more than a million pesos, you can have your own beach in your backyard.

text: Naplastar na ang Olympic rings sa popular nga Eiffel Tower sa Paris, France eksakto 50 ka adlaw antes ang pagsugod sang Summer Olympics.
english: The Olympic rings have been placed on the popular Eiffel Tower in Paris, France exactly 50 days before the start of the Summer Olympics.

text: 30 ka workers ang nagbuligay agud nga mabutang ang 29-by-13-meter rings nga human sa recycled steel.
english: 30 workers worked together to install the 29-by-13-meter rings made of recycled steel.

text: Gin-install ini sa idalom nga bahin sang nasambit nga iconic monument.
english: It was installed on the lower part of the said iconic monument.

text: Ang Eiffel Tower ukon “Iron Lady” amo ang mangin center stage sa Olympics kag ang beach volleyball competitions naman ang patigayunon sa tiilan gid sini nga landmark.
english: The Eiffel Tower or “Iron Lady” will be the center stage of the Olympics and the beach volleyball competitions will be held at the foot of this landmark.

text: Ang linibo naman ka fans ang magaplastar sa temporary Eiffel Tower Stadium sa Champ de Mars kun sa diin mahimo man maka-set up sang picnics ang Parisians kag mga turista.
english: Thousands of fans will be stationed at the temporary Eiffel Tower Stadium in Champ de Mars where Parisians and tourists can also set up picnics.

text: Mangin ang mga medalya nga itakod sa winners sa Paris 2024 ang may pieces man sang steel nga kuha mismo sa amo nga tower.
english: Even the medals that will be attached to the winners of Paris 2024 will have pieces of steel taken from the tower itself.

text: Maga-arangka na ang Olympiada sa palaabuton nga Hulyo 26 tubtub sa Agusto 11.
english: The Olympiad will be held from July 26 to August 11.

text: Narekord ang pila ka landslides sa national roads sa Iloilo kag Antique kadungan sang paglaslas sang bagyo Tino.
english: Several landslides were recorded on national roads in Iloilo and Antique during the onslaught of Typhoon Tino.

text: May natabo nga landslides kag rockfall sa national road sa Barangay Tagimtim kag Pacencia sa banwa sang Tobias Fornier, Antique.
english: Landslides and rockfall occurred on the national road in Barangay Tagimtim and Pacencia in the town of Tobias Fornier, Antique.

text: May pagtiphag sang duta man sa national road sang Barangay Iba, Anini-y kag sa barangay road sa Laua-an sa nasambit nga probinsya.
english: There were also landslides on the national road of Barangay Iba, Anini-y and the barangay road in Laua-an in the said province.

text: Nagtiphag man ang dalan sa Lopez Vito, San Joaquin, Iloilo kag indi ini maagyan sang mga depampasahero nga bus nga may ruta nga Iloilo to Antique and vice versa.
english: The road in Lopez Vito, San Joaquin, Iloilo also collapsed and cannot be used by passenger buses on the Iloilo to Antique route and vice versa.

text: Bangud sa nasambit nga landslides, apektado ang ruta sang mga 𝒍𝒐𝒘𝒆𝒓𝒆𝒅 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒐𝒓 𝒗𝒆𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒍𝒆𝒔 kag 𝒉𝒆𝒂𝒗𝒚 𝒗𝒆𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒍𝒆𝒔 kag limitado lang sa 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡 𝐯𝐞𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬 kag 𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐲𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬 ang makalabay sa 𝐈𝐥𝐨𝐢𝐥𝐨-𝐇𝐚𝐦𝐭𝐢𝐜 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝.
english: Due to the said landslides, the routes of the 𝒍𝒐𝒘𝒆𝒓𝒆𝒅 𝒗𝒐𝒕𝒐𝒓 𝒗𝒆𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒍𝒍𝒍𝒔 𝒉𝒆𝒂𝒗𝒚 𝒗𝒆𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒍𝒆𝒔 and is limited to 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡 𝐯𝐞𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐬𝐬𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐲𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬 can pass 𝐈𝐥𝐨𝐢𝐥𝐨-𝐇𝐚𝐦𝐭𝐢𝐜 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝.

text: Ang 𝐈𝐥𝐨𝐢𝐥𝐨–𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐢-𝐲 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝 naman ang indi maagyan sang ano man ngsa sahi sang salakyan.
english: The 𝐈𝐥𝐨𝐢𝐥𝐨–𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐢-𝐲 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐚 vehicle.

text: Matunog subong nga gina-istoryahan kun may yara sang bag-o nga nobya si Xian Lim apisar pa nga bag-o pa lamang nakumpirma ang ila breakup ni Kim Chiu.
english: Xian Lim is now rumored to have a new girlfriend despite the fact that he and Kim Chiu have just confirmed their breakup.

text: Nadabukan ini nga istorya sang nakit-an si Xian kaupod ang film producer nga si Iris Lee sa motorcycle riding school kaupod ang ila mga abyan lakip na sanday JK Labajo kag beauty queen nga si Dia Mate.
english: The story came to light when Xian was spotted with film producer Iris Lee at a motorcycle riding school with their friends including JK Labajo and beauty queen Dia Mate.

text: Sa amo nga picture, makit-an nga gina-agbayan ni Xian si Iris samtang gina-uyatan naman sang babayi ang kamot sang aktor.
english: In the picture, Xian can be seen hugging Iris while the woman is holding the actor's hand.

text: Sang Disyembre lamang sang ginkumpirma nanday Xian kag Kim ang ila nga pagbulaganay matapos ang masobra isa ka dekada nga relasyon.
english: It was only in December that Xian and Kim confirmed their separation after more than a decade of relationship.

text: Sang amo man nga bulan, may naga-guwa na nga huring-huring kaangot sa posible kaangtanan ni Xian kay Iris apang wala sang kumpirmasyon.
english: That same month, there were rumors about Xian's possible relationship with Iris but no confirmation.

text: Nahibaluan nga magkaupod sanday Xian kag Iris sa pila na ka mga proyekto kun sa diin ang pinakaulihi amo ang pelikula nga Hello, Universe nga gin-direk ni Xian kag bida naman si Janno Gibbs.
english: Xian and Iris have worked together on several projects, the latest of which is the film Hello, Universe directed by Xian and starring Janno Gibbs.

text: Sang May 2023, nag-post man sa Instagram si Iris sang picture nila ni Xian sa shooting sang pelikulakun sa diin gin-panginbulahan sini si Xian bilang director.
english: In May 2023, Iris also posted a picture of her and Xian at the shooting of the film on Instagram where she congratulated Xian as a director.

text: Sa mga paindis-indis sa pagkanta masami nga nagadaog ang singer nga may yara sang mas mataas nga tingog.
english: In singing competitions the singer with the higher voice usually wins.

text: Apang sa pungsod Wales sa United Kingdom may yara sang pinasahi nga singer nga ginpasidunggan sa pinasahi nga paagi.
english: But in the country of Wales in the United Kingdom there was a special singer who was honored in a special way.

text: Ang singer nga si Helen Leahey ang ginbansagan nga “Bass Queen” sang Guinness World Record matapos malab-ot sini ang pinakanubo nga vocal note nga ginkanta sang isa ka babayi nga singer.
english: Singer Helen Leahey was named the “Bass Queen” by the Guinness World Record after she reached the lowest vocal note sung by a female singer.

text: Ang pagkanta ni Helen gintakos gamit ang nagkalain-lain nga equipment sa Music School Wagnet sa Koblenz pungsod Germany  sa diin nalab-ot nya ang nota humalin sa D5 tubtob D2 sa 72.5 hertz kag gin agaw  niya ang nagligad nga record nga E2 sa 82.4 hertz.
english: Helen's singing was measured using various equipment at the Music School Wagnet in Koblenz, Germany where she reached notes from D5 to D2 at 72.5 hertz and broke the previous record of E2 at 82.4 hertz.

text: Suno kay Leahey, handom niya humalin sang bata pa ini nga mangin kabahin sang Guiness World Record kag bisan diin siya magkanta masami nga naga bilib ang mga tawo bangud sa kanubuon sang iya nga tingog.
english: According to Leahey, he has dreamed of becoming part of the Guinness World Record since he was a child and wherever he sings, people are often impressed by his low voice.

text: Ginsuspend sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) sang 90 ka adlaw ang driver’s license sang isa ka Transportation Network Vehicle Service (TNVS) driver nga magluwas nga ginpilosopo ang mga pasahero, ginhanaan pa niya nga bun-on ang mga ini sa Manila.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has suspended for 90 days the driver's license of a Transportation Network Vehicle Service (TNVS) driver who besides philosophizing passengers, also threatened to beat them in Manila.

text: Base sa panaysayon sang babaye nga pasahero, nag-book sila sang iya nga nobyo sa isa ka ride-hailing app kag sang palapit na sila sa drop-off location sang nagsala sang liko ang driver, ginhambal sila sini nga papanaugon nalang sila sa isa ka lokasyon nga malayo sa ila nga destinasyon.
english: According to the female passenger, she and her boyfriend booked a ride-hailing app and when they were approaching the drop-off location when the driver made a wrong turn, he told them to drop them off at a location far from their destination.

text: Didto na nagreklamo ang pasahero kag ginbuyayaw sila sang driver.
english: The passengers complained and the driver insulted them.

text: Nagbais ang driver kag ang magnobyo kag napilitan nga manaug ang mga ini sa Binondo.
english: The driver and the couple had an argument and were forced to get off at Binondo.

text: Nanaog man ang driver kag naghatag sang bayad ang magnobyo.
english: The driver got off and the couple paid.

text: Apang nagbalik ang driver sa kotse, nagkuha sang kutsilyo, kag ginhanaan ang mga biktima.
english: But the driver returned to the car, pulled out a knife, and stabbed the victims.

text: Gilayon naman nga gin-report sang magnobyo ang insidente sa otoridad kag nakalab-ot man ini sa LTO.
english: The couple immediately reported the incident to the authorities and it also reached the LTO.

text: Nag-isyu man sang show cause order ang LTFRB batok sa inDrive nga amo ang kompaniya kun sa diin nagatrabaho ang driver.
english: The LTFRB also issued a show cause order against inDrive, the company where the driver works.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag, ginsiling ni LTFRB chairperson Atty. Teofilo Guadiz III nga dapat ipaathag sang inDrive kun ngaa indi dapat pagkanselahon ukon suspendihon ang ila nga accreditation bangud sa ginhimo sang ila driver.
english: In a statement, LTFRB chairperson Atty. Teofilo Guadiz III that inDrive should explain why their accreditation should not be canceled or suspended because of the actions of their driver.

text:
𝗕𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗔𝗦 — Nakarekord ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) sang dugang nga aktibidad sa Taal Volcano sa Batangas matapos nga naobserbahan ang tatlo ka phreatic ukon steam-driven eruptions sang Byernes sang gab-i.

Ini ang natabo isa ka adlaw pagkatapos nga ginreport sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology ang isa ka phreatic eruption sa Taal.
english:
𝗕𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗔𝗦 — The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) recorded increased activity at Taal Volcano in Batangas after three phreatic or steam-driven eruptions were observed on Friday night.

This comes a day after the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology reported a phreatic eruption in Taal.

text:
Suno sa ahensya ang tatlo ka bag-o nga mga hitabo sa phreatic naglawig sang isa ka minuto kada isa, nga narekord sang 7:15 p.m., 7:19 p.m. kag 7:23 p.m.

Narekord man ang tatlo ka linog halin sa bulkan.
english:
The agency said the three new phreatic events lasted a minute each, recorded at 7:15 p.m., 7:19 p.m. and 7:23 p.m.

Three earthquakes from the volcano were also recorded.

text: Nagpaguwa man ang Taal Volcano sang 3,309 ka tonelada sang sulfur dioxide nga nagtuga sing vog, ukon aso sang bulkan.
english: Taal Volcano also released 3,309 tons of sulfur dioxide, creating vog, or volcanic smoke.

text: Ang iya plume nagtaas sang 2,100 metros, nga naanod pakadto sa bagatnan-sidlangan.
english: Its plume rose 2,100 meters, drifting to the southeast.

text: Nakit-an man sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology bulletin ang long-term deflation sang Taal caldera, kag ang short-term inflation sang pangkabilugan sang naaminhan kag bagatnan-sidlangan sa mga kilid sang Taal Volcano Island.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology bulletin also found long-term deflation of the Taal caldera, and short-term inflation of the general northern and southeastern flanks of Taal Volcano Island.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa alert level 1 ang Bulkan Taal, nga nagapatimaan sang manubo nga lebel sang paglupok.
english: Taal Volcano remains at alert level 1, indicating a low level of eruption.

text: Apang, ang posible nga mga katalagman sa idalom sang Alert level 1 amo ang mga paglupok ukon phreatic, mga linog gikan sa bulkan, gamay nga pagtupa sang abo kag makamamatay nga mga pagtipon ukon pagpaguwa sang gas gikan sa bulkan.
english: However, potential hazards below Alert level 1 are eruptions or phreatic, earthquakes from the volcano, small ash falls and deadly accumulations or release of gas from the volcano.

text: Nagapabilin nga hugot nga ginadumilian ang pagsulod sa Taal Volcano Island, ilabi na sa mayor nga crater kag Daang Kastila fissures.
english: Entry to Taal Volcano Island, especially the main crater and Daang Kastila fissures, remains strictly prohibited.

text: Ang isla ginkilala nga isa ka permanente nga ‘danger zone’,kon sa diin, ang pagtener sa Taal Lake ginadumilian man.
english: The island has been identified as a permanent ‘danger zone’,whereby, staying at Taal Lake is also prohibited.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology sa mga eroplano nga nagalupad malapit sa bulkan ang delikado sa abo sa kahawaan kag airborne ash and ballistic fragments nga halin sa Taal volcano.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology also warned aircraft flying near the volcano of the danger of ash and airborne ash and ballistic fragments from the Taal volcano.

text: Ginakabig nga Man’s bestfriend ang mga ido bangud sila ang isa sa mga pinaka loyal nga sapat.
english: Dogs are considered Man’s bestfriend because they are one of the most loyal animals.

text: Isa ka bala dog lover?
english: Are you a dog lover?

text: Kabalo ka bala nga kun tuman ka kapalangga sang imo ido sarang sini nga itaya ang iya kaugalingon nga kabuhi agud masalbar ka lang?
english: Did you know that if your dog loves you so much he can risk his own life just to save you?

text: Ginpamatud-an ini sang dachshund nga si Miley nga ginpanag-iyahan ni Jaim Bugtay Selim sang Barangay Lanao sa Kidapawan City matapos ini nga napatay sang ginsalbar ni Mily ang isa ka 1 ka tuig nga bata batok sa isa ka cobra.
english: This was proven by the dachshund Miley owned by Jaim Bugtay Selim of Barangay Lanao in Kidapawan City after he died when Mily saved a 1-year-old child from a cobra.

text: Suno kay Jaim, natulupangdan sang ila kaupod sa balay nga nagatinaghol ang ila 2 ka mga dachshund sa gwa sang ila nga balay kun sa diin yara man ang ila 1 ka tuig nga bata.
english: According to Jaim, their housemate noticed their two dachshunds barking outside their house where their 1-year-old child was also present.

text: Sang nag gwa ang kabulig, nakita sini ang isa ka cobra sa kilid sang ido nga si Miley nga nagahigda kag maluya na.
english: When the assistant came out, he saw a cobra next to the dog Miley lying down and weak.

text: Napatay si Miley matapos ang pila ka mga minutos pagkatapos sang insidente.
english: Miley died minutes after the incident.

text: Dugang pa ni Jaim, 5 na ka tuig nila nga kaupod si Miley kag nangin parte na ini sang ila nga pamilya.
english: Jaim added that they have been with Miley for 5 years and she has become part of their family.

text: Nagapasalamat naman ang pamilya ni Jaim kay Miley bangud sa ginhimo sini nga pagsalbar sa ila nga anak.
english: Jaim's family is grateful to Miley for saving their son.

text: Kasunod sang kamatayon sang isa ka Filipino climber sa Mount Everest sa Nepal, ginkumpirma sang expedition organizer nga may isa na naman nga nagtaliwan samtang nagatinguha nga masaka ang world’s highest mountain.
english: Following the death of a Filipino climber on Mount Everest in Nepal, the expedition organizer confirmed that another has died while trying to climb the world's highest mountain.

english: It is known that areas above 8,000 meters are called the “death zone” because of the thin air and low oxygen levels that increase the risk of altitude sickness.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga adlaw, napatay ang 45-anyos nga Filipino climber nga si Philipp “PJ” Santiago II samtang pakadto ini sa summit.
english: It can be recalled that last day, 45-year-old Filipino climber Philipp “PJ” Santiago II died while on his way to the summit.

text: Ginahulat ang dugang nga impormasyon halin sa awtoridad kun ano gid ang nangin rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: More information is awaited from the authorities on the exact cause of his death.

english: Last year, more than 800 climbers reached the summit of Everest, eight of whom were unlucky and killed.

english: A pickup driven by a man wearing a uniform with the logo of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) broke down after hitting concrete barriers on C. Raymundo Avenue in Pasig.

text: Nagluntad ang power interruption sa 25 ka mga kabanwahanan sa probinsya sang Iloilo bangud sa paglaslas sang Bagyo Tino.
english: Power interruption occurred in 25 towns in Iloilo province due to the onslaught of Typhoon Tino.

text: Sa numero nga ini, pito ang may partial interruption sa suplay sang kuryente, samtang 18 naman ang total blackout.
english: Of these, seven had partial interruptions in power supply, while 18 had total blackouts.

text: Sandig sa 5:00 sa kaagahon nga report sang Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) subong nga Myerkules, Nobyembre 5, fully-restored na ang suplay sa 12 pa lamang ka mga banwa.
english: According to the 5:00 am report of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) this Wednesday, November 5, the supply has been fully-restored in only 12 towns.

english: In the same updated report, 120,420 residents were affected by the typhoon from more than 37,000 families in 40 municipalities.

text: Nagdangat naman sa masobra 400 ka mga balay ang na-report nga naguba kun diin 418 ang partially damaged samtang 24 ang totally damaged bangud ginpangpalid sang hangin kag nagkalatumbahan sang kahoy.
english: More than 400 houses were reported destroyed with 418 partially damaged while 24 were totally damaged due to wind blowing and falling trees.

text: Lakip sa mga banwa nga may na-record nga nagkalaguba nga mga balay ang Pavia, Pototan, Leganes, San Enrique, Lemery, Maasin, Batad, New Lucena, Cabatuan, kag Janiuay.

english: It was learned that the typhoon landfall in Iloilo City around 1 pm yesterday where strong winds were also felt in the towns in the province.# (Photo: ILECO III)

text: Temporaryo nga nagbiya sa pwesto ang prosecutor sang International Criminal Court (ICC) nga si Karim Khan.
english: International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecutor Karim Khan has temporarily resigned.

text: Ini bangud nagahilapit na nga matapos ang imbestigasyon nga ginapatigayon sang United Nations Office of Internal Oversight Services batok sa iya bangud sa alegasyon sang sexual misconduct.
english: This is because the investigation conducted by the United Nations Office of Internal Oversight Services against him over allegations of sexual misconduct is nearing completion.

text: Suno sa opisina ni Khan, samtang naka-leave ini, ang iya duha ka deputy prosecutors amo ang magabulos anay sa iya nga mga trabaho.
english: Khan's office said that while he is on leave, his two deputy prosecutors will take over from him.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginpanginwala ni Khan ang alegasyon sang misconduct sang gin-report ini sang nagligad nga Oktubre 2024.
english: It can be recalled that Khan had previously denied the allegation of misconduct when it was reported last October 2024.

text: Sang amo nga tion, madamo nga non-government organizations kag staff members sang ICC ang nagpanawagan sa iya nga magpanaog anay sa pwesto samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon, apang nagtinir pa ini sa posisyon tubtub subong nga bulan.
english: At the time, many non-government organizations and ICC staff members called on him to step down while the investigation continued, but he remained in office until this month.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Khan amo ang nag-request agud nga madagdagan sang arrest warrant ang high-profile nga mga indibidwal lakip na si Russian President Vladimir Putin bangud sa ginasuspetsahan nga pag-deport sang kabataan halin sa Ukraine.
english: Khan was the one who requested that high-profile individuals including Russian President Vladimir Putin be issued arrest warrants for the suspected deportation of children from Ukraine.

text: Siya man ang sa likod sang pag-isyu sang tribunal sang arrest warrant batok kay Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu bangud sa ginaalegar nga war crimes sa Gaza.
english: He is also behind the tribunal's issuance of an arrest warrant against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for alleged war crimes in Gaza.

text: Si Khan amo man ang chief prosecutor sa alegasyon nga crimes against humanity batok kay former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte nga subong didto sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: Khan is also the chief prosecutor in the alleged crimes against humanity against former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte who is currently in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Ini nga latest development ang ginalantaw nga pagpanghangkat nga gina-atubang sang ICC ilabi na sa tunga sang sanctions sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga ginpatuman ni President Donald Trump bangud sa imbestigasyon sini sa Israel kaangot sa Israel-Hamas war.
english: This latest development is seen as a challenge facing the ICC especially amid the sanctions imposed by the United States of America imposed by President Donald Trump over its investigation into Israel in connection with the Israel-Hamas war.

text: VENICE — Ang kotse masami naton makit-an sa mga dalanon lang, apang nakabati ka na bala sang kotse nga sarang maka agi sa tubig?

english: In Venice Italy, you rarely see cars and other vehicles on the road because the city is surrounded by water and gondolas are their main means of transportation.

text: Tattoo is art, ini ang suno sa mga tawo nga nagapa tattoo ukon may pika sa ila lawas.
english: Tattoo is art, this is according to people who get tattoos or have pika on their bodies.

text: Dugang pa, ini ang pamaagi agud ma express nila ang ila kaugalingon.
english: In addition, it is a way for them to express themselves.

text: Sa Kaliningrad, Russia may yara sang isa ka lalaki nga masami nagapa pika sa iya nga lawas.
english: In Kaliningrad, Russia there is a man who often scratches his body.

text: Ini ang ginkilala nga si Adam Curlykale 32-anyos, suno kay Curlykale, nag-umpisa siya nga magpa tattoo sang sya ang 20-anyos matapos sya ang ma diagnosed nga may yara sang colon cancer kag may yara man sya sang albinism kun sa diin ang parte sang pigmentation sang iya nga panit ang amat-amat nga nagadula.
english: Adam Curlykale, 32, said he started getting tattoos when he was 20 years old after he was diagnosed with colon cancer and albinism, where part of the pigmentation of his skin is gradually disappearing.

text: Umpisa sadto, nangin hobby na ni Curlykale ang magpa pika bangud suno sa iya ini ang paagi nya agud makalimtan ang iya nga balatian.
english: Since then, Curlykale has become a hobby of pika because he says it is his way to forget his illness.

text: Sa subong dako na ang nangin pagbag-o nya bangud ginabanta 90% na sang lawas nya ang may yara sang pika.
english: Now she has changed a lot because about 90% of her body has pika.

text: Halin sa iya nga guya, abaga kag may yara man sa iya nga mata gamit ang jet black ink.
english: From his face, shoulders and also on his eyes using jet black ink.

text: Magluwas sa mga pika, may yara man sya sang tuhog sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang iya lawas.
english: Besides the scars, he also had bruises on various parts of his body.

text: Sa pihak sang mga negatibo nga opinyon sang tawo sa iya, suno kay Curlykale indi sya apektado sini kag sya ang magapadayon nga magpabutang sang tattoo tubtob nga mapuno ang iya bilog nga lawas.
english: Despite the negative opinions of people about him, Curlykale said he is not affected by it and he will continue to get tattoos until his whole body is filled.

text: Nakigkita si Pope Leo XIV sa Brothers of the Christian School sang Pilipinas ukon kilala man bilang De La Salle Brothers.
english: Pope Leo XIV met with the Brothers of the Christian School of the Philippines or also known as the De La Salle Brothers.

text: Nanguna sa delegasyon sang Lasallian Brothers sa Vatican ang superior general kag former Department of Education Secretary nga si Bro.
english: The delegation of the Lasallian Brothers to the Vatican was led by superior general and former Department of Education Secretary Bro.

text: Armin Luistro.
english: Armin Luistro.

text: Ini nga meeting ang may kaangtanan sa ika-300 nga anibersaryo sang papal recognition sa De La Salle Brothers kag ika-75 nga anibersaryo sang pagdeklara kay St.
english: This meeting is in connection with the 300th anniversary of the papal recognition of the De La Salle Brothers and the 75th anniversary of the declaration of St.

text: John Baptist De La Salle bilang patron sang mga Kristiyanong nga manunudlo.
english: John Baptist De La Salle as patron saint of Christian teachers.

text: Sa amo nga pagsinapol, nagpangabay ang Santo Papa sa mga bisita nga magpadayon sa ila misyon sa paghatag sang Christian education sa mga kabataan.
english: During the meeting, the Pope asked the guests to continue their mission of providing Christian education to children.

text: “After three centuries, it is wonderful to see how your presence continues to carry the freshness of a rich and far-reaching educational reality, through which, still today and in various parts of the world, you devote yourselves to the formation of young people with enthusiasm, fidelity, and a spirit of sacrifice,” kabahin sang pahayag sang bag-o lang na-eleher nga Santo Papa.
english: “After three centuries, it is wonderful to see how your presence continues to carry the freshness of a rich and far-reaching educational reality, through which, still today and in various parts of the world, you devote yourselves to the formation of young people with enthusiasm, fidelity, and a spirit of sacrifice,” the Santo Pahela sang-pahero said in a new statement.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) ang laragway kun sa diin kaupod ni Pope Leo XIV si Luistro.
english: The Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) also shared a picture of Luistro with Pope Leo XIV.

text:
Sa Pilipinas, ang Lasallian Brothers amo ang nagapadalagan sang De La Salle Philippines educational network lakip na ang pinakadumaan sini nga constituent nga amo ang De La Salle University.#

(Handout photo/Vatican Media)
english:
In the Philippines, the Lasallian Brothers operate the De La Salle Philippines educational network including its oldest constituent, De La Salle University.#

(Handout photo/Vatican Media)

text:
Sa seremonya nga ginpatigayon sa Los Angeles California kahapon, Pebrero 5 sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas), ginpasalamatan sang 34-anyos nga singer-songwriter ang iya longtime collaborator kag mga nagbulig sa iya sa album lakip na ang close friend sini nga si Lana Del Rey nga naka-feature man sa track nga “Snow on the Beach.”

Magluwas sa “Midnights” nga amo ang nadag-an sang Anti-Hero subong nga tuig, ginhingadlan man anay nga Album of the Year ang “Fearless” (2010), “1989” (2016), kag ang “Folklore” (2020).
english:
At a ceremony held in Los Angeles California yesterday, February 5 morning (Philippine time), the 34-year-old singer-songwriter thanked his longtime collaborator and those who helped him on the album including his close friend Lana Del Rey who also featured on the track “Snow on the Beach.”

In addition to “Midnights” which Anti-Hero won this year, “Fearless” (2010), “1989” (2016), and “Folklore” (2020) were also previously named Album of the Year.

text: “For me, the award is the work,” suno kay Swift.
english: “For me, the award is the work,” according to Swift.

text: “All I want to do is keep being able to do this.
english: “All I want to do is keep being able to do this.

text: I love it so much.
english: I love it so much.

text: It makes me so happy.
english: It makes me so happy.

text:
It makes me unbelievably blown away that it makes some people happy who voted for this award too.”

May pa-sorpresa man ini sa fans bangud sa pag-anunsyo sang release sang iya masunod nga album nga “The Tortured Poets Department” nga balantayan sa Abril 19.
english:
It makes me unbelievably blown away that it makes some people happy who voted for this award too.”

He also has a surprise for fans by announcing the release of his next album “The Tortured Poets Department” which will be held on April 19.

text: Espesyal man ang natabo sa awarding bangud ang nag-presentar sang award para kay Taylor amo ang 55-anyos nga “My Heart Will Go On” singer nga si Celine Dion.
english: The awarding was also special because presenting the award for Taylor was 55-year-old “My Heart Will Go On” singer Celine Dion.

text: Naga-suprer si Celine sang stiff person syndrome, isa ka tumalagsahon nga neurological disorder nga nagaapekto lamang sa isa ukon duha sa isa ka milyon ka tawo.
english: Celine suffers from stiff person syndrome, a rare neurological disorder that affects only one or two out of a million people.

text: “When I say that I’m happy to be here, I really mean it from my heart,” malipayon nga pahayag sang Canadian singer sa atubang sang audience.
english: “When I say that I’m happy to be here, I really mean it from my heart,” the Canadian singer said happily in front of the audience.

text:
Yari ang nakabaton sang top awards sa Grammys 2024:

Album of the year – Taylor Swift, MidnightsRecord of the year – Miley Cyrus, FlowersSong of the year – Billie Eilish, What Was I Made For?Best new artist – Victoria Monét

(PHOTO: CBS)
english:
Here are the recipients of the top awards at the Grammys 2024:

Album of the year – Taylor Swift, MidnightsRecord of the year – Miley Cyrus, FlowersSong of the year – Billie Eilish, What Was I Made For?Best new artist – Victoria Monét

text: CHINA–Kun maghambal nga boxing masami nga lalaki lang ang aton madumduman kag ginaekspektar nga maghampang sini bangud ang ini nga hampang ang pisikal kag nagakinahanglan sang mabaskog nga lawas pareho sang lalaki.
english: CHINA–When we talk about boxing, we often think of men and expect to play it because this sport is physical and requires a strong body like a man.

text: Apang sa Southern China, may yara sang isa ka bata nga babayi nga nagaedad 8-anyos ang naga stand out sa patag sang boxing.
english: But in Southern China, there is an 8-year-old girl who stands out in the field of boxing.

text: Ginkilala nga Little Dumpling, ang iya amay nga isa ka welder amo ang nag train sa iya nga wala sang proper boxing equipment kag wala man sang proper training pag-abot sa boxing.
english: Known as Little Dumpling, his father, a welder, trained him without proper boxing equipment and without proper training when it came to boxing.

text: Ang iya amay ang nagakuha lang sang ideya paagi sa pagtan-aw sini sang videos halin sa internet.
english: His father only gets the idea by watching videos from the internet.

text: Suno sa amay ni Little Dumpling nakita nya nga maisog kag makusog ang iya bata apisar ini isa ka babayi rason nga gin umpisahan niya ini nga i-train sa boxing kaupod man ang iya 10- anyos nga bata nga lalaki nga nangin sparring partner ni Little Dumpling.
english: According to Little Dumpling's father, he saw that his daughter was brave and strong despite being a woman so he started training her in boxing along with his 10-year-old son who became Little Dumpling's sparring partner.

text: Ginkabiliban naman sang mga boxing stars sa China ang istorya ni Little Dumpling kag sila ang naghatag sang bulig sa bata kaangay sang free trainings kag libre nga boxing equipment.
english: Boxing stars in China were impressed by Little Dumpling's story and provided assistance to the child such as free trainings and free boxing equipment.

text: Gin imbitahan naman sang Chinese boxer si Little Dumpling sa isa ka invitational competition kun sa diin sya ang nagdaog.
english: The Chinese boxer invited Little Dumpling to an invitational competition where he won.

text: Nagalaum naman ang amay ni Little Dumpling nga mangin isa ka professional boxer ang iya bata sa palaabuton.
english: Little Dumpling's father hopes that his son will become a professional boxer in the future.

text: Naglawig pa sang pila ka minutos antes ma-recover kag ma-rescue ang mga tagbalay matapos matumbahan sang puno sang lubi ang ila puluy-an sa Barangay Concordia, Nueva Valencia, Guimaras kahapon.
english: It took several minutes before the owners were recovered and rescued after a palm tree fell on their house in Barangay Concordia, Nueva Valencia, Guimaras yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Teresita Siason, head sang Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Guimaras, iya ginpahayag nga safe na ang apat ka myembro sang pamilya nga napilpilan sang naguba nga balay matapos nga natumbahan sang puno sang lubi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Teresita Siason, head of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Guimaras, said the four members of the family who were trapped in the collapsed house after being hit by a palm tree are safe.

text: Suno kay Siason, naka-record ang ila opisina sang apat ka mga puluy-an nga partially damaged kag isa ka totally damaged bangud sang paglaslas sang bagyo.
english: According to Siason, their office recorded four houses that were partially damaged and one totally damaged due to the typhoon.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang ginapatigayon nga verification kag assessment sang mga posible nga halit nga ginbilin sang bagyo Tino sa isla sang Guimaras.
english: At present, the verification and assessment of the possible damage left by Typhoon Tino on the island of Guimaras is still ongoing.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Siason nga nagapadayon ang pag-monitor sang PDRRMO sa sitwasyon agud masiguro ang safety sang mga pumuluyo nga apektado sang bagyo.
english: Siason also said that the PDRRMO continues to monitor the situation to ensure the safety of the residents affected by the typhoon.

text: Matandaan nga nag-landfall ang bagyo Tino sa San Lorenzo, Guimaras pasado alas-11 sang aga, nga nagdala sang mabaskog nga hangin kag ulan sa probinsya.
english: Typhoon Tino made landfall in San Lorenzo, Guimaras around 11 am, bringing strong winds and rain to the province.

text: Nagsaka epektibo subong nga adlaw, Agusto 1, ang presyo sang liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products.
english: The price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products rose effective today, August 1.

text: Base sa advisory sang Solane, pataasan sini sang P0.27 per kilogram ang presyo sang cooking gas umpisa 6:00 sa aga.
english: Based on Solane's advisory, it will increase the price of cooking gas by P0.27 per kilogram starting at 6:00 am.

text: Suno naman sa Petron Corporation, ang LPG prices sini ang may isaka man nga P0.30/kg epektibo 12:01 a.m. subong man nga Huwebes.
english: According to Petron Corporation, its LPG prices will also increase by P0.30/kg effective 12:01 a.m. this Thursday.

text: Nakasaad sa advisory nga gina-reflect sini ang international contract price sang LPG para sa sini nga bulan.
english: The advisory states that it reflects the international contract price of LPG for this month.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hulyo, may price hike man sa sini nga produkto.
english: It can be recalled that in July, there was also a price hike for this product.

text: Kuwalipikado na sa Paris Olympics ang Pinoy boxer nga si Carlo Paalam matapos ginlutos sini ang Indian nga kasumpong nga si Sachin Siwach sa semifinal round sang ikaduha nga World Olympic Qualification Tournament sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: Pinoy boxer Carlo Paalam has qualified for the Paris Olympics after defeating Indian opponent Sachin Siwach in the semifinal round of the second World Olympic Qualification Tournament in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Unanimous ang desisyon, 5-0, nga amo ang naghatag kay Paalam sang isa sa tatlo ka Olympic spots sa men’s 57kg class.
english: The decision was unanimous, 5-0, which gave Paalam one of the three Olympic spots in the men’s 57kg class.

text: Indi man nangin mahapos para sa nasambit nga Tokyo silver medalist nga makuha ini nga kadalag-an subong nga tuig.
english: It hasn’t been easy for the aforementioned Tokyo silver medalist to get this win this year.

text: Kun matandaan, ginpadala man siya sang Pilipinas sa una nga qualification tournament sa Italya apang nag-atras siya sa tunga-tunga sang ila hampang ni Shukur Ovezov sang Turkmenistan bangud sa iya ginsuprer nga shoulder injury.
english: The Philippines also sent him to the first qualifying tournament in Italy but he withdrew in the middle of their match with Shukur Ovezov of Turkmenistan due to a shoulder injury.

text: Si Paalam ang ikaapat nga Filipino boxer nga sigurado na nga makahampang sa Paris kun sa diin ang tatlo ka iban pa amo sanday Tokyo silver medalist Nesthy Petecio, Tokyo bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, kag si Aira Villegas.
english: Paalam is the fourth Filipino boxer to be confirmed to fight in Paris with the other three being Tokyo silver medalist Nesthy Petecio, Tokyo bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, and Aira Villegas.

text: Ang isa pa ka Filipino boxer nga si Hergie Bacyadan ang nagakinahanglan sang isa na lang ka daog sa women’s 75kg class agud nga maka-qualify man sa Summer Games.
english: Another Filipino boxer, Hergie Bacyadan, needs just one more win in the women’s 75kg class to qualify for the Summer Games.

text: Ang iban pa nga mga Pilipino nga magatiglawas sa Pilipinas sa Paris amo sanday: pole vaulter EJ Obiena; fencer Samantha Catantan; gymnasts Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Emma Malabuyo, kag Levi Ruivivar; rower Joanie Delgaco; kag weightlifters John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, kag Vanessa Sarno.
english: Other Filipinos who will represent the Philippines in Paris are: pole vaulter EJ Obiena; fencer Samantha Catantan; gymnasts Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Emma Malabuyo, and Levi Ruivivar; rower Joanie Delgaco; and weightlifters John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, ​​and Vanessa Sarno.

text: Burger ang isa sa masami ukon paborito nga fast food sang mga tawo apang pila ka burger ang sarang mo makaon sa sulod sang isa ka oras?
english: Burger is one of the most or favorite fast food of people but how many burgers can you eat in an hour?

text: Masarangan mo bala magkaon sang masobra 30 ka burger sa sulod lang sang 10 minutos?
english: Can you eat more than 30 burgers in just 10 minutes?

text: Ginkabiliban sang mga tawo   sang Plumas Lake, California ang 40 anyos nga  si Molly Schuyler bangud sa kadamuon sang burger nga nakaon niya nga naglab-ot sa  32 burgers sa sulod lang sang 10 minutos.
english: The people of Plumas Lake, California impressed 40-year-old Molly Schuyler with the amount of burgers she ate, reaching 32 burgers in just 10 minutes.

text: Si Schuyler man ang ang nagdaog sa 10th Annual Z Burger Eating Championship sa maka lima na nga beses.
english: Schuyler is also the winner of the 10th Annual Z Burger Eating Championship for the fifth time.

text: Si Schuley man ang nagdaog sa La Costena Jalapeno Eating Contest, second place sa Gringo Bandito Taco eating contest kag second place man sa isa ka pizza eating contest.
english: Schuley also won the La Costena Jalapeno Eating Contest, second place in the Gringo Bandito Taco eating contest and also second place in a pizza eating contest.

text: Suno kay Schuley iya lang gina enjoy ang pagkaon samtang sya ang yara sa competition kag sya ang nagasunod lang sa iya normal nga pamaagi sang pagkaon sang tuman ka dasig.//
english: Schuley said he was just enjoying the food while he was in the competition and he was just following his normal way of eating very fast.//

text: Nagtanyag si Pope Leo XIV nga magpatunga sa mga lider sang mga nasyon nga may gyera sa tuyo nga mapabalik na ang kalinong sa kalibutan.
english: Pope Leo XIV offered to mediate with the leaders of the warring nations in order to restore world peace.

text: Kadungan sini, nagpanawagan man ang Santo Papa sa mga Kristyano nga nagapuyo sa Middle East nga indi pagbayaan ang ila mga puluy-an.
english: At the same time, the Pope also called on Christians living in the Middle East not to leave their homes.

text: “Who, better than you, can sing a song of hope even amid the abyss of violence?” pahayag sini sa iya speech sa mga katapo sang Eastern Catholic Churches sa Paul VI hall sa Vatican.
english: “Who, better than you, can sing a song of hope even amid the abyss of violence?” pahayag sini sa iya speech sa mga katapo sang Eastern Catholic Churches sa Paul VI hall sa Vatican.

text: Ginhinambit sini ang mga lugar kaangay sang Holy Land, Ukraine, Lebanon, Syria, Middle East, Tigray kag ang Caucasus.
english: It mentioned places like the Holy Land, Ukraine, Lebanon, Syria, the Middle East, Tigray and the Caucasus.

text: Nagpanawagan ini nga magpangamuyo, kag sa iya bahin, nagpasalig ini nga magahimo man siya sang mga tikang agud magpangibabaw ang kalinong.
english: He called for prayers, and for his part, he assured that he would also take steps to ensure that peace prevails.

text:
“The Holy See is always ready to help bring enemies together, face to face, to talk to one another, so that peoples everywhere may once more find hope and recover the dignity they deserve, the dignity of peace… The peoples of our world desire peace, and to their leaders I appeal with all my heart: Let us meet, let us talk, let us negotiate!”

Ang iya speech natabo sa pre-arranged event para sa 2025 Jubilee holy year nga dedikado sa 23 Eastern Catholic Churches nga nalapta sa Eastern Europe, Middle East, India, kag mga parte sang Africa.
english:
“The Holy See is always ready to help bring enemies together, face to face, to talk to one another, so that peoples everywhere may once more find hope and recover the dignity they deserve, the dignity of peace… The peoples of our world desire peace, and to their leaders I appeal with all my heart: Let us meet, let us talk, let us negotiate!”

His speech took place at the pre-arranged event for the 2025 Jubilee holy year dedicated to the 23 Eastern Catholic Churches spread across Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and parts of Africa.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana nagpungko si Pope Leo bilang bag-o nga lider sang Catholic Church kasunod sang kamatayon ni Pope Francis sang Abril 21.
english: Last week, Pope Leo took office as the new leader of the Catholic Church following the death of Pope Francis on April 21.

text: Nalakip ang Antique sa mga lugar nga ginapaandaman sang posible matabo nga storm surge sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Antique is among the areas warned of a possible storm surge in the next 24 hours.

text: Yellow warning ang gin-isyu sa probinsya nga nagakahulugan sang estimated storm surge heights nga lab-ot sa 1-2 meters.
english: A yellow warning has been issued in the province which means estimated storm surge heights of 1-2 meters.

text: “A HIGH RISK OF LIFE-THREATENING STORM SURGE may occur within the next 24 hours.
english: “A HIGH RISK OF LIFE-THREATENING STORM SURGE may occur within the next 24 hours.

text: There is a possibility of inundation from rising sea water along with high waves in the low lying coastal communities,” suno sa state weather bureau.
english: There is a possibility of inundation from rising sea water along with high waves in the low lying coastal communities,” according to the state weather bureau.

text: Ginapahanumdom sa publiko nga maglikaw anay sa mga baybayon, ikanselar ang mga hilikuton sa dagat, kag magsaylo sa mas mataas nga lugar nga malayo sa baybay kag sa surge-prone areas.
english: The public is reminded to first avoid beaches, cancel marine activities, and move to higher ground away from the coast and surge-prone areas.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa alas dos sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang PAGASA subong nga Myerkules, Nobyembre 5, nabutang sa Signal Number 2 ang Antique lakip na ang Caluya Islands bangud sa Bagyo Tino nga subong yara na sa coastal waters sang northern Palawan.
english: As of 2:00 am, PAGASA's weather bulletin on Wednesday, November 5, placed Antique and the Caluya Islands under Signal Number 2 due to Typhoon Tino which is now in the coastal waters of northern Palawan.

text: Daku kag maayo ang nangin marka sang Filipina actress nga si Liza Soberano sa iya Hollywood acting debut bilang si Taffy sa pelikula nga “Lisa Frankenstein”.
english: Filipina actress Liza Soberano has made a big and good mark in her Hollywood acting debut as Taffy in the film “Lisa Frankenstein”.

text: Isa sa nakasapak sa iya performance amo ang American producer kag director nga si Joe Russo nga kilala sa iya nga hinimuan nga “Hard Kill” ni Bruce Willis.
english: One of those who noticed his performance was American producer and director Joe Russo, known for his work on Bruce Willis's “Hard Kill”.

text: Suno kay Russo, nakapangita sang superstar ang direktor sang pelikula nga si Zelda Williams kag screenwriter nga si Diablo Cody sa persona ni Liza nga scene-stealer gid bilang si Taffy nga stepsister sang bida nga si Lisa nga ginadala ni Kathryn Newton.
english: According to Russo, the film’s director Zelda Williams and screenwriter Diablo Cody found a superstar in the persona of Liza who is very much a scene-stealer as Taffy the stepsister of the heroine Lisa played by Kathryn Newton.

text:
“Movies like LISA FRANKENSTEIN can be great vehicles to break new stars, and @zeldawilliams and Diablo Cody found a superstar in Liza Soberano, who steals every scene she’s in as Lisa’s step-sister, Taffy,” post sini sa X.

Mangin si Newton ang una nagsiling nga “always perfect” ang Pinay actress kag wala na suno sa iya sang mangin bagay sa papel ni Taffy kundi si Liza.
english:
“Movies like LISA FRANKENSTEIN can be great vehicles to break new stars, and @zeldawilliams and Diablo Cody found a superstar in Liza Soberano, who steals every scene she’s in as Lisa’s step-sister, Taffy,” it posted to X.

Newton was the first to say that the Filipino actress is “always perfect” and that there is no one who can fit the role of Taffy but Liza.

text: Inspired ang “Lisa Frankenstein” sa gothic novel nga “Frankenstein” sang English writer nga si Mary Shelley.
english: “Lisa Frankenstein” is inspired by the gothic novel “Frankenstein” by English writer Mary Shelley.

text: Yara man sa sini nga movie si Cole Sprouse nga nag-tag man kay Liza nga ila nga favorite character sa film.
english: Cole Sprouse is also in this movie who also tagged Liza as their favorite character in the film.

text: Malantaw sa mga sinehan sa Pilipinas umpisa sa Pebrero 7 ang “Lisa Frankenstein” halin sa Universal Pictures International.#
english: “Lisa Frankenstein” from Universal Pictures International will be released in theaters in the Philippines starting February 7.#

text: Nautod ang krus nga nahamtang sa ibabaw sang simbahan sang Guimbal bangud sang mabaskog nga hangin kag ulan dala sang bagyo Tino.
english: The cross located on top of the church of Guimbal was cut off due to strong winds and rain brought by typhoon Tino.

text: Suno kay Guimbal Vice Mayor Christine “Ting Ting” Garin, ginakasubo sini ang insidente bangud ang krus amo ang isa ka importante nga simbolo sang pagtuo kag paglaum sang mga pumuluyo sang Guimbal.
english: Guimbal Vice Mayor Christine “Ting Ting” Garin said she regrets the incident because the cross is an important symbol of faith and hope of the people of Guimbal.

text: Pahayag pa sang bise alcalde, magluwas sa krus, wala naman sang may na-record nga naguba nga mga estruktura sa amo nga banwa.
english: The vice mayor said that except for the cross, no damaged structures were recorded in the town.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga tanan nga karsada kag taytay sa banwa sarang maagyan kag normal man ang lebel sang tubig sa mga sapa kag suba.
english: He also clarified that all roads and bridges in the town are passable and the water level in the streams and rivers is normal.

text: Apang, madamo sang mga puno sang kahoy ang nagkalatumba kag may pila ka mga salakyan ang nagkalaguba bangud sang nagkalahulog nga debris nga dala sang mabaskog nga hangin.
english: However, many of the trees were knocked down and several vehicles were damaged due to falling debris brought by the strong winds.

text: Samtang, gin-report man nga may yara sang 163 ka pamilya ukon 585 ka indibidwal nga ginpaidalom sa pre-emptive evacuation bilang pagpangaman sa posible nga peligro dala sang bagyo.
english: Meanwhile, it was also reported that there are 163 families or 585 individuals who underwent pre-emptive evacuation as a precaution against possible dangers caused by the typhoon.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Vice Mayor Garin bangud wala sang may na-report nga nasamaran ukon napatay sa paglaslas sang bagyo Tino sa banwa sang Guimbal.
english: Vice Mayor Garin expressed his gratitude that no one was reported injured or killed in the onslaught of Typhoon Tino in Guimbal town.

text: Ang makahulubog nga ilimnon nagakadapat nga ibutang sa tiyan kag indi sa ulo.
english: Alcoholic beverages deserve to be kept on the stomach and not on the head.

text: Sa pungsod China, isa ka lalaki ang ginpadangat sa ospital bangud sa pagpalanakit sang iya nga dughan.
english: In China, a man was rushed to the hospital with chest pain.

text: Nag inom-inom ang 26 anyos nga lalaki kaupod ang iya mga abyan kag sang pagpauli sini, ginkakibot niya nga wala na kag nadula na ang iya nga liyabe.
english: The 26-year-old man was drinking with his friends and when he returned home, he was surprised that his key was gone.

text: Apang bangud may yara man sang tawo sa sulod sang balay, iya ini nga gintawag agud nga buksan siya.
english: But since there was someone inside the house, he called him to open it.

text: Gilayon siya nga nagdiretso sa iya nga kwarto kag nagtulog.
english: He immediately went straight to his room and slept.

text: Pagka-aga, nabatyagan niya ang tuman nga pagsakit sang iya nga dughan.
english: The next morning, he felt a sharp pain in his chest.

text: Una nga gin pa X-ray ang lalaki kag ginkakibot sang mga doktor nga may yara sang liyabe sa iya esophagus.
english: The man was first X-rayed and the doctors were surprised to find a key in his esophagus.

text: Delikado ang nangin kahimtangan sang lalaki bangud sa tuman ka dako sang liyabe nga iya natulon.
english: The man was in a dangerous condition because of the size of the key he swallowed.

text: Ang liyabe nga sa pagkadumdom niya nga nadula ang yara gali sa sulod sang iya nga lawas.
english: The key he thought was lost was actually inside his body.

text: Bangud sa tuman nga kahulugbon, wala na nadumduman sang lalaki nga natulon  niya gali ang liyabe sang iya balay.
english: Because of his drunkenness, the man did not remember that he had swallowed the key to his house.

text: Ginsuspinde sang Land Transportation Office sang 90 ka adlaw ang lisensiya sang bus driver nga naga-online sugal samtang naga-drive sa Cavite.
english: The Land Transportation Office suspended for 90 days the license of a bus driver who was gambling online while driving in Cavite.

text: Nakuhaan sang video ang amo nga aktibidad sang driver.
english: The driver's activity was caught on video.

text: Suno sa LTO, mangatubang ang bus driver sang reklamo nga paglapas sa Land Transportation Traffic Code bangud sa reckless driving.
english: According to the LTO, the bus driver will face a complaint of violating the Land Transportation Traffic Code for reckless driving.

text: Ginapangayuan man siya sang paathag sang kumpaniya sang bus tuhoy sa insidente.
english: The bus company is also asking him for an explanation about the incident.

text: Ginsuspinde na man sang Kersteen Joyce Transport ang nasambit nga bus driver.
english: Kersteen Joyce Transport has also suspended the said bus driver.

text: Nagapasalig si Mayor Raisa Treñas nga may ara sang bastante nga supply ang pagkaon kag bulong sa mga evacuation center sa siyudad.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas assures that there is sufficient supply of food and medicine in the evacuation centers in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga naglibot na ini sa mga evacuation centers kag na-activate na ang mga community kitchen para sa pagkaon sang mga evacuues.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said he has already toured the evacuation centers and activated the community kitchens for the food of the evacuees.

text: Suno kay Treñas, may ara man sang mga medical team sa mga evacuation centers kun sa diin padayon ang pagpanghatag sang mga bulong.
english: Treñas said there are also medical teams in the evacuation centers where the distribution of medicines continues.

text: Dugang ni Treñas, nangin madasig man ang disaster response sang siyudad.
english: Treñas added that the city's disaster response has also been quick.

text: Ginpasalamatan man niya ang mga volunteer nga nagbulig kag mga pumuluvo nga nagkooperar.
english: He also thanked the volunteers who helped and residents who cooperated.

text: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Labi pa nga nagtunog ang pangalan sang Iloilo City kag Quezon Province sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 pageant matapos ang kumpirmasyon nga magabalik sa national stage si anay Miss International first runner-up Ahtisa Manalo.
english: The name of Iloilo City and Quezon Province in the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 pageant has been confirmed that former Miss International first runner-up Ahtisa Manalo will return to the national stage.

text: Ang duha ka beauty queens amo ang masami ginapasampok sang pageant fans kag ginaduso nga mangin kandidata sang Pilipinas sa international pageant.
english: The two beauty queens are often beaten by pageant fans and proposed to be the Philippines' candidates in the international pageant.

text: Si Manalo, 26, amo ang appointed nga official delegate sang Quezon Province kag frontrunner sa pageant kaupod kay Miss Iloilo 2024 Alexie Brooks.
english: Manalo, 26, is the appointed official delegate of Quezon Province and frontrunner in the pageant alongside Miss Iloilo 2024 Alexie Brooks.

text: 20-anyos pa lamang ini sang nagdaog ini bilang first runner-up sang 2018 sunod kay Miss Universe Philippines 2018 Catriona Gray.
english: She was only 20 years old when she won first runner-up in 2018 after Miss Universe Philippines 2018 Catriona Gray.

text: Siya man ang pinakabata sa ila nga batch, kag subong nga naga-edad na ini sang 26, ginsiling sini nga mas madamo na siya sang eksperyensya kag mas magamit na niya ang iya nga platform sang maayo.
english: He is also the youngest in their batch, and now that he is 26, he said he has more experience and can use his platform better.

text: Matandaan nga nag-file man ini sang aplikasyon para sa Miss Universe Philippines sang 2020 apang nag-withdraw bangud sa isyu sa ikaayong lawas.
english: She also filed an application for Miss Universe Philippines in 2020 but withdrew due to health issues.

text: Advocacy sini amo ang pag-empower sa mga kabataan paagi sa edukasyon.
english: Its advocacy is to empower children through education.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, isa naman ka atleta si Brooks, 22, antes pa man ini nagbalik sa pageant.
english: Brooks, 22, on the other hand, was an athlete before she returned to the pageant.

text: Tumandok siya sang Leon, Ilolo.
english: He is a native of Leon, Ilolo.

text: ILOILO – Ginkadlawan lang ni anay Health Secretary kag subong Iloilo 1st District Rep.
english: ILOILO – Former Health Secretary and now Iloilo 1st District Rep.

text: Janet Garin ang akusasyon batok sa iya ni  Public Attorney’s Office (PAO) chief Atty. Persida Acosta nga nagapamalay-balay ini sa media para iduso ang pagbalik sang dengvaxia vaccine samtang ginasumpa ini sang ginikinan sang mga napatay bangud sa nasambit nga bakuna.
english: Janet Garin the accusation against her by Public Attorney's Office (PAO) chief Atty. Persida Acosta said she is going from house to house in the media to push for the return of the dengvaxia vaccine while the parents of those who died because of the vaccine are swearing at her.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Rep.

text: Garin, iya ginpahayag nga indi mahimo nga maghipos lamang siya bangud bilang isa ka doktor kag vaccinologist, mas mapaathag niya sa publiko ang tuhoy sa bakuna.
english: Garin said he cannot remain silent because as a doctor and vaccinologist, he can explain to the public about the vaccine.

text: Suno sa mamalidha, luyag lamang ni Acosta nga pahipuson siya agud ma-solo sang PAO chief ang pagpalayag sa media nga suno pa sa mamalidha, lunsay kabutigan kag patalang lang ang ginabuy-an nga mga pahayag ni  Acosta.
english: According to the lawmaker, Acosta just wants to silence him so that the PAO chief can alone broadcast to the media that, according to the lawmaker, Acosta's statements are all lies and misleading.

text: Dugang pa ni Garin, mas nagakadapat nga pamatian ang World Health Organization nga nagasiling nga wala sang nagakapatay sa bakuna sa baylo nga pamatian si Acosta nga isa ka abugado kag wala man sang nagakaigo nga ihibalo tuhoy sa dengvaxia vaccine.
english: Garin said it is more appropriate to listen to the World Health Organization that says no one dies from the vaccine instead of listening to Acosta who is a lawyer and does not have proper knowledge about the dengvaxia vaccine.

text: COLOMBIA – Atensyon sa mga tawo nga manugtunto!
english: COLOMBIA – Attention to people who are tempting!

text: Isa ka lalaki sa Colombia ang nangin viral sa social media matapos nga hublas ini nga nagahapa sa atop sang salakyan bilang silot bangud sa pagtunto sa iya nga asawa.
english: A man in Colombia has gone viral on social media after he was lying naked on the roof of a car as punishment for cheating on his wife.

text: Ang lalaki ang gin-parada sa palibot sang Barranquilla, Colombia.
english: The man was paraded around Barranquilla, Colombia.

text: Ginapasuni nga nadakpan mismo sang asawa ang iya bana nga may ka-hulid nga iban nga babayi sa isa ka motel.
english: The wife allegedly caught her husband having sex with another woman at a motel.

text: Nagpakitluoy man ang lalaki sa iya asawa nga pasaylohon na lamang ini.
english: The man also begged his wife to forgive him.

text: Apang bangud sa kaakig, ginmanduan sang babaye ang iya bana nga agud mapatawad niya ini, kianhanglan niya atubangon ang silot.
english: But in anger, the woman ordered her husband that in order to forgive him, he must face the punishment.

text: Nagsugot man ang lalaki nga maghublas kag maghapa sa ibabaw sang salakyan samtang nagapauli sila sa ila balay nagikan sa motel.
english: The man also agreed to get naked and lay on top of the car as they drove home from the motel.

text: Makit-an sa video nga ginatinguhaan sang lalaki nga matabonan ang iya nawong gamit ang tuwalya nga iya ginakaptan.
english: The video shows the man trying to cover his face with a towel he was holding.

text: Nakit-an naman sang mga otoridad ang lalaki kag gindakop bangud sa iya kabastosan nga ginhimo.
english: The man was found by the authorities and arrested for his obscene act.

text: Gilayon naman nga nakaguwa sa presohan ang lalaki bangud nakabayad ini sang pyansa.
english: The man was immediately released from jail after paying bail.

text: Sa subong, malipayon na ang lalaki sa luyo sa gihapon sang iya nga asawa apisar ginpakahuy-an siya sa madamo nga tawo.
english: Now, the man is happy behind his wife despite being humiliated by many people.

text: Gani sa mga kalalakihan dira, indi gid pagtuntuhon ang inyo nobya ukon misis bangud mahimo nga ini man ang mahimo ninyo nga madangatan.
english: So to the men out there, never tempt your girlfriend or wife because it could happen to you.
