text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Natalana ang Pilipinas nga maggasto sang dugang pa nga utang subong nga tuig bangud sa mga loans nga nahimo sa tion sang pandemya sang COVID-19 kag ang pagnubo sang balor sang Philippine peso.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —The Philippines is set to finance more debt this year due to loans made during the COVID-19 pandemic and the depreciation of the Philippine peso.

text: Suno sa Department of Budget and Management (DBM), sa idalum sang ginaduso nga National Expenditure Programme (NEP), ang Pilipinas natalana nga maggasto sang P876.7 billion para sa debt payments sa masunod nga tuig nga nagalab-ot sa 13.8% sang P6.352 trillion nga budget nga ginpain sang gobyerno.
english: According to the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), under the proposed National Expenditure Program (NEP), the Philippines is scheduled to spend P876.7 billion for debt payments next year which is 13.8% of the P6.352 trillion budget allocated by the government.

text: Santo pinakaulihi nga datos sang Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), nagapakita nga ang wala pa mabayran nga utang sang gobyerno naglab-ot sa P15.347 trillion sang katapusan sang Mayo, 2.2% ukon P330.39 billion nga mas mataas sangsa P15.017 trillion sang Abril.
english: According to the latest data from the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), the government's outstanding debt reached P15.347 trillion at the end of May, 2.2% or P330.39 billion higher than the P15.017 trillion in April.

text: Ang Pilipinas natalana nga magasto sang P848.061 billion para sa interest payments subong nga tuig, mas mataas gikan sa P670.525 billion subong nga tuig, kaupod ang P7.068 million nga balor sang bank charges.
english: The Philippines is set to spend P848.061 billion for interest payments this year, up from P670.525 billion this year, including P7.068 million worth of bank charges.

text: Samtang, ang P6.352 trillion nga badyet para sa 2025 nagapakita sang 10.1% nga pagtaas kada tuig gikan sa P5.768-trillion nga badyet para sa 2024, kag katumbas sa 22.1% sang gross domestic product sang pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the P6.352 trillion budget for 2025 represents a 10.1% annual increase from the P5.768-trillion budget for 2024, and is equivalent to 22.1% of the country’s gross domestic product.

text: Opisyal man nga ginsumiter ang National Expenditure Programme sa Kongreso sang Lunes, sa diin P2.121 trillion ang magakadto sa social services, P1.853 trillion ang magakadto sa serbisyo pang-ekonomiya, P1.083 trillion ang magakadto sa general public services, P1419.3 billion para sa defense, kag P876.7 billion sa utang.
english: The National Expenditure Program was also officially submitted to Congress on Monday, with P2.121 trillion for social services, P1.853 trillion for economic services, P1.083 trillion for general public services, P1419.3 billion for defense, and P8.76 billion for debt.

text: ILOILO – Ginkalipay ni anay Health Secretary kag subong Iloilo 1st District Rep.
english: ILOILO – Former Health Secretary and now Iloilo 1st District Rep.

text: Janet Garin nga bukas ang Malacañang sa posibilidad sang liwat nga  paggamit sang dengvaxia vaccine sa Pilipinas.
english: Janet Garin said Malacañang is open to the possibility of the re-use of the dengvaxia vaccine in the Philippines.

text: Ini sa tunga sang nagataas pa gid nga kaso sang dengue sa pungsod kun sa diin naglab-ot na sa masobra sa 100,000 ang nabiktima kag yara sa 500 na ang napatay.
english: This is amid the increasing number of dengue cases in the country where more than 100,000 people have been infected and more than 500 have died.

text: Sa interview sang  Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Rep.

text: Garin, iya ginpahayag nga nalipay siya bangud wala nagpadala ang Malacañang sa pamahog ni Public Attorney’s Office (PAO) chief Atty. Persida Acosta.
english: Garin said he was pleased that Malacañang did not give in to the threat of Public Attorney's Office (PAO) chief Atty. Persida Acosta.

text: Suno kay Garin, nagapakita ini nga wala ginakilala sang palasyo ang mga pahayag ni Acosta nga suno sa mamalidha nagapakuno-kuno nga eksperto.
english: Garin said this shows that the palace does not recognize the statements of Acosta who, according to the lawmaker, pretends to be an expert.

text: Dugang pa sang opisyal, si Acosta ang tawo nga wala  dapat ginasapak bangud nagapalpta  lamang ini sang sala nga impormasyon agud patalangon ang publiko tuhoy sa dengvaxia
english: The official added that Acosta is a person who should not be ignored because he is only spreading false information to mislead the public about dengvaxia

text: Ginpaguwa na sa kustodiya sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang anay police major nga amo ang primary suspect sa pagkadula sang beauty queen kag teacher nga si Catherine Camilon.
english: The former police major who is the primary suspect in the disappearance of beauty queen and teacher Catherine Camilon has been released from the custody of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Suno kay PNP chief Police General Benjamin Acorda Jr., ginpaguwa si Police Major Allan de Castro bangud sang nagligad nga semana, ginsipa man ini pahalin sa serbisyo sa hanay sang kapulisan.
english: According to PNP chief Police General Benjamin Acorda Jr., Police Major Allan de Castro was released because last week, he was also kicked out of the police force.

text: Apisar sini suno kay Acorda, magapadayon ang PNP sa pagmonitor kun sa diin magkadto si De Castro agud mahapos nga madakpan pananglitan may warrant of arrrest na nga i-isyu ang korte para sa iya.
english: Despite this, Acorda said, the PNP will continue to monitor where De Castro goes so that he can be easily arrested if the court issues a warrant of arrest for him.

text: Oktubre 2023 sang nadeklarar nga missing si Camilon sa Batangas.
english: Camilon was declared missing in Batangas in October 2023.

text: Sa amo man nga bulan, ginpaidalom si De Castro sa Regional Personnel Holding and Accounting Unit sang PRO 4A kag ginhingadlan nga isa sa mga persons of interest sa pagkadula sang beauty queen.
english: In the same month, De Castro was placed under the Regional Personnel Holding and Accounting Unit of PRO 4A and named as one of the persons of interest in the disappearance of the beauty queen.

text: Siya man ang naga-guwa nga tabuon kuntani sang biktima antes natabo ang insidente.
english: He was also the one who was about to be covered by the victim before the incident.

text: Sang nagligad naman nga semana, ginkumpirma ni Police Regional office (PRO) 4A chief Police Brigadier General Paul Kenneth Lucas nga ginpahalin na si De Castro sa serbisyo epektibo sang Enero 16.
english: Last week, Police Regional Office (PRO) 4A chief Police Brigadier General Paul Kenneth Lucas confirmed that De Castro was dismissed from service effective January 16.

text: Ang gin-cite nga rason amo ang conduct unbecoming of a police officer bangud sang gin-alegar pagpakigrelasyon sini kay Camilon apisar nga kasado ini sa lain nga babayi.
english: The reason cited was the conduct unbecoming of a police officer because of his alleged relationship with Camilon despite being married to another woman.

text: Magluwas diri, may napasaka man nga kaso nga kidnapping kag serious illegal detention complaints batok kay De Castro, iya driver-bodyguard nga si Jeffrey Magpantay, kag duha ka John Does.
english: In addition, a case of kidnapping and serious illegal detention complaints was also filed against De Castro, his driver-bodyguard Jeffrey Magpantay, and two John Does.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag sang mga pulis nga sandig sa panaysayon sang mga testigo, nagaguwa nga posible patay na si Camilon.
english: Police earlier said that based on the testimony of witnesses, it appears that Camilon may be dead.

text: Matandaan nga nag-sorry lamang si De Castro bangud nga naulamid ang pangalan sang PNP sa kaso apang magluwas diri, wala ini sang tinimok-timok sa iya kaangtanan kay Camilon, kun matuod nga sila ang may kahimuan sa krimen, kag kun sa diin na ang lawas sini.#
english: It can be recalled that De Castro only apologized because the name of the PNP was involved in the case but besides that, he did not say anything about his relationship with Camilon, if it is true that they were involved in the crime, and where his body is.

text: Nangin mas kumplikado ang kondisyon sa ikaayong lawas sang actress-host nga si Kris Aquino sa pagsugod sang 2024.
english: Actress-host Kris Aquino's health condition became more complicated at the beginning of 2024.

text: Ginsiling sini sa fans nga padayon siya nga magabato kag indi magpaluya apisar pa nga may sintomas na naman sang lain na naman nga autoimmune disease nga nakit-an sa iya lawas.
english: He told fans that he will continue to fight and not give up despite having symptoms of another autoimmune disease found in his body.

text: Suno pa sa 52-anyos nga aktres, mahina na ang iya lawas halin pa sa Thanksgiving Day sa Amerika kag nadulaan na ini sang gana nga magkaon kag masami nga nagasakit ang ulo.
english: The 52-year-old actress said she has been feeling weak since Thanksgiving Day in the United States and has lost her appetite and has frequent headaches.

text: Ang bag-o nga sintomas sang posible lain na naman nga autoimmune connective tissue disease ang nagtuga sang rashes sa iya nawong.
english: A new symptom of possibly another autoimmune connective tissue disease caused rashes on his face.

text: Posible suno sa iya nga yara siya sa initial stage sang Systemic lupus erythematosus ukon lupus.
english: He said it is possible that he is in the initial stage of systemic lupus erythematosus or lupus.

text: “I’m at the initial stage of SLE or what’s commonly known as lupus… My battle has become more complex BUT I promised my sons and my sisters I won’t be a wimp.
english: “I’m at the initial stage of SLE or what’s commonly known as lupus… My battle has become more complex BUT I promised my sons and my sisters I won’t be a wimp.

text: And I’m promising all my friends plus all who continue to pray for me: bawal sumuko, tuloy pa rin ang laban,” pahayag sini.
english: And I'm promising all my friends plus all who continue to pray for me: don't give up, the fight is still going on,” he said.

text: Suno sa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, nagakatabo ang lupus kun gina-atake sang immune system ang kaugalingon nga tissues kag nagatuga sang inflammation kag tissue damage sa organs.
english: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, lupus occurs when the immune system attacks its own tissues and causes inflammation and tissue damage to the organs.

text: Maapektuhan sini ang joints, lungs, brain, kidneys, kag blood vessels.
english: It can affect the joints, lungs, brain, kidneys, and blood vessels.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini nga update halin kay Kris, nasapubliko na nga may yara siya sang lima ka delikado nga autoimmune diseases nga rason sang iya nga health treatment sa Amerika sa sulod sang pila na ka tuig.
english: It is known that before this update from Kris, it was public that he has five dangerous autoimmune diseases which is the reason for his health treatment in America for several years.

text: Ginklaro sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) nga indi matuod ang mga impormasyon sa social media nga indi safe ang pagkaon sang isda bangud sang medical waste nga ginpangtampok sa dagat.
english: The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) has clarified that information on social media that fish is unsafe to eat due to medical waste dumped in the sea is not true.

text: Ang ginatumod sang bureau amo ang social media posts kun sa diin gin-anunsyo sa publiko nga indi anay magkaon sang isda bangud may yara sang medical wastes sa dagat partikular ang tube halin sa ospital nga nagaunod sang human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
english: The bureau is referring to social media posts where it was announced to the public not to eat fish because there is medical waste in the sea particularly the tube from the hospital containing the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

text: Indi matuod ini nga posts suno sa ahensya kag dapat indi pagpatihan sang publiko.
english: The agency said these posts are not true and should not be believed by the public.

text: Sa baylo suno sa BFAR, dapat anay nga i-verify ang source sang impormasyon antes ini i-share.
english: Instead, according to the BFAR, the source of information should be verified before sharing it.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang BFAR mismo ang naga-isyu sang warnings kag nagapatuman sang bans pananglitan may mga isyu sa food safety kaangay sang red tide kag kun may matabo nga oil spill.
english: It is known that the BFAR itself issues warnings and enforces bans in case of food safety issues such as red tide and oil spill.

text: In view of the ongoing clearing operations, and the continued care of evacuees in the various evacuation centers in the city, ginapadayon naton ang pag-suspend sang trabaho sa Iloilo City Hall kag mga outside offices sini kag facilities, lakip ang iban nga government offices within the territorial jurisdiction of Iloilo City sa November 5, 2025.

english: This is to ensure that we can continue to return to normal due to the onslaught of typhoon Tino, and for the general welfare and safety of all.

text: Isa ka babaye nga nagsulod sa imburnal para magpangita sang pagkaon ang gin-rescue sa Bula-Lagao Road sa General Santos City.
english: A woman who entered the sewer to look for food was rescued on Bula-Lagao Road in General Santos City.

text: Nakit-an ini sang isa ka tricycle driver kun sa diin nagahibi ang amo nga babaye kag nagapangayo sang bulig gani ginpahibalo niya ini sa otoridad.
english: A tricycle driver saw the woman crying and asking for help and informed the authorities.

text: Kaupod ang mga pulis, nagresponde ang mga tinawo sang Barangay Bula, Bureau of Fire Protection, kag City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office.
english: Along with the police, personnel from Barangay Bula, Bureau of Fire Protection, and City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office responded.

text: Ila ginkuha ang kongkreto nga takop sang imburnal kag ginbuligan ang babaye nga makagwa apang bangud nabudlayan ini nga magginhawa, ginhatagan siya sang breathing apparatus kag natigayon nga mapagwa sa imburnal kag nadala sa ospital.
english: They removed the concrete cover of the sewer and helped the woman out but as she had difficulty breathing, she was given a breathing apparatus and managed to get out of the sewer and was taken to hospital.

text: Nakilala ang babaye nga nagaedad sang 23-anyos nga residente sang Cotabato Province.
english: The woman was identified as a 23-year-old resident of Cotabato Province.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, naligo sa dagat ang babaye ka nagsulod sa isa ka kanal agud mangita sang pagkaon.
english: According to the investigation, the woman was swimming in the sea when she entered a canal to look for food.

text: Nagkamang ini sang ginabanta 300 metros kag nabudlayan na ini nga magbalik.
english: It crawled about 300 meters and was struggling to get back up.

text: Yara na sa maayo nga kondisyon ang babaye.
english: The woman is in good condition.

text: BATAAN – Natalana nga magkuha sang sample ang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) sang mga isda sa mga lugar nga apektado sang oil spill gikan sa naglugdang nga MT Terra Nova sa baybayon sang Bataan agud mahibaluan kon may kinahanglanon nga magdeklarar sang pagdumili sa pagpangisda.
english: BATAAN – The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) is scheduled to take samples of fish in the areas affected by the oil spill from the sunken MT Terra Nova off the coast of Bataan to determine if there is a need to declare a ban on fishing.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources spokesperson Nazario Briguera nga posible maapektuhan ang palangabuhian sang linibo ka mga mangingisda kun temporaryo nga dumilian sila sa pagpangisda bangud sa oil spill.
english: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources spokesperson Nazario Briguera also said that the livelihood of thousands of fishermen could be affected if they are temporarily banned from fishing due to the oil spill.

text: Suno kay Environment Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga, posible makaapekto ang oil spill sa Bulacan, Cavite, kag Pampanga.
english: According to Environment Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga, the oil spill is likely to affect Bulacan, Cavite, and Pampanga.

text: Sugod sang Sabado, ginlaragway sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang oil spill nga 12 tubtob 14 kilometros ang kalabaon apang “manageable” gihapon.
english: As of Saturday, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) described the oil spill as 12 to 14 kilometers long but still “manageable”.

text: Ang mga technical divers sang Harbor Star, ang salvor nga gin-arkilahan sa pagtrabaho sa M/T Terra Nova, bisan pa, nakatukib sang isa ka gamay nga pagtulo nga naghalin sa valve sang tangke.
english: The technical divers of the Harbor Star, the salvor chartered to work on the M/T Terra Nova, however, discovered a small leak coming from the tank valve.

text: Suno kay Briguera, gina-engganyo sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources ang mga mangingisda nga bantayan ang ila palibot agud mahibaluan kun nagalapta na ang oil spill sa ila lugar.
english: Briguera said the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources is encouraging fishermen to monitor their surroundings to see if the oil spill is spreading in their area.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginpahayag ni Briguera nga nakahanda ang gobyerno nga magbulig sa mga mangingisda nga maapektuhan sang posible fishing ban.
english: Meanwhile, Briguera said the government is ready to assist fishermen who will be affected by the possible fishing ban.

text: Ang MT Terra Nova nga padulong kuntani sa Iloilo ang may dala nga 1.4 million ka litro sang industrial fuel sang nagkulob ini sa kalayuon nga 3.6 nautical miles east off Lamao Point sa banwa sang Limay sa Bataan.
english: The MT Terra Nova, which was bound for Iloilo, was carrying 1.4 million liters of industrial fuel when it capsized 3.6 nautical miles east off Lamao Point in Limay town in Bataan.

text: Suno sa Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), 16 sa 17 ka mga tripulante ang na-rescue, samtang isa ka crewman ang nasapwan nga patay.
english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), 16 of the 17 crew members were rescued, while one crewman was found dead.

text: Sang Sabado, ginmando ni Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr ang pagtukod sang isa ka inter-agency task force nga maga-address sa oil spill.
english: On Saturday, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr ordered the creation of an inter-agency task force to address the oil spill.

text: Tuman ka bala ka malilipaton nga apisar ang imo nga anak ang mahimo mo pa nga malipatan?
english: Are you so forgetful that you can forget even your child?

text: Sa Hamburg, Germany, nalimtan sang mag-asawa ang ila bag-o bun-ag nga anak sa sulod sang taxi sang sila ang naghalin sa ospital.
english: In Hamburg, Germany, a couple forgot their newborn son inside a taxi when they left the hospital.

text: Kaupod sang mag-asawa ang isa man nila ka anak nga isa ka tuig ang edad sa diin sang sila ang nagpanaog na sa taxi, wala nakahibalo ang mag-asawa nga may isa pa sila ka anak nga nabilin sa sulod sang salakyan.
english: The couple were accompanied by their one-year-old child. When they got out of the taxi, they did not know that they had another child left inside the vehicle.

text: Sang gilayon nga naglakat ang taxi, na-realize sang mag-asawa nga nabilin nila ang ila anak sa sulod sang taxi.
english: As soon as the taxi pulled away, the couple realized they had left their daughter inside the taxi.

text: Apisar nga nagdalagan pa ang amay agud nga mapabalik ang taxi apang wala niya ini naabtan.
english: Although the father ran to get the taxi back but he could not catch it.

text: Gilayon nga nag report ang mag-asawa sa pulis.
english: The couple immediately reported the incident to the police.

text: Wala man na tulupangdan sang driver nga may nabilin pa nga pasahero sa backseat sa diin nagdesisyon pa ini nga i-park ang salakyan sa underground parking lot agud nga makapanyaga na ini.
english: The driver did not notice that there were still passengers left in the backseat and decided to park the vehicle in the underground parking lot so that he could take a break.

text: Gintinguhaan naman sang mgma kapulisan nga makita ang taxi sa bilog nga syudad sang Hamburg.
english: Police tried to find the taxi throughout the city of Hamburg.

text: Matapos nga magpanyaga sang driver, nagpadulong na ini sa paluparan agud nga magkuha sang pasahero.
english: After the driver said goodbye, he went to the airport to pick up passengers.

text: Samtang siya ang nagamaneho, iya na nga natulupangdan ang bag-o bun-ag nga bata nga nagakatulog.
english: While he was driving, he noticed the newborn baby sleeping.

text: Bangud sini, gilayon man nga nagpdulong ang driver sa pulis agud nga i-report ang nabilin nga bata sa iya nga salakyan.
english: The driver immediately went to the police station to report the remaining child in his vehicle.

text: Sa subong, kaupod na sang mag-asawa ang ila nga anak.
english: The couple is now with their son.

text: Nagtibusok ang isa Super Huey helicopter sang Philippine Air Force nga nagadala sang humanitarian aid kag disaster response para sa mga naapektuhan sang Bagyo Tino sa Loreto, Agusan del Sur subong nga adlaw.
english: A Super Huey helicopter of the Philippine Air Force carrying humanitarian aid and disaster response for the victims of Typhoon Tino landed in Loreto, Agusan del Sur today.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirmar sang Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom).
english: This was confirmed by the Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom).

text: Suno sa AFP, ang nasambit nga helicopter ang kabahin sang ila madasig nga sabat agud madul-ong ang bulig sa mga residente nga naapektuhan sang bagyo.
english: According to the AFP, the helicopter is part of their rapid response to deliver aid to residents affected by the typhoon.

text: Sa subong padayon ang rescue kag assessment operations sa lugar agud masiguro ang safety sang mga sakay kag mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga bulig.
english: Rescue and assessment operations are ongoing in the area to ensure the safety of the passengers and provide appropriate assistance.

text: Posible nga patay na ang beauty queen nga si Catherine Camilon — kun basehan lamang ang mga panugdaon sang mga testigo nga nagabulig sa imbestigasyon sang pulis.
english: Beauty queen Catherine Camilon may be dead — based on the suggestions of witnesses who are helping the police investigation.

text: Suno kay Deputy Maj.
english: According to Deputy Maj.

text: Nilo Morallos sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Region 4-A, nagalaum pa ang pulis sa maayo nga balita sa ila nga imbestigasyon, apang may ginapanan-aw man nga malain nga hitabo.
english: Nilo Morallos of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Region 4-A, said the police are still hoping for good news in their investigation, but there are also expected bad events.

text: “Hindi po namin masabi kung wala na po talaga, pero base po sa account ng witnesses namin it appears na ‘yun na nga po, na patay na po,” pahayag sini.
english: “We can't say if he's really gone, but based on the accounts of our witnesses it appears that he's dead,” he said.

text: Ang CIDG amo ang primary investigation branch sang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag amo ang nagatutok sa kaso sang missing nga beauty queen nga tumandok sang Tuy, Batangas.
english: The CIDG is the primary investigation branch of the Philippine National Police (PNP) and is focusing on the case of the missing beauty queen native of Tuy, Batangas.

text: Sang Nobyembre 8, 2023, ginpahayag sang PNP nga may duha ka mga testigo nga nag-claim nga nakit-an nila ang tatlo ka mga lalaki nga nagatuwang sa lawas ni Camilon kag ginsaylo ini sa lain nga salakyan.
english: On November 8, 2023, the PNP said two witnesses claimed to have seen three men carrying Camilon’s body and moving it to a different vehicle.

text: Sang Nobyembre 9, sunod man nga na-recover sang mga pulis ang abandonado nga salakyan (kaangay sa ginalaragway sang mga testigo) sa bakante nga lote sa corner sang Dumuclay Road kag Star Tollway sa Barangay Pallocan East.
english: On November 9, police also recovered an abandoned vehicle (similar to the one described by witnesses) in a vacant lot at the corner of Dumuclay Road and Star Tollway in Barangay Pallocan East.

text: Base sa resulta sang forensic examination, ang mga unot sang buhok ukon hair strands nga nakuha sa pula nga Honda CRV ang naga-match sa DNA sang ginikanan ni Camilon.
english: Based on the results of the forensic examination, the hair strands recovered from the red Honda CRV matched the DNA of Camilon's parents.

text: Oktubre 2023 sang gin-report nga missing ang amo nga beauty queen.
english: October 2023 when the beauty queen was reported missing.

text: Tiglawas siya sang Tuy sa Miss Grand Philippines 2023 kag isa man ka teacher sa Batangas.
english: She is Tuy’s representative in Miss Grand Philippines 2023 and is also a teacher in Batangas.

text: Kahapon, Enero 18, ginkumpirma man sang Police Regional Office 4A (PRO 4A) nga ginkakas na sa serbisyo epektibo sang Enero 16 ang pulis nga si Police Major Allan de Castro nga amo ang prime suspect sa pagkadula ni Camilon.
english: Yesterday, January 18, the Police Regional Office 4A (PRO 4A) also confirmed that Police Major Allan de Castro, the prime suspect in Camilon's disappearance, was dismissed from service effective January 16.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginpahalin ini bangud sa conduct unbecoming of a police office bangud sa gina-alegar pagpakigrelasyon sini kay Camilon apisar nga kasado na ini sa lain nga babayi.
english: He was reportedly fired for conduct unbecoming of a police office because of his alleged relationship with Camilon despite being married to another woman.

text: Nagapangatubang man ang amo nga police major sang reklamo nga kidnapping kag serious illegal detention — kaangay man sa ginpasaka sa iya driver-bodyguard nga si Jeffrey Magpantay kag duha pa ka John Does.#
english: The police major is also facing charges of kidnapping and serious illegal detention — similar to those filed against his driver-bodyguard Jeffrey Magpantay and two other John Does.

text: Liwat nga maga-request sang interim release ang kampo ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp will again request an interim release.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang lead counsel sang anay presidente nga si Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, kasunod sang pagbasura sang International Criminal Court (ICC) Appeals Chamber sa ila una nga request para sa interim release.
english: This was revealed by the lead counsel of the former president, Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, following the International Criminal Court (ICC) Appeals Chamber’s rejection of their initial request for interim release.

text: Suno kay Kaufman, magahulat anay sila sang resulta sang medical evaluation ni Duterte nga iga-release sa masunod nga bulan.
english: Kaufman said they will wait for the results of Duterte's medical evaluation to be released next month.

text: Pahayag pa niya, indi makasarang magpalagyo ang isa ka 80-anyos nga tawo nga mahina na ang kondisyon sang lawas kag may yara pa sang cognitive issues.
english: He said an 80-year-old man who is in poor physical condition and has cognitive issues cannot escape.

text: Dugang pa ni Kaufman, indi man makabig si Duterte nga pamahog sa mga testigo.
english: Kaufman added that Duterte is not a threat to witnesses.

text: Gin-emphasize pa sang abogado nga wala pa sang tinion nga nag-affirm ang ICC chamber sang interim release para sa isa ka akusado nga ginapasakaan sang kaso nga crimes against humanity.
english: The lawyer stressed that the ICC chamber has not yet affirmed an interim release for an accused charged with crimes against humanity.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni ICC Assistant to Counsel Atty. Kristina Conti nga indi na maka-apelar ang kampo ni Duterte sa rejection, apang mahimo sila nga mag-file sang bago nga request base sa lain naman nga ground.
english: It can be recalled that ICC Assistant to Counsel Atty. Kristina Conti said Duterte's camp can no longer appeal the rejection, but they can file a new request based on a different ground.

text: Samtang, ginarespeto naman sang Palasyo sang Malacañang ang nangin desisyon sang ICC sa pagbasura sang interim release ni Duterte.
english: Meanwhile, the Malacañang Palace respects the ICC's decision to reject Duterte's interim release.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer USec.
english: According to Palace Press Officer USec.

text: Claire Castro nga nag desisyon na ang ICC kag pabay-an nalang ang lakat sang kaso.
english: Claire Castro said the ICC has decided to let the case go.

text: Patay ang isa babaye nga pulis sang aksidente nga matiruhan ang iya kaugalingon samtang yara sa trabaho.
english: A female police officer was killed when she accidentally shot herself while on duty.

text: Ang biktima amo si Patrolwoman Kay Remando Dumasig.
english: The victim was identified as Patrolwoman Kay Remando Dumasig.

text: Natiruhan sini ang iya kaugalingon sa sulod sang Female Quarters sang ila nga istasyon sa Purok Tahimik, Barangay Poblacion, Matanao, Davao del Sur sang gab-i sang Hulyo 11, 2025.
english: She stabbed herself inside the Female Quarters of their station in Purok Tahimik, Barangay Poblacion, Matanao, Davao del Sur on the night of July 11, 2025.

text: Base sa una nga imbestigasyon, ginahanda sang biktima ang iya nga service firearm nga isa ka 9mm Girsan pistol bilang parte sang pagpanghanda para sa posible nga buy-bust operation.
english: Based on preliminary investigation, the victim was preparing his service firearm, a 9mm Girsan pistol, as part of preparations for a possible buy-bust operation.

text: Samtang, ginabutangan niya sang bala ang pusil, aksidente ini nga nahulog.
english: Meanwhile, he was putting a bullet in the gun, it accidentally dropped.

text: Sang gintuyo niya nga saluon ini, aksidente nga napitik sini ang gatilyo kag naglupok kag naigo ini sa ulo.
english: When he tried to salute her, she accidentally pulled the trigger and it went off and hit her in the head.

text: Nangguba na sang domestic box office sales ang pelikula sang mag-asawa nga sanday Marian Rivera kag Dingdong Dantes nga “Rewind”.
english: Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes' film “Rewind” has broken domestic box office sales.

text: Ini na ang ginakabig nga highest-grossing Filipino film sa domestic sales matapos nga naglapaw sa P815-million ang kita sini sang Enero 17.
english: It is now considered the highest-grossing Filipino film in domestic sales after it earned more than P815-million on January 17.

text: Nalapawan sini ang local box office records nga gin-set sang “Hello, Love, Goodbye” nanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Alden Richards sangg 2019 kag “The Hows of Us” nanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Daniel Padilla sang 2018 nga may mga income nga P691 million kag P690 million.
english: It surpassed the local box office records set by “Hello, Love, Goodbye” by Kathryn Bernardo and Alden Richards in 2019 and “The Hows of Us” by Kathryn Bernardo and Daniel Padilla in 2018 with incomes of P691 million and P690 million respectively.

text: Sa global sales naman, nakalab-ot na sa P845-M ang nalabot sang “Rewind” kag kinahanglan pa lab-uton ang P880-million nga na-set sang “Hello, Love, Goodbye” nga amo gihapon ang ginakilala nga highest-grossing Filipino film of all time.
english: In global sales, “Rewind” has already reached P845-M and needs to reach the P880-million set by “Hello, Love, Goodbye” which is still recognized as the highest-grossing Filipino film of all time.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapadayon subong ang international run sang pelikula sa masobra 300 ka mga sinehan sa lain-lain nga mga pungsod lakip na sa Canada, Guam, kag Saipan.
english: The film is currently running internationally in more than 300 theaters in various countries including Canada, Guam, and Saipan.

text: Ginabantayan man ang pag-abot sini sa mga sinehan sa Middle East matapos nga nakakuha na sang clearance subong gid lamang nga semana.#
english: It is also expected to arrive in theaters in the Middle East after getting clearance this week.

text: Ano bala ang sarang mo nga himuon agud nga indi ka pagbayaan sang imo nga nobyo?
english: What can you do to keep your boyfriend from leaving you?

text: Sa Colombia, isa ka 37 anyos nga babayi ang naghimo-hmo sang istorya nga nagabusong siya apisar nga wala agud nga indi lang siya pagbayaan sang iya nga nobyo.
english: In Colombia, a 37-year-old woman made up a story that she was pregnant when she was not so that her boyfriend would not leave her.

text: Madugay na nga magkarelasyon sanday Antonela Santiago Padilla kag Victor umpisa sang 14 anyos pa lamang sila.
english: Antonela Santiago Padilla and Victor have been in a long-term relationship since they were 14 years old.

text: Apang nagbulagay ang duha sang mahibaluan ni Antonela nga ginatunto siya ni Victor sa diin may yara pa ini sang iban pa gid nga babayi.
english: But the two broke up when Antonela learned that Victor was cheating on her with another woman.

text: Bangud sini, gintinguhaan pa ni Victor nga kaayuhon ang ila relasyon kag ginpasaylo man siya ni Antonela.
english: Because of this, Victor tried to repair their relationship and Antonela forgave him.

text: Nag-umpisa liwat ang romatic relationship sang duha apang nahibaluan na lamang ni Antonela nga padayon sa gihapon nagakitaay si Victor kag ang iya other woman.
english: The two resumed their romantic relationship but Antonela learned that Victor and his other woman were still seeing each other.

text: Nadesisyonan na lamang ni Antonela nga magpakuno-kuno nga nagabusong agud nga indi na siya pagluiban sang iya nga nobya kag indi man pagbayaan.
english: Antonela decided to pretend to be pregnant so that her girlfriend would not cheat on her and leave her.

text: Sa una nga pagkabalo ni Victor, nalipay ini bangud mangin tatay na siya kag ginkalipay man ni Antonela nga nagtinir ang nobyo niya sa iya.
english: When Victor first found out, he was happy because he was going to be a father and Antonela was happy that her boyfriend stayed with her.

text: Makaligad ang siyam ka bulan nga pagpakuno-kuno ni Antonela nga nagabusong, iya naman na desisyonan nga maghimo sang istorya agud nga indi mahibaluan sang iya nobyo nga ginpeke niya ang iya pagbusong.
english: After nine months of pretending to be pregnant, Antonela decided to make up a story so that her boyfriend would not know that she had faked her pregnancy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Antonela nga ginkidnap siya sang gang members kag ginkuha ang iya nga bata.
english: Antonela said she was kidnapped by gang members and took her child.

text: Apang wala gilayon nagpati si Victor sa diin nagpakitluoy siya kay Antonela nga ihambal ang kamatuoran.
english: But Victor did not immediately believe and begged Antonela to tell the truth.

text: Gin-ako ni Antonela nga naluoy siya kay Victor bangud nakit-an niya sa mga mata sang iya nobyo nga tuman ini nga nasakitan.
english: Antonela admitted that she felt sorry for Victor because she saw in her boyfriend's eyes that he was very hurt.

text: Nakonsensya man si Antonela sa iya nga ginhimo nga pagpanunto sa iya nobyo kag gin-ako na lang ang iya nga sala.
english: Antonela also felt guilty for stabbing her boyfriend and admitted her guilt.

text: Nagpanindugan man ang babayi nga bangud sa paghigugma kun ngaa iya nahimo ang nasambit nga butang.
english: The woman also insisted that it was out of love that she did the said thing.

text: Nagbalik sang masobra P100 million nga kwarta si former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) District Engineer Henry Alcantara sa Department of Justice (DOJ) kahapon.
english: Former DPWH District Engineer Henry Alcantara returned more than P100 million to the Department of Justice (DOJ) yesterday.

text: Suno kay Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida, nagalab-ot sa P110 million ang kabug-usan nga kantidad sang kwarta nga gin-turn over ni Alcantara sa ahensya.
english: Acting Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida said the total amount of money Alcantara turned over to the agency was P110 million.

text: Ginbuyagyag pa ni Vida nga binulto nga kwarta ang gindala ni Alcantara, nga gin-ako sini nga naghalin sa iya mga ginkawat gikan sa mga maanomaliya nga flood control projects sang gobyerno.
english: Vida also revealed that Alcantara brought a large amount of money, which he admitted came from his thefts from anomalous government flood control projects.

text: Kabahin ini sang ginapahayag nga ginpromisa ni Alcantara nga “restitution” nga nagalab-ot sa kabug-usan nga P300 milyon, suno sa tiglikom.
english: This is part of Alcantara's alleged promise of “restitution” totaling P300 million, according to the secretary.

text: Pahayag pa ni Vida, ang tikang ni Alcantara kag ang iya pag-ako nga naulamid siya sa flood control scandal amo ang isa sa mga kondisyon para mapilian siya bilang state witness.
english: Vida said Alcantara's move and his confession that he was involved in the flood control scandal was one of the conditions for him to be elected as a state witness.

text: Apang ginpunto man niya nga indi ini nagakahulugan nga automatic nga mangin testigo sang estado si Alcantara bangud lamang nga nagbalik siya sang ginkawat nga kwarta.
english: But he also pointed out that this does not mean that Alcantara automatically becomes a witness for the state just because he returned the stolen money.

text: Kasunod sini, ginpakigbahin ni Vida nga isipon pa sang banko ang kwarta agud masiguro ang eksakto nga kabug-usan sini.
english: Subsequently, Vida shared that the bank will count the money to ensure the exact amount.

text: Nagalaom ang kampo ni Alcantara nga makabulig ang pagbalik sini sang kwarta agud mapilian bilang state witness sang kaso.
english: Alcantara's camp hopes that his return of the money will help him be selected as a state witness in the case.

text: MANILA – Ginmanduan sang National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) ang mga telecommunication companies nga siguraduhon ang gilayon nga pagkay-o kag pagbalik sang telecommunications services kasunod sang kahalitan nga gintuga sang Tropical Cyclone Carina kag Southwest Monsoon ukon Habagat.
english: MANILA – The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) has ordered telecommunication companies to ensure the immediate repair and restoration of telecommunications services following the damage caused by Tropical Cyclone Carina and the Southwest Monsoon or Habagat.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag, ang NTC, nga nagasambit sang isa ka memorandum nga ginpaguwa sang Hulyo 22, nagmando sa tanan nga mga public telecommunications entities (PTEs) nga siguraduhon nga may bastante nga kadamuon sang mga teknikal kag suporta nga mga tinawo, standby generator, mga galamiton kag mga ekstra nga kagamitan sa mga lugar nga dapat apektado sang Bagyo Carina, subong man padasigon ang pagkay-o kag pagpanumbalik sang mga serbisyo sa telekomunikasyon sa amo nga mga lugar.
english: In a statement, the NTC, citing a memorandum issued on July 22, directed all public telecommunications entities (PTEs) to ensure sufficient numbers of technical and support personnel, standby generator, tools and spare equipment in areas that should be affected by Typhoon Carina, as well as expedite water restoration and restoration of telecommunication services in such areas.

text: Ang telecommunications regulator nagsiling man nga ang mga public telecommunications entities nagreport sa ahensya nga may mga issue sa serbisyo sang mobile kag broadband sa pila ka mga lugar nga apektado sang pagsalakay sang Carina, una bangud sa mga pagkadula sang kuryente.
english: The telecommunications regulator also said public telecommunications entities reported to the agency that there were issues with mobile and broadband services in some areas affected by the Carina attack, primarily due to power outages.

text: Suno kay Cathy Yang, PLDT-Smart Corporate Communications head, ang ila network team nagapamatuod nga ang mga site nga na-down bangod sang Carina nagalakip lamang sang mga 3% sang na-install nga base sa sina nga mga lugar, gani ginakabig ang epekto nga menor lamang.
english: According to Cathy Yang, PLDT-Smart Corporate Communications head, its network team confirms that the sites that were down due to Carina only comprise about 3% of the installed base in those areas, so the impact is considered only minor.

text: Sa pahayag naman sang chief sang Globe Telecom Sustainability kag Corporate Communications nga si Yoly Crisanto, samtang nag-ayo ang panahon kag nag-untat ang baha, ang ila mga tinawo nagatrabaho karon sa madasig nga pagpanumbalik sang mga serbisyo sa pila ka naapektohan nga mga lugar kag nakaeksperyensya sang mga issues sa ila mga serbisyo sa call, text kag data .
english: Globe Telecom Sustainability and Corporate Communications chief Yoly Crisanto said that as the weather has improved and the floods have subsided, their staff are now working to quickly restore services in some affected areas and have experienced issues with their call, text and data services.

text: Suno kay Crisanto, wala sang may narekord nga damage ang Globe sa ila network infrastructure.
english: Crisanto said Globe has not recorded any damage to its network infrastructure.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ehekutibo sang Globe nagsiling nga kapin sa 90% sang mga mobile sites sang Globe sa Metro Manila ang naga-operate, nga may pila lamang ka mga pasilidad bangud sang pagkadula sang kuryente, samtang wala sang 3G sites ang apektado.
english: It is known that the Globe executive said that more than 90% of Globe’s mobile sites in Metro Manila were operational, with only a few facilities due to power outages, while no 3G sites were affected.

text: Sa Northern Luzon, kapin sa 95% sang 2G, 3G, LTE kag 5G sites sang Globe ang naga-operate.
english: In Northern Luzon, more than 95% of Globe’s 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G sites are operational.

text: Natumbahan sang kahoy ang isa ka balay sa Brgy.
english: A tree hit a house in Brgy.

text: Concordia, Nueva Valencia, Guimaras.
english: Concordia, Nueva Valencia, Guimaras.

text: Naguba gid ang balay kag napit-alan ang mga tawo sa sulod.
english: The house was completely destroyed and people were trapped inside.

text: Natigayon man nga ma-rescue ang mga biktima kag yara na sa hilway nga kondisyon.
english: The victims were rescued and are in good condition.

text: Balik na sa kondisyon ang lawas sang Pinoy Olympian nga si Carlo Paalam sa una nga pagsabak sa World Qualification Tournament sa Bangkok, Thailand nga amo man ang iya ulihi nga tyansa nga maka-sulod sa Paris Olympics subong nga tuig.
english: Pinoy Olympian Carlo Paalam is back in shape for the first leg of the World Qualification Tournament in Bangkok, Thailand, which is also his last chance to qualify for the Paris Olympics this year.

text: Ginlutos sini ang iya una nga kasumpong nga si Alexei Lagkazasvili sang Greece sa round of 64 sang men’s 57kg.
english: He defeated his first opponent Alexei Lagkazasvili of Greece in the round of 64 of the men’s 57kg.

text: Nahimo ini ni Paalam paagi sa unanimous decision sang mga judges nga lunsay nag-skor sang 30-27 pabor sa iya.
english: Paalam did so by the unanimous decision of the judges who all scored 30-27 in his favour.

text: Ang finalists lamang sa men’s 57kg amo ang awtomatiko nga hatagan sang ticket para sa Olympiada samtang ang duha nga malutos sa semifinals ang magasambuwa para sa katapusan nga Paris spot nga available pa sa amo nga division.
english: Only the finalists in the men's 57kg will automatically be given tickets to the Olympiad while the two losers in the semifinals will compete for the last Paris spot still available in the division.

text: Matandaan nga sang Marso sa Italya, ginpadala man sang Pilipinas si Paalam sa World Qualification Tournament apang nag-surrender ini sa tunga-tunga sang hampang sa last 16 bangud sa injury sa iya abaga.
english: It can be recalled that in March in Italy, the Philippines also sent Paalam to the World Qualification Tournament but he surrendered in the middle of the last 16 match due to a shoulder injury.

text: Sang amo nga tion, kasumpong sini si Shukur Ovezov sang Turkmenistan nga amo ang awtomatiko nga nagsulod sa masunod nga round bangud sa pag-withdraw sang Pinoy Olympic silver medalist.
english: At that time, he was facing Shukur Ovezov of Turkmenistan who automatically entered the next round due to the withdrawal of the Pinoy Olympic silver medalist.

text: Kag daw kaangay nga isa ka hampang sang kapalaran, liwat nga magakit-anay sanday Paalam kag ang nasambit nga boksidor sa round of 32 sa Martes, Mayo 28.
english: And as if it were a game of fate, Paalam and the said boxer will meet again in the round of 32 on Tuesday, May 28.

text: Magluwas kay Paalam, ang ginpadala sang Pilipinas sa Bangkok amo sanday Rogen Ladon (men’s 51kg), Criztian Pitt Laurente (men’s 63.5kg), kag Hergie Bacyadan (women’s 75kg).
english: Besides Paalam, the Philippines sent to Bangkok were Rogen Ladon (men’s 51kg), Criztian Pitt Laurente (men’s 63.5kg), and Hergie Bacyadan (women’s 75kg).

text: Tuyo nila nga updan ang tatlo ka Pinoy boxers nga una na nag-qualify sa Olympics nga amo sanday Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, kag Aira Villegas.
english: They intend to accompany three Filipino boxers who have already qualified for the Olympics, Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, and Aira Villegas.

Defensor Sr., regarding this.

text:
Suno kay Banias,
apisar madamo na ang naga-endorso sa iya, mas pakamaayuhon niya nga
magtutok sa trabaho bilang alkalde sang iya banwa.
english:
According to Banias,
although many people already endorse him, he will be more blessed to
focus on the job as mayor of his town.

text:
Ginpahayag sang
alkalde nga luyag niya ibubo ang iya atensyon agud mapa-uswag ang
banwa sang Concepcion.
english:
Revealed by
mayor says he wants to pour his attention to improve the
town of Concepcion.

text:
Igatugyan naman ni
Banias sa kaupdanan sini sa Liga kun sin-o ang luyag nila iduso
bangud madamo pa man sang iban nga alkalde nga bukas kag masarangan
ang mangin LMP-Iloilo President.
english:
It will be handed over by
Banias to his colleagues in the League who they want to push
because there are many other mayors who are open and capable
to become LMP-Iloilo President.

text: Dog is a man’s bestfriend.
english: Dog is a man’s bestfriend.

text: Ini ang pagpati sang kadam-an.
english: This is the popular belief.

text: Gani sa pungsod India, tuman ang pagpalangga sang isa ka software engineer nga si Rakesh Shukla sa iya 735 ka mga ido.
english: So in India, a software engineer named Rakesh Shukla loves his 735 dogs very much.

text: Suno kay Rakesh, ang mga ido nga yara subong sa iya nga luyo amo ang mga ido nga ginapabay-an na ukon mga stray dogs.
english: According to Rakesh, the dogs currently behind him are abandoned dogs or stray dogs.

text: Panaysayon sang software engineer, masami niya nga gina-istorya ang iya mga ido sa diin ginakabig niya nga tawo ini kag indi sapat.
english: The software engineer said he often talks to his dogs where he considers them humans and not animals.

text: Ang mga ido nga yara sa iya ang may nagkalain-lain man nga sahi lakip na ang Labradors, Golden Retrievers, Great Danes, Beagles,  Rottweilers, Saint Bernards kag iban pa.
english: The dogs he has are also of various breeds including Labradors, Golden Retrievers, Great Danes, Beagles, Rottweilers, Saint Bernards and others.

text: Ginbansagan man si Rakesh sa nasambit nga pungsod bilang “Dog Father”.
english: Rakesh is also nicknamed in the said country as “Dog Father”.

text: Kun may makit-an si Rakesh nga ido nga gin-abandona ukon nagamasakit, ginadala niya ini sa iya nga balay agud nga ma hatagan sang pagkaon kag tubig kag amo man sang may matiniran.
english: When Rakesh sees an abandoned or sick dog, he takes it to his house so that it can be given food and water and also a place to stay.

text: Nagdesisyon man si Rakesh nga mag-hire sang 10 ka tawo nga magluto sang pagkaon kag makapakaon sa tanan niya nga ido.
english: Rakesh also decided to hire 10 people to cook food and feed all his dogs.

text: CONCEPCION,ILOILO– Gin-dismiss sang Regional Trial Court – Branch 66 sa Barotac Viejo, Iloilo  ang election protest nga ginpasaka batok kay Concepcion, Iloilo Mayor Raul Banias.
english: CONCEPCION, ILOILO – The Regional Trial Court – Branch 66 in Barotac Viejo, Iloilo dismissed the election protest filed against Concepcion, Iloilo Mayor Raul Banias.

text:
Sa interview sang
Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Mayor Banias, iya ginpahayag nga sa resolution
nga ginpagwa ni Judge Oscar Leo Billena, nasaad nga ‘insufficient in
form and substance’ ang  protest nga gin-file sang napierde nga
kasumpong ni Banias sa pagka-alkalde sang May 13 midterm elections
nga si Rainier Balida.
english:
In an interview with
Bombo Radyo Iloilo to Mayor Banias, he said that in the resolution
issued by Judge Oscar Leo Billena, was found to be ‘insufficient in
form and substance’ the protest filed by the defeated
Banias' opponent in the May 13 midterm elections
Rainier Balida.

text:
Suno kay Banias,
nagapamatuod lamang ini nga wala sang basehan ang alegasyon ni Balida
nga may anomaliya sa isipay sang boto bangud napaslawan si Balida nga
i-detalye ang  electoral fraud ukon iregularidad sa protested
precincts nga amo ang ginarequire sa 2010 Rules of Procedures in
Election Contests Involving Elected Municipal Officials.
english:
According to Banias,
this only proves that Balida's allegation is baseless
that there was an anomaly in the vote count because Balida failed to
detail electoral fraud or irregularities in protested
precincts as required by the 2010 Rules of Procedures in
Election Contests Involving Elected Municipal Officials.

text:
Nahibaluan nga sa
election protest ni  Balida nga myembro sang Nacionalista Party batok
kay Banias nga yara sa idalom sang  Partido Demokratiko Pilipino –
Lakas ng Bayan 9PDP-Laban) , iya gin-alegar nga wala maisip ang 
1,517 ka mga boto para sa pagka- mayor rason nga naghingyo ini sang 
manual recount sa 43 ka clustered precincts sa Concepcion.
english:
It is known that in
election protest by Balida, a member of the Nacionalista Party, against
to Banias under the Democratic Party of the Philippines –
Lakas ng Bayan 9PDP-Laban) , he alleged that the 
1,517 votes for the mayor's office, which led him to request 
manual recount in 43 clustered precincts in Concepcion.

text:
Magluwas diri,
gintumod man ni Balida ang pag- malfunction sang pila ka
vote-counting machines (VCM).
english:
Besides,
Balida also pointed out the malfunction of some
vote-counting machines (VCM).

text:
Matandaan nga tatlo
ang nagpapili sa pagka-mayor sa Concepcion nga ginalakipan nanday
Banias nga nakakuha sang 10,106 ka boto, Balida nga nakakuha sang
9,862 ka boto, kag independent candidate nga si Butch Ariola nga
nakakuha sang 166 ka boto.
english:
Recall that three
candidates for the mayoralty of Concepcion, including
Banias who got 10,106 votes, Balida who got
9,862 votes, and independent candidate Butch Ariola who
garnered 166 votes.

text: Luyag nga makig-areglo sang midwife nga nagpaltak sa bata nga napatay sa Tondo, Maynila sang Mayo.
english: The midwife who gave birth to a child who died in Tondo, Manila in May wants to settle.

text: Naaresto ng Manila Police District ang 68-anyos nga suspek sa Balut, Tondo sang Huwebes, Hulyo 10.
english: The Manila Police District arrested the 68-year-old suspect in Balut, Tondo on Thursday, July 10.

text: Subong nga adlaw, nag-ako ang babaye sa ginhimo nga pagpaltak sa 10-anyos nga bata bisan indi siya lisensyado ng doktor.
english: Today, the woman pleaded guilty to raping a 10-year-old child even though she was not a licensed doctor.

text: Nagapangabay siya nga makig-areglo sa pamilya sang bata nga napatay bangud indi man niya gusto ang natabo.
english: He asks to make peace with the family of the child who died because he does not like what happened.

text: Apang ang iloy sang biktima, wala sang plano nga makig-areglo sa suspek.
english: But the victim's mother, has no plans to settle with the suspect.

text: Mayo 17 sang nagpapaltak ang bata kag wala pa sang isa ka oras, nagpalanggit-om ini, nabudlayan magginhawa tubtob nga napatay.
english: On May 17, the child vomited and less than an hour later, he screamed, had difficulty breathing until he died.

text: Ang suspek may kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting in homicide kag illegal practice of medicine.
english: The suspect is facing charges of reckless imprudence resulting in homicide and illegal practice of medicine.

text: Mas nagapag-on ang tyansa sang Alas Pilipinas nga makasulod sa masunod nga round matapos ginhatagan sang mapait nga kalutusan ang India sa nagapadayon nga hampang sa AVC Challenge Cup sa Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
english: Alas Pilipinas' chances of qualifying for the next round are getting stronger after they suffered a bitter defeat to India in the ongoing AVC Challenge Cup at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.

text: Nakuha na subong sang national team ang lead kag nagaisahanon na lamang nga grupo nga undefeated sa Pool A, 2-0.
english: The national team has now taken the lead and is the only undefeated team in Pool A, 2-0.

text: Naalangan man sa first set apang nakabawi ang Pilipinas, 22-25, 25-21, 25-17, 25-18.
english: The Philippines also lost in the first set but recovered, 22-25, 25-21, 25-17, 25-18.

text: Padayon sa pag-idlak ang pangalan sang young player kag national team debutant nga si Angel Canino samtang suksok ang Pilipinas jersey.
english: The name of young player and national team debutant Angel Canino continues to shine while wearing the Philippines jersey.

text:
Gin-reset sini ang iya nga national team career-high nga rekord paagi sa 22 puntos nga mas mataas sa iya 17-puntos nga ginpaulan sa ila man four-set win batok sa Australia sang nagligad nga gab-i.

Nakabubo naman si Eya Laure sang 17 puntos; may tag-12 sanday Fifi Sharma kag Thea Gagate; samtang may nuebe puntos naman si Sisi Rondina.
english:
He reset his national team career-high record with 22 points higher than his 17-point rain in their four-set win over Australia last night.

Eya Laure poured in 17 points; Fifi Sharma and Thea Gagate had 12 each; while Sisi Rondina has nine points.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Pilipinas ang Iran (1-1) 7:00 buwas sa gab-i, Mayo 25, kag pagasundan sang hampang batok sa Chinese Taipei (0-3) sa Domingo sang gab-i nga amo ang magamarka sang pagtakop sang group campaign.
english: The Philippines will next face Iran (1-1) at 7:00 pm tomorrow, May 25, followed by a game against Chinese Taipei (0-3) on Sunday night that will mark the close of the group campaign.

text: Ang duha sa pinakamataas nga teams amo ang magaabanse sa knockout semifinals nga magasugod sa Martes sa masunod nga semana.
english: The top two teams will advance to the knockout semifinals starting on Tuesday next week.

text:
Ginplastar ni Mayor
Eugene Gallo Reyes sang Buenavista, Guimaras ang iya mga plano
kadungan sang iya pormal na nga pagpungko bilang alkalde sang
nasambit nga banwa sa iya ikatatlo nga termino.
english:
Mayor laid out
Eugene Gallo Reyes of Buenavista, Guimaras his plans
on the occasion of his formal inauguration as mayor of
said town in his third term.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo
Radyo Iloilo kay Mayor Reyes, iya ginpahayag nga sentrohan niya ang
pagdihon sang ordinansa nga magadumili sang pagbaligya sang sigarilyo
sa banwa kag ordinansa nga nagahatag sang incentives kag assistance
sa mga senior citizens nga nagaedad 90-anyos pasaka.
english:
In an interview with Bombo
Radyo Iloilo to Mayor Reyes, he said he will focus on
enactment of an ordinance to prohibit the sale of cigarettes
to the town and ordinance providing incentives and assistance
to senior citizens aged 90 years and above.

text:
Suno sa alkalde, iya man
tinguhaan nga mapalapad kag mapaayo ang terminal sang pumboats sa
Buenavista Wharf para mangin convenient sa mga pasahero nga nagatabok
halin sa Guimaras pakadto sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english:
According to the mayor, he also
try to expand and improve the pumboats terminal in
Buenavista Wharf to be convenient for passengers crossing
from Guimaras to Iloilo City.

text:
Positibo man ang opisyal
nga ma-umpisahan  na sa labing madali nga panahon ang pagtukod sang
taytay nga magakonekta sang Panay kag Guimaras pakadto sa Negros.
english:
The officer also tested positive
that the construction of the
bridge that will connect Panay and Guimaras to Negros.

text: Suno sa natungdan, may patigayunon nga public scoping sa munisipyo sang Buenavista sa palaabuton nga Hulyo 17,2019 nga pagatambungan sang mga stakeholders kag iban nga involved sa nasambit nga proyekto lakip na ang mga tiglawas sang Chinese government nga amo ang magapondo sa proyekto.
english: He said a public scoping will be held in the municipality of Buenavista on July 17, 2019 which will be attended by stakeholders and others involved in the project including representatives of the Chinese government who will fund the project.

text:
Samtang, nagpangayo sang
pasaylo si Reyes sa kapaslawan sini nga magtambong sa oath-taking
sang bag-o nga set sang elected officials sa probinsya sang Guimaras
sang Hunyo 29.
english:
Meanwhile, asked for
Reyes apologizes for failing to attend oath-taking
of the new set of elected officials in the province of Guimaras
on June 29.

text:
Suno sa alkalde, may
conflict sa iya schedule sang amo nga adlaw  bangud may gintambungan
ini nga kasal.
english:
According to the mayor, there is
conflict with his schedule that day because he attended
this wedding.

text:
Apang ginpahayag niya nga
naka-oath-taking naman siya sa Malacañang  upod sa iban nga
nagdalaug nga miembro sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng
Bayan ( PDP-Laban) sa atubang mismo ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte
sadtong Hunyo 25,2019.
english:
But he stated that
he was sworn-in in Malacañang along with other
winning member of the Democratic Party of the Philippines
Bayan (PDP-Laban) in front of President Rodrigo Duterte
on June 25,2019.

text: Magapabilin sa kustodiya sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands si former President Rodrigo Duterte matapos nagdesisyon ang Appeals Chamber nga ibasura ang iya apelar para sa interim release.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte will remain in the custody of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands after the Appeals Chamber decided to reject his appeal for interim release.

text: Unanimous ang desisyon sang chamber.
english: The chamber's decision was unanimous.

text: “Having rejected the three grounds of appeal, the appeals chamber unanimously confirms the impugned decision,” suno sa desisyon nga ginbasa ni presiding judge Luz Del Carmen Ibañez sa open court.
english: “Having rejected the three grounds of appeal, the appeals chamber unanimously confirms the impugned decision,” according to the decision read by presiding judge Luz Del Carmen Ibañez in open court.

text: Sa ruling, ginpaboran sang Appeals ang nauna nga desisyon sang Pre-Trial Chamber I kun sa diin una na nga ginplastar nga bisan ang temporaryo nga paghilway sa anay presidente ang makadala sang risgo sa mga testigo, mga ebidensya, kag sa integridad sang imbestigasyon.
english: In the ruling, the Appeals upheld the previous decision of the Pre-Trial Chamber I which had previously held that even the temporary release of the former president could pose a risk to witnesses, evidence, and the integrity of the investigation.

text: Wala nagtambong si Duterte sa hearing kag ang nagtiglawas sa iya amo ang lead counsel sang defense nga si Atty. Nicholas Kaufman.
english: Duterte did not attend the hearing and was represented by defense lead counsel Atty. Nicholas Kaufman.

text: Sa una nga statement ni Kaufman, ginsiling nila nga mahimo maplastar sang defense team ang ICC Rule 118 nga naga-require sang Pre-Trial Chamber nga irepaso ang status sang detainee sa kada 120 days kag magpatigayon sang at least isa ka hearing kada tuig.
english: In Kaufman’s initial statement, they said the defense team could lay out ICC Rule 118, which requires the Pre-Trial Chamber to review a detainee’s status every 120 days and conduct at least one hearing per year.

text: Wala na nakahambal si Kaufman sa pagbasa sang desisyon subong nga hapon.
english: Kaufman was speechless at the reading of the decision this afternoon.

text: More on this shortly.
english: More on this shortly.

text: Bilog na nga syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo ang ginpasaka sa Wind Signal No.
english: The entire city and province of Iloilo have been placed under Wind Signal No.

english: 4 based on the 8 am weather bulletin of PAGASA.

english: Signal No.

text: Signal no.
english: Signal no.

english: 3 the rest of Aklan and the rest of Antique including the Caluya Islands.

text: Naka-landfall na ang bagyo sa Silago, Leyte; sa Borbon, Cebu; kag sa Sagay City, Negros Occidental kag gina-forecast nga maglaslas sa Visayas kag northern Palawan antes ini magtuhaw sa West Philippine Sea buwas sa aga.
english: The typhoon has already made landfall in Silago, Leyte; in Bourbon, Cebu; and Sagay City, Negros Occidental and is forecast to strike the Visayas and northern Palawan before emerging in the West Philippine Sea tomorrow morning.

text:
Ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa Sagay City, Negros Occidental dala ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 150 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 205 km/h.

Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h.

Magaguwa ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility buwas sa gab-i ukon sa Huwebes sang aga.
english:
The center of the typhoon was last spotted in Sagay City, Negros Occidental with winds of 150 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 205 km/h.

It is moving in the direction west northwest at a speed of 25 km/h.

It will appear in the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility tomorrow night or Thursday morning.

text: Makatalandog balatyagon ang anom ka tuig nga bata sa China sa iya nangin lihok sa pagsapupo sa iya nga amay.
english: A six-year-old boy in China is touched by his move to adopt his father.

text: Ang mag-amay na lang ang nagapangabuhi.
english: Only the father and son are living.

text: Ini bangud nga ginbayaan si Tian Haicheng, 38 anyos sang iya nga asawa kag mismo ang anak niya na lang nga anom ka tuig ang nagatatap sa iya ilabi pa nga disabled na ini bangud sa pagka aksidente sa salakyan.
english: This is because Tian Haicheng, 38, was abandoned by his wife and his six-year-old son is taking care of him especially since he is disabled due to a car accident.

text: Ang iya anak mismo ang nagaluto, nagapaninlo kag ginasiguro nga maayo ang kahimtangan sang iya nga amay.
english: His son cooks, cleans and makes sure that his father is doing well.

text: Sa una, madamo ang  indi makapati nga masarangan sang isa ka anum ka tuig nga bata nga himuon ang tanan nga responsibilidad apang makit-an sa video nga naglapta sa social media nga siya mismo ang nagabulong sa iya pilas, nagabulig sa pagkuha sang wheelchair kag nagahungit sa iya nga amay.
english: At first, many could not believe that a six-year-old child could take on all the responsibilities but a video that circulated on social media shows him treating his wounds, helping to get a wheelchair and whispering to his father.

text: Bangud sa bulig sang anak ni Tian, nalampuwasan niya ang depresyon kag nagalaum sa maayo nga bwas damlag sang iya anak.
english: With the help of Tian's son, she overcame depression and hopes for a better future for her son.

text: Madamo ang nagdayaw sa pagpalangga sang anak sa iya nga amay apang may yara naman sang may nasubuan bangud nga kuntani nagahampang pa ang bata apang ini ang wala na niya ma eksperyensyahan sa responsibilidad nga iya kinahanglan himuon agud nga mabuhi sila sang iya amay.
english: Many praised the son's love for his father but there were those who were sad because the child was still playing but he did not experience the responsibility that he had to do to support his father.

text: Madugang-dugangan ang balor nga kinahanglan i-preparar para sa plane tickets para sa nagaplano nga magbyahe sa Agusto.
english: The value of plane tickets for those planning to travel in August will increase.

text: Sa advisory sang Civil Aeronautics Board, nakasaad nga may yara sang pagsaka sa fuel surcharge bilang pagsunod man sa global prices.
english: In the advisory of the Civil Aeronautics Board, it is stated that there will be an increase in the fuel surcharge in compliance with global prices.

text: Sa masunod nga bulan, mahimo na ini nga Level 6 halin sa Level 5 subong nga Hulyo.
english: Next month, it will be Level 6 from Level 5 this July.

text: Base sa trackers sang International Air Transport Association, ang presyo sang jet fuel ang nagsaka sang tres porsyento pa- $103.5 per barrel as of July 12 sa monthly comparison.
english: Based on the trackers of the International Air Transport Association, the price of jet fuel rose by three percent to $103.5 per barrel as of July 12 in monthly comparison.

text: Sa matrix sang CAB, ang Level 6 ang nagapatuman sang fuel surcharge nga P185 to P665 sa domestic flights kag P610.37 to P4,538.4 sa foreign trips.
english: In the CAB matrix, Level 6 imposes a fuel surcharge of P185 to P665 on domestic flights and P610.37 to P4,538.4 on foreign trips.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa projection, maganubo ang air travel demand sa Agusto kumpara sa Hulyo bangud naka-schedule naman nga magbalik sa klase ang mga eskwelahan.
english: It is known that based on the projection, air travel demand will decrease in August compared to July as schools are scheduled to return to classes.

text: Nagalaslas subong ang Bagyo Tino sa Camotes Islands kag may dala nga makusog nga hangin samtang nagahinampot sa Cebu.
english: Typhoon Tino is now raging in the Camotes Islands and is bringing strong winds as it approaches Cebu.

text: Base sa 5:00 a.m. weather bulletin sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ulihi nga nakit-an ang mata sang bagyo sa kadagatan nga sakop sang San Francisco, Cebu.
english: Based on the 5:00 a.m. weather bulletin of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the eye of the typhoon was last seen in the waters of San Francisco, Cebu.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 150 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 205 km/h. Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h.

WIND SIGNALS SA WESTERN VISAYAS

Nagapabilin sa Wind Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of 150 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 205 km/h. It is moving in a westward direction at a speed of 25 km/h.

WIND SIGNALS IN WESTERN VISAYAS

Remains on Wind Signal No.

text: 4 ang Iloilo City kag ang mga areas nga sakop sang central kag southern portions sang probinsya san Iloilo bangud sa Bagyo Tino.
english: 4 Iloilo City and the areas covered by the central and southern portions of the province of Iloilo due to Typhoon Tino.

english: Under this signal number, there is a warning lead-time of 12 hours, a wind speed range of 118 to 184 km/h, and a serious threat to human life and property.

english: These areas include Calinog, New Lucena, Maasin, Oton, Concepcion, Pavia, Dueñas, Barotac Nuevo, Guimbal, Ajuy, Iloilo City, Tigbauan, Anilao, San Miguel, Leon, Mina, Santa Barbara, Barotac Viejo, Leganes, Dingle, Zarraga, Bingawan, Bingawan, Cabat, San Gas, Duman, Duman Joaquin, San Rafael, San Enrique, Badiangan, Banate, City of Passi, Pototan, Lambunao, Lemery, Tubungan, Igbaras, Janiuay, Miagao, San Dionisio, and Sara.

english: Guimaras and the southern portion of Antique including Valderrama, Patnongon, San Remigio, Sibalom, Belison, San Jose, Hamtic, Tobias Fornier, Anini-Y, and Bugasong are also under signal number 4.

english: 2 Aklan and the rest of Capiz and the rest of Antique including the Caluya Islands.

text: Kaina sang 12:00 sang tungang gab-i, nag-landfall ang bagyo sa Silago, Southern Leyte.
english: Yesterday at 12:00 midnight, the typhoon made landfall in Silago, Southern Leyte.

text: Base sa track forecast, magalabay ini sa Visayas.
english: Based on the track forecast, it will pass through the Visayas.

text: 2:00 karon sa hapon, ginalantaw nga magalabay ang bagyo sa coastal waters sang Patnongon, Antique antes magdiretso sa Palawan.
english: 2:00 pm today, the typhoon is expected to pass through the coastal waters of Patnongon, Antique before heading to Palawan.

text: Buwas sa aga, magatuhaw ang bagyo sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Tomorrow morning, a typhoon will emerge in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Maga-guwa ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) sa buwas sang gab-i ukon sa Huwebes sang aga.
english: It will leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) tomorrow night or Thursday morning.

text: Bangud magaagi ini sa kabukiran sang Visayas, magahina ini apang magapabilin nga yara sa typhoon category samtang yari diri sa Pilipinas.
english: As it will pass through the mountains of the Visayas, it will weaken but remain in the typhoon category while here in the Philippines.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagtaas naman ang tyansa nga mangin isa ka Tropical Depression sa masunod nga 24 oras ang isa ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga yara sa guwa sang PAR.
english: Meanwhile, a Low Pressure Area (LPA) outside the PAR is likely to become a Tropical Depression in the next 24 hours.

text: Ulihi ini nga nakit-an sa kalayuon nga 2,165 km nasidlangan sang northeastern Mindanao.#
english: It was last seen 2,165 km east of northeastern Mindanao.#

text: Nahatagan sang daku nga oportunidad ang Filipino K-pop boy band nga Hori7on nga maka-perform sa opening ceremonies sang 2024 Winter Youth Olympics sa Gangwon province sa South Korea sa Byernes, Enero 19.
english: Filipino K-pop boy band Hori7on was given a great opportunity to perform at the opening ceremonies of the 2024 Winter Youth Olympics in Gangwon province in South Korea on Friday, January 19.

text: Ang banda ang ginabug-usan nanday Vinci Malizon, Kim Ng, Kyler Chua, Reyster Yton, Winston Pineda, Jeromy Batac kag Marcus Cabais.
english: The band consists of Vinci Malizon, Kim Ng, Kyler Chua, Reyster Yton, Winston Pineda, Jeromy Batac and Marcus Cabais.

text: Suno sa International Olympic Committee, sa amo nga event, pangunahan sang Korean singer nga si Taeyon ang lista sang performers.
english: According to the International Olympic Committee, at the event, Korean singer Taeyon will lead the list of performers.

text: Patigayunon ang opening events sang quadrennial meet sa PyeongChang Dome kag sa Gangneung Oval nga amo man ang gingamit sang 2018 Winter Olympics.
english: The opening events of the quadrennial meet will be held at the PyeongChang Dome and the Gangneung Oval, which was also used during the 2018 Winter Olympics.

text: Magalibot ang kahiwatan sa tema nga ‘The Universe’ nga naga-simbolo sang madamo nga posibilidad para sa mga kabataan.
english: The event will revolve around the theme of ‘The Universe’ which symbolizes the many possibilities for children.

text: Nahibaluan na tatlo ka mga Pinoy athletes ang magapakigbahin sa Winter Youth Olympic Games lakip ang speed skater nga si Peter Groseclose, freestyle skier nga si Laetaz Amihan Rabe, kag cross-country skier nga si Avery Balbanida.#
english: Three Filipino athletes will participate in the Winter Youth Olympic Games including speed skater Peter Groseclose, freestyle skier Laetaz Amihan Rabe, and cross-country skier Avery Balbanida.

text: Gin-activate na sang 61st Infantry Battalion ang ila Hunter Emergency Action Response Team (HEART) bilang preparasyon sa pagresponde sa mga maapektuhan sang Bagyo Tino.
english: The 61st Infantry Battalion has activated its Hunter Emergency Action Response Team (HEART) in preparation to respond to those affected by Typhoon Tino.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Lt.

english: Col.

english: Jekyll Julian Dulawan, Commanding Officer of the 61st IB, said the soldiers are on standby for search and rescue, relief distribution, rescue of those stranded in the floods, and other needs of the affected.

text: Nakapreparar naman ang military ambulance, trucks, kag iban pa nga mga kagamitan.
english: Military ambulances, trucks, and other equipment are ready.

text: Ang HEART sa idalum sang pagdumala ni Lt.
english: HEART under the leadership of Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

english: Dulawan coordinates with Local Government Units (LGUs), Office of Civil Defense, and other agencies for organized security.

text: Ginpahanumdom man nila ang publiko nga magpabilin nga alerto, magsunod sa mandu sang otoridad, kag mag-monitor sang opisyal nga weather updates.
english: They also reminded the public to remain alert, follow the orders of the authorities, and monitor official weather updates.

text: Dugang pa ni Lt.
english: He added that Lt.
