english: Col.

text: Dulawan, nagahiwat man sila sang training sa water search and rescue kag first aid para sa local volunteers kag barangay tanod sa Iloilo kag Antique, agud mapabakod ang kapasidad sang pumuluyo sa pagresponde sa kalamidad.
english: Dulawan, they are also conducting training in water search and rescue and first aid for local volunteers and barangay tanods in Iloilo and Antique, to strengthen the capacity of the people to respond to disasters.

text: Kun kahapon gintutukan ang imbukada nga sambuwa sa tunga sang Boston Celtics kag Indiana Pacers sa Eastern Conference Finals, magaliso naman sa subong nga adlaw ang atensyon sa hampang sang Dallas Mavericks kag Minnesota Timberwolves sa Game 1 sa Western Conference finals.
english: If yesterday was the focus of the opening match between the Boston Celtics and Indiana Pacers in the Eastern Conference Finals, today's attention will turn to the match between the Dallas Mavericks and Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 1 of the Western Conference finals.

text: Matabo ini sa homecourt sang Wolves sa Target Center sa Minneapolis 8:30 sa aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: It will take place at the Wolves' homecourt at the Target Center in Minneapolis at 8:30 am Philippine time.

text: Antes nakaabot sa finals, ginlutos sang third-seeded nga Timberwolves ang defending champions nga Denver Nuggets sa Game 7 sa second round.
english: Before reaching the finals, the third-seeded Timberwolves defeated the defending champions Denver Nuggets in Game 7 in the second round.

text: Sa pihak nga bracket, ginlutos sang No.
english: In the other bracket, No.

text: 5 seed nga Dallas ang Oklahoma City Thunder sa anum ka games.
english: 5 seed Dallas the Oklahoma City Thunder in six games.

text: Magluwas nga maayo ang record sang Wolves sa regular season ipaanggid sa Mavs, may yara pa sila sang home court advantage sa third round sang best-of-seven series.
english: Besides the Wolves having a good regular season record compared to the Mavs, they still have home court advantage in the third round of the best-of-seven series.

text: Isa ang yara sa injury report sang Wolves nga amo si Mike Conley nga wala man nakahampang sa Game 5 sang semis apang nakabalik sa duha ka ulihi nga hampang batok sa Nuggets.
english: One is on the injury report for the Wolves which is Mike Conley who also missed Game 5 of the semis but returned for the last two games against the Nuggets.

text: Sa Mavs, ginlista nga probable ang All-Star forward nga si Luka Doncic gani posible nga available man ini sa hampang apisar sang iya nga sprain sa tuo nga tiil.
english: For the Mavs, All-Star forward Luka Doncic is listed as probable and is likely to be available for the game despite his right foot sprain.

text: Sa nagligad nga season,matandaan nga napierde ang Timberwolves sa first round samtang wala naman ang Mavs sa playoffs.
english: Last season, the Timberwolves lost in the first round while the Mavs were not in the playoffs.

text: Kun sin-o ang magdaog sa duha amo ang maga-abanse sa finals batok sa winner sa tunga sang Boston Celtics kag Indiana Pacers.
english: The winner of the two will advance to the finals against the winner between the Boston Celtics and Indiana Pacers.

text: 1-0 na ang serye sa pihak pabor sa Boston matapos ang Game 1, 133-128.
english: The series was 1-0 in favor of Boston after Game 1, 133-128.

text: Nagmandu ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga temporaryo nga i-suspinde ang pagbaligya sang vape products online.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has ordered a temporary suspension of the sale of vape products online.

text: Sa idalom sang Department Administrative Order No.
english: Under Department Administrative Order No.

text: 24-03, series of 2024 nga ginpaguwa ni Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual, nakasaad ang mandu sa e-marketplace operators nga suspendihon ang online sale, distribution, kag advertising sang vapor products kag devices.
english: 24-03, series of 2024 issued by Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual, orders e-marketplace operators to suspend the online sale, distribution, and advertising of vapor products and devices.

text: Suno sa trade department, tugutan lang sini liwat ang online selling kun maka-demonstar ang e-marketplace sang maayo nga mga tikang agud masigurado nga nagasunod ang online sellers sa proof-of-age verification kag tanan nga mandatory legal requirements sa idalom sang Republic Act No.
english: According to the trade department, it will only allow online selling again if the e-marketplace can demonstrate good measures to ensure that online sellers comply with proof-of-age verification and all mandatory legal requirements under Republic Act No.

text: 11900 ukon Vaporized Nicotine and Non-Nicotine Products Regulation Act.
english: 11900 or Vaporized Nicotine and Non-Nicotine Products Regulation Act.

text: Sa idalom sang nasambit nga layi, nakasaad nga indi pwede baligyaan sang vape products ang mga kustomer nga wala pa nakatapak sa edad nga 18-anyos.
english: Under the said law, it is prohibited to sell vape products to customers who have not reached the age of 18 years.

text: Ginmanduan man ang online sellers nga magpasa sang nagakaigu nga IDs, permits and licenses, valid government-issued IDs, business permits halin sa local government unit, registration sa DTI, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) ukon Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) kag registration sa Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).
english: Online sellers were also directed to submit proper IDs, permits and licenses, valid government-issued IDs, business permits from the local government unit, registration with the DTI, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) and registration with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).

text: Ang nasambit nga tikang sang DTI ang kasunod man sang ginpahayag maka-alarma na nga numero sang bayolasyon partikular sa pagbaligya sang vapes sa mga menor de edad sa e-marketplaces.
english: The DTI's move also follows the reportedly alarming number of violations particularly in the sale of vapes to minors in e-marketplaces.

text: Nagbalos sang kontra-atake ang Pakistan sa mga air base sang India matapos ang ginreport nga pagtupa sang mga missile halin sa India sa tatlo ka air base sang Pakistan.
english: Pakistan counter-attacked Indian air bases after missiles from India reportedly landed on three Pakistani air bases.

text: Ginpahayag sang militar sang Pakistan nga gintarget nila kag gin-igo ang madamo nga mga pasilidad sang militar sa India kag sa ginakabig nga India-administered Kashmir.
english: The Pakistani military claimed to have targeted and struck numerous military facilities in India and what is considered Indian-administered Kashmir.

text: Lakip sa mga gin-atake nga target amo ang Brigade Headquarters sa KG Top, Field Supply Depot sa Uri, Artillery Gun Position sa Derangyari, BrahMos battery site sa Nagrota, Udhampur airfield, Pathankot airfield, kag Suratgarh airfield.
english: Among the targets attacked were Brigade Headquarters at KG Top, Field Supply Depot at Uri, Artillery Gun Position at Derangyari, BrahMos battery site at Nagrota, Udhampur airfield, Pathankot airfield, and Suratgarh airfield.

text: Ginpunto man sang Pakistan nga kadam-an sa mga nasambit nga location yara sa malapit ukon yara mismo sa de facto border nga nagapatunga sa ginaagawan nga Kashmir region sa tunga sang New Delhi kag Islamabad.
english: Pakistan also pointed out that most of these locations are near or right on the de facto border between New Delhi and Islamabad.

text: Ginklaro sang Pakistan nga ang mga airfield nga Pathankot (Punjab state) kag Suratgarh (Rajasthan state) yara gid mismo sa sulod sang undisputed nga teritoryo sang India.
english: Pakistan has clarified that the airfields Pathankot (Punjab state) and Suratgarh (Rajasthan state) are right inside the undisputed territory of India.

text: Dugang pa sang Pakistan military, ini nga operasyon isa ka “eye for an eye” nga balos sa ginpatihan nila nga paggamit sang India sang nasambit nga mga air base sa paglunsar sang missiles batuk sa ila.
english: The Pakistan military said the operation was an “eye for an eye” in retaliation for what they believed was India's use of the said air bases to launch missiles against them.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang komento ang kampo sang Ministry of Defense sang India kag Indian Air Force sa gina-angkon sang Pakistan.
english: So far, the Indian Ministry of Defense camp and the Indian Air Force have yet to comment on Pakistan’s claim.

text: Natak-an kana bala nga magbais, mag-esplikar ukon magprangka sa tawo nga mabudlay maghangop?
english: Are you tired of arguing, explaining or being frank with someone who is difficult to understand?

text: Indi magkabalaka bangud ang isa ka Chinese online marketplace ang nagatanyag sa publiko sang tyansa nga maka-hire sang “Professional Quarreler” agud nga magtindog nga imo tiglawas.
english: Don't worry because a Chinese online marketplace is offering the public the chance to hire a “Professional Quarreler” to stand as your representative.

text: Ang ginatawag nga “quarreling by proxy” ang nagahatag sang tyansa sa tawo nga mag hire sang estranghero nga ipakigbato ini sa mga away.
english: The so-called “quarreling by proxy” gives a person the chance to hire a stranger to fight him in fights.

text: Nagabalor lamang sang  5 yuan tubtob 20 yuan ukon P34 tubtob P155 pesos ang presyo sa pag-hire sang estranghero.
english: The price of hiring a foreigner is only 5 yuan to 20 yuan or P34 to P155 pesos.

text: Manubo lamang ang bayad sa pag-hire sang imo tiglawas sa baisanay kag kumprontahay bangud ini ang ginahimo via phone call ukon text kag indi nga face to face.
english: The cost of hiring your representative is low because it is done via phone call or text and not face to face.

text: Liwat nga magasugat-anay ang banas sang box office hits nga “Barbie” kag”Oppenheimer” sa awards show sa Hollywood antes pa man ang ginakalangkagan sang tanan nga Academy Awards ukon Oscars!
english: Box office hits “Barbie” and “Oppenheimer” will cross paths again at the awards show in Hollywood before the much-anticipated Academy Awards or Oscars!

text: Pareho nga may tag-apat ka nominasyon ang duha ka nasambit nga pelikula sa Screen Actors Guild awards.
english: Both films received four nominations each at the Screen Actors Guild awards.

text: Isa sa “Barbenheimer” ang posible makakuha sa pinakamataas nga pagkilala sa amo nga show nga amo ang “Best Movie Cast” apang kinahanglan man sini atubangon ang “The Color Purple,” “Killers of the Flower Moon” kag “American Fiction”.
english: One of “Barbenheimer” is likely to get the highest recognition in that show which is “Best Movie Cast” but it will also have to face “The Color Purple,” “Killers of the Flower Moon” and “American Fiction”.

text: Sa Best Actress, nominated ang “Barbie” star nga si Margot Robbie, samtang ang iban pa sini nga nominasyon amo ang para sa supporting actor nga si Ryan Gosling ukon si Ken, kag amo man ang stunt performers sa movie.
english: In Best Actress, “Barbie” star Margot Robbie was nominated, while the other nominations were for supporting actor Ryan Gosling or Ken, as well as the stunt performers in the movie.

text: Sa Oppenheimer, nominated si Cillian Murphy sa best actor; samtang nominated man sanday Robert Downey Jr.
english: In Oppenheimer, Cillian Murphy is nominated for best actor; while Robert Downey Jr. was also nominated.

text: kag Emily Blunt sa ila nga supporting roles.
english: and Emily Blunt in their supporting roles.

text: Ginabantayan gid ang Screen Actors Guild awards bangud ginabug-usan man sang mga aktor ang pinakadaku nga grupo sang voters para sa Oscars nga patigayunon na sa Marso.
english: The Screen Actors Guild awards are closely watched as actors also make up the largest group of voters for the Oscars to be held in March.

text: Ang mga magadaog sa SAG awards ang pasidunggan sa red-carpet ceremony sa Los Angeles sa Pebrero 24.
english: The winners of the SAG awards will be honored at a red-carpet ceremony in Los Angeles on February 24.

text: Sa amo man nga event, hatagan sang lifetime achievement honor ang singer, actor kag director nga si Barbra Streisand nga amo ang star sa “Funny Girl,” “A Star is Born” kag iban pa nga classic films.
english: At the same event, singer, actor and director Barbra Streisand, the star of “Funny Girl,” “A Star is Born” and other classic films, will be given a lifetime achievement honor.

text: Gintapos sang Filipino gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo ang iya kampanya sa 2024 Asian Gymnastic Union Men’s Artistic Gymnastics Championships sa Uzbekistan nga may apat tanan ka gold medals.
english: Filipino gymnast Carlos Yulo concluded his campaign at the 2024 Asian Gymnastic Union Men’s Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Uzbekistan with a total of four gold medals.

text: Ini matapos nagpangibabaw pa gid sa duha ka iban nga kategorya nga amo ang vault kag parallel bars sang weekend.
english: This after dominating two other categories, vault and parallel bars, over the weekend.

text: Sa vault event, naka-skor siya sang 14.883; nagapangaduha ang Uzbekistan kag pangatlo ang Malaysia.
english: In the vault event, she scored 14.883; Uzbekistan is second and Malaysia is third.

text: Sa parallel bars event, naka-skor si Yulo sang 15.133 para sa gold, silver medalist ang China, samtang bronze medalist ang tumandok sang host country.
english: In the parallel bars event, Yulo scored 15.133 for the gold, silver medalist China, while the bronze medalist was the native of the host country.

text: Antes sini nga duha ka events, gold medalist man ang Pinoy Olympian sa individual all-around kag floor exercise sa amo man nga tournament.
english: Before these two events, the Pinoy Olympian was also a gold medalist in the individual all-around and floor exercise in the same tournament.

text: Isa si Yulo sa magatiglawas sang Pilipina sa gymnastics sa Paris Olympics kun sa diin makaupod man sini sanday Aleah Finnegan kag Levi Ruivivar.
english: Yulo is one of those who will represent the Philippines in gymnastics at the Paris Olympics where she will also be joined by Aleah Finnegan and Levi Ruivivar.

text: Lauman sang mga motorista ang pagnubo sa presyo sa kada litro sang Diesel kag Kerosene, samtang ang Gasoline naman ang magataas sa masunod nga semana.
english: Motorists can expect a drop in the price of diesel and kerosene per litre, while gasoline will rise next week.

text: Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director III Rodela Romero, ang “mixed movements” sa presyo sang gatong ang resulta sang oil trading sa sulod sang apat ka adlaw.
english: According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director III Rodela Romero, the “mixed movements” in fuel prices are the result of oil trading over the past four days.

text: Ang Gasolina ang possible nga wala sang adjustment ukon magasaka sang P0.20 per liter.
english: Gasoline is likely to have no adjustment or increase by P0.20 per liter.

text: Samtang ang Diesel naman ang possible maganubo sang P0.30 tubtob P0.60 per liter.
english: Meanwhile, diesel is likely to drop by P0.30 to P0.60 per liter.

text: Ang Kerosene naman ang maganubo man sang P0.60 tubtob P0.70 per liter.
english: Kerosene will also decrease by P0.60 to P0.70 per liter.

text: “Crude oil prices lost their gaining streak on the early part of the week as market participants remained cautious over the global demand outlook with top importer China experiencing slow economic growth.
english: “Crude oil prices lost their gaining streak on the early part of the week as market participants remained cautious over the global demand outlook with top importer China experiencing slow economic growth.

text: Also, there is an expectation of higher crude flows from Iran.
english: Also, there is an expectation of higher crude flows from Iran.

text:
But yesterday’s trading and relevant news showed demand optimism after US crude inventories declined.”



Inanunsyo naman sang mga oil companies ang pinal nga price adjustments sa Lunes kag ipatuman sa Martes.
english:
But yesterday’s trading and relevant news showed demand optimism after US crude inventories declined.”



Oil companies announced the final price adjustments on Monday and will be implemented on Tuesday.

english: It can be recalled that President Rodrigo Duterte called Iloilo City as the Most Shabulized City during the administration of dismissed Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: Madamo na sang mga picture ang nagalapta sa social media tuhoy sa Cardrona Bra Fence ukon mas kilala na subong bilang Bradrona.
english: Many pictures have been circulating on social media regarding the Cardrona Bra Fence or better known today as Bradrona.

text: Nag-umpisa ang ‘bra fence’ sang tuig 1999 sang natukiban nga may yara sang apat ka mga bra nga nakabutang sa kudal.
english: The bra fence began in 1999 when it was discovered that there were four bras on the fence.

text: Nangin kontrobersyal ang ini nga tourist attraction sa Central Otago, New Zealand bangud sa madamo nga bra nga nakabutang sa kudal sa kilid lamang sang dalan.
english: This tourist attraction in Central Otago, New Zealand has become controversial because of the many bras placed on the fence just off the road.

text: Apisar nangin atraksyon ang nasambit nga kudal, madamo naman ang nagpakamalaot bangud sa kahuy-anan nga ginatuga sini sa lugar kag delikado para sa mga driver bangud mahimo nga ang atensyon ang yara na sa kudal kag indi sa dalan.
english: Although the fence has become an attraction, many have criticized it for the embarrassment it causes in the area and the danger for drivers because the attention may be on the fence and not on the road.

text: Kinahanglan lamang nga kuhaon sang babayi ang iya nga bra kag ibutang sa kudal.
english: The woman just needs to take off her bra and put it on the fence.

text: Katuyuan sang Bradrona amo ang makabulig sa mga tawo nga may breast cancer pinaagi sa paghatag sang donasyon sang mga tawo nga nagabisita sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: The purpose of Bradrona is to help people with breast cancer by providing donations from people who visit the said place.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Nagnawagan ang isa ka union sang mga mamumugon nga buhinan ang kontribusyon sa Philippine Health Insurance Company (PhilHealth) sa tunga sang manubo nga sweldo sang madamo nga mga empleyado kag pag-utilize sang gobyerno sang idle funds sang state health insurer.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — A labor union has called for a reduction in contributions to the Philippine Health Insurance Company (PhilHealth) amid the low salaries of many employees and the government’s utilization of the state health insurer’s idle funds.

text: Suno kay Federation of Free Workers (FFW) president Sonny Matula, indi patas nga buhinan ang gamay nga sweldo sang isa kon halos wala na sang bisan ano nga mabaton sa sweldo.
english: According to Federation of Free Workers (FFW) president Sonny Matula, it is not fair to reduce one's small salary when there is almost nothing to receive in salary.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang Republic Act 11223 ukon ang Universal Health Care Law nagasiling nga sa tagsa ka tion nga ang aktwal nga reserba magsobra sa kinahanglanon nga ceiling sa katapusan sang tuig, ang sobra sang PhilHealth reserve fund pagagamiton sa pagdugang sang mga benepisyo sang Programa kag sa pagpanubo sang kantidad sang mga kontribusyon sang mga katapo sini.
english: He also stated that Republic Act 11223 or the Universal Health Care Law states that whenever the actual reserve exceeds the required ceiling at the end of the year, the excess of the PhilHealth reserve fund shall be used to increase the benefits of the Program and to reduce the amount of its members’ contributions.

text: Ginpanawagan man sang Federation of Free Workers nga gamiton ang ginreport nga P89 billion nga wala magamit kag idle funds sang PhilHealth para sa pet projects, nga mahimo kuntani magamit sa pagpauswag sang healthcare system sang pungsod.
english: The Federation of Free Workers also called for the use of the reported P89 billion unused and idle funds of PhilHealth for pet projects, which could have been used to improve the country's healthcare system.

text: Una na nga nagreport sang numero si Independent health advocate Dr. Tony Leachon, nga suno sa iya mahimo gamiton sa pag-address sang mataas nga pagbayad sang premium kag pagpauswag sang manubo nga mga benepisyo sa ospital, kag iban pa.
english: Independent health advocate Dr. Tony Leachon, which he said could be used to address high premium payments and improve low hospital benefits, among others.

text: Ang Department of Finance una nga nagdepensa nga ang paggamit sang wala magamit pundo gikan sa PhilHealth kag iban pa nga mga kumpanya sang estado “more prudent” sangsa paghulam ukon pagpatuman sang buhis.
english: The Department of Finance initially defended that using unused funds from PhilHealth and other state-owned companies is “more prudent” than borrowing or imposing taxes.

text: Suno naman kay Vilma Garcia, Federation of Free Workers board member kag union president sang De La Salle Health and Medical Sciences Inc.
english: Vilma Garcia, Federation of Free Workers board member and union president of De La Salle Health and Medical Sciences Inc.

text: Employees Union-FFW, ang misappropriation ang isa ka daku nga disservice sa mga mamumugon nga ginakinahanglan nga mag-amot sa mga pundo gikan sa gamay nga sweldo nga gutom ang ila nabaton.
english: Employees Union-FFW, the misappropriation is a great disservice to the workers who are required to contribute to the funds from the small salary they receive.

text: Isa man ini ka dako nga lukdo sang mga propesyonal sa ikaayong lawas nga kulang ang sweldo kag ang mga barangay health workers nga wala gani nagabaton sang social protection.
english: This is also a big step for health professionals who are underpaid and barangay health workers who do not even receive social protection.

text: Una na nga gin-aprubahan sang Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) ang P35-hike sa daily minimum wage sang mga mamumugon sa Metro Manila sa diin nagsaka ini halin sa P610 tubtob P645 para sa non-agriculture sector.
english: The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) earlier approved a P35-hike in the daily minimum wage of workers in Metro Manila from P610 to P645 for the non-agriculture sector.

text: Apang ginpahayag sang Trade Union Congress of the Philippines (TUCP) nga kulang sa gihapon ang P35-hike sa daily minimum wage sang mga mamumugon sa capital region.
english: However, the Trade Union Congress of the Philippines (TUCP) said the P35-hike is still insufficient for the daily minimum wage of workers in the capital region.

text: Duha ka pasabog ang dungan nga ginbuy-an sang yoga teacher kag model nga si Alexis Suapengco — una, siya ang iloy sang anak ni Diego Loyzaga nga si Hailey, kag ikaduha, ginpalayas siya kag ang iya bata bangud sa lain nga babayi sang 28-anyos nga aktor.
english: Yoga teacher and model Alexis Suapengco released two explosions at the same time — first, she is the mother of Diego Loyzaga's daughter Hailey, and second, she and her child were kicked out because of the 28-year-old actor's different woman.

text: Ini nga alegasyon ang ginbuyagyag sa Instagram story ni Suapengco kun sa diin naka-tag pa mismo si Loyzaga.
english: This allegation was revealed on Suapengco's Instagram story where Loyzaga himself was tagged.

text:

May gin-share man ini nga Instagram profile sang babayi nga nakapangalan kay “Cecile Mendoza.”

Sunod diri amo ang isa ka separado nga post kun sa diin gin-alegar sang model nga ginhingyo sa iya sang aktor nga kakason ang iya post, bangud kun indi, indi sini pag-sustentuhan ang ila baby.
english:
It said: “So my baby daddy @diegoloyzaga decided to kick me out and his baby out of his house so this girl can come over.”

He also shared an Instagram profile of a woman named “Cecile Mendoza.”

This was followed by a separate post where the model alleged that the actor asked her to remove his post, because otherwise, he would not support their baby.

text: “@diegoloyzaga said if I don’t take down the post, he won’t provide for my daughter daw.
english: “@diegoloyzaga said if I don’t take down the post, he won’t provide for my daughter.

english:

text:

english: Why would you say that in your post?!?

english:

“Again, not denying anything else, but my baby will be taken care of definitely.”

The Instagram stories and screenshots of his conversation with Suapengco have now been deleted.

text: Ang nabilin na lamang sa story sa profile sang aktor amo ang album art sang “Trouble in Paradise” ni Ty Thom kag may “sad” emoji.
english: The only thing left in the story on the actor's profile is the album art of Ty Thom's “Trouble in Paradise” with a “sad” emoji.

text: Hunyo 2023 sang ginsapubliko ni Loyzaga nga isa na siya ka amay apang wala sang detalye kun sin-o ang iloy sang bata.
english: In June 2023, Loyzaga announced that he was a father but did not provide details on the mother of the child.

text: Sang damlag lamang, may interview kay Loyzaga kun sa diin gin-ako sini nga nagsulod siya sa rehab kag naglawig sang 14 ka bulan sang 2018 bangud sa iya nga “psychological way of thinking,” “suicidal” thoughts, kag “substances I was taking.”#
english: Recently, there was an interview with Loyzaga where he admitted that he entered rehab and lasted 14 months in 2018 because of his “psychological way of thinking,” “suicidal” thoughts, and “substances I was taking.”#

text: Nasapwan na ang bangkay sang isa ka transportation network vehicle services (TNVS) driver nga missing humalin pa sang Mayo.
english: The body of a transportation network vehicle services (TNVS) driver who has been missing since May has been found.

text: Ginkumpirma sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang pagkasapo sa bangkay sang biktima nga si Raymond Cabrera nga ginholdap kag ginpatay sang iya nga mga pasahero.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) confirmed the discovery of the body of the victim, Raymond Cabrera, who was robbed and killed by his passengers.

text: Nakit-an ini sa kahilamunan sa Bgy.
english: It was found in the grass in Bgy.

text: Batitang, Zaragoza, Nueva Ecija.
english: Batitang, Zaragoza, Nueva Ecija.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Mayo 18 pa nadula si Cabrera matapos magpasakay sang pasahero malapit sa isa ka casino hotel sa Parañaque City.
english: Cabrera disappeared on May 18 after picking up a passenger near a casino hotel in Parañaque City.

text: Kahapon sang nagsungka ang tatlo ka mga suspek kay Manila Mayor Isko Moreno kag gintudlo nila kun sa diin nila ginhaboy ang lawas sang biktima.
english: Yesterday, the three suspects surrendered to Manila Mayor Isko Moreno and pointed out where they dumped the victim's body.

text: Nagahibi kag nagapangayo naman sang pasaylo ang isa sa mga suspek kag nagsiling nga naghinulsol siya sa ginhimo nga krimen.
english: One of the suspects was crying and apologizing and said he regretted the crime.

text: Ginkilala sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) nga isa si Pope Leo XIV sa pinakamadasig nga napilian nga Santo Papa sa bug-os nga kasaysayan sang Simbahang Katolika.
english: The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) has recognized Pope Leo XIV as one of the fastest elected Popes in the history of the Catholic Church.

text: Suno kay CBCP spokesperson Fr.
english: According to CBCP spokesperson Fr.

text: Jerome Secillano, apat lang ka balota ang gin-obra sang mga cardinal antes ginpili si Cardinal Robert Prevost bilang bag-o nga lider sang simbahan.
english: Jerome Secillano, the cardinals worked on only four ballots before electing Cardinal Robert Prevost as the new leader of the church.

text: Gin-athag ni Secillano nga posible nga may ideya na ang mga cardinal parte kay Cardinal Prevost antes pa magsugod ang conclave, kag nadunggan man sang tanan ang iya background sa general congregations.
english: Secillano explained that the cardinals may have had an idea about Cardinal Prevost before the conclave began, and everyone had heard about his background in general congregations.

text: Ginpahayag man nga isa sa mga rason nga madasig ini nga nga napilian amo ang iya posisyon bilang head sang Dicastery for Bishops, isa ka mataas nga katungdanan sa Vatican.
english: It was also said that one of the reasons he was quickly elected was his position as head of the Dicastery for Bishops, a high position in the Vatican.

text: Ini nga opisina amo ang naga-ugyon sa Santo Papa sa pagpili kag pag-appoint sang mga obispo sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: This office coordinates with the Pope in the election and appointment of bishops around the world.

text: Dugang pa ni Fr.
english: Fr. added.

text: Secillano, ang pagpili sang ngalan nga “Leo” sang bag-o nga Santo Papa isa ka paathag sang iya pasidungog sa mga imol kag sa mga mamumugon, nga ginatagan sang pagpakilala kag pagrespeto.
english: Secillano, the choice of the name “Leo” by the new Pope is an explanation of his respect for the poor and the workers, who are given recognition and respect.

text: Ginpaathag man sang CBCP nga kaupod ang bug-os nga komunidad sang Katoliko sa Pilipinas sa pagbaton kag pagsuporta sa bag-o nga lider sang Simbahang Katolika.
english: The CBCP also explained that it is with the entire Catholic community in the Philippines in welcoming and supporting the new leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Mahibaluan na 5:30 karon sa hapon ang desisyon sang International Criminal Court (ICC) Appeals Chamber kaangot sa petisyon ni former President Rodrigo Duterte para sa interim release.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) Appeals Chamber's decision on former President Rodrigo Duterte's petition for interim release will be announced at 5:30 pm today.

text: Nagpirma sang waiver si Duterte agud indi na siya kinahanglan magtambong — pisikal man ukon virtual.
english: Duterte signed a waiver so that he does not have to attend — physically or virtually.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang ICC nga ang iya abogado nga si Nicholas Kaufman ang magatindog sa iya bilang representante sa hearing.
english: The ICC confirmed that his lawyer Nicholas Kaufman will stand in for him as a representative at the hearing.

text: Naka-detain ang anay punong ehekutibo sa Scheveningen Prison sang ICC sa The Hague, Netherlands umpisa sang gindakop siya sa NAIA sang Marso 11, 2025.
english: The former chief executive has been detained at the ICC's Scheveningen Prison in The Hague, Netherlands since his arrest at the NAIA on March 11, 2025.

text:
Ang kaso nga ginaatubang ni Duterte amo ang crimes against humanity nga ginaangot sa extrajudicial killings sang tion nga ginlunsar sini ang drug war kag ang mas nauna nga mga operasyon sa Davao sa pagpanguna sang “Davao Death Squad.”

Ginapanindugan sang iya kampo nga indi na ini makasarang mag-atubang sa trial bangud sa iya katigulangon.
english:
The case Duterte is facing is crimes against humanity linked to extrajudicial killings at the time he launched the drug war and earlier operations in Davao under the leadership of the “Davao Death Squad.”

His camp insists he is incompetent to stand trial due to his old age.

text: Sa ila petisyon sa korte, ginsiling nga malipaton na ang former president, gani nga nagmandu ang ICC sang medical examination.
english: In their petition to the court, they said the former president was forgetful, so the ICC ordered a medical examination.

text: Pananglitan baliskadon sang Appeals Chamber ang ruling sang ICC Pre-Trial Chamber kag tugutan ang interim release, ipaidalom si Duterte sa istrikto nga mga kondisyon sa idalom sang Rule 119 sang ICC Rules of Procedure and Evidence.
english: If the Appeals Chamber overturns the ruling of the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber and allows the interim release, Duterte will be subject to strict conditions under Rule 119 of the ICC Rules of Procedure and Evidence.

text: Lakip diri ang istrikto nga limitasyon sa pagbyahe, pagpuyo sa court-approved address, pagdumili sa iya nga makig-angot sa mga biktima kag mga testigo, kag mandatory appearances sa atubang sang awtoridad.#
english: These include strict travel restrictions, residence at a court-approved address, prohibition of his contact with victims and witnesses, and mandatory appearances before authorities.#

text: Padayon nga suspendido ang tanan nga klase sa pampubliko kag pribado nga eskwelahan sa siyudad sang Iloilo sa tanan nga lebel subong nga adlaw Nobyembre 4 tubtob buwas Nobyembre 5 suno kay Mayor Raisa Treñas.
english: All classes in public and private schools in Iloilo City at all levels remain suspended from today November 4 to tomorrow November 5, according to Mayor Raisa Treñas.

text: Gin-abiso man sang alkalde nga suspendido man subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 4, ang trabaho sa Iloilo City Government kag tanan nga government offices bilang pagpreparar sa posible nga epekto sang Bagyo Tino.
english: The mayor also warned that work in the Iloilo City Government and all government offices will also be suspended today, November 4, in preparation for the possible impact of Typhoon Tino.

text: Gina-engganyo man sang alkalde ang mga pribado nga establisyemento nga magpatuman sang pagsuspende sang mga trabaho para sa precautionary measures agud masiguro ang kaluwasan kag seguridad sang ila mga empleyado.
english: The mayor also encouraged private establishments to implement the suspension of work for precautionary measures to ensure the safety and security of their employees.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man nga suspendido man subong nga adlaw ang trabaho sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol bangud man sa bagyo, base sa kumpirmasyon sang Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office ukon PDRRMO.
english: Meanwhile, it was also reported that work at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol was also suspended today due to the typhoon, based on the confirmation of the Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO).

text: Magapabilin naman nga naka-alerto ang Emergency Operation Center kag Response Cluster Team sang Iloilo Provincial Government para sa pag-monitor sa kahimtangan sang panahon kag koordinasyon sa mga regional offices.
english: The Emergency Operation Center and Response Cluster Team of the Iloilo Provincial Government will remain on alert for weather monitoring and coordination with regional offices.

text: BINZ, GERMANY – Atensyon sa mahilig magkaon sa restaurant.
english: BINZ, GERMANY – Attention restaurant lovers.

text: Nakakita ka na bala sang restaurant nga ginadumilian ang mga kabataan nga naga edad 14 anyos panubo?
english: Have you ever seen a restaurant where children under the age of 14 are not allowed?

text: Sa Binz, Germany, wala ginapahanugutan ang mga 14 anyos panubo nga mga kabataan matapos ang alas 5:00 sang hapon sa isa ka restaurant.
english: In Binz, Germany, children under the age of 14 are not allowed after 5:00 pm in a restaurant.

text: Suno kay Rudolf Markl, tag-iya sang restaurant, indi niya luyag nga may mga kabataan nga nagasinabad sa sulod sang restaurant rason nga gin-ban niya ang mga naga edad sang 14 anyos panubo.
english: According to Rudolf Markl, owner of the restaurant, he did not want children to be loud inside the restaurant so he banned those under the age of 14 years.

text: May nahamtang man nga signage sa guwa sang restaurant nga ‘ADULT-ONLY RESTAURANT’.
english: There is also a signage outside the restaurant that says ‘ADULT-ONLY RESTAURANT’.

text: Apisar sang madamo nga pagpakamalaot sa tag-iya bangud sa ginapahayag discriminasyon, padayon nga nagapanindugan si Markl sa iya nangin desisyon.
english: Despite widespread criticism of the owner for alleged discrimination, Markl continues to stand by her decision.

text: Liwat nga ginduso sang Freedom from Debt Coalition (FDC) nga ipatuman ang wealth tax ukon ang pagsukot sang buwis sa mga manggaranon agud nga makatipon sang pondo ang gobyerno sa tunga sang nagapanglakaak sini nga utang.
english: The Freedom from Debt Coalition (FDC) has once again proposed the implementation of a wealth tax or the collection of taxes on the rich so that the government can raise funds amid its mounting debt.

text: Ginpaguwa sang grupo ini nga statement kasunod sang pag-anunsyo sang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) nga ginpatuman na sini ang 1 percent creditable withholding tax sa online sellers.
english: The group issued this statement following the announcement by the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) that it has implemented a 1 percent creditable withholding tax on online sellers.

text: Sa latest revenue memorandum circular ni BIR Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr., nakasaad nga ginamanduan ang electronic marketplace operators nga mag-impose sang withholding tax sa sellers kag merchants halin sang Hulyo 15, 2024.
english: In the latest revenue memorandum circular of BIR Commissioner Romeo Lumagui Jr., it is stated that electronic marketplace operators are directed to impose withholding tax on sellers and merchants from July 15, 2024.

text: Suno naman kay FDC Vice President Raquel Castillo, sang tion sang pandemya, ang online selling ang nakabulig sa mga tawo nga makasalbar man sa adlaw-adlaw nga kinahanglanon, gani mas maayo suno sa iya nga ang mga manggaranon ang lagson sang tax bureau ukon ang mga may ginatago nga financial flow.
english: According to FDC Vice President Raquel Castillo, during the pandemic, online selling has helped people to save on daily needs, so it is better for the rich to be pursued by the tax bureau or those who have hidden financial flow.

text: “Nung nag-pandemic, ang dami sa atin na nagsubok na magbenta online.
english: “When the pandemic hit, many of us tried to sell online.

text: Nakahanap ng paraan para magcope ang mga tao tapos madadagok naman sila dito.
english: People find a way to cope and then they get stuck here.

text: Bakit hindi mo targetin yung mas mayayaman?
english: Why not target the wealthier?

text: Habulin ninyo yung mga tao na nagtatago ng financial flows?” pahayag ni Castillo.
english: Will you chase the people who are hiding financial flows?” Castillo said.

text: Antes sini, matunog na ang panawagan sang grupo nga iimplementar ang wealth tax sa mga bilyonaryo ukon mga indibidwal nga nagalapaw na sa P300-million ang net worth.
english: Earlier, the group called for the implementation of a wealth tax on billionaires or individuals whose net worth exceeds P300-million.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang national debt sang Pilipinas ang nagsaka na sa P15.35 trillion sa katapusan sang Mayo.
english: The Philippines' national debt rose to P15.35 trillion at the end of May.

text: Ginapasalig naman sang grupo nga magapakig-angot sila sa mga mamalidha nga handa nga mag-sponsor sa ila ginaduso nga hagna.
english: The group assures that they will contact lawmakers who are willing to sponsor their proposed bill.

english: (Photo: Unbox Ph)

text: Patay ang German Hollywood actor nga si Christian Oliver kag ang iya duha ka bata nga babayi sang nagtibusok ang ila ginasakyan nga eroplano sa Carribean sea.
english: German Hollywood actor Christian Oliver and his two daughters were killed when their plane crashed in the Caribbean Sea.

text: Gintumod sang mga pulis ang mga biktima nga amo ang 51-anyos nga aktor nga Christian Klesper ang matuod nga pangalan; iya mga anak nga sanday Madita Klepser, 10, kag Annik Klepser, 12; kag ang piloto nga si Robert Sachs.
english: Police identified the victims as 51-year-old actor Christian Klesper; her children Madita Klepser, 10, and Annik Klepser, 12; and pilot Robert Sachs.

text: Naghalin ang eroplano sa Saint Vincent kag Grenadines airport sa eastern Caribbean kag padulong na kuntani sa St.
english: The plane took off from Saint Vincent and the Grenadines airport in the eastern Caribbean and was heading to St.

text: Lucia, isa ka isla sa tunga sang Caribbean Sea kag North Atlantic Ocean.
english: Lucia, an island between the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean.

text: Pila ka minutos pa lang sang naka-take off, nakit-an na nga may deperensya na sa lupad sang eroplano kag nagtibusok sa dagat apang indi pa subong matumod ang rason sang aksidente.
english: A few minutes after takeoff, the plane was found to have a flight defect and plunged into the sea but the cause of the accident has not yet been determined.

text: Kasunod sang hitabo, nagbubo ang mensahe sang kalisod ilabi na halin sa entertainment industry.
english: Following the incident, messages of grief poured in especially from the entertainment industry.

text: Kilala si Oliver sa nagkalain-lain nga film kag television roles lakip na sa 2008 action flick nga “Speed Racer,” “The Baby-Sitters Club” sang 1995 kag “The Good German” nga isa ka 2006 World War II film ni Stephen Soderbergh kun sa diin bida sanday George Clooney kag Cate Blanchett.# (GISELA SCHOBER/GETTY IMAGES)
english: Oliver is known for various film and television roles including the 2008 action flick “Speed ​​Racer,” “The Baby-Sitters Club” in 1995 and “The Good German” a 2006 World War II film by Stephen Soderbergh starring George Clooney and Cate Blanchett.

text: Nalakip ang hepe sang Digos City Police sa Davao del Sur sa mga person of interest kaangot sa pagpatay sa isa ka barangay captain samtang naka-livestream ini ukon Facebook live.
english: The chief of the Digos City Police in Davao del Sur is among the persons of interest in connection with the killing of a barangay captain while he was livestreaming or Facebook live.

text: Suno sa Police Regional Office 11 (PRO11), gin-relieve na sa iya puwesto si Digos City Police Station acting chief Police Lieutenant Colonel Peter Glenn Ipong samtang ginatutukan ang imbestigasyon bahin sa kamatayon ni Barangay Tres de Mayo captain Oscar “Dodong” Bucol Jr.
english: According to the Police Regional Office 11 (PRO11), Digos City Police Station acting chief Police Lieutenant Colonel Peter Glenn Ipong has been relieved of his post while the investigation into the death of Barangay Tres de Mayo captain Oscar “Dodong” Bucol Jr. is being focused on.

text: Ginsiling sang PRO11 nga ang director nga si Police Brigadier General Leon Victor Rosete amo ang nagmandu nga pahalinon si Ipong sa puwesto agud masiguro nga patas ang pag-imbestigar.
english: PRO11 said director Police Brigadier General Leon Victor Rosete ordered Ipong's removal to ensure a fair investigation.

text: Base sa impormasyon, namensyonar nga isa sa mga nakontra ni Bucol sa iya pag-livestream amo si Ipong.
english: Based on information, it was mentioned that one of Bucol's opponents in his livestream was Ipong.

text: Gindugang pa sa report nga may 20 ka pulis ang ginpaidalom na sa paraffin test.
english: The report added that 20 policemen have already undergone paraffin tests.

text: Naghingyo man ang pamilya sang biktima nga ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon sa krimen.
english: The victim's family also requested that the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) conduct an investigation into the crime.

text: Ginausisa man ang CCTV footage nga nakakuha sang salakyan nga ginasuspetsahan nga gingamit sang mga suspek sa pagluthang kay Bucol.
english: CCTV footage that captured the vehicle suspected to have been used by the suspects to shoot Bucol is also being examined.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang P2 milyon nga padya nga halin kay Vice President Sara Duterte kag Governor Yvonne Cagas para sa pagdakop sang mga suspek.
english: It is known that there is a P2 million reward from Vice President Sara Duterte and Governor Yvonne Cagas for the arrest of the suspects.

text: “He [Police Brigadier General Leon Victor Rosete] further directed the Davao del Sur Provincial Police Office, under the leadership of Police Colonel Leo T. Ajero, Provincial Director, to conduct a thorough and comprehensive probe, which may take one to six months depending on the complexity of the case,” suno sa statement sang PRO 11.#
english: “He [Police Brigadier General Leon Victor Rosete] further directed the Davao del Sur Provincial Police Office, under the leadership of Police Colonel Leo T. Ajero, Provincial Director, to conduct a thorough and comprehensive probe, which may take one to six months depending on the complexity of the case,” the PRO said in a statement.

Wala maswelduhan ang mga
empleyado sang munisipyo sang New Lucena,Iloilo.
english:
They were not paid
employee of the municipality of New Lucena, Iloilo.

Radyo Iloilo kay Vice-Mayor Erwin Sustento, iya ginpahayag nga tubtob
subong wala marelease ang Hunyo 1 tubtob Hunyo 15 nga sweldo sang mga

While in the interview
Mayor Christian Sorongon, he said

gintuyo man nila nga mag designate sang OIC Municipal Accountant

It's just handed over

employee.

It is known that he is on leave

text: BANGKOK, THAILAND – Atensyon sa mga tawo nga luyag mag-angkon sang instant abs.
english: BANGKOK, THAILAND – Attention people who want to get instant abs.

text: Sa Bangkok, Thailand, nag viral ang isa ka ospital nga naga tanyag sang instant six-packs abs sa mga pasyente.
english: In Bangkok, Thailand, a hospital offering instant six-packs abs to patients has gone viral.

text: Ang abs ang indi mahapos nga maangkon apisar nga mag gym pa ang isa ka tawo.
english: Abs are not easy to achieve even if a person goes to the gym.

text: Apang tungod sa mga plastic surgeons sa Masterpiece Hospital, nangin posible na ang pag-angkon sang abs sa pinakamadasig nga tion.
english: But thanks to the plastic surgeons at Masterpiece Hospital, it has become possible to achieve abs as soon as possible.

text: Pinaagi sa abdominal etching, ginakuha sang surgeon ang fat nga yara sa tyan agud nga makit-an ang six-packs abs.
english: Through abdominal etching, the surgeon removes the fat present in the abdomen to reveal six-packs abs.

text: Suno kay Raweewat “Sae” Maschamadol, Chief Executive Officer sang ospital, wala sila nagahimo sang plastic ukon silicone implants sa baylo abs-focused liposuction gid lamang.
english: According to Raweewat “Sae” Maschamadol, Chief Executive Officer of the hospital, they do not do plastic or silicone implants but only abs-focused liposuction.

text: Madamo naman ang nagahingyo sang six packs abs kada bulan sa diin ginabanta 20 tubtob 30 ka mga pasyente ang nagapadulong sa ospital.
english: Many people are asking for six packs abs every month with an estimated 20 to 30 patients coming to the hospital.

text: Bangud sa ginatanyag sang ospital, nangin kilala ini sa Thailand kag nangin viral sa social media bangud sa mga pictures nga ginapakigbahin sang ila mga customer sa pag-angkon sang six-packs abs.
english: Because of what the hospital offers, it has become well-known in Thailand and has gone viral on social media because of the pictures that their customers share of achieving six-packs abs.

text: Ginabulubanta nga masobra sang 10% sang House of Representatives ang maapektuhan sang ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon sa flood control anomalies, suno kay Ombudsman Boying Remulla.
english: It is estimated that more than 10% of the House of Representatives will be affected by the ongoing investigation into flood control anomalies, according to Ombudsman Boying Remulla.

text: Ginsiling niya ini matapos ang pagrekomendar sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag Independent Commission of Infrastructure (ICI) sang reklamo batok sa walo ka mga “congtractors” ukon mga kongresista nga may kaangtanan sa ginapahayag nga construction firms nga nakabaton sang kontrata sa DPWH projects.
english: He said this after the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and Independent Commission of Infrastructure (ICI) recommended a complaint against eight “congtractors” or congressmen linked to alleged construction firms that received contracts for DPWH projects.

text: “Madi-disrupt talaga ang Congress dito.
english: “Congress is really disruptive here.

text: Madi-disrupt sila.
english: They will be disruptive.

text: I have to talk to the (House) Speaker,” pahayag ni Remulla.
english: I have to talk to the (House) Speaker,” Remulla said.

text: Duha na ka gold medals ang nabulsa sang Pinoy gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo matapos nga nagpangibabaw pa gid sa floor exercise sa 2024 Asian Gymnastics Union Senior Men’s Artistic Gymnastic Championships sa Uzbekistan.
english: Pinoy gymnast Carlos Yulo has already bagged two gold medals after dominating the floor exercise at the 2024 Asian Gymnastics Union Senior Men’s Artistic Gymnastic Championships in Uzbekistan.

text: Naka-skor si Yulo sang 14.933 samtang nagpangaduha naman si Milad Karimi sang Kazakhstan (14.600) kag nagpangatlo si Yanzhi Yang sang China (14.200).
english: Yulo scored 14.933 while Milad Karimi of Kazakhstan was second (14.600) and Yanzhi Yang of China (14.200) was third.

text: Matandaan nga sang Huwebes, nadag-an man sang Filipino pride ang bulawan nga medalya sang nakuha sini ang 84.931 points sa individual all-around nga kategorya sa tournament.
english: On Thursday, Filipino pride also won the gold medal with 84.931 points in the individual all-around category of the tournament.

text: Ini naman ang ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga gold medal ni Yulo sa floor exercise sang Asian championships bangud siya man ang nagpangibabaw sa sini nga event sang 2022 kag 2023 editions.
english: This is Yulo's third consecutive gold medal in the floor exercise of the Asian championships as he also dominated the event in the 2022 and 2023 editions.

text: Isa si Yulo sa magatiglawas sang Pilipina sa gymnastics sa Paris Olympics kun sa diin makaupod man sini sanday Aleah Finnegan kag Levi Ruivivar.
english: Yulo is one of those who will represent the Philippines in gymnastics at the Paris Olympics where she will also be joined by Aleah Finnegan and Levi Ruivivar.

text: Halos nahitso na ang Committee Chairmanship sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo.
english: The Committee Chairmanship in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo is almost fixed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Iloilo Vice Governor Christine Garin, iya ginpahayag nga halos may yara na sang ginauyatan nga kumitiba ang tanan mga incoming Provincial Board members.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Iloilo Vice Governor Christine Garin said that almost all the incoming Provincial Board members already have a committee.

text: Suno kay Vice- Governor Garin, importante nga mas temprano ang pag-assign sang chairmanship bangud may mga outgoing board members nga magabuya sa mga kumitiba kaangay nanday board members Demy Sonza kag Leicel Seville sang second district; Lorenz Defensor kag Emmanuel Gallar sang third district; Bryant Paul Biron sang fourth district; kag Jeneda Salcedo-Orendain kag Nielo Tupas sang fifth district.
