text: SAUDI ARABIA – Atensyon sa mga kalalakihan!
english: SAUDI ARABIA – Attention men!

text: Sa pungsod Saudi Arabia, isa ka egyptian nga lalaki ang gin-dakup sang mga otoridad matapos nga nag upod lamang ini sa pagpamahaw sa isa ka babayi sa Jeddah hotel.
english: In Saudi Arabia, an Egyptian man was arrested by authorities after he accompanied a woman to breakfast at a Jeddah hotel.

text: Nakit-an sa social media ang short video nga ginpost ni Bahaa nga ginpakamalaot sang mga tawo sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: A short video posted by Bahaa was found on social media and was condemned by people in the country.

text: Ang ini ng sahi nga lihok amo ang paglapas sa layi sa Saudi Arabia sa diin nasaad nga ang mga kalan-an kag ginatrabahuan ang may separado nga lugar para sa mga lalaki kag babayi.
english: This type of behavior is a violation of the law in Saudi Arabia which stipulates that restaurants and workplaces have separate areas for men and women.

text: Depensa naman ni Bahaa, wala sang malain sa nangin lihok nila sang iya co-worker bangud nagakaon lamang sila sang pamahaw.
english: Bahaa said there was nothing wrong with his co-worker's actions because they were just eating breakfast.

text: Mahimo naman nga ma deport ang lalaki bangud sa ginakabig sala nga iya ginhimo.
english: The man could be deported for the alleged crime.

text: Ini ang pagkabig ni anay presidential spokesperrson Atty. Harry Roque tuhoy sa ginapangatubang sini nga inciting to sedition charges.
english: This is the view of former presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque regarding the inciting to sedition charges he is facing.

text: Suno kay Roque, “badge of honor” ini bangud sa ginakontra na sang gobyerno ang mga tawo.
english: According to Roque, this is a “badge of honor” because the government is already opposing the people.

text: “So ang sinasabi ko as a long term advocate for freedom of expression, hinding-hindi ka pwedeng magpakulong for speech unless there is a clear and present danger,” pahayag niya.
english: “So what I am saying as a long term advocate for freedom of expression, you cannot go to jail for speech unless there is a clear and present danger,” he said.

text: Gindepensahan naman ni Roque ang pagguwa niya sang “polvoron” video nga nangin basehan para i-reklamo siya sang inciting to sedition.
english: Roque defended his release of the “polvoron” video which became the basis for a complaint of inciting to sedition.

text: “That’s never incitement to sedition.
english: “That’s never incitement to sedition.

text: Its freedom of expression and the right of the people to information on matters affecting their everyday lives,” dugang pa.
english: Its freedom of expression and the right of the people to information on matters affecting their everyday lives,” he added.

text:
Kapin
sa duha ka milyon ka mga tawo ang nagpakigbahin sa pinakaulihi nga
mass protest sa Hong Kong batok sa kontrobersiyal nga extradition
bill.
english:
Kapin
over two million people participated in the latest
mass protest in Hong Kong against controversial extradition
bill.

text:
Sa
interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo International Correspondent
Merly Bunda direkta sa Hong Kong, iya ginpahayag nga narekord ang 
pinakadako nga protesta sa maragtas sang rehiyon sang nagtipon ang
mga pumuluyo sa pihak sang suspension sang hagna nga nagapahanugot
sang extradition gikan sa Hong Kong pakadto sa mainland China.
english:
In
Bombo Radyo's interview with Bombo International Correspondent
Merly Bunda directly in Hong Kong, he said recorded the 
largest protest in the history of the region when the
residents despite the suspension of the bill allowing
of extradition from Hong Kong to mainland China.

text:
Suno
kay Bunda, apisar nga nagpangayo na sang pasaylo ang Hong Kong leader
nga si Carrie Lam  bangud sa pagproponer sang hagna, apang wala
nakontento diri ang mga tawo.
english:
Dream
to Bunda, despite the Hong Kong leader's apology
that Carrie Lam for proposing the bill, but did not
people are satisfied here.

text:
Ginpahayag
ni Bunda nga luyag sang mga pumuluyo nga magresign si Lam kag dulaon
ang hagna sa baylo nga suspendihon lang.
english:
Declared
Bunda says residents want Lam to resign and get rid of
the bill instead of just suspending it.

text:
Nahibaluan
nga sa nasambit nga hagna, nasaad nga sayluhon gikan sa Hongkong kag
pagadal-on sa China ang mga nagapangatubang sang kaso agud didto
pamatbatan.
english:
Known
that in the said bill, it is promised to be transferred from Hong Kong and
those facing charges will be taken to China to be there
justification.

text: Nagpadala ang Iloilo City Government sang doctors kag nurses agud nga ma-check ang evacuees nga nagalain ang pamatyag ilabi na ang mga kabataan kag ang mga may edad na.
english: The Iloilo City Government sent doctors and nurses to check the evacuees who are feeling unwell especially the children and the elderly.

text: Sa post ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, ginsiling sini nga ginasigurado man nga may mga bulong nga mahatag sa mga nagamasakit subong nga malain ang tyempo.
english: In a post, Mayor Raisa Treñas said that they are also ensuring that there are medicines to be given to those who are sick during the bad weather.

text: “Clinic, kag naga-roving nga doktor kag nurse agud ma check ang mga evacuees nga nagalain ang pamatyag, especially ang aton seniors kag kabataan,” suno kay Treñas.
english: “Clinic, and roving doctors and nurses to check the evacuees who are feeling unwell, especially our seniors and children,” Treñas said.

text:
“Pharmacy, ini agud may ready kita nga mga meds in kaso may maglain ang pamatyag ilabi na subong nga tyempo sang trangkaso bangud sang malain nga panahon.”

Activated man ang community kitchen nga amo ang nagapreparar sang pagkaon para sa mga residente nga nagkadto anay sa evacuation centers.
english:
“Pharmacy, this is so that we have ready meds in case someone feels unwell especially during this flu season due to bad weather.”

The community kitchen, which prepares food for residents who went to evacuation centers, is also activated.

text: As of 8:00 p.m. nga report sang City Government, may preemptive evacuation sa 24 ka mga barangay kun sa diin may 575 ka mga pamilya ang apektado.
english: As of 8:00 p.m. report of the City Government, there is preemptive evacuation in 24 barangays where 575 families are affected.

text: Nalakip ang Iloilo sa ginpasaka sa Heavy Rainfall Red Warning subong nga gab-i bangud sa bagyo.#
english: Iloilo was among those placed under Heavy Rainfall Red Warning tonight due to the typhoon.

text: THAILAND – Mahilig ka bala sa kuring?
english: THAILAND – Are you a cat lover?

text: Ang lalaki sa Thailand nga si Lomphonten Lomphontan  ang nagdesisyon nga magbutang sang hidden camera sa sulod sang iya nga kwarto agud nga mabantayan kag mahibaluan kun ano ang ginahimo sang iya alaga nga kuring samtang yara siya sa trabaho.
english: A man in Thailand named Lomphonten Lomphontan decided to install a hidden camera inside his bedroom to monitor and know what his pet cat is doing while he is at work.

text: Nakibot na lamang si Lomphonten nga sa kada gab-i, nagatulog ang kuring sa iya nga nawong.
english: Lomphonten was surprised to find that every night, the cat slept on his face.

text: Nangin routine na sang kuring  nga tulogan ang nawong sang iya amo.
english: It became a routine for the cat to sleep on his master's face.

text: Magluwas sini, daw kaangay nga nakahibalo man ang kuring nga mag hampang kag maglango-lango sa atubang sang camera.
english: Besides, the cat seems to know how to play and dance in front of the camera.

text: Mas ginplangga naman ni Lomphonten ang iya nga kuring bangud sa nangin lihok sini sa diin nangin bantog ang mga ini sa bilog nga kalibutan bangud sa naglapta nila nga mga pictures.
english: Lomphonten loved his dog more because of his actions where they became famous all over the world because of their pictures.

text: Nagsentro ang mensahe ni Pope Leo XIV sa pagdala sang kalinong kag koneksyon ukon paghiliusa sa kalibutan sa iya labing-una nga pag-atubang sa mga tumuluo sa Vatican matapos ini na-eleher bilang Santo Papa.
english: Pope Leo XIV's message focused on bringing peace and connection or unity to the world in his first address to the faithful at the Vatican after he was elected Pope.

text: Gin-umpisahan sini ang iya mensahe paagi sa pagsambit sang “peace be with you”, kag sunod nga gindumdom ang nagtaliwan nga Roman Catholic leader nga si Pope Francis.
english: He began his message by mentioning “peace be with you”, and subsequently remembered the late Roman Catholic leader Pope Francis.

text: “We still have in our ears that weak, but always courageous voice of Pope Francis as he blessed Rome!
english: “We still have in our ears that weak, but always courageous voice of Pope Francis as he blessed Rome!

text: The Pope who blessed Rome, gave his blessing to the world, to the entire world, that Easter morning.
english: The Pope who blessed Rome, gave his blessing to the world, to the entire world, that Easter morning.

text: Allow me to follow up on that same blessing: God loves us, God loves you all, and evil will not prevail!
english: Allow me to follow up on that same blessing: God loves us, God loves you all, and evil will not prevail!

text: We are all in the hands of God,” pahayag sini.
english: We are all in the hands of God,” it said.

text: Ginhinambit man sini ang iya mensahe ang komunidad nga naga-upod sa Diyos kag may pag-isa.
english: He also mentioned in his message the community that is with God and has unity.

text: “Without fear, united hand in hand with God and among ourselves, we move forward.
english: “Without fear, united hand in hand with God and among ourselves, we move forward.

text: We are disciples of Christ.
english: We are disciples of Christ.

text: Christ precedes us.
english: Christ precedes us.

text: The world needs his light.
english: The world needs his light.

text: Humanity needs him as the bridge to allows it to be reached by God and by his love,” dugang niya.
english: Humanity needs him as the bridge to allows it to be reached by God and by his love,” he added.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga dapat naga-isa ang simbahan kag dapat nga mangin ma-abi-abihon sa isa kag isa.
english: He also said that the church should be united and should be welcoming to each other.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa mga cardinal nga nag-eleher sa iya bilang Santo Papa antes sini gin-recite ang “Hail Mary” prayer.
english: He also thanked the cardinals who elected him as Pope before reciting the “Hail Mary” prayer.

text: “Help us, too, and help each other to build bridges, with dialogue, with meetings, uniting us all to be one people, always in peace.
english: “Help us, too, and help each other to build bridges, with dialogue, with meetings, uniting us all to be one people, always in peace.

text: Thank you, Pope Francis!
english: Thank you, Pope Francis!

text: I also want to thank all my brother cardinals who have chosen me to be Peter’s Successor, and to walk together with you, as a united Church always seeking peace, justice, always seeking peace, justice, always seeking to work as men and women who are faithful to Jesus Christ, without fear, to proclaim the Gospel, to be missionaries,” dugang sa iya speech.
english: I also want to thank all my brother cardinals who have chosen me to be Peter’s Successor, and to walk together with you, as a united Church always seeking peace, justice, always seeking peace, justice, always seeking to work as men and women who are faithful to Jesus Christ, without fear, to proclaim the Gospel,” he added.

text: Pasado 12:00 kaina sang kaagahon sang ginproklamar nga may napili na nga bag-o nga lider sang Roman Catholic Church.#
english: The new leader of the Roman Catholic Church was proclaimed around 12:00 this morning.

text: Gamiton ni Luka Doncic kag Dallas Mavericks ang home court advantage agud nga malutos ang pangayaw apang top-seeded nga Oklahoma City Thunder sa Game 6 sang Western Conference second-round series subong nga adlaw, Mayo 19.
english: Luka Doncic and the Dallas Mavericks will use home court advantage to defeat the foreign but top-seeded Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 6 of the Western Conference second-round series today, May 19.

text: Magasugod ang hampang 8:00 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: The game will start at 8:00 this morning (Philippine time).

text: Gina-uyatan sang Mavs ang lead sa serye, 3-2, kag pananglitan malutos sini liwat ang Oklahoma, diretso na ini sa conference finals sa ikaduha nga tion sa sulod sang tatlo ka seasons.
english: The Mavs hold the lead in the series, 3-2, and should they beat Oklahoma again, they will be straight to the conference finals for the second time in three seasons.

text: Apang kun matandaan, sa ila man home floor nalutos ang Dallas sang Game 4 kag nakabawi lamang kag nakuha liwat ang series lead paagi sa 104-92 nga kadalag-an sa Game 5 sa bulig sang 31-point triple-double ni Doncic.
english: But if you remember, Dallas lost on their home floor in Game 4 and only recovered and regained the series lead with a 104-92 victory in Game 5 with the help of Doncic's 31-point triple-double.

text: Magapanguna sa Thunder si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander nga pareho kay Doncic finalist man sa voting para sa NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) subong nga season nga sang ulihi nadag-an ni Nikola Jokic sang reigning champions nga Denver Nuggets.
english: The Thunder will be led by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander who, like Doncic, was also a finalist in the voting for NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) this season which was eventually beaten by Nikola Jokic of the reigning champions Denver Nuggets.

text: Ang winner sa tunga sang duha ka team amo naman ang ma-atubang sa magadaog sa tunga sang Nuggets kag Minnesota Timberwolves pag-abot sa Western Conference finals.#
english: The winner of the two teams will face the winner of the Nuggets and Minnesota Timberwolves in the Western Conference finals.

text: Mas gusto ni anay presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque nga magtenir sa The Netherlands bangud sa promisa niya kay anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga indi niya sini pagbayaan.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque to stay in The Netherlands because of his promise to former president Rodrigo Duterte that he will not leave him.

text: Ginsiling ini ni Roque sa isa ka interview, kasunod sang wala nadayon nga flight sini padulong sa Vienna, Austria bangud sa health issue.
english: Roque said this in an interview, following his canceled flight to Vienna, Austria due to health issues.

text: “But when I was in the plane already… thinking I was already en route to Austria, ang iniisip ko naman, I will just explain na hindi ko naman siya iniwan because I’m still in Europe,” pahayag ni Roque.
english: “But when I was in the plane already... thinking I was already en route to Austria, I was thinking, I will just explain that I didn't leave him because I'm still in Europe,” Roque said.

text: Sa subong, nakadetene sa The Hague sa Netherlands si Duterte bangud sa kaso nga crimes against humanity angot sa madinuguonh nga war on drugs.
english: Duterte is currently detained in The Hague in the Netherlands on charges of crimes against humanity in connection with the bloody war on drugs.

text: Wala sang iban nga balasulon si anay provincial administrator/ blocktimer nga si Manuel Boy Mejorada kun ngaa gin-aresto ini sa kaso nga 5 counts sang cyberlibel kundi ang iya kaugalingon kag abugado.
english: Former provincial administrator/blocktimer Manuel Boy Mejorada has no one else to blame for his arrest in the case of 5 counts of cyberlibel but himself and his lawyer.

text: Ini kasunod sang reklamo ni Mejorada nga hungod ini nga ginpaaresto sang tinalikdan nga Hunyo 7,nga natuon sa adlaw sang Biernes agud indi ini maka-piyansa gilayon.
english: This follows Mejorada's complaint that he was deliberately arrested last June 7, which was held on Friday so that he could not be released on bail immediately.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Atty. Hector Teodosio, legal counsel ni outgoing Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Atty. Hector Teodosio, legal counsel of outgoing Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: nga amo ang nagpasaka sang kaso batok sa blocktimer, iya ginpahayag nga kun ginbantayan lang ni Mejorada kun san-o ginfile ang kaso kag wala na ginhulat ang pag-isyu sang warrant of arrest antes magpiyansa, wala na naglab-ot pa ang sitwasyon sa diin ginkinahanglan pa nga i-serbi sa iya puluy-an ang warrant of arrest.
english: who filed the case against the blocktimer, he said that if Mejorada had watched when the case was filed and did not wait for the issuance of the warrant of arrest before granting bail, the situation would not have reached where the warrant of arrest had to be served at his house.

text: Matandaan nga ginpasibangdan ni Mejorada sang paghimbunanay sanday Governor Defensor kag si Police Major Jonathan Pinuela sang Provincial Special Operations Group (PSOG) nga amo ang nagserbi sang warrant of arrest sa iya balay sa Parc Regency, Balabag, Pavia, Iloilo sa diin gin-alegar sang blocktimer nga gin-harass siya sang police official.
english: It can be recalled that Mejorada blamed Governor Defensor and Police Major Jonathan Pinuela of the Provincial Special Operations Group (PSOG) who served the warrant of arrest on his house in Parc Regency, Balabag, Pavia, Iloilo where the blocktimer alleged that he was harassed by the police official.

text: May posibilidad nga mapaidalom sa signal #4 ang siyudad sang Iloilo suno kay Darwin Joemil Papa sang City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (CDRRMO).
english: Iloilo City is likely to be placed under signal #4, according to Darwin Joemil Papa of the City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office (CDRRMO).

text: Ini ang mahimo matabo samtang nagapalapit ang Bagyo Tino kag kun ini man ang magadepende sa kun mahina ukon mabaskog ang hangin nga mabatyagan.
english: This may happen as Typhoon Tino approaches and whether it will depend on whether the wind is weak or strong.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Signal #4 ang may kadasigon nga hangin nga nagalab-ot sa 118 to 184 km/h kag makabig nga may severe threat sa kabuhi kag propiedad.
english: Signal #4 has wind speeds of 118 to 184 km/h and is considered a severe threat to life and property.

text: Ang land fall sang amo nga bagyo ang gina-ekpektar buwas las-2:00 sa hapon.
english: The landfall of the typhoon is expected tomorrow at 2:00 pm.

text: Sa subong, ginpasaka na sa red alert status ang siyudad kag naka-standby na ang tanan nga responder nga magahatag sang bulig sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: The city has been raised to red alert status and all responders are on standby to provide assistance in times of emergency.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒔𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: INDIA – Malapit na lang ang eleksyon!
english: INDIA – Elections are just around the corner!

text: Bilang botante, kinahanglan nga mangin mahinalungon kita sa pagpili sang atun nahamut-an nga kandidato.
english: As voters, we need to be careful in choosing our favorite candidate.

text: Sa pungsod India, partikular sa Uttar Pradesh, aksidente nga nagsala ang 25 anyos nga Indian national sa pagboto sang kandidato sa nangin national election sang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: In India, particularly in Uttar Pradesh, a 25-year-old Indian national accidentally made a mistake in voting for a candidate in the country's national election.

text: Bangud sa pagkadismaya, gin-utod ni Kumar ang iya ‘index finger’ukon tudlo bilang self-punishment sa pagboto sang indi niya luyag nga kandidato.
english: Frustrated, Kumar cut off his index finger as self-punishment for voting for a candidate he did not like.

text: Suno kay Kumar, nabudlyan siya sa paghangop sang party symbols rason nga lain ang iya naboto.
english: Kumar said he found it difficult to understand the party symbols and voted for a different one.

text: Iya tuman nga ginhinulsulan ang pagboto sang indi nagakadapat nga kandidato.
english: He deeply regretted voting for the wrong candidate.

text: Kaangay man sa atun diri sa pungsod Pilipinas, ginabutang sang inedible ink ang tudlo sang tagsa ka botante kun tapos na ini sa pagboto agud nga masiguro nga indi na ini makaboto pa liwat.
english: Like us here in the Philippines, inedible ink is placed on the finger of each voter when he or she is done voting to ensure that he or she cannot vote again.

text: Gani, kamo mga ka Bombo, mangin maalam sa pagpili sang kandidato kag indi magpadala-dala sa kwarta sang mga pulitiko.
english: Therefore, you Bombo, be wise in choosing candidates and do not be carried away by the money of politicians.

text: Kasado na ang 37-anyos nga aktres nga si Angelica Panganiban sa iya businessman fiancé nga si Gregg Homan.
english: 37-year-old actress Angelica Panganiban is married to her businessman fiancé Gregg Homan.

text: Gindungan nila ang ila nga kasal sa bisperas sang bag-ong tuig, Disyembre 31.
english: They were married on New Year's Eve, December 31.

text: “123123 – Patuloy na mananalig at maniniwala sa pag-ibig.
english: “123123 – Continue to trust and believe in love.

text: Sa kabila ng lahat.
english: In spite of everything.

text: Ang pagmamahal pa rin ang kakapitan,” pahayag sang aktres sang iya na ginsapubliko ang balita sa iya kasal.
english: Love is still the captain,” the actress said when she made the news of her marriage public.

text:
“Maligayang bagong taon – Mrs Angelica Panganiban Homan.”

Wala man sini gin-anunsyo kun sa diin ang partikular nga venue sang iya kasal apang antes ang big event, naka-post pa ini sang pictures kaupod sa iya mga abyan nga sanday Bela Padilla kag Kim Chiu sa Los Angeles, California, USA.
english:
“Happy new year – Mrs Angelica Panganiban Homan.”

She did not announce the specific venue of her wedding but before the big event, she posted pictures with her friends Bela Padilla and Kim Chiu in Los Angeles, California, USA.

text: Sa seremonya sang kasal, siyempre, bida man ang anak nanday Angelica kag Gregg nga si Amila Sabine ukon si baby Bean.
english: The wedding ceremony, of course, also starred Angelica and Gregg’s daughter Amila Sabine or baby Bean.

text: 2018 sang una nga nagkitaay ang duha.
english: 2018 when the two first met.

text: Sang amo nga tion, may taping si Angelica sa isa ka TV series sa Subic kun sa diin nagapuyo si Gregg.
english: At the time, Angelica was taping a TV series in Subic where Gregg lived.

text: 2020 sang nag-umpisa ang relasyon bilang magkahagugma kag 2022 naman sang nag-propose ang lalaki sang nagabusong pa ang aktres kay Baby Bean.
english: 2020 when the relationship began as lovers and 2022 when the man proposed when the actress was pregnant with Baby Bean.

text: May napili na nga Santo Papa!
english: A Pope has been elected!

text: Nagguwa ang puti nga aso sa chimney sang Sistine Chapel sang Vatican 12:08 subong nga kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: White smoke emerged from the chimney of the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican at 12:08 this morning Philippine time.

text: Nagakahulugan ini nga may napili na ang 133 ka cardinal electors nga magapungko bilang lider sang 1.4 billion strong Roman Catholic church.
english: This means that the 133 cardinal electors have already chosen the leader of the 1.4 billion strong Roman Catholic church.

text: Ang Cardinal nga napili nga mangin Pope ang ginpailisan na sang bag-o nga papal garments sa Room of Tears.
english: The Cardinal who was elected Pope has been changed into new papal garments in the Room of Tears.

text: Sunod nga lauman nga makit-an si Cardinal protodeacon Dominique Mamberti sa central balcony sang Saint Peter’s Basilica agud nga i-anunsyo ang popular nga mga tinaga nga: Habemus papam!
english: Cardinal protodeacon Dominique Mamberti is next expected to be seen on the central balcony of Saint Peter's Basilica to announce the popular words: Habemus papam!

text:
(We have a pope!)

Diri na kag sunod nga ipakilala kun sin-o ang napilian nga Santo Papa kag kun ano ang iya papal name.
english:
(We have a pope!)

This is where the elected Pope and his papal name will be announced.

text: Matandaan nga Myerkules sang gab-i oras sa Pilipinas sang pormal nga nagsugod ang Conclave kun sa diin nalakip sa tatlo ka electors ang tatlo ka mga Filipino: Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Cardinal Jose Advincula, kag Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David.#
english: It can be recalled that the Conclave formally began on Wednesday night Philippine time with three Filipinos among the three electors: Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Cardinal Jose Advincula, and Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David.

text: Ginbasura ang isa sa pito ka mga kaso nga ginapangatubang sang drag artist nga si Pura Luka Vega kaangot sa iya kontrobersyal nga performance sang “Ama Namin” nga ginkaakig sang Catholic community sa pungsod.
english: One of the seven cases facing drag artist Pura Luka Vega in connection with her controversial performance of “Ama Namin” that angered the Catholic community in the country has been dismissed.

text: Suno kay Pura nga ang legal nga pangalan amo si Amadeus Fernando Pagente, nalipay siya nga at least may isa ka kaso nga na-dismiss.
english: Pura, whose legal name is Amadeus Fernando Pagente, said he is happy that at least one case was dismissed.

text:
Pahayag pa sini, “Laban lang.”

Matandaan nga gindakop anay sang Manila Police District si Pura kasunod sang mandu sang Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 36 bangud sang ginpahayag nga “immoral doctrine, obscene publications and exhibition, and indecent shows.”

Naka-guwa siya sa presuhan matapos nakapyansa sang P72,000.
english:
He added, “Just fight.”

It can be recalled that the Manila Police District earlier arrested Pura following the order of the Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 36 for allegedly “immoral doctrine, obscene publications and exhibition, and indecent shows.”

He was released from jail after posting bail of P72,000.

text: Magluwas sa iya anum ka iban pa nga mga kaso nga pending tubtub subong, isa man ka persona non grata si Pura sa 17 ka mga lugar lakip sa Manila, General Santos City, Floridablanca sa Pampanga, Laguna, Nueva Ecija, Cagayan de Oro City, Bukidnon, Cebu City, kag Toboso sa Negros Occidental.#
english: Besides his six other cases pending so far, Pura is also a persona non grata in 17 places including Manila, General Santos City, Floridablanca in Pampanga, Laguna, Nueva Ecija, Cagayan de Oro City, Bukidnon, Cebu City, and Toboso in Negros Occidental.

text: Ikatatlo si Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle sa pasunod sang 133 ka mga cardinal nga magaboto sa bag-o nga Santo Papa.
english: Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle is third among the 133 cardinals who will vote for the new Pope.

text: Base sa report sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), “by order of precedence” ang casting sang boto sa papal election — buot silingon, una ang “cardinal-bishops” nga amo ang may pinakamataas nga ranggo sa College of Cardinals.
english: According to a report by the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), the casting of votes in the papal election is “by order of precedence” — that is, first the “cardinal-bishops” who have the highest rank in the College of Cardinals.

text: Ang una amo si Italian Cardinal Pietro Parolin nga amo ang nagpungko nga secretary of state sa idalom ni Pope Francis, samtang ikaduha nga elector naman si Cardinal Fernando Filoni nga amo ang former apostolic nuncio to the Philippines kag prefect sang old Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples.
english: The first is Italian Cardinal Pietro Parolin who served as secretary of state under Pope Francis, while the second elector is Cardinal Fernando Filoni who is the former apostolic nuncio to the Philippines and prefect of the old Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples.

text: Nagasunod naman kay Cardinal Tagle ang Amerikano nga si Francis Prevost; kag panglima si Louis Raphaël I Sako sang Chaldean Catholic Church.
english: Cardinal Tagle was followed by American Francis Prevost; and fifth Louis Raphaël I Sako of the Chaldean Catholic Church.

text: Kasunod sang cardinal-bishops sa pagboto ang 108 cardinal-priests kag 20 cardinal-deacons.
english: The cardinal-bishops were followed in the vote by 108 cardinal-priests and 20 cardinal-deacons.

text: Nakabase ini sa adlaw kun san-o sila ginhimo nga kardinal.
english: It is based on the day they were made a cardinal.

text: Lakip diri sa cardinal-priests ang duha ka Pilipino.
english: The cardinal-priests include two Filipinos.

text: Ika-72 si Archbishop of Manila Jose Advincula nga nangin cardinal sang 2020; samtang ika-103 naman ang Bishop of Kalookan kag CBCP President nga si Pablo Virgilio David nga nangin kardinal naman sang nagligad gid lamang nga 2024.
english: 72nd Archbishop of Manila Jose Advincula who became a cardinal in 2020; while the 103rd is Bishop of Kalookan and CBCP President Pablo Virgilio David who became a cardinal in 2024.

text: Sa Sistine Chapel sa Vatican nagatingob ang 133 Cardinals para magboto sang bag-o nga lider sang Roman Catholic Church.
english: In the Sistine Chapel in the Vatican, 133 Cardinals gather to elect a new leader of the Roman Catholic Church.

text: Sa una nga gab-i sang Conclave, nagguwa ang itom nga aso sa chimney sa chapel nga isa ka patimaan nga wala pa sang napilian nga bag-o nga Pope.#
english: On the first night of the Conclave, black smoke came out of the chimney in the chapel as a sign that no new Pope had been elected.#

text: ILOILO – Naka-hospital arrest subong si Janiuay Iloilo Mayor-elect Frankie Locsin.
english: ILOILO – Janiuay Iloilo Mayor-elect Frankie Locsin is currently under hospital arrest.

text: Ini matapos gin-aresto ini sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) bangud sa kaso ini nga pagalapas sa Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.
english: This was after he was arrested by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) for violating the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Atty. Jorge Jularbal, Regional Director sang NBI Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga nagkuha sang NBI clearance si Locsin, natukiban nga convicted ini sa nasambit nga kaso.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Atty. Jorge Jularbal, Regional Director of NBI Region 6, said Locsin obtained NBI clearance, it was discovered that he was convicted in the said case.

text: Suno kay Atty. Jularbal, nakibot ang alkalde bangud wala ini nagalaom nga arestuhon gilayon apisar may ginpapanaog na nga desisyon ang Sandiganbayan First Division sa diin convicted ini sa kaso nga graft.
english: According to Atty. Jularbal, the mayor was surprised because he did not expect to be arrested immediately despite the decision of the Sandiganbayan First Division where he was convicted of graft.

text: Gintagaan naman sang Sandiganbayan sang kopya sang arrest warrant ang NBI.
english: The Sandiganbayan provided the NBI with a copy of the arrest warrant.

text: Ginpahayag ni Atty. Jularbal, na ginkuhaan na sang mugshots ang alkalde.
english: Atty. Jularbal, who has already taken mugshots of the mayor.

text: Apang sang ginhambalan na ini nga dal-on sa Sandiganbayan, gulpi lang nagsakit ang iya dughan rason nga gindala ini sa hospital.
english: But when he was told to be taken to the Sandiganbayan, he suddenly felt chest pain and was taken to the hospital.

text: Natukiban man nga may balatian ini sa dughan kag may pneumonia.
english: He was also diagnosed with chest pain and pneumonia.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin sa The Medical City ang alkalde kag ginabantayan sang mga katapo sang NBI.
english: The mayor is currently staying at The Medical City and is being guarded by NBI personnel.

text: Matandaan nag-ugat ang kaso bangud sa pagbakal sang banwa sang Janiuay sang P15 million nga balor sang bulong halin sa Priority Development Assistance Fund ni Sen.
english: It can be recalled that the case stemmed from the purchase of P15 million worth of medicines by the town of Janiuay from the Priority Development Assistance Fund of Sen.

text: Vicente Sotto III sang tuig 2001.
english: Vicente Sotto III in 2001.

text: Ang medical supply contract ang gin-award sa AM Europharma, sa diin ang ila accreditation ang ginsuspend sang Department of Health (DOH).
english: The medical supply contract was awarded to AM Europharma, whose accreditation was suspended by the Department of Health (DOH).

text: Magluwas kay Locsin gin-convict man sang Sandiganbayan sanday municipal accountant Carlos Moreno Jr., budget officer Ramon Tirador, treasurer Luzviminda Figueroa, Ricardo Minurtio, kag Rodrigo Villanueva.
english: Besides Locsin, the Sandiganbayan also convicted municipal accountant Carlos Moreno Jr., budget officer Ramon Tirador, treasurer Luzviminda Figueroa, Ricardo Minurtio, and Rodrigo Villanueva.

text: Ginpamatbatan man sang anti-graft court ang mga natungdan sang anom tubtub 10 ka tuig nga pagka preso kag ginpapanaugan sang perpetual disqualification from public office.
english: The anti-graft court also sentenced the suspects to six to 10 years in prison and perpetual disqualification from public office.

text: Ito ay kasabay ng mabibigat na pag-ulang dala ng Typhoon Tino na nagbabanta sa malaking bahagi ng Visayas.
english: This is in line with the severe disruption caused by Typhoon Tino that threatens much of the Visayas.

text: Batay sa impormasyong inilabas ng weather bureau, ang pagkakalantad ng lahat sa matindi at tuloy-tuloy na pag-ulan ay maaaring magdulot ng lahar flow, hindi lamang sa dalisdis ng bulkan, kungdi maging sa mga komunidad na direktang nakaharap dito.
english: According to information released by the weather bureau, the exposure of all to heavy and continuous rains can cause lahar flow, not only in the volcano's slopes, but also in the communities directly facing it.

text: Maaari umanong umagos ito sa southern at western slopes ng Kanlaon Volcano.
english: It is likely to flow on the southern and western slopes of Kanlaon Volcano.

text: Giit ng weather bureau, mataas ang bulto ng pyroclastic density current (PDC) deposits sa mga dalisdis ng bulkan mula sa magkakasunod na ash emission.
english: According to the weather bureau, the bulk of pyroclastic density current (PDC) deposits in the volcanic slopes is high from the successive ash emissions.

text: Maaari umanong maranasan ang pag-agos ng mainit na lahar o sediment-laden streamflow sa Tamburong/Ibid Creek sa Biak-na-Bato; Baji-Baji Falls at Talaptapan Creek sa Cabacungan, La Castellana, Negros Occidental.
english: Hot lahar or sediment-laden streamflow can be experienced in Tamburong/Ibid Creek in Biak-na-Bato; Baji-Baji Falls and Talaptapan Creek in Cabacungan, La Castellana, Negros Occidental.

text: Kasama rin dito ang mga drainage na komukunekta sa mga gully na dating pinagbagsakan ng PDC materials.
english: This also includes the drainage that connects to the gullies where PDC materials were previously dumped.

text: Dahil dito, pinaghahanda ang publiko sa posibilidad ng agarang paglikas, habang pinayuhan din ang mga residente na iwasang dumaan sa mga sapat, canal, atbpang maaaring daanan ng lahar.
english: Because of this, the public is being prepared for the possibility of immediate evacuation, while residents are also advised to avoid passing through animals, canals, etc. that may be affected by lahar.

text: Antes pormal nga nagsugod ang Conclave, nagpanguna ang Dean sang College of Cardinals nga si Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re sa pag-deliver sang homily sa Mass for the Election of a Roman Pontiff ukon Pro Eligendo Romano Pontifice.
english: Before the Conclave formally began, the Dean of the College of Cardinals, Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re, led the delivery of a homily at the Mass for the Election of a Roman Pontiff or Pro Eligendo Romano Pontiff.

text: Ginpatigayon ini sa Saint Peter’s Basilica sa Vatican halin 4:00 kahapon sang hapon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: It was held at Saint Peter's Basilica in the Vatican from 4:00 pm yesterday Philippine time.

text: Magluwas sa mga cardinal, nagtambong man ang masobra lima ka libo nga mga tumuluo.
english: In addition to the cardinals, more than five thousand faithful also attended.

text: Sa amo nga selebrasyon sang misa, ginpaathag ni Cardinal Re nga ginapangabay ang Balaan nga Espiritu nga mag-ubay sa Cardinal-electors nga makapili sang Santo Papa nga kinahanglan sang Simbahan kag katawhan sa sining mabudlay nga mga tinion sa kalibutan.
english: During the celebration of the mass, Cardinal Re explained that the Holy Spirit is asked to accompany the Cardinal-electors to elect the Pope that the Church and people need in these difficult times in the world.

text: Diri ginapahigad suno sa iya ang personal nga interes kag ginatugutan nga magpangibabaw ang Ginuo kag ang ikaayo sang katawhan kag Simbahan.
english: Here, he said, personal interests are put aside and the Lord and the good of the people and the Church are allowed to prevail.

text: “We are here to invoke the help of the Holy Spirit, to implore his light and strength so that the Pope elected may be he whom the Church and humanity need at this difficult and complex turning point in history,” kabahin sang homily sini.
english: “We are here to invoke the help of the Holy Spirit, to implore his light and strength so that the Pope elected may be he whom the Church and humanity need at this difficult and complex turning point in history,” part of its homily.

text: “To pray, by invoking the Holy Spirit, is the only right and proper attitude to take as the cardinal-electors prepare to undertake an act of the highest human and ecclesial responsibility and to make a choice of exceptional importance,” dugang pa sini.
english: “To pray, by invoking the Holy Spirit, is the only right and proper attitude to take as the cardinal-electors prepare to undertake an act of the highest human and ecclesial responsibility and to make a choice of exceptional importance,” it added.

text:
“This is a human act for which every personal consideration must be set aside, keeping in mind and heart only the God of Jesus Christ and the good of the Church and of humanity.”

Kasunod sini, isa-isa man nga nagbasa ang cardinal electors sa Solemn Oath lakip na ang tatlo ka mga Pilipino — sanday Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, kag Cardinal Jose Advincula.
english:
“This is a human act for which every personal consideration must be set aside, keeping in mind and heart only the God of Jesus Christ and the good of the Church and of humanity.”

Following this, the cardinal electors also recited the Solemn Oath one by one, including three Filipinos — Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, and Cardinal Jose Advincula.

text: Halin sa Pauline Chapel, nag-martsa ang mga cardinal-elector pasulod sa Sistine Chapel samtang ginakanta ang “Litany of the Saints” kag ang hymn nga “Veni Creator Spiritus” agud nga pangabayon ang Balaan nga Espiritu nga ubayan sila sa desisyon.
english: From the Pauline Chapel, the cardinal-electors marched into the Sistine Chapel while singing the “Litany of the Saints” and the hymn “Veni Creator Spiritus” to ask the Holy Spirit to guide them in the decision.

text: Nagpanguna sa prusisyon ang krus, ginsundan sang choir, kag ang priest assistants to the Master of Ceremonies.
english: The cross led the procession, followed by the choir, and the priest assistants to the Master of Ceremonies.

text: Sa likod sini amo ang Secretary of the Conclave, ang cardinal nga amo ang naghatag sang opening meditation sa pagsirado sang Sistine chapel, ang Cardinal-electors, kag ang nagsunod amo ang Master of Ceremonies.
english: Behind this was the Secretary of the Conclave, the cardinal who gave the opening meditation at the closing of the Sistine chapel, the Cardinal-electors, and following was the Master of Ceremonies.

text: Sa cardinal electors, may tradisyon sa pagpasunod nga amo ang cardinal deacons, priests, kag ang bishops.
english: Among the cardinal electors, there is a tradition of succession that is cardinal deacons, priests, and bishops.

text: Ginproklamar naman ang Extra Omnes ukon “Everyone Out” bilang proklamasyon sa pagguwa sang iban nga personnel sa Sistine Chapel magluwas lamang sa mga cardinal electors.
english: Extra Omnes or “Everyone Out” was proclaimed as a proclamation for the exit of other personnel from the Sistine Chapel except for the cardinal electors.

text: Nag-deliver si Cardinal Raniero Cantalamessa sang meditation nga amo ang nag-imbitar sa cardinals sa pagpangamuyo kag discernment antes ang opisyal nga pag-umpisa sang eleksyon agud mapili ang magabulos kay Pope Francis.#
english: Cardinal Raniero Cantalamessa delivered a meditation that invited the cardinals to pray and discernment before the official start of the election to elect Pope Francis' successor.

text: Ginhimuslan na, ginpangayuan pa sang kwarta sang isa ka construction worker ang 17-anyos nga dalagita sa isa ka subdibisyon sa Quezon City.
english: A 17-year-old girl was raped and demanded money by a construction worker in a subdivision in Quezon City.

text: Manugpauli na kuntani ang biktima matapos nagbakal sang school supplies sang ginsundan ini sang 32-anyos nga suspek kag ginbutong pakadto sa isa ka bakante nga lote.
english: The victim was on his way home after buying school supplies when the 32-year-old suspect followed him and dragged him to a vacant lot.

text: Suno sa dalagita, gintayaan siya sang kutsilyo kag ginpahog nga patyon.
english: The girl said he threatened her with a knife and threatened to kill her.

text: Matapos ang pagpanghimulos, ginpangayuan pa sang suspek sang kwarta ang biktima apang P66 lang ang kwarta nga dala sang dalagita gani nagpasugot ang suspek nga magkadto sa tindahan ang biktima para magpa-cashout.
english: After the rape, the suspect asked the victim for money but the girl brought only P66 so the suspect agreed to let the victim go to the store to cashout.

text: Didto na nakapangayo sang bulig ang dalagita.
english: That's when the girl asked for help.

text: Madasig naman nga naaresto ang suspek kag preso na subong sa Payatas Bagong Silangan Police Station.
english: The suspect was quickly arrested and is now detained at the Payatas Bagong Silangan Police Station.

text: Ginpaidalom naman sa counseling ang biktima.
english: The victim was submitted to counseling.

text: Wala pang limang minuto, mabilis na inaprubahan sa plenaryo ng Senado ang panukalang pondo ng Office of the President (OP) na aabot sa P27.3 billion at ang P854 million na budget ng Presidential Management Staff (PMS) para sa 2026.
english: In less than five minutes, the Senate plenary quickly approved the proposed budget of the Office of the President (OP) amounting to P27.3 billion and the P854 million budget of the Presidential Management Staff (PMS) for 2026.

text: Sa plenary deliberations ng Senado para sa budget ng tanggapan ng pangulo para sa susunod na taon, nagkasundo ang mga senador na iendorso ang budget ng OP at PMS para sa pag-apruba sa ikalawang pagbasa.
english: In the plenary deliberations of the Senate for the budget to be received by the president for next year, the senators agreed to endorse the budget of OP and PMS for approval on second reading.

text: Ayon kay Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Senador Sherwin Gatchalian, ito na ang ikaapat na pagkakataong humarap sa Senado si Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, na kamakailan lamang ay nagsilbi bilang kalihim ng Department of Finance (DOF).
english: According to Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, this is the fourth time that Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, who recently served as secretary of the Department of Finance (DOF), has appeared before the Senate.

text: Nagmosyon naman si Senador Jinggoy Estrada na tapusin ang interpelasyon para sa OP at PMS budgets bilang pagpapakita ng institutional courtesy sa ehekutibong sangay—na kapantay ng lehislatura—at bilang paggalang na rin sa Pangulo, na dati nilang kasama sa Senado noong 15th at 16th Congress.
english: Senator Jinggoy Estrada motioned to end the interpellation for the OP and PMS budgets as a show of institutional courtesy to the executive branch—which is equal to the legislature—and as a sign of respect for the President, who was their Senate colleague during the 15th and 16th Congresses.

text: Tumaas ng 66.2 million ang budget ng tanggapan ng pangulo dahil malaking bahagi nito ay ilalaan para sa pag-host ng Pilipinas sa ASEAN Summit at mga kaugnay na pagpupulong sa susunod na taon.
english: The president's budget will increase by 66.2 million as a large portion of it will be allocated for the Philippines' hosting of the ASEAN Summit and related meetings next year.

text: Maga-export na liwat ang Pilipinas sang raw sugar sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa Agusto — halos apat ka tuig matapos ang katapusan nga shipment sini sang kalamay sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The Philippines will resume exporting raw sugar to the United States of America in August — nearly four years after its last shipment of sugarcane to the country.

text: Suno kay Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) administrator kag CEO Pablo Luis Azcona, ini nga tikang amo ang sabat sa hingyo sang exporters kun mahimo na sila makapadala sang suplay.
english: According to Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) administrator and CEO Pablo Luis Azcona, this move is in response to the request of exporters when they can send supplies.

text: Sang Marso, matandaan nga gin-anunsyo sang US Trade Representative (USTR) nga nagpain ini sang dugang nga 25,300 metric tons raw value (MTRV) para sa Pilipinas para sa fiscal year 2024 (October 1, 2023 – September 30, 2024).
english: In March, it can be recalled that the US Trade Representative (USTR) announced that it had set aside an additional 25,300 metric tons raw value (MTRV) for the Philippines for fiscal year 2024 (October 1, 2023 – September 30, 2024).

text: Suno kay Azcona, magaabot sa US ang raw sugar sa Septyembre gani ginalauman nga Agusto pa lang, umpisahan na ang proseso sang pag-export.
english: According to Azcona, the raw sugar will arrive in the US in September so it is expected that the export process will begin in August.

text: Ang plano sa pag-export ang iga-implementer paagi sa sugar order nga subong nga bulan pa madesisyunan.
english: The export plan will be implemented through a sugar order that will be decided this month.

text: Matandaan nga katapusan nga naka-ship ang Pilipinas sang kalamay sa US sang crop year 2020–2021 sang nagdangat sa 112,008 MT sang commercial raw sugar ang ginpadala.
english: It can be recalled that the Philippines last shipped sugarcane to the US in the crop year 2020-2021 when 112,008 MT of commercial raw sugar was shipped.

text: Nagaplano man ang Pilipinas nga mag-import sang ginabanta nga 200,000 MT sang refined sugar subong nga tuig agud nga ma-fill in ang gina-antisipar na nga supply gap kag agud masigurado nga mapabilin ang price stability sang amo nga produkto.
english: The Philippines also plans to import an estimated 200,000 MT of refined sugar this year to fill in the anticipated supply gap and to ensure the price stability of the product.

text: ILOILO CITY- Igatiglawas sang Strong Group Athletics (SGA) ang Pilipinas sa 43rd William Jones Cup sa Hulyo 13 tubtob 21 sa Taipei, Taiwan.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Strong Group Athletics (SGA) will represent the Philippines in the 43rd William Jones Cup on July 13 to 21 in Taipei, Taiwan.

text: Pangunahan ini ni coach Charles Tiu nga nagsiling nga nabaton na sini ang blessing halin sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) nga itiglawas ang pungsod sa prestihiyoso nga international tournament,kun sa diin ang Pilipinas ang nagapangaduha sa gold medal count ngaa ginapangunahan sang USA.
english: It will be led by coach Charles Tiu who said he has already received the blessing from the Philippine Basketball Association (SBP) to represent the country in the prestigious international tournament, where the Philippines is second in the gold medal count led by the USA.

text: Sang damlag, ang Strong Group Athletics ang nakakuha sang silver medal sa Dubai International Basketball Championship, kun sa diin si Tiu man ang naggiya sa squad kun sa diin nangin kabahin sanday Dwight Howard, Andray Blatche, Kevin Quiambao, kag Justine Baltazar.
english: Recently, Strong Group Athletics won a silver medal at the Dubai International Basketball Championship, where Tiu also led the squad which included Dwight Howard, Andray Blatche, Kevin Quiambao, and Justine Baltazar.

text: Magabulig naman kay Tiu si Rajko Toroman, nga nagaserbe nga iya assistant coach sa De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde sa National Collegiate Athletics Association.
english: Tiu will be assisted by Rajko Toroman, who serves as his assistant coach at De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde in the National Collegiate Athletics Association.

text: Wala pa sang ginpagwa nga pangalan sang mga players nga magabug- os sang team.
english: The names of the players who will make up the team have not been released yet.

text: Sa pihak sang sampaw-sampaw nga kontrobersiya nga ginakaulamiran, chill lang ang aktor nga si Rob Gomez kag nagtambong pa sa bunyag sang iya anak nga si Amelia.
english: Despite the controversy, actor Rob Gomez is chill and even attended the baptism of his daughter Amelia.

text: Si Baby Amelia amo ang ila anak sang doktor kag anay beauty queen nga si Shaila Rebortera.
english: Baby Amelia is the daughter of doctor and former beauty queen Shaila Rebortera.

text: Caption pa ni Rob sa iya Instagram post: “I love you 3000.
english: Rob captioned his Instagram post: “I love you 3000.

text: TYG for this day”.
english: TYG for this day”.

text: Yara man sa pictures si Shaila nga nagakungkong sa ila anak.
english: Shaila is also in the pictures hugging their daughter.

text: Sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw sang naglupok ang isyu kay Rob bangud nag-leak ang pribado sini nga mga mensahe sa iya co-stars sa “Magandang Dilag” series nga sanday Herlene Budol kag Bianca Manalo.
english: Just last day, the issue of Rob exploded because his private messages to his co-stars in the “Magandang Dilag” series Herlene Budol and Bianca Manalo were leaked.

text: Pareho naman nga nag-depensa sanday Herlene kag Bianca nga wala sila sang relasyon sa amo nga aktor.
english: Both Herlene and Bianca defended that they had no relationship with the actor.

text: Una naman nga nagpaathag si Rob nga may nanghilabot sa iya cellphone kag amo ang nagpaguwa sang screengrabs sang mga mensahe sa duha ka beauty queens-actresses.
english: Earlier, Rob explained that someone interfered with his cellphone and released screengrabs of messages to the two beauty queens-actresses.

text: Iniimbestigahan na ngayon ng City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) ng Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu ang insidente kung saan makikita sa isang video ang isang 60-anyos na lola na inilulubog sa baha ang kanyang 12-anyos na apo sa Sitio Balanghoy, Barangay Gun-ob sa nasabing lungsod.
english: The City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) of Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu is now investigating the incident where a 60-year-old grandmother can be seen in a video drowning her 12-year-old grandson in the flood in Sitio Balanghoy, Barangay Gun-ob in the said town.

text: Bagamat nangyari pa ito noong Marso, muling lumutang ang video at marami ang nagpahayag ng pagkondena sa ginawa ng lola.
english: Although it happened in March, the video resurfaced and many expressed condemnation of the grandmother's actions.

text: Ayon sa CSWDO, nagpadala sila ng mga tauhan upang magsagawa ng imbestigasyon.
english: According to the CSWDO, they sent personnel to conduct an investigation.

text: Sa kanilang pag-uusap sa lola, inamin nito na nawalan siya ng pasensya sa asal ng kanyang apo at ginawa lamang niya iyon upang disiplinahin ang bata.
english: In their conversation with the grandmother, she admitted that she lost patience with her grandson's behavior and did so only to discipline the child.

text: Kasalukuyan nang sinusuri kung kinakailangan munang ilayo ang bata sa kanyang lola.
Ayon sa CSWDO, ibabase nila ang kanilang desisyon sa kung ano ang tunay na makakabuti para sa bata.
Nagtakop ang una nga gab-i sang Conclave nga wala sang may napilian nga bag-o nga Santo Papa.
english: The first night of the Conclave ended without the election of a new Pope.

text: 9:00 sang Myerkules sang gab-i sa Roma kag alas tres naman kaina sang kaagahon oras diri sa Pilipinas sang nakit-an nga nagguwa ang itom nga aso halin sa chimney sang Sistine Chapel.
english: 9:00 Wednesday night in Rome and 3 am yesterday here in the Philippines when black smoke was seen coming out of the chimney of the Sistine Chapel.

text: Ini nga aso nagakahulugan nga napaslawan ang Cardinal electors nga maka-eleher sang magabulos kay Pope Francis sa una nga hugnat sang pagbinotohay.
english: This smoke means that the Cardinal electors failed to elect a successor to Pope Francis in the first round of voting.

text: Nagakinahanglan ang bag-o nga Pope sang boto sang two-thirds majority.
english: The new Pope needs a two-thirds majority vote.

text: Sa 133 ka mga cardinal, kinahanglan nga may 89 nga makasulat sang isa lang ka pangalan sa ila nga secret ballot papers para nga madesisyunan nga magapungko ang bag-o nga Pope.
Suno sa Vatican, may apat ka balota sa kada adlaw kun sa diin duha sa aga kag duha sa hapon.
english: According to the Vatican, there are four ballots per day, two in the morning and two in the afternoon.

text: Lauman nga magapahuway anay ang mga cardinal kag magatipon sila liwat buwas 10:30 am (oras sa Roma).
english: The cardinals are expected to take a break and meet again tomorrow at 10:30 am (Rome time).

text: Pananglitan wala gihapon sang Santo Papa pagkatapos sang tatlo ka adlaw, untaton anay ang papal election para sa isa ka adlaw sang pagpangamuyo, informal discussions, kag malip-ot nga spiritual exhortation nga himuon sang senior cardinal deacon.
english: If there is still no Pope after three days, the papal election will be suspended for a day of prayer, informal discussions, and a brief spiritual exhortation by the senior cardinal deacon.

text: Untaton liwat kag may exhortation naman nga himuon sa kada pito ka dugang nga voting rounds nga wala gihapon sang napilian.
english: It will be stopped again and an exhortation will be made every seven additional voting rounds that still do not choose.

text: Una ini nga himuon sang senior cardinal priest, kag mangin sang senior cardinal bishop kun kinahanglan.
english: This is done first by the senior cardinal priest, and then by the senior cardinal bishop if necessary.

text: May final pause of prayer, dialogue, kag reflection kun wala pa gid sang mapilian matapos ang 21 votes.
english: There will be a final pause of prayer, dialogue, and reflection if no one is elected after 21 votes.

text: Kun wala man gihapon, magapili ang cardinals sa tunga sang duha mga kandidato nga may pinakamataas nga boto sa nagligad nga voting round.
english: If not, the cardinals will choose between the two candidates with the highest votes in the previous voting round.

text: Iga-require sa gihapon ang two-thirds majority apang kun maglab-ot na sa amo nga tion, indi na pagtugutan ang duha ka kandidato sa pagka-Santo Papa nga makaboto.
english: A two-thirds majority will still be required but when that time is reached, the two papal candidates will not be allowed to vote.

text:
DFA, ginkumpirma nga wala sang Pilipino ang napatay sa airstrikes sang India sa Pakistan

Ginkumpirma sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga wala sang Pilipino ang napatay sa ginpatigayon nga airstrikes sang India sa Pakistan.
english:
DFA confirms no Filipinos killed in Indian airstrikes in Pakistan

The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) confirmed that no Filipinos were killed in India's airstrikes in Pakistan.

text: Suno sa DFA, padayon nila ginabantayan ang sitwasyon sa tunga sang India kag Pakista.
english: The DFA said it is continuously monitoring the situation between India and Pakistan.

text: Ginkumpirman man sang Embahada sang Pilipinas sa Islamabad nga safe ang mga Pilpino sa mga apektado nga lugar.
english: The Philippine Embassy in Islamabad also confirmed that Filipinos are safe in the affected areas.

text: Kasunod sang airstrikes nga ginatawag sang India nga ‘Operation Sindoor’ kun sa diin nagtarget sa mga pasilidad sang terorista kag nagtuga sang kamatayon sang 26 ka mga sibilyan.
english: It follows airstrikes that India calls 'Operation Sindoor' which targeted terrorist facilities and caused the death of 26 civilians.

text: ILOILO – Ginhikayan ni Iloilo Gov.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: si outgoing Iloilo 4th district Cong.
english: is outgoing Iloilo 4th district Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron matapos nga nagwangal ini sa iya kapaslawan sa gubernatorial elections sa diin plano sini nga magpa recount.
english: Ferjenel Biron after he lamented his failure in the gubernatorial elections where he plans to recount.

text: Nahibaluan nga makaduha ka beses na nga nalutos si Biron sa pagpadalagan sini sa pagka gobernador.
english: Biron has been defeated twice in his run for governor.

text: Una nga nalutos si Biron sang nagpadalagan ini sa gubernatorial elections sang tuig 2013 sa diin nakasumpong sini si outgoing Iloilo Gov.
english: Biron was first defeated in the 2013 gubernatorial elections against outgoing Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: kag liwat naman ini nga napierde sang tinalikdan nga May 13,  2019 midterm elections  sa diin nakasumpong sini ang anak sang gobernador nga si Iloilo 3rd District Congressman kag subong governor elect Arthur ‘Toto’ Defensor Jr.
english: and he lost again in the last May 13, 2019 midterm elections where he was challenged by the governor's son, Iloilo 3rd District Congressman and now governor elect Arthur 'Toto' Defensor Jr.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa gobernador, iya ginpaangid ang kapalaran ni Biron sa poem ukon tula nga ‘For dreams must die nga isa ka romantic novel nahanungod sa kabuhi nanday Jose Rizal kag Leonor Rivera  kag ambahanon nga ‘The Impossible Dream’ ni Frank Sinatra.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the governor compared Biron's fate to the poem 'For dreams must die' which is a romantic novel about the lives of Jose Rizal and Leonor Rivera and the song 'The Impossible Dream' by Frank Sinatra.

text: Suno kay Defensor, posible nga matabo man kay Biron ang natabo kay the late US president Abraham Lincoln sa diin walo ka beses ini nga nalutos sang nagpadalagan antes napilian bilang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang tuig 1960.
english: According to Defensor, it is possible that Biron will experience what happened to the late US President Abraham Lincoln where he was defeated eight times when he ran before being elected president of the United States in 1960.

text: Ginapahayag ni Defensor nga posible sa makapila ka beses nga pagpadalagan ni Biron sa pagka gobernador, madaog man ini sa ulihi.
english: Defensor said it is possible that Biron will win several times for governor.

text: Nagalibog man ang ulo sang gobernador kun sin-o ang nagsutsot kay Biron nga magpa recount.
english: The governor is also confused about who incited Biron to recount.

text: Nagkadlaw man si Defensor bangud nagapati si Biron nga ang wala maisip nga 100,000 ka mga boto sang midterm elections ang i-credit sa iya.
english: Defensor also laughed because Biron believes that the uncounted 100,000 votes of the midterm elections will be credited to him.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Biron nga may mga botante nga makapamat-ud nga siya ang ginboto sa balota apang sa paggwa sang resibo sa Vote Counting Machine, si Defensor na ang nakabutang.
english: Biron earlier said that there are voters who can prove that he was voted on the ballot but when the receipt came out of the Vote Counting Machine, it was Defensor.

text: Gindugang man niya mabudlay man i-reconcile ang resulta sang election sa resulta sang survey sa Random Access Consultants Inc.
english: He added that it is also difficult to reconcile the election results with the results of the survey in Random Access Consultants Inc.

text: (RACI) sa diin consistent ini nga nagapangibabaw sa survey.
english: (RACI) sa diin consistent ini nga nagapangibabaw sa survey.

text: Samtang, sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginkadlawan lang ni Cong.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, Cong.

text: Toto  ang  nangin tikang sang iya nalutos nga kasumpong.
english: Toto became the step of his defeated opponent.

text: Suno kay Cong.
english: According to Cong.

text: Toto , kaangay nga  wala sang merito ang mga grounds ni Biron sa pag-file sang election protest.
english: Toto, Biron's grounds for filing an election protest seem to have no merit.

text: Merry gid ang Paskuwa sang lifestyle content creator nga si Kryz Uy kag bana sini nga si Slater Young matapos gin-anunsyo nga nagabusong si Kryz sang ila ikatatlo na nga anak.
english: Lifestyle content creator Kryz Uy and her husband Slater Young are having a Merry Christmas after it was announced that Kryz is pregnant with their third child.

text: Ginpakigbahin ini sang Cebu-based vlogger kag content creator kadungan sang Christmas Eve.
english: The Cebu-based vlogger and content creator shared this during Christmas Eve.

text:
Iya ini gintawag nga “Christmas miracle indeed,” kag nag-greet sa ila followers sang “happy holidays from our growing family to yours.”

Pebrero 2019 sang ginkasal sanday Kryz kag Slater, Hunyo 2020 sang nabun-ag si Scott Knoa kag ginsundan ni Sevi sang Mayo 2022.
english:
He called it a “Christmas miracle indeed,” and greeted their followers with “happy holidays from our growing family to yours.”

Kryz and Slater were married in February 2019, Scott Knoa was born in June 2020 followed by Sevi in ​​May 2022.

text: May yara sila sang podcast show nga ginatawag Skypodcast.#
english: They have a podcast show called Skypodcast.#

text: Naglab-ot sa P12 billion ang kabug-usan nga assets ang na-freeze sang Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) lakip ang P4 billion nga air assets ni Zaldy Co, 3,566 bank accounts, 198 insurance policies, 247 ka mga salakyan, 178 real properties, kag 16 e-wallets.
english: A total of P12 billion in assets were frozen by the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) including Zaldy Co's P4 billion air assets, 3,566 bank accounts, 198 insurance policies, 247 vehicles, 178 real properties, and 16 e-wallets.

text: Ini ang gin-report ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This was reported by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno sa Presidente umpisa pa lamang ini kag sa palaabuton nga mga inadlaw mas madamo nga assets pa ang ma-freeze kag para mabalik ang kwarta sa publiko.
english: The President said this is just the beginning and in the coming days more assets will be frozen and to return the money to the public.

text: Ginpunto man sang Presidente nga promisa niya ini sa publiko nga ang mga ginkawat nga kwarta ang mabalik.
english: The President also pointed out that he promised the public that the stolen money will be returned.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Marcos nga magasumiter man ang ICI kag DPWH sang ebidensya sa Ombudsman para sa rekomendasyon nga magpasaka sang kaso nga plunder, anti-graft, bribery, kag conflict of interest batok sa walo ka mga kongresista nga tag-iya sang construction companies.
english: Marcos also revealed that the ICI and DPWH will also submit evidence to the Ombudsman for a recommendation to file plunder, anti-graft, bribery, and conflict of interest cases against the eight congressmen who own construction companies.

text: ILOILO – Mismo ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) Main office ang magadesisyon sa election protest ni outgoing Iloilo 4th district Cong.
english: ILOILO – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) Main office will decide on the election protest of outgoing Iloilo 4th district Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron matapos nagreklamo sang malutos sa gubernatorial elections sa Probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Ferjenel Biron after complaining about losing the gubernatorial elections in Iloilo Province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Provincial Comelec Officer Atty. Roberto Salazar, iya ginpahayag nga nagakadapat nga may yara sang form kag substance ang election protest agud maghulag ang reklamo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Provincial Comelec Officer Atty. Roberto Salazar, he said that the election protest should have form and substance in order to move the complaint.

text: Suno kay Salazar, mismo ang Comelec Main Office ang mamando kun ano nga mga precinto ukon lugar ang sakop sang election protest.
english: According to Salazar, the Comelec Main Office itself will decide which precincts or areas will be covered by the election protest.

text: Ginpahayag  ni Salazar nga ang Electoral Contests Adjudication Department (ECAD) amo ang may katungdanan sa mga ginapang file nga  election protest.
english: Salazar said the Electoral Contests Adjudication Department (ECAD) is responsible for the filed election protests.

text: Natalana na buwas, Hulyo 12, ang paglunsar sang “Rice for All” program sang Department of Agriculture (DA) agud nga maka-benepisyo ang general population sa presyo sang bugas nga P45 per kilogram tubtub sa P48/kg.
english: The launch of the Department of Agriculture (DA)'s “Rice for All” program is scheduled for tomorrow, July 12, to benefit the general population from the price of rice at P45 per kilogram to P48/kg.

text: Suno kay DA Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa, spokesperson sang ahensya, mahimo nga imported kag local rice na ang i-upod sa sini nga programa.
english: According to DA Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa, spokesperson of the agency, imported and local rice may be included in this program.

text: Mahimo man ini i-dungan suno kay De Mesa sa pagpasangkad sang programa nga nagabaligya sang P29 per kilo nga daan apang maayo pa man nga bugas sa vulnerable sector sa dugang nga Kadiwa sites sa Malabon, Navotas, kag Marikina.
english: De Mesa said this can also be coupled with the expansion of the program that sells P29 per kilo of old but still good rice to the vulnerable sector in additional Kadiwa sites in Malabon, Navotas, and Marikina.

text: Sakop sang mga benepisyaryo sini ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), senior citizens, solo parents, kag persons with disabilities (PWDs).
english: The beneficiaries include the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), senior citizens, solo parents, and persons with disabilities (PWDs).

text: Suno kay De Mesa, madamo ang naga-hingyo kaangay sa construction workers nga kuntani kabahin man sila sang P29 program, apang bangud indi sila covered sini nga programa, pwede suno sa natungdan nga maka-avail sila sa Rice for All program.
english: According to De Mesa, many people like construction workers are requesting that they should be part of the P29 program, but since they are not covered by this program, they can avail of the Rice for All program.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang Rice for All program ang iga-lunsar sa mga lugar nga may yara lamang sang Kadiwa sites.
english: He also clarified that the Rice for All program will be launched in areas where there are only Kadiwa sites.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginpahayag sang DA nga target nila nga pasangkaron pa ang P29 kag Rice for All programs sa Visayas kag Mindanao sa katapusan sang Agusto ukon sa temprano nga bahin sang Septyembre.
english: The DA earlier said it targets to expand the P29 and Rice for All programs in the Visayas and Mindanao by the end of August or early September.

text: Nagapabilin sa Creamline Cool Smashers ang korona sa PVL All-Filipino Conference matapos ginlutos ang sister team sini nga Choco Mucho Flying Titans sa Game 2 sang finals sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: Creamline Cool Smashers retain the crown in the PVL All-Filipino Conference after defeating its sister team Choco Mucho Flying Titans in Game 2 of the finals at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text:
Ini na ang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga All-Filipino crown sang Cool Smashers kag pang-walo naman sa kabug-usan sa maragtas sang liga nga amo pa ang nagsemento sa ila pangalan bilang “undisputed greatest PVL team of all time.”

Nangin makahalawat-hawat ang skor, 20-25, 25-20, 22-25, 25-22 kag 15-11 kun sa diin nagpanguna ang Finals MVP nga si Jema Galanza nga may 20 points kag 16 receptions.
english:
This is the Cool Smashers' fourth consecutive All-Filipino crown and eighth overall in league history, cementing their name as the “undisputed greatest PVL team of all time.”

The scores were 20-25, 25-20, 22-25, 25-22 and 15-11 with Finals MVP Jema Galanza leading the way with 20 points and 16 receptions.

text: Sanday Bernadeth Pons kag Tots Carlos naman ang nagpaulan sang 17 kag 16 points.
english: Bernadeth Pons and Tots Carlos scored 17 and 16 points respectively.

text: Nakahatag ang beterano nga middle blocker nga si Jeannette Panaga sang 13 points samtang si Michele Gumabao kag anay Flying Titans star nga si Bea De Leon ang may tag-seven points.
english: Veteran middle blocker Jeannette Panaga contributed 13 points while Michele Gumabao and former Flying Titans star Bea De Leon had seven points each.

text: Antes nabulsa ang kadalag-an, nangin roller-coaster man ang inagyan sang Cool Smashers sa sini nga edisyon matapos nga nagpang-apat lamang sa elimination round sang ginlutos ini sang Choco Mucho sa semifinals.
english: Before pocketing the victory, the Cool Smashers also had a roller-coaster experience in this edition after finishing fourth in the elimination round when they were defeated by Choco Mucho in the semifinals.

text: Sa sini nga season, nagpangatlo ang Petro Gazz nga may mataas nga points ratio sa Chery Tiggo.
english: This season, Petro Gazz finished third with a high points ratio to Chery Tiggo.

english: James “Jojo” Ang is one of the congressmen recommended by the ICI to file civil and administrative cases with the Office of the Ombudsman.
