english: According to the Independent Commission on Infrastructure, this is based on 1,300 infra projects from 2016 to 2024.

text: Nagmandu ang Bureau of Immigration (BI) nga i-deport ang American actor nga si Lee O’Brian nga amo ang estranged partner sang komedyante nga si Pokwang kag amay sang iya anak nga si Malia.
english: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) has ordered the deportation of American actor Lee O'Brian, the estranged partner of comedian Pokwang and father of her daughter Malia.

text: Sa walo ka pahina nga resolution nga napetsahan sang Disyembre 12, gin-order sang bureau ang deportation sa aktor kasunod sang kaso nga gin-file ni Pokwang sang Hunyo 12 bangud sa pagbayolar sa iya nga work visa.
english: In an eight-page resolution dated December 12, the bureau ordered the actor's deportation following a case filed by Pokwang on June 12 for violating his work visa.

text: Si O’Brian, tumandok sang San Francisco, California, USA, ang nagsugod sa pagtinir sa Pilipinas sang 2015 para sa iya nga acting career.
english: O’Brian, a native of San Francisco, California, USA, started living in the Philippines in 2015 for his acting career.

text: “We thank the Bureau of Immigration for siding with the truth in our case against Lee O’Brian,” suno kay Atty. Rafael Vicente Calinisan nga legal counsel ni Pokwang.
english: “We thank the Bureau of Immigration for siding with the truth in our case against Lee O’Brian,” said Atty. Rafael Vicente Calinisan, Pokwang's legal counsel.

text: “We have been consistent that Lee O’Brian must be made accountable, as his repeated renewal of his tourist visa constitutes fraud and willful misrepresentation of facts, while his work engagements are violations of limitations under which he was admitted as a non-immigrant,” kasugpon sang statement.
english: “We have been consistent that Lee O’Brian must be made accountable, as his repeated renewal of his tourist visa constitutes fraud and willful misrepresentation of facts, while his work engagements are violations of limitations under which he was admitted as a non-immigrant,” the statement added.

text: Ginpaguwa ang deportation order kasunod sang nakit-an nga development sa relasyon nanday Pokwang kag O’Brian kun sa diin gintugutan na sang komedyante ang lalaki nga magbisita kag mag-upod liwat sa ila anak nga babayi.
english: The deportation order was issued following the development in the relationship between Pokwang and O'Brian where the comedian allowed the man to visit and reunite with their daughter.

text: Naglunsar ang India sang serye sang missile strikes sa Pakistani-controlled territory bilang kabahin sang “Operation Sindoor” nga naga-target sang siyam ka mga lokasyon nga naangot sa terrorist infrastructure sa Pakistan-administered Kashmir kag Punjab.
english: India launched a series of missile strikes in Pakistani-controlled territory as part of “Operation Sindoor” targeting nine locations linked to terrorist infrastructure in Pakistan-administered Kashmir and Punjab.

text: Ang tikang kasunod man sang makamamatay nga atake sa Indian-administered Kashmir, nga ginabasol sang India sa Pakistan-based militants apang ginpanginwala man ini sang Pakistan.
english: The move also follows a deadly attack in Indian-administered Kashmir, which India blames on Pakistan-based militants but which Pakistan has also denied.

text: Suno sa Defense Ministry sangIndia, ang strikes nangin focused, restrained, kag naglikaw sa Pakistani military facilities.
english: According to India’s Defense Ministry, the strikes have been focused, restrained, and have avoided Pakistani military facilities.

text: Isa ka bata ang patay kag duha ang pilason sa amo nga missile attack, suno sa Pakistan officials.
english: One child was killed and two wounded in that missile attack, Pakistan officials said.

text: Gin-guba sang Filipina-American nga si Kristina Knott ang iya kaugalingon nga national record sang nagpangibabaw ini sa women’s 100m sa Philippine Athletics Championships sa PhilSports Track Oval sa Pasig.
english: Filipina-American Kristina Knott broke her own national record when she dominated the women’s 100m at the Philippine Athletics Championships at the PhilSports Track Oval in Pasig.

text: Nagdangat lamang sa 11.2 segundos ang time kay Knott nga mas madasig sa 11.27 mark sini nga na-set sa Drake Blue Oval Meet sa United States sang 2020.
english: Knott's time was only 11.2 seconds, faster than his 11.27 mark set at the Drake Blue Oval Meet in the United States in 2020.

text: Buot silingon sini, mas nagahilapit na ini sa qualifying standard para sa Paris Olympics.
english: This means it is getting closer to the qualifying standard for the Paris Olympics.

text: Agud makakuha sang Olympic spot sa women’s 100m, kinahanglan sini malab-ot ang qualifying standard nga 11.07 seconds.
english: To earn an Olympic spot in the women’s 100m, she needed to meet the qualifying standard of 11.07 seconds.

text: Isa ka Tokyo Olympian si Knott kag nagalaum man nga makasulod sa women’s 200m sa Paris.
english: Knott is a Tokyo Olympian and also hopes to qualify for the women’s 200m in Paris.

text: Padayunon sang 28-anyos nga sprinter ang iya paglagas sa Olympic spot paagi sa pagpasakop sa mga kumpetisyon sa Espanya.
english: The 28-year-old sprinter will continue her pursuit of an Olympic spot by competing in competitions in Spain.

text: Tatlo ka mga kongresista ang ginapilian sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) agud mangin kandidato sang partido sa House Speakership.
english: Three congressmen are being selected by the Philippine Democratic Party-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) to be the party's candidate for the House Speakership.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay 3rd district board member kag Congressman-elect Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa ginapilian sang partido sanday anay House Speaker kag re-elected Davao del Norte Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, 3rd district board member and Congressman-elect Lorenz Defensor said that among the party's candidates are former House Speaker and re-elected Davao del Norte Rep.

text: Pantaleon Alvarez, Cong.
english: Pantaleon Alvarez, Cong.

text: Allan Velasco sang Marinduque kag CongDong Gonzales sang Pampanga.
english: Allan Velasco of Marinduque and CongDong Gonzales of Pampanga.

text:
Suno kay Defensor, magaagi pa sa maid-id nga proseso
antes makadesider ang partido kun sin-o ang mangin tiglawas sang partido para magpapili sa nasambit nga posisyon.
english:
According to Defensor, it will go through a thorough process
before the party can decide who will be the party's representative to run for the said position.

text: Samtang, naghatag man sang reaksyon si Cong-elect Defensor tuhoy sa pahayag ni Rep.
english: Meanwhile, Cong-elect Defensor also reacted to Rep.

text: Alvarez nga may yara sang baklanay sang boto sa kamara nga naga-involve sang 150 tubtob 300 million pesos nga kantidad kabaylo sang boto.
english: Alvarez that there is a vote buying in the chamber involving 150 to 300 million pesos in exchange for votes.

text: Suno kay Defensor, wala ini sang may nabaton nga ano man nga tanyag gikan sa sin-o man nga kongresista nga luyag magpungko bilang house speaker.
english: Defensor said he has not received any offer from any congressman who wants to sit as house speaker.

text: Samtang sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Iloilo 3rd district Cong.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Iloilo 3rd district Cong.

text: kag Governor-elect Arthur Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga kaangay nga imposible na ang vote-buying bangud sa masami, ang nagapapili nga house speaker ang wala sang kasumpong kag maathag na ang kadalag-an.
english: and Governor-elect Arthur Defensor Jr., he said that vote-buying is almost impossible because usually, the elected house speaker has no opponent and the victory is clear.

text: Suno naman kay Iloilo 4th district Cong.
english: According to Iloilo 4th district Cong.

text: Ferj Biron, wala man ini  naka-eksperyensiya nga gintuyo baklon ang iya boto para sa house speakership nga sang amo nga tion, si Alvarez man ang nagpapili kag nagdaug.
english: Ferj Biron, he also did not experience any attempt to buy his vote for the house speakership that at that time, Alvarez also ran and won.

text: Nakuhaan sang laragway ang pinasahi nga itsura sang panganod kahapon sang hapon sa Sibunag, Guimaras.
english: The unique appearance of the cloud was captured yesterday afternoon in Sibunag, Guimaras.

text: Ka-bombo, may buot silingon bala ini ukon natabuan lang?
english: Ka-bombo, does this mean anything or is it just a coincidence?

text: Madasig nga gin-aprubahan sa plenaryo sang Senado ang ginaduso nga pondo sang Office of the President (OP) nga nagalab-ot sa P27.3 billion kag ang P854 million nga budget sang Presidential Management Staff (PMS) para sa 2026.
english: The Senate plenary quickly approved the proposed budget of the Office of the President (OP) amounting to P27.3 billion and the P854 million budget of the Presidential Management Staff (PMS) for 2026.

text: Sa plenary deliberations sang Senado para sa budget sang OP para sa masunod nga tuig, wala pa sang lima ka minutos, nagsugtanay ang mga senador nga iendorso ang budget sang OP kag PMS para sa pag-apruba sa second reading.
english: In the plenary deliberations of the Senate for the OP budget for next year, in less than five minutes, senators agreed to endorse the OP and PMS budgets for approval on second reading.

text: Suno kay Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Senador Sherwin Gatchalian, ini na ang ikaapat nga tion nga nag-atubang sa Senado si Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, nga sang damlag lang nagserbe nga tiglikom sang Department of Finance (DOF).
english: According to Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, this is the fourth time that Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, who recently served as secretary of the Department of Finance (DOF), has appeared before the Senate.

text: Nagmosyon naman si Senador Jinggoy Estrada nga tapuson ang interpelasyon para sa OP kag PMS budgets bilang pagpakita sang institutional courtesy sa ehekutibo nga sangay kag bilang pagtahod sa Presidente nga kaupod nila sadto sa Senado sang tion sang 15th kag 16th Congress.
english: Senator Jinggoy Estrada motioned to end the interpellation for the OP and PMS budgets as a show of institutional courtesy to the executive branch and as a sign of respect for the President who was with them in the Senate during the 15th and 16th Congresses.

text: Nagtaas sang 66.2 million ang budget sang OP bangud dako nga parte sini ang igapain para sa pag-host sang Pilipinas sa ASEAN Summit kag mga kaangot nga kahiwatan sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The OP's budget increased by 66.2 million because a large part of it will be allocated for the Philippines' hosting of the ASEAN Summit and related events next year.

text: Hihilingin ng Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) ang pagbibitiw nina Pangulong Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The New People's Alliance (Bayan) will demand the resignation of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: at Vice President Sara Duterte kasabay ng nakatakdang malawakang kilos-protesta sa Linggo, Nobyembre 30.
english: and Vice President Sara Duterte in conjunction with the scheduled massive protest on Sunday, November 30.

text: Ayon kay Bayan Chairperson Teddy Casiño, dapat managot ang lahat ng sangkot sa umano’y sistematikong korapsyon sa pamahalaan, at itinuturing niyang pangunahing responsable si Marcos.
english: According to Bayan Chairperson Teddy Casiño, all those involved in the alleged systematic corruption in the government should be held accountable, and he considers Marcos primarily responsible.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo, sinabi ni Casiño na nadadawit din umano si Duterte dahil sa mga isyu hinggil sa confidential at intelligence funds.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Casiño said Duterte is also involved in issues related to confidential and intelligence funds.

text: Giit niya, nagbabatuhan lamang ng paratang ang dalawang pangunahing Partido, ngunit pareho umanong may kinalaman sa mga anomalya.
english: He insisted that the two main parties are just throwing stones at each other, but both are allegedly involved in anomalies.

text: Hangga’t sila aniya ang nasa pinakamataas na posisyon, hindi inaasahang magkakaroon ng malaya at seryosong imbestigasyon.
english: As long as they are in the highest position, it is not expected that there will be an independent and serious investigation.

text: Kasama rin sa kanilang isusulong ang paghahanda para sa susunod na halalan sakaling magbitiw sa puwesto ang dalawang opisyal.
english: They will also advance preparations for the next election in case the two officials resign.

text: Naninindigan ang grupo na kailangan ang pagtatatag ng isang transition council upang matiyak ang malinis na halalan at maiwasan ang muling pag-impluwensya ng mga political dynasty gaya ng mga Marcos at Duterte.
english: The group insists that the establishment of a transition council is necessary to ensure a clean election and avoid the re-influence of political dynasties like the Marcos and Dutertes.

text: Indi mabaton ni Iloilo 4th district Congressman Ferjenel Biron ang iya kapaslawan sa gubernatorial elections sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo 4th district Congressman Ferjenel Biron cannot accept his failure in the gubernatorial elections in Iloilo province.

text: Nahibaluan nga makaduha ka beses na nga nalutos si Biron sa pagpadalagan sini sa pagka gobernador.
english: Biron has been defeated twice in his run for governor.

text: Una nga nalutos si Biron sang nagpadalagan ini sa gubernatorial elections sang tuig 2013 sa diin nakasumpong sini si outgoing Iloilo Gov.
english: Biron was first defeated in the 2013 gubernatorial elections against outgoing Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: kag liwat naman ini nga napierde sang tinalikdan nga May 13,  2019 midterm elections  sa diin nakasumpong sini ang anak sang gobernador nga si Iloilo 3rd District Congressman kag subong governor elect Arthur ‘Toto’ Defensor Jr.
english: and he lost again in the last May 13, 2019 midterm elections where he was challenged by the governor's son, Iloilo 3rd District Congressman and now governor elect Arthur 'Toto' Defensor Jr.

text: Ang kapaslawan ni Biron sa piniliay ang rason sa pagpasaka sini sang  election protest batok kay Defensor Jr.
english: Biron's failure in the election was the reason for him to file an election protest against Defensor Jr.

text: sa Election Contest and Adjudication Department sang Commission on Elections (Comelec).
english: at the Election Contest and Adjudication Department of the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Cong.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Cong.

text: Biron, iya ginpahayag nga luyag niya pabuksan ang tanan nga mga balota kag magpatigayon sang manual recount sa bilog nga probinsya.
english: Biron, he said he wants to open all the ballots and conduct a manual recount throughout the province.

text: Iya ginapanidugan nga may natabo nga anomaliya sa natabo nga canvassing sang boto.
english: He insisted that there was an anomaly in the canvassing of the vote.

text: Suno kay Biron, may mga botante nga makapamat-ud nga siya ang ginboto sa balota apang sa paggwa sang resibo sa Vote Counting Machine, si Defensor na ang nakabutang.
english: According to Biron, there are voters who can prove that he was voted on the ballot but when the receipt came out of the Vote Counting Machine, it was Defensor.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Biron nga may yara sang kapin 100 mil ka boto sa probinsya sang Iloilo ang wala maisip kag katingalahan kun diin ini nagkadto.
english: Biron also said that there are more than 100,000 votes in Iloilo province that have not been counted and it is strange where they went.

text: Gindugang man niya mabudlay man i-reconcile ang resulta sang election sa resulta sang survey sa Random Access Consultants Inc.
english: He added that it is also difficult to reconcile the election results with the results of the survey in Random Access Consultants Inc.

text: (RACI) sa diin consistent ini nga nagapangibabaw sa survey.
english: (RACI) where it consistently dominates the survey.

text: Samtang, sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginkadlawan lang ni Defensor ang  nangin tikang sang iya nalutos nga kasumpong.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, Defensor laughed at the move of his defeated opponent.

text: Suno kay Defensor, kaangay nga  wala sang merito ang mga grounds ni Biron sa pag-file sang election protest.
english: According to Defensor, Biron's grounds for filing an election protest seem to have no merit.

text: Sa subong suno kay Defensor, wala pa niya nabaton ang kopya sang nasambit nga petisyon.
english: Defensor said he has not yet received a copy of the petition.

text: Nakatilaw na liwat sang matam-is nga kadalag-an ang anay two-division champion nga si Marlon Tapales matapos naagaw sang undefeated Japanese superstar nga si Naoya Inoue ang iya nga WBA kag IBF super-bantamweight titles paagi sa 10th-round knockout sa undisputed championship fight sa Tokyo, Japan sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Former two-division champion Marlon Tapales once again tasted a sweet victory after undefeated Japanese superstar Naoya Inoue captured his WBA and IBF super-bantamweight titles by 10th-round knockout in an undisputed championship fight in Tokyo, Japan last year.

text: Nahimo ini sang Pinoy boxer matapos gintumba sa una nga round si Nattapong Jankaew sang Thailand kag nabulsa ang WBC Asian Continental super bantamweight title kagab-i, Mayo 10, sa Pasay.
english: The Filipino boxer did this after knocking out Nattapong Jankaew of Thailand in the first round and pocketing the WBC Asian Continental super bantamweight title last night, May 10, in Pasay.

text: Una nga na-knockdown sang Lanao del Norte pride ang Thai boxer paagi sa iya nga clean right hook sa 1:59 mark sang first round.
english: Lanao del Norte pride first knocked down the Thai boxer with a clean right hook at the 1:59 mark of the first round.

text: Wala pa isa ka minuto ang nagligad, liwat ini nga natumba bangud sa left hook sang 32-anyos nga si Tapales.
english: Less than a minute later, he was knocked down again by a left hook from 32-year-old Tapales.

text: Sa 2:15 nga marka sang amo man nga round, ang uppercut ni Tapales ang nagtumba pa liwat kay Jankaew kag amo na ang dalayon nga nagtapos sa sambuwa.
english: At the 2:15 mark of the same round, Tapales' uppercut knocked down Jankaew again and immediately ended the fight.

text: Nabatak sini ang professional boxing record ni Tapales sa 38-4 nga may 20 knockouts samtang nanaog naman ang record ni Jankaew sa 12-4 nga may 8 knockouts.
english: It pushed Tapales' professional boxing record to 38-4 with 20 knockouts while Jankaew's record dropped to 12-4 with 8 knockouts.

text: Plano ni Tapales nga magbalik sa world championship picture kasunod sini nga kadalag-an sa atubang sang Pinoy fans.
english: Tapales plans to return to the world championship picture following this victory in front of Pinoy fans.

text: Sa co-main event sini nga sambuwa, nalutos ang isa man ka former world title challenger nga si Reymart Gaballo sa kamot sang Mexican nga si Kenbun Torres.
english: In the co-main event of this fight, former world title challenger Reymart Gaballo lost to Mexican Kenbun Torres.

text: Nauntat man ang hampang sa Round 1 matapos tatlo ka beses man nga natumba si Gaballo.#
english: The match was also stopped in Round 1 after Gaballo fell three times.

text: Apisar nadala man sa listahan sang showbiz breakup subong nga 2023, ginsigurado nanday Cherry Pie Picache kag Edu Manzano nga maayo ang ila pagtamdanay, mag-abyan gihapon, kag may pagpalangga gihapon sa isa kag isa.
english: Despite being included in the list of showbiz breakups this 2023, Cherry Pie Picache and Edu Manzano have made sure that they have a good relationship, are still friends, and still have love for each other.

text: Ang 53-anyos nga aktres mismo ang nagkumpirma sang huring-huring nga nagbulagay na sila sang 68-anyos nga host-actor apang wala na sini gin-detalye ang rason sa pagtapos sang ila nga relasyon.
english: The 53-year-old actress herself confirmed the rumors that she and the 68-year-old host-actor had split but did not elaborate on the reason for ending their relationship.

text: “We’re very good friends; he’s a very good person, very good friend and you know, we will always love each other,” suno kay Pichache.
english: “We’re very good friends; he’s a very good person, very good friend and you know, we will always love each other,” according to Pichache.

text: May clues man nga nahatag nga madugay-dugay na ang ila nga breakup, apang suno sa aktres, mangin “merry” gihapon ang iya Paskwa apisar single bangud natun-an na niya nga wala dapat gina-depende sa iban nga mga tawo ang kalipay.
english: There are also clues given that their breakup has been going on for a long time, but according to the actress, her Christmas will still be “merry” even though she is single because she has learned that happiness should not depend on other people.

text: “Sa edad kong ito ngayon, I cannot depend my happiness anymore on somebody else.
english: “At this age, I cannot depend my happiness anymore on somebody else.

text: Besides, dapat din buo ako or whatever or kumpleto ako kung magmamamahal ako ulit,” pahayag sang beterana nga aktres.
english: Besides, I must also be whole or whatever or complete if I love again,” said the veteran actress.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka-date na ang duha sang bataon pa lamang sila apang nagbalikay sang nagligad lamang nga Nobyembre 2021.
english: The two dated when they were younger but got back together last November 2021.

text: Natigayon ang ila nga reunion kag second chance sa dating sang pareho sila nga nangin kabahin sang teleserye nga Marry Me, Marry You kaupod kanday Janine Gutierrez kag Paulo Avelino.#
english: Their reunion and second chance at dating came when they were both part of the television series Marry Me, Marry You with Janine Gutierrez and Paulo Avelino.

text: Matapos ang sunud-sunod nga pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa pungsod sang mga tinalikdan nga semana, lauman na naman sang mga motorista ang saka sa presyo sini sa bwas, Hulyo 9, 2024.
english: After a series of price hikes in the country in recent weeks, motorists can expect another price hike tomorrow, July 9, 2024.

text:
Suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry, yari ang ipatuman nga oil price hike:

Gasolina – magasaka sang P1.60Diesel – magasaka sang P0.60Kerosene – magasaka sang P0.65

Suno sa ahensiya, ang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong ang bangud sa geopolitical tension sa Middle East kag pag-isol sang US crude investors.
english:
According to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry, here are the oil price hikes to be implemented:

Gasoline – to rise by P1.60Diesel – to rise by P0.60 Kerosene – to rise by P0.65

The agency said the rise in fuel prices was due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the withdrawal of US crude investors.

text: Nahibaluan nga humalin sang Enero subong nga tuig, nagdangat na sa P9.25 ang ginsaka sa presyo sang kada litro sang Gasolina, P8.40 sa kada-litro sang Diesel, kag P1.75 sa Kerosene.
english: Since January this year, the price of gasoline has been increased by P9.25 per liter, diesel by P8.40 per liter, and kerosene by P1.75 per liter.

text: ILOILO CITY-– Wala sang ideya kag wala naka-eksperyensya si outgoing Iloilo City Lone District Congressman kag sa subong Mayor Elect Jerry Treñas sang  tagtaganay sang kwarta sa Kamara agud  magboto sa nagapapili bilang  House Speaker.
english: ILOILO CITY-– Outgoing Iloilo City Lone District Congressman and now Mayor Elect Jerry Treñas has no idea and no experience of giving money to the House of Representatives to vote for the House Speaker.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan man sa mga alegasyon ni  Davao Del Norte Rep.
english: This is also in connection with the allegations of Davao Del Norte Rep.

text: Pantaleon Alvarez nga may yara sang  tagtaganay sang kwarta kabaylo sang suporta kag boto para sa mga nagapapili bilang  House Speaker.// Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga sa iya pagpungko bilang kongresista wala siya sang may nadumduman nga pagbinaydanay sa tion sang pagpili  ukon pagboto kun sin-o ang magapungko bilang house speaker.
english: Pantaleon Alvarez that there is a money giver in exchange for support and votes for those who are running for House Speaker.// In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Treñas said that during his tenure as a congressman, he did not remember any disputes during the election or vote on who will sit as House Speaker.

text: Ang nahibaluan lang  niya suno kay Treñas amo  nga ang mga partido ang nagapatawag sang ila tagsa ka mga miyembro agud istoryahan ang ila mangin desisyon sa pagbinotohay.
english: Treñas said he only knows that the parties are calling their respective members to discuss their decision on the vote.

text: Nakabatak na sa Signal number 2 ang pila ka mga lugar sa Eastern Samar bangud sa bagyo Tino.
english: Some areas in Eastern Samar have been placed under Signal number 2 due to Typhoon Tino.

text: Suno sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), Nakita ang sentro sang bagyo sa may 605 kilometers sang Sidlangan nga bahin sang Guiuan, Eastern Samar.
english: According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the center of the typhoon was found about 605 kilometers east of Guiuan, Eastern Samar.

text:
Ini may dala nga hangid nga nagadangat sa 100 kilometers per hour kag pagmadlos sang 125km/h.

Ang mga lugar nga yara sa signal number 2 ang ginalakipan sang Guiuan, Salcedo kag Mercedes sa Eastern Samar.
english:
It has winds of up to 100 kilometers per hour and gusts of 125km/h.

Areas under signal number 2 include Guiuan, Salcedo and Mercedes in Eastern Samar.

text: Nakabatak naman sa signal number 1 ang mga lugar sang Barcelona, Bulusan, Magallanes, Gubat, Santa Magdalena, Casiguran, Juban, Bulan, Irosin, Matnog sa Sorsogon kag Masbate lakipna ang Ticao Island.
english: The areas of Barcelona, ​​Bulusan, Magallanes, Gubat, Santa Magdalena, Casiguran, Juban, Bulan, Irosin, Matnog in Sorsogon and Masbate including Ticao Island are under signal number 1.

text: Signal number 1 man ang nabilin nga bahin sang Eastern Samar , Northern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Cebu, Bohol; Negros Oriental; Negros Occidental; Guimaras, Iloilo kag Capiz.
english: The rest of Eastern Samar, Northern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Cebu, Bohol are also under signal number 1; Negros Oriental; Negros Occidental; Guimaras, Iloilo and Capiz.

text: Lakip man ang Surigao del Norte; Surigao del Sur; Agusan del Sur; kag Agusan del Norte .
english: Also included are Surigao del Norte; Surigao del Sur; Agusan del Sur; and Agusan del Norte .

text: Makabatyag man sang mabaskog nga pag-ulan kag hangin sa mga nasambit nga mga lugar.
english: Heavy rain and winds are also expected in these areas.

text: Posible mag-landfall sa Eastern Samar, Leyte ukon Dinagat Island sang gabi karon, Nobyembre 3 ukon buwas sa Aga, Nobyembre 4.
english: It is likely to landfall in Eastern Samar, Leyte or Dinagat Island tonight, November 3 or tomorrow morning, November 4.

text: Ginapapreparar na sang PAGASA ang mga emergency offices sang nasambit nga mga lugar bangud sa mga pag-ulan tuga sang amo nga bagyo.
english: PAGASA is already preparing the emergency offices of these areas due to the rains caused by the typhoon.

text: Nagpamahog sang pagpasaka sang sampaw-sampaw nga kaso si Iloilo City Lone District Congressman kag subong Iloilo City Mayor-elect Jerry Treñas batok sa administrasyon ni  outgoing Mayor Jose Espinosa III.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Congressman and now Iloilo City Mayor-elect Jerry Treñas has threatened to file multiple cases against the administration of outgoing Mayor Jose Espinosa III.

text: Ini sa tion nga may makit-an nga mga iligalidad sa mga transakyon sa idalom sang administrasyon ni Espinosa.
english: This comes at a time when illegalities are being found in transactions under the Espinosa administration.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Cong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Cong.

text: Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga pat-uron niya nga mabusisi kag maid-idan sang maayo sang Local Governance Transition Team sa patigayunon nga inventory sang  mga propedad sang Local Government Unit; pagtipon kag pagpreserba sang tanan nga dokumento kag mga records;pag-audit sang mga personnel sang syudad kag madamo pa.
english: Treñas, he said he will ensure that the Local Governance Transition Team will conduct a thorough inventory of the properties of the Local Government Unit; collection and preservation of all documents and records;audit of city personnel and more.

text: Suno sa kongresista, katuyuan sini nga maprotektahan ang interes sang pumuluyo sang syudad sang Iloilo.
english: According to the congressman, the purpose of this is to protect the interests of the people of Iloilo City.

text: Nahibaluan nga gintukod ang transition team bilang pamaagi sa pagpasiguro nga mangin matalunsay ang transisyon gikan sa daan nga administrasyon saylo sa bag-o nga administrasyon sa tion nga magpungko na ang mga bag-o na -elihir nga opisyales sang syudad sa Hulyo 1, 2019.
english: The transition team was established as a way to ensure a smooth transition from the old administration to the new administration when the newly elected city officials take office on July 1, 2019.

text: Samtang, nagpangabay naman si Espinosa kay Treñas nga kuntani indi na lang magpasaka sang kaso sa mga department heads nga ginapahayag nagkampanya para sa iya sang piniliay.
english: Meanwhile, Espinosa asked Treñas not to file cases against department heads who allegedly campaigned for him during the election.

text: Suno kay Espinosa, wala ini nagapamilit sa bisan sin-o nga empleyado sang Iloilo City Hall nga magkampanya para sa iya.
english: Espinosa said he is not forcing any employee of Iloilo City Hall to campaign for him.

text: Natural lang suno sa alkalde nga may banggi-anay kag may sakitanay sang buot sang eleksyon.
english: The mayor said it is natural that there will be fights and hurt feelings during the election.

text: Apang subong nga natapos na ang eleksyon, kinahanglan nga mag move forward ukon magpinatawaray ang tanan.
english: But now that the election is over, everyone needs to move forward or forgive each other.

text: Ginlutos sang Creamline Cool Smashers ang sister team sini nga Choco Mucho Flying Titans sa imbukada nga hampang sa Premier Volleyball League (PVL) 2024 All-Filipino Conference best-of-three finals.
english: Creamline Cool Smashers defeated its sister team Choco Mucho Flying Titans in the opening match of the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) 2024 All-Filipino Conference best-of-three finals.

text: Sa atubang sang masobra 17,400 ka volleyball fans sa Smart Araneta Coliseum, naka-recover ang defending champions sa kabos nga puntos sa opening set kag ginpakita ang determinasyon nga madepensahan ang titulo, 24-26, 25-20, 25-21, 25-16.
english: In front of more than 17,400 volleyball fans at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, the defending champions recovered from a poor opening set and showed determination to defend the title, 24-26, 25-20, 25-21, 25-16.

text: Nangin makahalawat-hawat pa ang ikapaat nga set sang nawigit sa puntos ang Cool Smashers, 9-5, antes napatas ang skor sa 13.
english: The fourth set was even more exciting when the Cool Smashers pulled ahead, 9-5, before leveling the score at 13.

text: Ang net touch error sa Choco Mucho ang nangin lyabe para makakuha sang lead ang Creamline tubtub nga nakuha ang control sa set, napasaka sa pito ang antad, 21-14, tubtub dalayon nakuha ang kadalag-an sa Game 1.
english: A net touch error in Choco Mucho was the key for Creamline to take control of the set, increasing the gap to seven, 21-14, and immediately winning Game 1.

text: Naka-21 puntos si Jema Galanza nga amo ang Player of the Game samtang may 17 points naman si Tots Carlos.
english: Jema Galanza scored 21 points while Tots Carlos had 17 points.

text: Sa Flying Titans, may game-high nga 27 puntos si Sisi Rondina samtang naka-15 puntos naman si Royse Tubino.
english: For the Flying Titans, Sisi Rondina had a game-high 27 points while Royse Tubino scored 15 points.

text: Balantayan ang Game 2 sa Domingo, Mayo 12, sa amo gihapon nga venue.
english: Watch Game 2 on Sunday, May 12, at the same venue.

text: Pananglitan magdaog pa liwat sa ikaduha nga hampang, ini na ang mangin ika-walo nga kampyonato sang Creamline sa liga kag ikaduha nga sunod-sunod pagkatapos sang Second All-Filipino Conference sang 2023 season sang PVL.
english: If it wins the second game, it will be Creamline's eighth league championship and second in a row after the Second All-Filipino Conference in the 2023 PVL season.

text: Ini man ang ila makabig nga balos sa Flying Titans nga nakakuha anay sang breakthrough five-set win batok sa ila sang ginpatigayon ang semifinals isa ka semana na ang nagligad.#
english: This is also their revenge against the Flying Titans who had a breakthrough five-set win against them in the semifinals a week ago.

text: Nagdepensa si US President Donald Trump matapos ini gin-ulan sang pagpakamalaot bangud sa pag-post sang picture kun sa diin nakasuksok siya sang bayo sang Santo Papa.
english: US President Donald Trump has defended himself after he was condemned for posting a picture of himself wearing the Pope's clothes.

text: Suno kay Trump, lahog-lahog lang ang AI-generated image.
english: According to Trump, the AI-generated image is just a joke.

text: Pahayag pa sini, indi man mga Katoliko ang nagpangakig kundi ang mga fake news media.
english: He said it was not Catholics who were angry but the fake news media.

text: “They can’t take a joke,” suno kay Trump samtang naga-atubang sa reporters sa Oval Office.
english: “They can’t take a joke,” Trump said as he faced reporters in the Oval Office.

text:
Dugang sini: “You don’t mean the Catholics, you mean the fake news media … the Catholics loved it.”

Dugang sini, indi siya ang naghimo sang picture kag indi man siya ang nagbutang sini sa Truth Social media platform nga amo ang naglapta online.
english:
It added: “You don’t mean the Catholics, you mean the fake news media … the Catholics loved it.”

He added that he did not make the picture and he did not put it on the Truth Social media platform that spread online.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Trump nga naham-ot pa gani si First lady Melania Trump sa picture.
english: Trump also said that First Lady Melania Trump was even in the picture.

text: “I have no idea where it came from,” dugang sini.
english: “I have no idea where it came from,” it added.

text: “Maybe it was AI.
english: “Maybe it was AI.

text: But I know nothing about it.
english: But I know nothing about it.

text: I just saw it last evening.
english: I just saw it last evening.

text: Actually my wife thought it was cute.
english: Actually my wife thought it was cute.

text:
She said, isn’t that nice?”

Naglahog man siya nga indi man kasado ang mga Santo Papa gani nga mabudlayan gid siya nga makuha ang amo nga pwesto.
english:
She said, isn’t that nice?”

He also joked that the Popes are not married so it would be very difficult for him to get the position.

text: “Actually I would not be able to be married though,” suno kay Trump.
english: “Actually I would not be able to be married though,” according to Trump.

text: “That would be a lot.
english: “That would be a lot.

text: I’d have to — to the best of my knowledge, popes aren’t big on getting married, are they?
english: I’d have to — to the best of my knowledge, popes aren’t big on getting married, are they?

text:
Not that we know of, no.”

Nahibaluan nga sa picture nga na-share sang nagligad nga semana, suksok ni Trump ang traditional Catholic mitre, cross kag white cassock.
english:
Not that we know of, no.”

In the picture shared last week, Trump is wearing the traditional Catholic miter, cross and white cassock.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtambong man si Trump sa lubong ni Pope Francis kag masako subong ang College of Cardinals sa pagpreparar sa pagpili sa bag-o nga Santo Papa para mangin lider sang Simbahang Katolika.#
english: Trump also attended the funeral of Pope Francis and the College of Cardinals is now busy preparing to elect the new Pope to be the leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Ginsuspinde ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang klase sa syudad sang Iloilo para buwas, Nobyembre 3, bilang pagpanghanda sa mangin epekto sang Bagyo Tino.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas has suspended classes in Iloilo City for tomorrow, November 3, in preparation for the impact of Typhoon Tino.

text: Sakop sang suspension ang klase sa tanan nga lebel sa pampubliko kag pribado nga mga eskwelahan.
english: The suspension covers classes at all levels in public and private schools.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson sang alkalde, iya ginpahayag nga kabahin ini sang pagpangaman sang syudad sa posible makusog nga hangin, pag-ulan, kag pagbaha.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of the mayor, she said this is part of the city's preparedness against possible strong winds, rain, and flooding.

text: Ginklaro sini nga sa latest advisory sang alkalde, magapadayon naman ang trabaho kag operasyon sa Iloilo City Hall.
english: He clarified that in the latest advisory of the mayor, the work and operation of the Iloilo City Hall will continue.

text: Ginapahanumdom sa tanan ilabi na sa mga nagapuyo sa flood-prone, manubo, kag coastal areas nga magkoordinar gid sa barangay officials para sa posible patigayunon nga preemptive evacuation.
english: Everyone is reminded especially those living in flood-prone, low-lying, and coastal areas to coordinate with barangay officials for possible preemptive evacuation.

text: Pananglitan kinahanglan ang pagbakwit, may yara sang 450 ka evacuation centers nga yara sa tanan nga distrito.
english: In case evacuation is required, there are 450 evacuation centers located in all districts.

text: Naka-preposition man ang food packs sa tanan nga distrito para nga mapanagtag kun may yara sang emerhensya.
english: Food packs are also prepositioned in all districts for distribution in case of emergency.

text: Ginpasiguro man nga naka-monitor 24/7 ang Iloilo City Operations Center agud nga maka-responde gilayon kag agud nga makahatag sang advisories sa mga pumuluyo kadungan sang bagyo.
english: He also assured that the Iloilo City Operations Center is monitored 24/7 to respond immediately and to provide advisories to the residents during the typhoon.

text: Kaina sang aga sang nagsulod si Tino sa Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: Tino entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility yesterday morning.

text: Alas dos subong nga hapon, nahimo na ini nga Severe Tropical Storm.
english: As of 2 pm, it has become a Severe Tropical Storm.

text: Nakuhaan sang suspected shabu ang isa ka 11- anyos nga lalaki sa Abada Escay, Barangay Vista Alegre, Bacolod City.
english: An 11-year-old boy was recovered with suspected shabu in Abada Escay, Barangay Vista Alegre, Bacolod City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Bacolod kay Barangay Kagawad Elizde Bernardino, ginpalapitan nila ang bata kag ginhaboy sini gilayon ang sachets sang suspected shabu nga iya nga ginpulot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Bacolod, Barangay Kagawad Elizde Bernardino said they approached the child and he immediately threw away the sachets of suspected shabu that he picked up.

text: Suno sa kagawad, ginpamangkot nila ang menor de edad kun sa diin sini ginkuha, apang sabat sang bata nga ini ang halin sa basurahan.
english: According to the kagawad, they asked the minor where he got it, but the child replied that it was from the garbage dump.

text: Apang wala man nakumpirmar kun sa basurahan gid man nakuha sang bata ang ginapatihan illegal nga droga.
english: However, it was not confirmed whether the child actually got the suspected illegal drugs from the garbage dump.

text: Pahayag pa sang kagawad, nga ang lugar kun sa diin narecover ang sachets sang suspected sa shabu ang kilala naman nga may nagakatabo nga madata nga pagbaligyaanay sang druga.
english: The kagawad said the area where the sachets of suspected shabu were recovered is known for drug trafficking.

text: 11 ka sachets sang suspected shabu ang narecover kun sa diin nagabug-at sang kapin sa 5 grams.
english: 11 sachets of suspected shabu weighing more than 5 grams were recovered.

text: Suno sa Barangay Kagawad, ang bata ang residente sang Barangay Sincang Airport apang nagakadto lang sa iya paryente sa Barangay Vista Alegre.
english: According to the Barangay Kagawad, the child is a resident of Barangay Sincang Airport but only goes to his relative in Barangay Vista Alegre.

text: Bulagay naman ang mga ginakanan sang bata.
english: The child's parents are separated.

text: Ginpatigayon ang turn-over sang sachets sang suspected shabu sa mga kapulisan sa Barangay Hall sang Barangay Vista Alegre.
english: The sachets of suspected shabu were turned over to the police at the Barangay Hall of Barangay Vista Alegre.

text: Nagpanugyan ang Barangay Kagawad sa mga pumuluyo sang Barangay nga mangin mabinantayon bangud ang illegal nga druga ang makaguba sa kabuhi sang mga kabataan.
english: The Barangay Kagawad advised the residents of the Barangay to be vigilant because illegal drugs can ruin the lives of children.

text: Nakaabot na sa Vatican ang tanan nga mga cardinal nga eligible sa pagpasakop sa Conclave kun sa diin iga-eleher ang bag-o nga Santo Papa.
english: All cardinals eligible to participate in the Conclave where the new Pope will be elected have arrived at the Vatican.

text: Suno sa Vatican, 133 cardinals na ang nakaabot sa Roma antes pa man pormal nga mag-umpisa nga papal election buwas, Mayo 7.
english: According to the Vatican, 133 cardinals have arrived in Rome before the formal start of the papal election tomorrow, May 7.

text: 170 man ka mga Cardinals lakip ang 132 ka Cardinal electors ang nagpartisipar sa eleventh General Congregation sang Lunes sang hapon (oras sa Roma).
english: Also 170 Cardinals including 132 Cardinal electors participated in the eleventh General Congregation on Monday afternoon (Rome time).

text: Lakip sa gintutukan sang congregation amo ang ethnocentrism sa simbahan kag sosyudad; amo man ang migration, migrants bilang regalo, kag ang importansya sang pagsuporta sa pagtuo sang migrants.
english: Among the congregation's focuses were ethnocentrism in the church and society; also migration, migrants as a gift, and the importance of supporting migrants’ faith.

text: Nadiskusyunan man ang nagapadayon nga mga gyera kag kumplikto sa kalibutan.
english: The ongoing wars and conflicts in the world were also discussed.

text: Yara man ang Synod on Synodality kag ecclesiology of communion, kag ang commitment kag katungdanan sang cardinals nga suportahan ang bag-o nga Santo Papa.
english: There is also the Synod on Synodality and ecclesiology of communion, and the commitment and duty of cardinals to support the new Pope.

text: Myerkules sang hapon oras sa Roma natalana nga mag-umpisa ang Conclave sa sulod sang sirado nga Sistine Chapel agud nga makapili sang lider sang 1.4-billion-member Catholic Church.
english: The Conclave is scheduled to begin inside the closed Sistine Chapel on Wednesday afternoon Rome time to elect the leader of the 1.4-billion-member Catholic Church.

text: Duha ka Cardinals nga isa halin sa Spain kag isa halin sa Kenya ang indi makaupod sa conclave bangud sa problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Two Cardinals, one from Spain and one from Kenya, will not be able to join the conclave due to health problems.

text: ANTIQUE– Nagapabilin nga mapainubuson si Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao matapos magdaug sa pagka gobernador batok kay Cong.
english: ANTIQUE – Antique Governor Rhodora Cadiao remains humble after winning the governor's race against Cong.

text: Exequiel Javier.
english: Exequiel Javier.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cadiao, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ang iya nga pagpasalamat sa mga Antiqueño nga nagboto sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cadiao said he is very grateful to the Antiqueños who voted for him.

text: Ginpahayag ni Cadiao nga ang iya kasumpong ang mabudlay piyerdihon bangud nga ang pamilya Javier ang kilala nga mga pulitiko sa ila lugar.
english: Cadiao said his opponent is difficult to defeat because the Javier family are well-known politicians in their area.

text: Magluwas kay Cadiao, halos kalabanan sa iya mga ka-partido ang nagdala-og man sa midterm elections sa diin kabaliskaran naman ang natabo sang 2016 elections.
english: Besides Cadiao, almost most of his party colleagues also won the midterm elections where the opposite happened in the 2016 elections.

text: Nagapakita lamang ini suno sa gobernador nga patas ang tanan sa patag sang pulitika.
english: The governor said this only shows that everyone is equal in the political arena.

text: Sa subong suno sa natungdan, iya padayunon ang mga proyekto nga naumpisahan na sang nakaligad nga administrasyon.
english: For now, he said, he will continue the projects that were started by the previous administration.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Cadiao nga indi na ma-into ang mga botante sa subong bisan pa nga nagapamakal sang boto ang iya kasumpong sa pulitika.
english: Cadiao also said that voters will not be tempted now even if his political opponent is buying votes.

text: Ginkalipay man niya nga ang kontrobersyal nga 2019 budget sang probinsya sang Antique ang napasar na ugaling naabutan lang sang election banning.
english: He also welcomed the fact that the controversial 2019 budget of the province of Antique was passed but was caught up in the election ban.

text:
Yari ang reaksyon ni Cadiao sa iya liwat nga pagdaug sa pagka gobernador sang Antique:

Samtang, yari naman ang akusayson ni Cadiao batok sa iya kasumpong sa pulitika:

Pamati-an ang pahayag ni Cadiao tuhoy sa update sa 2019 budget sang probinsya sang Antique:
english:
Here is Cadiao's reaction to his re-election as governor of Antique:

Meanwhile, here is Cadiao's accusation against his political opponent:

Cadiao is also ready for reconciliation with the Javier family and all his political opponents, here is his statement:

text: Nag-report ang state weather bureau nga mataas ang risgo nga may matabo nga storm surge sa masunod nga 48 oras sa madamo nga areas sa Pilipinas bangud sa Bagyo Tino.
english: The state weather bureau reported that there is a high risk of storm surge in the next 48 hours in many areas in the Philippines due to Typhoon Tino.

text: Lakip sa ginpasaka sa yellow warning ang Iloilo, Capiz, kag Guimaras.
english: Iloilo, Capiz, and Guimaras are among those placed on yellow warning.

text: Ini nagakahulugan nga posible magadangat sa isa tubtub duha ka metros ang storm surge.
english: This means that the storm surge is likely to reach one to two meters.

text: May yellow warning man sa Agusan del Norte, Biliran, Bohol, Camiguin, Cebu, Leyte, Masbate, Misamis Oriental, Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, Northern Samar, Samar (Western Samar), Siquijor, Sorsogon, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte, kag Surigao del Sur.
english: There is also a yellow warning for Agusan del Norte, Biliran, Bohol, Camiguin, Cebu, Leyte, Masbate, Misamis Oriental, Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, Northern Samar, Samar (Western Samar), Siquijor, Sorsogon, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte, and Surigao del Sur.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpasaka ang red warning sa Eastern Samar nga nagakahulugan sang posible storm surges nga nagalapaw sa tres metros.
english: Meanwhile, a red warning has been raised in Eastern Samar which means possible storm surges exceeding three meters.

text: May orange warning naman sa Dinagat Islands, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Northern Samar, Samar (Western Samar), kag Surigao del Norte kun sa diin magalab-ot ang storm surge sa 2.1 tubtub sa tres metros.
english: There is an orange warning for Dinagat Islands, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Northern Samar, Samar (Western Samar), and Surigao del Norte where the storm surge will reach 2.1 to three meters.

text: Gina-abisuhan sang PAGASA ang publiko nga maglikaw anay sa coastal kag beach areas, suspendihon ang maritime activities, kag magsaka sa mataas nga mga lugar nga malayo sa coastlines kag storm surge-prone areas.
english: PAGASA advises the public to avoid coastal and beach areas, suspend maritime activities, and climb to high places away from coastlines and storm surge-prone areas.

text: Kaina sang aga sang nagsulod si Tino sa Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: Tino entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility yesterday morning.

text: Alas dos subong nga hapon, nahimo na ini nga Severe Tropical Storm.
english: As of 2 pm, it has become a Severe Tropical Storm.

text: Ginapangita na sang otoridad ang lawas sang isa ka transportation network vehicle services (TNVS) driver nga ginholdap kag ginapatihan nga ginpatay sang iya nga mga pasahero.
english: Authorities are searching for the body of a transportation network vehicle services (TNVS) driver who was robbed and believed to have been killed by his passengers.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Cavite.
english: The incident occurred in Cavite.

text: Ang krimen mabatian sa video halin sa recording sang dashcam sang salakyan sang biktima.
english: The crime can be heard on video from the dashcam recording of the victim's car.

text: Base sa impormasyon, nagsakay ang tatlo ka mga suspek sa isa ka establisimyento sa Parañaque City sang May 18.
english: According to information, the three suspects boarded an establishment in Parañaque City on May 18.

text: Nakita man ang isa ka suspek nga may ginkuha nga kutsilyo sa mga tanom.
english: A suspect was also seen with a knife removed from the vegetation.

text: Sa dashcam footage sang salakyan, mabatian ang istoryahan sang mga suspek tuhoy sa pagkuha sa cellphone at kag ang pagpatay nila sa biktima.
english: In the dashcam footage of the vehicle, the suspects can be heard talking about taking the cellphone and killing the victim.

text: May nakit-an naman nga CCTV footage ang NBI kun sa diin yara ang duha ka suspek nga nanaog halin sa ginkawat nga salakyan.
english: The NBI also found CCTV footage of the two suspects getting out of the stolen vehicle.

text: Hustisya naman ang ginasinggitan sang pamilya sang biktima kag nagalaum nga makit-an na ang lawas sini.
english: The victim's family is crying for justice and hopes that his body will be found.

text: Natumod naman sang NBI ang identity sang mga suspek nga pasakaan sang kaso nga carnapping kag robbery with homicide.
english: The NBI has identified the suspects and will be charged with carnapping and robbery with homicide.

text: ILOILO – Nagakadapat nga tahuron kag mag move-on na sa nangin resulta sang eleksyon.
english: ILOILO – The election results should be respected and moved on.

text: Ini ang pahayag ni outgoing Iloilo 1st District Cong.
english: This is the statement of outgoing Iloilo 1st District Cong.

text: Richard Garin tuhoy sa pagaklutos sang ka-partido nga si Iloilo 4th District Cong.
english: Richard Garin on the embrace of his partymate Iloilo 4th District Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron sa gubernatorial race.
english: Ferjenel Biron in the gubernatorial race.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Cong.

text: Garin, iya ginpahayag nga dapat nga tahuron ang desisyon sang pumuluyo.
english: Garin, he said the decision of the people should be respected.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Cong.
english: He also said that Cong.

text: Garin nga makaligad sang tatlo ka tuig, magala-in naman ang mga pulitiko nga magaserbe sa gobyerno.
english: Garin said that after three years, the politicians who will serve in the government will be different.

text: Kun ano man nga mga sirkumstansya suno sa mamalidha, nagakadapat nga atubangon ini sang tagsa ka pulitiko, nalutos man ukon nagdaug.
english: Whatever the circumstances, the lawmaker said, every politician, whether defeated or victorious, should face them.

text: Sa baylo nga magbinahin-bahin, dapat suno sa natungdan nga maghugpong ang tanan nga pulitiko para sa kauswagan sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Instead of being divided, he said all politicians should unite for the development of Iloilo province.

text: Nanindugan si Quezon City 1st District Rep.
english: Quezon City 1st District Rep.

text: Arjo Atayde nga wala siya sang kahilabtanan sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Arjo Atayde said he has nothing to do with the anomalous flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Suno sa iya, bilang kongresista wala siya sang ikasarang nga magdikta sa mga proseso sang DPWH.
english: He said that as a congressman he does not have the ability to dictate the processes of the DPWH.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga wala siya nangin kabahin sang Bicameral Conference Committee.
english: He also clarified that he was not part of the Bicameral Conference Committee.

text: “I also made it very clear before the Commission that I have no connection and no relationship with Mr. Pacifico Discaya.
english: “I also made it very clear before the Commission that I have no connection and no relationship with Mr. Pacifico Discaya.

text: Wala pong kahit anong ugnayan na magdudugtong sa amin,” pahayag ni Atayde matapos mag-atubang sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) subong nga Martes, Nov.
english: There is no connection between us,” Atayde said after appearing before the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) on Tuesday, Nov.

text: “I will continue to cooperate fully with the ICI until it completes its work.
english: “I will continue to cooperate fully with the ICI until it completes its work.

text: Haharap muli ako kung kinakailangan,” dugang pa niya.
english: I will face back if necessary,” he added.

text: Sumama ang pakiramdam ng ilang mga Ilonggo na bumisita sa mga sementeryo sa Iloilo City ngayong araw kasabay ng paggunita sa Undas.
english: Some Ilonggos who visited the cemeteries in Iloilo City today felt the same way in conjunction with the commemoration of Undas.

text: Isa rito ang isang 78-anyos na babae na nahilo habang palabas ng Forest Lake Cemetery kaninang tanghali.
english: One of them is a 78-year-old woman who died while performing at Forest Lake Cemetery yesterday afternoon.

text: Tumama ang kanyang ulo sa semento at nagtamo ng bahagyang galos matapos tumaas ang kanyang blood pressure sa 190/94.
english: His head hit the concrete and he sustained minor bruises after his blood pressure rose to 190/94.

text: Sa Molo Cemetery naman, ilang mga residente rin ang sumama ang pakiramdam kaya pinaalalahanan ng mga pulis ang publiko na magdala ng payong at tubig kapag bibisita sa mga yumao.
english: In Molo Cemetery, some residents also felt the same way so the police reminded the public to bring umbrellas and water when visiting the yumao.

text: Ngayong araw, mahigit 8,000 katao ang bumisita sa mga sementeryo sa Iloilo City, ayon sa pinakahuling ulat ng Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO).
english: Today, more than 8,000 people visited the cemeteries in Iloilo City, according to the latest report of the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO).

text: Napansin na kakaunti lamang ang mga bumisita kanina dahil sa matinding init ng panahon, kung saan umabot sa 39°C ang heat index.
english: It was noticed that there were few visitors yesterday due to the extreme heat of the weather, where the heat index reached 39°C.

text: Sa kabila nito, nananatiling payapa at maayos ang sitwasyon sa lungsod, at wala pang naiulat na anumang insidente sa kasalukuyan.
english: Despite this, the situation in the town remains peaceful and orderly, and no incidents have been reported at this time.

text: Ayon kay Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, direktor ng Police Regional Office 6, mananatili ang mga pulis sa mga sementeryo upang masiguro ang kaligtasan ng mga bumibisita.
english: According to Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, director of Police Regional Office 6, police will remain at the cemeteries to ensure the safety of visitors.

text: Mahigpit ding sinisiyasat ang mga dala ng publiko upang matiyak na walang armas, patalim, inumin, o iba pang ipinagbabawal na gamit na maipapasok sa loob ng sementeryo.
english: Public belongings are also strictly checked to ensure that no weapons, blades, alcoholic beverages, or other prohibited items are allowed into the cemetery.

text: Mangin masako na ang Gilas Pilipinas sa training camp sa masunod nga bulan bilang preparasyon sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament (OQT) sa Latvia nga amo ang mangin katapusan nga paagi agud maka-qualify ang pungsod sa Paris Olympics.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will be busy in training camp next month in preparation for the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament (OQT) in Latvia which will be the last way for the country to qualify for the Paris Olympics.

text: Suno kay Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) executive director Erika Dy, Hunyo 22 magatipon liwat si Coach Tim Cone kag ang mga miyembro sang national team sa Inspire Sports Academy sa Laguna.
english: According to Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) executive director Erika Dy, Coach Tim Cone and members of the national team will meet again on June 22 at the Inspire Sports Academy in Laguna.

text: Halin sa Laguna, magapadulong naman ang nationals sa Turkey para sa friendly fame batok sa team sang amo nga pungsod sa Hunyo 27.
english: From Laguna, the nationals will travel to Turkey for a friendly against the team of that country on June 27.

text: Sunod sila nga magabyahe pakadto sa Poland para sa isa na naman ka tuneup match antes dalayon nga mag-compete sa Latvia.
english: They will next travel to Poland for yet another tuneup match before immediately competing in Latvia.

text: Hulyo 3 atubangon sang Gilas ang world No.
english: On July 3, the Gilas will face world No.

text: 8 nga Latvia sa Arena Riga sa Riga sa amo nga pungsod anted atubangon ang world no.
english: 8 Latvia at the Arena Riga in Riga in that country before facing world no.

text: 23 nga Georgia sa Hulyo 4 sa amo man nga venue.
english: 23 Georgia on July 4 at the same venue.

text: Bisan ano man ang resulta sa tournament, ginalauman nga padayunon sang Gilas ang preparasyon para naman sa ikaduha nga window sang FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers sa Nobyembre kun sa diin atubangon naman sini ang New Zealand kag Hong Kong sa duha ka home games.
english: Whatever the outcome of the tournament, the Gilas are expected to continue preparations for the second window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers in November where they will face New Zealand and Hong Kong in two home games.

text: Gamiton man ni Coach Cone ang original nga 12-man roster magluwas lang kun may player nga indi makahampang bangud sa injuries.#
english: Coach Cone will also use the original 12-man roster unless a player is unable to play due to injuries.#

text: MANILA – Naghinay ang hulag sang inflation rate sa pungsod sang Hunyo.
english: MANILA – The inflation rate in the country slowed in June.

text: Suno kay National Statistician kag Philippine Statistics Authority chief Claire Dennis Mapa ang inflation — nga nagatakos sa rate sang pagtaas sang mga presyo sang mga balaklon kag serbisyo — ang naghinay sa 3.7% sang nagligad nga bulan gikan sa 3.9% rate sang Mayo.
english: According to National Statistician and Philippine Statistics Authority chief Claire Dennis Mapa inflation — which measures the rate of increase in the prices of goods and services — slowed to 3.7% last month from a 3.9% rate in May.

text: Ang nasambit nga development ang nagpahagan-hagan sa inflation rate sa apat ka bulan.
english: The development eased the inflation rate in four months.

text: Nalakip man diri ang year-to-date nga inflation print nga nagdangat sa 3.5%, nga yara sa sulod sang pagbanta sang gobyerno nga 2% tubtob 4%.
english: It also includes the year-to-date inflation print which stood at 3.5%, which is within the government’s estimate of 2% to 4%.

text: Masobra 8,000 ka mga indibidwal ang nagbisita sa mga patyo sa syudad sang Iloilo, suno sa monitoring sang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO).
english: More than 8,000 individuals visited the cemeteries in Iloilo City, according to the monitoring of the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO).

text: Base sa report sang CDRRMO, naglab-ot sa ginabulubanta nga 8,280 ka tawo ang nagbisita sa napulo ka pampubliko kag pribado nga mga patyo sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: According to the CDRRMO, an estimated 8,280 people visited ten public and private cemeteries in Iloilo City.

text:
Naobserbahan nga gamay lang ang nagbisita bangud sa mainit nga panahon, nga ang heat index naglab-ot sa 39°C.

Nagapabilin naman nga malinong kag matawhay ang sitwasyon sa syudad kag wala sang insidente nga na-record sa subong.
english:
It was observed that there were few visitors due to the hot weather, with the heat index reaching 39°C.

The situation in the city remains calm and peaceful and no incidents have been recorded so far.

text: Himuon nga health clinic para sa kabataan sa Gaza ang popemobile ni Pope Francis.
english: Pope Francis' popemobile will be turned into a health clinic for children in Gaza.

text: Ini ang katumanan sang iya final wishes.
english: This is the fulfillment of his final wishes.

text: Ang salakyan nga gin-gamit sang santo papa sadtong 2014 sa pagbisita sa Holy Land, ang gina-transform subong sa isa ka diagnostic kag emergency medical equipment aguf buligan ang mga bata nga pasyente sa Gaza.
english: The vehicle used by the pope in 2014 to visit the Holy Land, is now being transformed into a diagnostic and emergency medical equipment to help child patients in Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagkalaguba na ang mga health facilities sa lugar bangud sa Israeli invasion.
english: It is known that health facilities in the area have been destroyed due to the Israeli invasion.

text: Ang mobile unit may yara sang rapid infection tests, vaccines, diagnostic tools, kag suture kits, kag may yara man sang medical personnel.
english: The mobile unit is equipped with rapid infection tests, vaccines, diagnostic tools, and suture kits, and is also staffed with medical personnel.

text: Plano sang Caritas nga i- deploy ang clinic sa mga komunidad nga wala sang access sa maayo nga healthcare facilities sa tion nga posible na ang humanitarian access pasulod sa Gaza.
english: Caritas plans to deploy the clinic in communities without access to good healthcare facilities once humanitarian access into Gaza is possible.

text: Gintugyan ni Pope Francis ang inisyatibo sa Catholic aid organization nga Caritas Jerusalem pila ka bulan antes ini napatay.
english: Pope Francis handed over the initiative to the Catholic aid organization Caritas Jerusalem a few months before his death.

text: MAASIN, ILOILO – Ginakalipay ni Maasin, Iloilo Vice Mayor Francis Amboy ang iya kadalag-an bilang alkalde sa nasambit nga banwa batok kay Atty. Sweet Malones anak ni Mayor Mariano Malones.
english: MAASIN, ILOILO – Maasin, Iloilo Vice Mayor Francis Amboy is celebrating his victory as mayor of the said town against Atty. Sweet Malones is the daughter of Mayor Mariano Malones.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Amboy, iya ginpahayag nga iya gid nga ginapasalamatan nga nagbuylog gid ang mga pumuluyo sa ila banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Amboy said he is grateful that the residents of his town joined him.

text: Kadungan sang campaign period suno kay Amboy, isa lang ang iya ginapahanumdom sa mga botante kag ini amo ang pagpili sang nahamut-an nga kandidato.
english: During the campaign period, Amboy said he reminds voters of one thing and that is to choose the candidate they like.

text: Mahimo suno kay Amboy nga ang iya maayo nga pag-amuma sa mga pumuluyo kag ang abilidad sa panghimanwa amo ang rason kun nga-a ginpaboran siya sang botante nga mangin alkalde.
english: Amboy said his good care for the people and citizenship skills may be the reason why voters favored him as mayor.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpahayag man sang bise alkalde nga pagkatapos sang eleksyon, gilayon siya nga nagpalab-ot sang mensahe sa pamilya Malones nga nagapasalamat sa malinong nga eleksyon.
english: Meanwhile, the vice mayor said that after the election, he immediately conveyed a message to the Malones family thanking them for the peaceful election.

text: Nagalaum man si Amboy nga may matabo nga reconcilation sa tunga nila sang pamilya Malones.
english: Amboy also hopes that there will be a reconciliation between them and the Malones family.

text: Pilason ang 6 ka mga indibidwal sa Israel matapos nagtupa ang isa ka missile halin sa Yemen malapit sa terminal sang Ben Gurion Airport sa Israel.
english: Six individuals in Israel were injured after a missile from Yemen landed near the terminal of Ben Gurion Airport in Israel.

text: Ginpahayag nga temporaryo nga gin-suspende ang mga flight sa airport, apang gilayon man ini nga ginbuksan.
english: Flights at the airport were reportedly temporarily suspended, but were immediately reopened.

text: Naghatag sang warning si Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, nga nagsiling nga magabalos sila sang pito ka beses.
english: Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant issued a warning, saying they would retaliate seven times.

text:
Pahayag ni Gallant, “Anyone who hits us, we will hit them seven times stronger,”

Ang Houthi rebels halin sa Yemen ang nag-angkon sang responsibilidad sa pag-atake.
english:
Gallant said, “Anyone who hits us, we will hit them seven times stronger,”

Houthi rebels from Yemen claimed responsibility for the attack.

text: Suno sa spokesperson sang grupo, indi na safe ang airport para sa mga nagabyahe.
english: According to the group's spokesperson, the airport is no longer safe for travelers.

text: Bisan pa nga madamo nga missile attacks ang ginahimo sang Iran-backed Houthi rebels batuk sa Israel bilang suporta sa Hamas, padayon sagihapon ang pagdepensa sang Israel.
english: Although Iran-backed Houthi rebels are carrying out many missile attacks against Israel in support of Hamas, Israel continues to defend itself.

text: Padayon man nga gina-atake sang grupo ang mga barko sa Red Sea, apang ginahatagan man sang igtalupangod sang airstrikes gikan sa U.S. kag U.K.
english: The group also continues to attack shipping in the Red Sea, but also draws attention to airstrikes from the U.S. and U.K.

text: Ginkilala ang dalayawon nga performances sang pila ka Filipino artists kadungan sang star-studded nga 2023 Asia Artist Awards (AAA) sa Philippine Arena sa Bulacan, Disyembre 14.
english: The outstanding performances of several Filipino artists were recognized during the star-studded 2023 Asia Artist Awards (AAA) at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan, December 14.

text: Lakip diri amo ang host-comedienne kag actress nga si Melai Cantiveros nga naka-upod sa popular nga South Korean TV kag movie stars nga sanday Kim Sejeong, Ahn Hyo Seop, Lee Dong Hwi, kag Lee Jun Hyuk nga palareho nga nagdaog sang Best Actor award.
english: Among them is host-comedienne and actress Melai Cantiveros who has joined popular South Korean TV and movie stars Kim Sejeong, Ahn Hyo Seop, Lee Dong Hwi, and Lee Jun Hyuk who both won the Best Actor award.

text: Todo-hugyaw man ang fans sa 55,000-seater arena sang ginlawag sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Daniel Padilla nga pareho nga nagdaog sang AAA Fabulous Award kaupod sa NewJeans, Stray Kids, kag Lim Young Woong.
english: Fans in the 55,000-seater arena also cheered when Kathryn Bernardo and Daniel Padilla both won the AAA Fabulous Award alongside NewJeans, Stray Kids, and Lim Young Woong.

text: Apisar preska pa ang kumpirmasyon sa ila nga breakup, magkaupod ang duha sa event, dungan nga nagsaka sa stage, apang separado nga naghatag sang ila acceptance speeches.
english: Although the confirmation of their breakup is still fresh, the two attended the event together, went on stage together, but gave their acceptance speeches separately.

text: “It’s my first time attending this and nakaka-proud na bilang Pilipino, tayo yung nagho-host sa ganitong event.
english: “It’s my first time attending this and it makes me proud that as Filipinos, we are hosting this event.

text: Also, I want to take this opportunity to thank everybody who’s supporting Filipino-made TV series and as well as movies.
english: Also, I want to take this opportunity to thank everyone who’s supporting Filipino-made TV series and as well as movies.

text: Patapos na yung taon, but I feel so blessed and I’m sharing this award with all of you.
english: The year is coming to an end, but I feel so blessed and I’m sharing this award with all of you.

text: Maraming-maraming salamat po,” kabahin sang speech ni Bernardo.
english: Thank you very much,” Bernardo said in part of his speech.

text: Big winner man sanday Pablo, Josh, Stell, Ken, kag Justin sang P-Pop supergroup nga SB19 nga nagkuha ang duha ka awards — ang AAA Best Artist (Singer) kag AAA Hot Trend.
english: Also big winners were Pablo, Josh, Stell, Ken, and Justin of P-Pop supergroup SB19 who picked up two awards — AAA Best Artist (Singer) and AAA Hot Trend.

text: Ginkilala man ang rising P-pop boy group nga HORI7ON bilang AAA Focus awardee.
english: Rising P-pop boy group HORI7ON was also recognized as an AAA Focus awardee.

text: Nagpangibabaw man ang grupo ang Filipino folk pop band nga BEN&BEN nga nagdaog sang AAA Best Choice Award.
english: Filipino folk pop band BEN&BEN also won the AAA Best Choice Award.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion nga ginpatigayon sa Pilipinas ang AAA — isa ka popular awards show nga nagakilala sang excellence sa music, television, film kag online content creation sa Asya.#
english: This is the first time that AAA — a popular awards show that recognizes excellence in music, television, film and online content creation in Asia — will be held in the Philippines.

text: Nadulaan sang pangalibutan ang isa ka 78-anyos nga babaye samtang nagapagwa sa Forest Lake Cemetery kaina sang udto.
english: A 78-year-old woman lost consciousness while leaving Forest Lake Cemetery yesterday afternoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Melrose Orbase, nakakita sa biktima, iya ginpahayag nga antes maguwa sa sementeryo, ginpapungko pa sini ang tigulang agud makapahuway.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Melrose Orbase, who saw the victim, said that before leaving the cemetery, he sat the elderly man down to rest.

text: Apang sang ini ang nagtalikod, nakita na lamang nga nagapang-lubaybay ang amo nga tigulang kag hinali lang nga natumba.
english: But when he turned around, he saw the old man staggering and suddenly fell down.

text: Bangud sini, naigo ang iya nga ulo sa semento kag nakaagom sang gamay nga gasgas.
english: As a result, his head hit the cement and sustained minor injuries.

text: Gilayon ini nga gindala sa opisina sang Forest Lake kag gindapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
english: He was immediately brought to the Forest Lake office and given proper treatment by the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

text: Nahibaluan nga yara sa 190/94 ang blood pressure sini.
english: His blood pressure was 190/94.

text: Nagpamalibad naman ang amo nga tigulang mga dal-on sa ospital rason nga ginpapirma nalang ini sang waiver kag gindul-ong pauli sang BFP.
english: The elderly man refused to be taken to the hospital so he was signed a waiver and taken home by the BFP.

text: Naaresto sang otoridad ang lalaki nga wanted sa paghimulos sa iya mismo nga anak sa Briones, Kalibo, Aklan.
english: Authorities have arrested a man wanted for raping his own daughter in Briones, Kalibo, Aklan.

text: Ang suspek amo si alyas ” Junjun”, 34-anyos, residente sang Zone 3,Alalasan, Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: The suspect was identified as Junjun, 34, resident of Zone 3, Alalasan, Lapuz, Iloilo City.

text: Gin-aresto ang suspek sa gahum sang warrant of arrest sa kaso nga Statutory Rape.
english: The suspect was arrested on a warrant of arrest for Statutory Rape.

text: Wala sang ginrekomendar nga piyansa sa iya nga kaso.
english: No bail was recommended in his case.

text: Yara na ini sa kustodiya sang Kalibo PNP.
english: He is now in the custody of Kalibo PNP.

text: Ginpatigayon ang dululungan nga pagsindi sang mga kandila sa lulubngan sang mga Baganihan sa Taguig Cily bilang kabahin sang pagselebrar sang Undas.
english: A simultaneous candlelight vigil was held at the Heroes' Cemetery in Taguig Cily as part of the celebration of Undas.

text: Ginpangunahan sang mga myembro sang Girl Scouts of the Philippines ang aktibidad nga ginakabig nga Synchronized Lighting of Candles sa idalom sang superbisyon sang Philippine Army.
english: Members of the Girl Scouts of the Philippines led the activity called Synchronized Lighting of Candles under the supervision of the Philippine Army.

text: Nagbutang man sila sang magagmay nga flag sa kada krus bilang simbolo sang pafrespeto kag pagkilala.
english: They also placed small flags on each cross as a symbol of respect and recognition.

text: Sa kabug-usan sang Undas break, ginalauman nga magalab-ot sa 60,000 ang numero sang nagabisita a LBMB.
english: Overall, the number of visitors to LBMB is expected to reach 60,000 during the Undas break.

text: Una na nga ginsiguro sang Philippine Army ang enough nga seguridad sa lugar, kaupod ang Philippine National Police.
english: The Philippine Army has already ensured enough security in the area, along with the Philippine National Police.

text: Lakip sa mga kilala nga nakalubong sa LNMB amo sanday anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, Fidel V. Ramos, Carlos Garcia, kag iban pa.
english: Among those prominently buried in the LNMB are former President Ferdinand Marcos, Fidel V. Ramos, Carlos Garcia, and others.

text: Wala sang makatupong sa pagpalangga nga mahatag sang isa ka iloy.
english: Nothing compares to the love a mother can give.

text: Bisan sa tion nga magpahuway na ini, pat-od nga indi gid mapanas sa panghuna-huna kag balatyagon sang iya bata ang iya ginhatag nga mga hakos, mga halok, kag adlaw-adlaw nga pagtatap.
english: Even after she retires, her hugs, kisses, and daily care will surely never be erased from her child's mind and feelings.

text: “Kung waay si Mama, kabudlay gid para sa akon,” suno kay Raven, 12-anyos nga nagbisita sa Tanza Public Cemetery subong nga Undas.
english: “If Mama is not there, it is very difficult for me,” said Raven, 12-year-old who visited the Tanza Public Cemetery this Undas.

text: Napatay ang iloy ni Raven sang 2023 sang naga-edad ini sang 45-anyos bangud sa balatian nga cancer.
english: Raven’s mother died in 2023 at the age of 45-years-old due to cancer.

text: “Pagkabati ko nga may nagsinggit, nagbugtaw ko.
english: “When I heard someone screaming, I woke up.

text: Kita ko si Mama ara sa dalom sang hiligdaan.
english: I saw Mom under the bed.

text: Pagkakita ko sa hiligdaan, damo dugo,” panaysayon sini samtang ginabalikan ang adlaw nga nadula ang iya iloy.
english: When I saw the bed, there was a lot of blood,” he said, recalling the day his mother disappeared.

text: Pahayag ni Raven, antes naglala ang kondisyon sang iya Mama, pila ka beses na ini nga nagguwa-sulod sa ospital.
english: Raven said that before her mother's condition worsened, she had been in and out of the hospital several times.

text: Ginsugid man sini nga sang tion nga napatay ang iya iloy, may problema pa sa iya pamilya bangud may ginkawat ang iya amay.
english: He also said that when his mother died, there were still problems in his family because his father stole something.

text: Napreso ini sang isa ka bes, apang sang ulihi nakaguwa man.
english: He was imprisoned once, but was later released.

text: “Daw ginbuno lang ko sa puso kay waay na si Mama ko,” pahayag sini.
english: “I felt like I was stabbed in the heart because my mother was gone,” she said.

text: Bilang agot sa apat ka mag-utod, indi gid sini malipatan kun daw ano siya kapalangga sang iya iloy.
english: As the youngest of four children, he will never forget how much his mother loved him.

text: Sa iya pagsindi sang kandila kag pagduaw sa lulubngan sang iya iloy subong nga adlaw, ginabalikan sini ang ila nagligad — istorya nga puno sang pagpalangga kag mga handumanan.
english: As she lights a candle and visits her mother’s grave today, it reflects on their past — a story filled with love and memories.

text: “Ginapalangga man ko ni Manong ko, pero na-miss ko lang nga ginapalangga ako ni Mama ko,” pahayag pa sini.#
english: “My uncle loves me too, but I just miss that my mom loves me,” he said.

text: JANIUAY, ILOILO – Ginakabig ni anay Janiuay, Iloilo Mayor kag subong Mayor elect Frankie Locsin nga pinakamabudlay nga eleksyon ang May 13 midterm elections nga iya naagyan sa bug-os nga political career.
english: JANIUAY, ILOILO – Former Janiuay, Iloilo Mayor and now Mayor elect Frankie Locsin considers the May 13 midterm elections to be the most difficult election he has experienced in his entire political career.

text: Ini matapos nga nagdaug si Locsin batok sa iya tatlo ka mga kasumpong sa pagka-alkalde sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: This is after Locsin won against his three opponents for the mayoralty in the said town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Locsin, iya ginpahayag nga napamatud-an niya sa mga kasumpong sa pulitika nga mas nahamut-an siya sang mga pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Locsin said he has proved to his political opponents that he is more popular with the people.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Locsin nga normal lamang sa tion sang eleksyon nga nagahabuyanay sang isyu ang mga pulitiko apang ang ginapatu-pato sa iya nga kontrobersiya ang indi niya maagwantahan.
english: Locsin said it is normal for politicians to throw issues during elections but he cannot tolerate the controversy.

text: Sa pihak sang disqualification case kag iban pa nga kontrobersiya nga iya ginakaulamiran, ‘life must go on’ suno sa natungdan kag iya pa nga ginpasalamatan ang mga nagapatu-pato sa iya.
english: Despite the disqualification case and other controversies that he is aware of, 'life must go on', he said and he thanked those who are making fun of him.

text: Ini bangud nga sa baylo nga gub-on ang iya kandidatura, ginpahayag ni Locsin nga nagdamu pa ang nagsimpatiya sa iya nga mga pumuluyo.
english: This is because instead of destroying his candidacy, Locsin said that more people sympathized with him.
