text: Gin-anunsyo ni Miss Universe 2010 4th runner-up Venus Raj ang isa ka “major-major” event sa iya kabuhi: ang iya malapit na nga pagpakasal!
english: Miss Universe 2010 4th runner-up Venus Raj announced a “major-major” event in her life: her impending marriage!

text: Lakip sa ginpakita sang beauty queen sa iya nga kumpirmasyon amo ang pre-nuptial photoshoot kaupod ang iya nga non-showbiz partner.
english: Among the things the beauty queen showed in her confirmation was a pre-nuptial photoshoot with her non-showbiz partner.

text: Makit-an sa mga litrato nga masadya ang magkahagugma sa isa ka beach sa Zambales samtang nga ginahulat ang big day nga suno sa iya, “inadlaw na lang” kag matabo na.
english: The photos show the couple happy on a beach in Zambales while waiting for the big day which, according to him, is “just a day away” and will happen.

text:
Ginsuguran ni Venus ang iya anunsyo paagi sa pagsiling nga: “There is blessing in waiting.”

Pahayag sini, walo ka tuig siya nga nangin single tubtub nga ginsabat sang Ginuo ang iya pangamuyo nga ihatag ang husto nga tawo para sa iya.
english:
Venus began her announcement by saying that: “There is blessing in waiting.”

She said she was single for eight years until the Lord answered her prayer to give her the right person.

text:
Yari ang kumpleto nga post:

“For 8 years, God allowed me to be single.
english:
Here is the complete post:

“For 8 years, God allowed me to be single.

text: Since I have fully surrendered my life to Jesus, I have never entered into a romantic relationship.
english: Since I have fully surrendered my life to Jesus, I have never entered into a romantic relationship.

text: I asked Him to protect my heart and to keep it until the right man comes.
english: I asked Him to protect my heart and to keep it until the right man comes.

text: The Lord brought me to a beautiful journey of grace, joy, learning, trials, challenges, loneliness, and victories.
english: The Lord brought me to a beautiful journey of grace, joy, learning, trials, challenges, loneliness, and victories.

text: In the process, I have devoted my single years in serving the Lord, serving communities, and serving my family.
english: In the process, I have devoted my single years in serving the Lord, serving communities, and serving my family.

text: God is indeed the giver of good gifts, He knows His timeline for my life, and the right time has finally come.
english: God is indeed the giver of good gifts, He knows His timeline for my life, and the right time has finally come.

text: In a few days, I will be spending the rest of my life with this man of God that my Father has brought me to.
english: In a few days, I will be spending the rest of my life with this man of God that my Father has brought me to.

text: My prayer is that, together, we will journey towards God’s will in fulfilling His purpose for our union.
english: My prayer is that, together, we will journey towards God’s will in fulfilling His purpose for our union.

text: We pray to glorify and honor Him in our lives.
english: We pray to glorify and honor Him in our lives.

text: We have a future ahead of us, it will not be perfect, but God is the anchor that will keep secure.
english: We have a future ahead of us, it will not be perfect, but God is the anchor that will keep secure.

text: If you are still single and praying to the Lord for marriage, please know that God hears your prayers and He knows the desires of your heart.
english: If you are still single and praying to the Lord for marriage, please know that God hears your prayers and He knows the desires of your heart.

text: The answer might be — wait, yes, or no, but one thing is for sure, He knows what’s best for you.
english: The answer might be — wait, yes, or no, but one thing is for sure, He knows what’s best for you.

text: Trust His process.
english: Trust His process.

text:
“

Kilala si Venus bilang “drought-breaker” sa Philippine pageantry.
english:
“

Venus is known as the “drought-breaker” in Philippine pageantry.

text: Siya ang nagtapos sa 10 ka tuig nga semifinal drought sa Pilipinas sa Miss Universe pageant, kag sa iya man nagsugod ang indi kinaandan nga reign sang Pilipinas sa amo nga global stage.
english: She ended the Philippines' 10-year semifinal drought in the Miss Universe pageant, and with her also began the Philippines' unusual reign on such a global stage.

text: Ini nga winning streak sang Pilipinas ang nagdangat sang 2021 kag nagbalik subong nga 2023.
english: The Philippines' winning streak dates back to 2021 and is back in 2023.

text: Dalawa na ang kumpirmadong nasawi sa pagsabog sa isang pabrika ng baril sa Marikina City, ayon sa kumpanyang Armscor Global Defense Inc.
english: Two people have been confirmed injured in an explosion at a gun factory in Marikina City, according to Armscor Global Defense Inc.

text: nitong Martes.
english: on Tuesday.

text: Ang insidente ay naganap noong hapon ng Hulyo 7 sa Ammunition Section ng planta.
english: The incident occurred on the afternoon of July 7 in the Ammunition Section of the plant.

text: Tatlong empleyado ang nasugatan sa insidente, at dalawa sa kanila ang hindi na nakaligtas.
english: Three employees were injured in the incident, and two of them did not survive.

text: Ang ikatlong empleyado na nasugatan ay nakalabas na ng ospital at kasalukuyang nagpapagaling na sa kanilang tahanan.
english: The third employee who was injured has been released from the hospital and is currently recovering at home.

text: Batay sa paunang imbestigasyon ng Marikina City Police, isang kahon ng primer ang bigla umanong sumabog, na siyang nagdulot ng insidente.
english: According to preliminary investigation of Marikina City Police, a box of primer suddenly exploded, causing the incident.

text: Ang primer ay isang kemikal na ginagamit upang simulan ang pagsiklab ng pulbura sa loob ng bala.
english: A primer is a chemical used to initiate the ignition of gunpowder inside a bullet.

text: Ang mga biktima ay agad na dinala sa Amang Rodriguez Medical Center.
english: The victims were rushed to the Amang Rodriguez Medical Center.

text: Isa sa kanila ang naputulan ng parehong kamay at kalaunan ay pumanaw rin.
english: One of them was cut off in both hands and throat and also died.

text: Ang dalawa pa ay nagtamo ng pinsala sa bahagi ng dibdib at mata.
english: The other two sustained injuries to the chest and eyes.

text: Nagpaabot ng pakikiramay ang pamunuan ng kumpanya sa mga naiwang pamilya at tiniyak ang pagbibigay ng kinakailangang tulong at suporta.
english: The company's management extended its condolences to the bereaved families and assured the provision of necessary assistance and support.

text: Noong Pebrero ng nakaraang taon, isa pang pagsabog ang naganap sa storage unit ng parehong planta kung saan nakaimbak ang mga pulbura.
english: In February last year, another explosion occurred in the storage unit of the same plant where the gunpowder was stored.

text: Nagresulta ito sa sunog.
english: This resulted in a fire.

text: Tiniyak ng kumpanya na sila ay sumusunod sa lahat ng lokal at internasyonal na pamantayan sa kaligtasan.
english: The company confirms that they comply with all local and international safety standards.

text: Iginiit din ng pamunuan na ang kaligtasan at kapakanan ng kanilang mga empleyado ang pangunahing prayoridad ng kanilang operasyon.
english: The management also stressed that the safety and well-being of their employees is the top priority of their operation.

text: NEW LUCENA, ILOILO – Hugot nga ginabaton ni Mayor Christian Sorongon ang kalutusan batok kay Iloilo 2nd District Board Member Liecel Mondejar-Seville sa pagka-alkalde sa New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: NEW LUCENA, ILOILO – Mayor Christian Sorongon strongly accepts the defeat against Iloilo 2nd District Board Member Liecel Mondejar-Seville for the mayoralty of New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Sorongon, iya ginpahayag nga iya gid nga ginatahod ang desisyon sang pumuluyo nga mas paboran si Seville nga mangin alkalde.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Sorongon said he respects the decision of the people to favor Seville as mayor.

text: Sa pihak sang kalutusan sa pulitika, ginpahayag man ni Sorongon nga nalipay siya bangud nga may yara na siya sang tion para sa personal nga pagpangabuhi.
english: Despite the political defeat, Sorongon said he is happy because he now has time for personal life.

text: Bugal para sa iya suno kay Sorongon nga mapili-an bilang alkalde sa edad nga 25 anyos kag nabuslan ang 30 anyos nga dinastiya sang pamilya Mondejar sa ila banwa.
english: Sorongon said it is a pride for him to be elected mayor at the age of 25 and replace the 30-year-old dynasty of the Mondejar family in their town.

text: Kadungan sini, isa-isa man nga ginsabat ni Sorongon ang mga isyu nga ginahaboy sa iya sang kasumpong sa pulitika kasubong na lang sa indi pag-angkon sang Seal of Good Local Governance sang siya pa ang alkalde.
english: Meanwhile, Sorongon also answered one by one the issues thrown at him by his political opponents such as not having the Seal of Good Local Governance when he was mayor.

text:
Sa pagpaathag sang alkalde, naka-angkon sang Seal of Good Local Governance ang New Lucena sang siya na ang nagapamuno apang

ang nasambit nga pasidungog ang gina-angkon ni Seville.
english:
The mayor explained that New Lucena received the Seal of Good Local Governance when he was in charge but

the award is claimed by Seville.

text: Tuhoy naman sa posibilidad sang reconcilation nga matabo sa tunga nila ni Seville, ginpahayag ni Sorongon nga wala na sang rason nga mag-inaway ang ila pamilya bangud sa iya bahin suno sa natungdan, wala na siya sang interes sa pulitika.
english: Regarding the possibility of reconciliation between him and Seville, Sorongon said there is no reason for their family to fight because for his part, he has no interest in politics.

text: Binalewala lamang ng Malacañang ang panawagan ni Vice President Sara Duterte na sumailalim sa drug test si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Malacañang ignored Vice President Sara Duterte's call for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to undergo a drug test.

text: Ayon kay Palace press officer Claire Castro na maging si dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte ay hindi pumatol sa parehas na hiling noong anim na taong panunungkulan nito.
english: According to Palace press officer Claire Castro, even former President Rodrigo Duterte did not cut the same line during his six years in office.

text: Dagdag pa nito na sinabi noon ni dating Presidential spokesperson Harry Roque na hindi maaring utusan ang Pangulo ng bansa na sumailalim sa drug test.
english: He added that former Presidential spokesperson Harry Roque said earlier that the President of the country cannot be ordered to undergo a drug test.

text: Magugunitang noong Agosto 2018 ng ibinasura ni Roque ang panawagan noon ni dating Senador Antonio Trillanes IV na sumailalim si Duterte kasama ang pamilya nito ng drug test.
english: In August 2018, Roque rejected former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV's call for Duterte and his family to undergo a drug test.

text: Ang nasabing panawagan ay matapos na inamin ni Duterte na ito ay gumagamit ng marijuana para manatiling gising na kalaunan ay binawi din nito.
english: The call came after Duterte admitted that he used marijuana to stay awake, which he also withdrew.

text: Isang sawa na may dalawang metro ang haba ang nagpakita kasabay ng paggunita ng Undas sa isang sementeryo sa Iloilo City.
english: A two-meter-long snake appeared during the commemoration of Undas in a cemetery in Iloilo City.

text: Natagpuan at nahuli ito ng isang maintenance personnel sa Forest Lake Memorial Park sa Mandurriao matapos itong gumapang sa likod ng isang mausoleo.
english: It was found and caught by a maintenance personnel at Forest Lake Memorial Park in Mandurriao after it crawled behind a mausoleum.

text: Ayon kay Senior Fire Officer 1 Vicente Garbosa, hepe ng Fire Engine Company–Mandurriao Fire Station, na-turn-over sa kanila ang ahas at kalaunan ay ibinigay naman ito sa Urban Search and Rescue teams (USAR).
english: According to Senior Fire Officer 1 Vicente Garbosa, chief of Fire Engine Company-Mandurriao Fire Station, the snake was turned over to them and the snake was handed over to the Urban Search and Rescue teams (USAR).

text: Wala namang taong nakagat ng naturang ahas.
english: No one has ever been bitten by a snake.

text: Nagpatuloy naman nang maayos at matiwasay ang mga aktibidad sa naturang sementeryo, gayundin sa iba pang mga lugar sa Iloilo.
english: Activities in the cemetery, as well as in other parts of Iloilo, continued smoothly and peacefully.

text: Nabatid na halos 4,000 law enforcers at force multipliers ang na-deploy ngayong Undas sa buong Western Visayas, kabilang na ang 2,756 organic members ng Philippine National Police.
english: It was learned that nearly 4,000 law enforcers and force multipliers have been deployed this Undas across Western Visayas, including 2,756 organic members of the Philippine National Police.

text: Naaresto ang 20 Filipino seafarers sa Lagos, Nigeria matapos makumpiska ang humigit-kumulang 20 kilo ng cocaine sa isang barkong may bandera ng Panama, ayon sa ulat ng National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) noong Biyernes.
english: Twenty Filipino seafarers were arrested in Lagos, Nigeria after more than 20 kilos of cocaine were seized from a Panama-flagged ship, according to a report by the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) on Friday.

text: Ayon sa NDLEA, natagpuan ang “top-grade” na droga nitong Linggo, nakatago sa ilalim ng kargamento ng barko na karaniwang nagdadala ng coal mula Brazil patungong Colombia.
english: According to the NDLEA, the “top-grade” drugs were found on Sunday, hidden under the cargo of a ship that usually carries coal from Brazil to Colombia.

text: Kasama ang lahat ng Filipino crew members sa kustodiya habang isinasagawa ang masusing imbestigasyon.
english: All Filipino crew members are in custody while a thorough investigation is being conducted.

text: Naunang inanunsyo ng NDLEA na nakikipagtulungan sila sa U.S. at U.K. upang tutukan ang isang kartel na may kaugnayan sa 1,000 kilo ng cocaine na nahuli rin sa Lagos port noong nakaraang buwan.
english: The NDLEA earlier announced that it is working with the U.S. and U.K. to focus on a cartel linked to 1,000 kilos of cocaine that was also seized at the Lagos port last month.

text: Nangin palaagyan ang mga pagsinapol kaupod ang Department of Public Works and Highways–Iloilo City District Engineering Office (DPWH–ICDEO) agud masanagan ang mga barangay official kag mga pumuluyo kaangot sa isyu sang pagbaha sa syudad.
english: The meetings with the Department of Public Works and Highways-Iloilo City District Engineering Office (DPWH-ICDEO) served as a platform to enlighten barangay officials and residents regarding the issue of flooding in the city.

text: Ini ang pahayag ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda kasunod sang serye sang ‘People’s Meeting’ nga ginpatigayon sang iya opisina kaupod ang ICDEO.
english: This was stated by Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda following a series of 'People's Meetings' conducted by her office in collaboration with the ICDEO.

text: Suno kay Baronda, paagi sini, nahangpan sang mga Ilonggo nga indi dapat pag-ibasol ang tanan sa DPWH.
english: According to Baronda, through this, Ilonggos understand that not everyone should be blamed on the DPWH.

text: “Because ang may mandate to mitigate [sang baha] kag magpa-pondo especially kung barangay roads are the barangay and the City of Iloilo or the LGU,” suno sa kongresista.
english: “Because the mandate to mitigate [floods] and fund especially if barangay roads are the barangay and the City of Iloilo or the LGU,” said the congressman.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Baronda kadungan sang ikaapat kag final leg sang People’s Meeting sang Oktubre 29 kun sa diin naka-sentro ang istorya sa pagbaha sa Lapuz kag La Paz.
english: Baronda said this during the fourth and final leg of the People's Meeting on October 29 where the discussion focused on flooding in Lapuz and La Paz.

text: Antes sina, may yara man sang kaangay nga meeting sa Jaro, Molo, City Proper, Mandurriao, kag Arevalo.
english: Earlier, there were similar meetings in Jaro, Molo, City Proper, Mandurriao, and Arevalo.

text: “It’s very fruitful kay naintindihan nila.
english: “It’s very fruitful because they understand.

text: Parehas sina — indi man na pwede nga mabasol lang ta tanan sa national government kay ang ila nga mandate, klaro.
english: Like that — we can't just blame the national government because their mandate is clear.

text: National road.
english: National road.

text: National highways,” pahayag pa sini.
english: National highways,” he said.

text: Gin-abi-abi man sini sanday City Council Majority Floor Leader Rex Marcus Sarabia kag Councilor Nene De Llana nga nagtambong sa final session kag naghaboy man sang mga pamangkot.
english: He also welcomed City Council Majority Floor Leader Rex Marcus Sarabia and Councilor Nene De Llana who attended the final session and also threw questions.

text: Ginpahanumdom pa ni Baronda ang importansya sang pag-isa agud masolbar ang dinekada na nga problema sa baha sa syudad.
english: Baronda also reminded the importance of unity to solve the decades-old flood problem in the city.

text: “Kinahanglan mag-double time gid kita.
english: “We have to do double time.

text: It’s over 26 years, or 30 years, ang baha ara gihapon.
english: It’s over 26 years, or 30 years, the flood is still there.

text: Umpisahan ta, kag tapuson ta para sa masunod nga generation,” pahayag pa sini.
english: Let's start, and let's finish for the next generation,” he said.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-umpisahan ang People’s Meetings sang Oktubre 23.
english: The People's Meetings began on October 23.

text: Gin-updan ini sang mga tiglawas nagikan sa national government agencies kaangay sang Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD), Department of Education (DepEd), National Irrigation Administration (NIA), Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), city offices, kag iban pa.
english: It was accompanied by representatives from national government agencies such as the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD), Department of Education (DepEd), National Irrigation Administration (NIA), Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), city offices, and others.

text: Lauman nga mas madamo ang makabakal sang bugas sa presyo nga P29 kada kilo bangud ibaligya ini sa dugang nga Kadiwa stores sa Byernes kadungan sang official rollout sang “Bigas 29” program sang Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: More people are expected to buy rice at P29 per kilo as it will be sold at additional Kadiwa stores on Friday in conjunction with the official rollout of the “Bigas 29” program of the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Suno kay Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, iga-anunsyo sa Huwebes ang dugang nga improvement kag kun may mga pagbag-o sa sini nga programa.
english: Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa said further improvements and changes to the program will be announced on Thursday.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Earlier, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga aprubado na sang National Food Authority (NFA) Council nga ibaligya ang daan apang maayo pa man nga stocks sang bugas sa NFA sa presyo nga P29 per kilo paagi sa Kadiwa stores.
english: that the National Food Authority (NFA) Council has approved the sale of old but still good stocks of rice to the NFA at a price of P29 per kilo through Kadiwa stores.

text: Apang ginklaro ni De Mesa nga ang P29-per-kilo rice nga ibaligya sa Kadiwa stores ang indi lamang magahalin sa NFA inventory.
english: However, De Mesa clarified that the P29-per-kilo rice to be sold in Kadiwa stores will not only come from the NFA inventory.

text: Para ini nga programa sa vulnerable sectors nga nagalakip sang persons with disabilities, solo parents, senior citizens kag indigenous peoples.
english: This program is for vulnerable sectors including persons with disabilities, solo parents, senior citizens and indigenous peoples.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag sang opisyal nga magauna ang implementasyon sini sa Metro Manila kag sa kaiping nga mga probinsya, apang makalab-ot man ini pati sa iban nga areas sa pungsod.
english: Earlier, the official said the implementation will begin in Metro Manila and neighboring provinces, but it will also reach other areas in the country.

text: Ang implementasyon sang “Bigas 29” ang ginalantaw nga nagakinahanglan sang P1.39 billion kag P1.53 billion per month halin sa gobyerno base sa pagbanta sang agriculture chief.
english: The implementation of “Bigas 29” is expected to require P1.39 billion and P1.53 billion per month from the government based on the agriculture chief's estimate.

text: Agud ma-secure ang rice supply para sa sini nga inisyatibo, plano sang DA nga mag-import sang 363,697 metric tons para maka-augment sa national buffer stocks, samtang ang NFA naman ang maga-procure sang 559,535 metric tons sang palay halin sa local farmers.
english: To secure the rice supply for this initiative, the DA plans to import 363,697 metric tons to augment the national buffer stocks, while the NFA will procure 559,535 metric tons of rice from local farmers.

text: Malapit na makumpleto ang bracket para sa ikaduha nga round sang NBA playoff series!
english: The bracket for the second round of the NBA playoff series is almost complete!

text: Patigayunon subong nga aga ang nabilin nga duha ka elimination games kun sa diin mangin host ang Orlando Magic sa kasumpong nga Cleveland Cavaliers, samtang magabisita naman ang Los Angeles Clippers sa home court sang Dallas Mavericks.
english: The remaining two elimination games will be played this morning with the Orlando Magic hosting the Cleveland Cavaliers, while the Los Angeles Clippers will visit the home court of the Dallas Mavericks.

text: 7:00 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas) magasambuwa ang Magic kag Cavaliers kun sa diin sa isa ka daog na lang ang kinahanglan sang Cleveland sa 3-2 nga serye kag atubangon ang Boston Celtics sa semifinals sang Eastern Conference.
english: 7:00 this morning (Philippine time) the Magic and Cavaliers will meet where Cleveland needs only one win in the 3-2 series and face the Boston Celtics in the semifinals of the Eastern Conference.

text: Amo man ang sitwasyon sa pihak nga hampang apang balantayan 9:30 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas) kun mapatas sang Clippers sa 3-3 ang serye ukon maga-magic si Luka Doncic kag maga-diretso na ang Dallas sa second round.
english: The situation is the same in the other game but watch at 9:30 this morning (Philippine time) if the Clippers tie the series 3-3 or Luka Doncic will do magic and Dallas will go straight to the second round.

text: Ang winner sa tunga sang Dallas kag Los Angeles ang magaatubang naman sa Oklahoma City sa West semifinals.
english: The winner between Dallas and Los Angeles will face Oklahoma City in the West semifinals.

text: Nahibaluan nga kahapon, nag-abanse ang Knicks matapos ginlutos sa tres puntos ang 76ers sa Game 6; samtang nagsulod man sa second round ang Pacers kasunod sang 4-2 series win sa Game 6 nga mas nangin mahapos bangud wala ang presensya sang two-time MVP nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo sa playoff run bangud sa calf injury.
english: Yesterday, the Knicks advanced after beating the 76ers by three points in Game 6; while the Pacers also entered the second round following a 4-2 series win in Game 6 that was made easier by the absence of two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo in the playoff run due to a calf injury.

text: Bad news ang magasugata sa mga motorista subong nga Hulyo.
english: Bad news will meet motorists this July.

text: Ini bangud ipatuman na naman bwas, Hulyo 2 ang panibag-o nga oil price hike.
english: This is because the new oil price hike will be implemented tomorrow, July 2.

text:
Suno sa oil industry sources, yari ang lauman nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasolina – magasaka sang P0.95/literKerosene – magasaka sang P0.35/literDiesel – magasaka sang P0.65/liter
english:
According to oil industry sources, here are the expected increases in fuel prices:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.95/literKerosene – to rise by P0.35/literDiesel – to rise by P0.65/liter

text: Hinimok ni Bise Presidente Sara Duterte si Pangulong Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte called on President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: na sumailalim sa drug test kasunod ng alegasyon ni Senator Imee Marcos na umano’y gumagamit ng iligal na droga ang ilang miyembro ng First Family.
english: to undergo a drug test following the allegation of Senator Imee Marcos that some members of the First Family are using illegal drugs.

text: Ayon kay VP Duterte, mahalagang ipakita ng pangulo ang resulta ng drug test upang patunayan na kaya pa rin niyang pamunuan ang bansa.
english: According to VP Duterte, it is important for the president to show the result of the drug test to prove that he can still lead the country.

text: Nang tanungin kung naniniwala siya sa alegasyon, sinabi ng bise presidente na marami sa mga nakapaligid sa pangulo ang nagkumpirmang may kaugnayan sa paggamit ng droga.
english: When asked if he believed the allegation, the vice president said many of those around the president confirmed that he was involved in drug use.

text: Sa kabilang banda, nilinaw ng Malacañang na negatibo ang resulta ng isinagawang drug test ni Pangulong Marcos at wala rin itong balak na sumailalim sa hair follicle test.
english: On the other hand, Malacañang clarified that the result of President Marcos' drug test was negative and he has no intention of undergoing a hair follicle test.

text: Tungkol naman sa posibilidad na siya ang pumalit sa pangulo kung mapaalis si Marcos dahil sa lumalalang isyu ng korapsyon, nagpasya si VP Sara na hindi muna magbigay ng pahayag.
english: Regarding the possibility that he will replace the president if Marcos is removed due to the worsening corruption issue, VP Sara decided not to give a statement.

text: Ayon sa report, dadalo si Duterte sa Senate Hearing sa Huwebes, Nobyembre 27, kaugnay sa 2026 budget ng Office of the Vice President.
english: According to the report, Duterte will attend the Senate Hearing on Thursday, November 27, regarding the 2026 budget of the Office of the Vice President.

text: Kun katahum ang pagahambalan, sigurado nga malinya ang actress, host, kag fashion icon nga si Anne Curtis mangin sa international personalities kag pamatuod dira ang pag-angkon sini sang iya kaugalingon nga wax figure sa Madame Tussauds Hong Kong.
english: When it comes to beauty, actress, host, and fashion icon Anne Curtis is sure to be among the international personalities and proof of that is her own wax figure at Madame Tussauds Hong Kong.

text: Ang Madame Tussauds isa ka world famous wax museum nga kilala sa lifelike sculptures sang global stars kag icons.
english: Madame Tussauds is a world famous wax museum known for its lifelike sculptures of global stars and icons.

text: Ibutang ang figure ni Anne sa Hong Kong Glamour Zone kaupod sa bantog nga Hollywood stars kaangay kanday Nicole Kidman, Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie, Robert Pattinson, kag Chris Hemsworth.
english: Put Anne’s figure in the Hong Kong Glamor Zone alongside famous Hollywood stars like Nicole Kidman, Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie, Robert Pattinson, and Chris Hemsworth.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, nasuguran na sang sculptors sa United Kingdom ang pag-obra sa amo nga figure kag ginalantaw nga malunsar ang natapos na nga project sa katapusan sang 2024.
english: According to initial information, sculptors in the United Kingdom have already started work on the figure and are expected to launch the completed project by the end of 2024.

text: “I cannot believe this is happening.
english: “I cannot believe this is happening.

text: So thrilled to share that I will be joining [Madame Tussauds Hong Kong].
english: So thrilled to share that I will be joining [Madame Tussauds Hong Kong].

text: Another dream ANNE-locked!” pagpakigbahin ni Anne sa iya nga Instagram post.
english: Another dream ANNE-locked!” Anne shared in her Instagram post.

text: Sini lamang nga 2023 sang nag-selebrar ang nasambit nga 38-anyos nga multi-media star sang iya ika-25 nga tuig sa show business.
english: Just this 2023, the 38-year-old multi-media star celebrated his 25th year in show business.

text: Sa guwa naman sang entertainment industry, kilala ang host-actress bilang UNICEF Philippines National Ambassador, kag isa ka proud mom sa ila isa isahanon nga anak ni Erwan Heussaff nga si Dahlia Amelie.
english: Outside the entertainment industry, the host-actress is known as a UNICEF Philippines National Ambassador, and a proud mom to Erwan Heussaff's only daughter, Dahlia Amelie.

text: Ang iban pa nga mga Pinoy nga may wax figures sa bantog nga Madame Tussauds museums amo sanday Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach kag Manny Pacquiao nga naka-display sa Hong Kong; kag Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray nga naka-display sa Singapore.#
english: Other Filipinos with wax figures in the famous Madame Tussauds museums are Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach and Manny Pacquiao on display in Hong Kong; and Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray on display in Singapore.#

text: Isa ka player ang gindala sa Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital sang nagluntad ang tensyon kag sang ulihi nag-ilinaway na kadungan sang football (men’s division) championship match sa Palarong Bicol 2024.
english: A player was taken to the Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital when tension broke out and later a fight broke out during the football (men's division) championship match at Palarong Bicol 2024.

text: Sambuwa ini sa tunga sang mga team sang Masbate kag Naga kun sa diin nakuha mismo sa live stream ang natabo nga pagtapungulay kag sipaay.
english: The match was between the teams of Masbate and Naga where the live stream captured the fighting and fighting.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang ginhalinan sang inaway, apang sandig sa inisyal nga impormasyon, may intanay sa skor matapos nagdaog ang Masbate team, 5-0.
english: It is not clear what caused the fight, but according to initial information, there was a score gap after the Masbate team won, 5-0.

text: May inisyal man nga impormasyon nga ang nag-umpisa sa away amo ang players sang Naga nga red-carded.
english: There was also initial information that the fight was started by Naga players who were red-carded.

text: Ginpahayag man nga antes pa man ang kick-off, may “sportsmanly tension” sa tunga sang players nga pareho nga gusto nga mabulsa ang gold.
english: It was also claimed that even before kick-off, there was “sportsmanly tension” between the players who both wanted to pocket the gold.

text: Indi lang players ang nagginamo bangud sa separado nga video, may mga kabataan man sa sports complex nga nagalantaw lang sang football match kag sang ulihi nag-ilinaway man.
english: Not only players were in turmoil over the separate video, there were also children in the sports complex who were just watching the football match and later started fighting.

text: Gina-imbestigaran na sang Department of Education Regional Office V ang nasambit nga insidente.#
english: The Department of Education Regional Office V is investigating the incident.

text: May plano ka bala nga mag-biyahe sakay sa eroplano subong nga Hulyo?
english: Any plans to travel by plane this July?

text: Maayo nga balita bangud may pagnubo sa airfare subong nga bulan bangud man sa pagbuhin sang fare surcharge.
english: Good news because there is a reduction in airfare this month due to the reduction of fare surcharge.

text: Suno kay Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) administrative division OIC Clarabel Anne Lacsina, ang ginpanubo nga world market prices para sa fuel amo man ang nagtulod sa Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) nga panubuon ang fuel surcharges sa Level 5 halin sa 6.
english: According to Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) administrative division OIC Clarabel Anne Lacsina, the reduced world market prices for fuel also prompted the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) to reduce fuel surcharges to Level 5 from 6.

text: Sa idalom sang level 5 fuel surcharges, yara na lang sa P151 tubtub sa P542 ang range sa domestic flights.
english: Under level 5 fuel surcharges, the range is only P151 to P542 for domestic flights.

text: Sa international flights, ang fuel surcharges ang magatupa sa P498 tubtub sa P3,703.
english: On international flights, fuel surcharges will drop from P498 to P3,703.

text: Ang fuel surcharge ang isa ka optional fee nga ginapasa sang airlines sa mga pasahero agud nga ma-recover ang ila ginbayaran bangud man sa volatility sang jet fuel.
english: The fuel surcharge is an optional fee that airlines pass on to passengers to recover their payments due to the volatility of jet fuel.

text: Lain ini sa base fare.
english: This is different from the base fare.

text: Ini nga surcharge ang nakasandig sa movement sang jet fuel prices sa international market.
english: This surcharge is dependent on the movement of jet fuel prices in the international market.

text: Gin-report man sang CAB nga mas mabaskog ang air travel demand subong nga 2024 ipaanggid sang 2023.
english: The CAB also reported that air travel demand is stronger in 2024 compared to 2023.

text: “Ang total domestic passengers natin ngayon ay nasa 7.4 million na siya at ang international naman ay nasa 6.9 million kumpara po noong 2023 ng first quarter din po.
english: “Our total domestic passengers are now at 7.4 million and international passengers are at 6.9 million compared to the first quarter of 2023.

text: So, patuloy po na sana po makikita pa tayo nang patuloy na pagtaas ng bilang ng ating mga pasahero lalo na po na bumaba ang ating fuel surcharge na nagta-transmit na ng lower fares po,” kabahin sang statement ni Lacsina.
english: So, we hope to continue to see a continuous increase in the number of our passengers especially as our fuel surcharge decreases which is transmitting lower fares,” Lacsina said in a statement.

text: Istrikto nga magabantay ang kapulisan sa screening area sa mga patyo sa syudad sang Iloilo agud malikawan nga may magpasulod sang delikado nga mga hinganiban kaangay sang armas kag patalom.
english: Police will strictly guard the screening area in the courtyards of Iloilo City to prevent the entry of dangerous weapons such as firearms and knives.

text: Lakip man sa dumilian nga dal-on amo ang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: Also prohibited from carrying are alcoholic beverages.

text: Ginapahanumdom man sang kapulisan nga ginadumilian nga magsugal kag magpatukar sang matunog nga musika kadungan sang pagbisita sa mga minatay.
english: Police also remind that it is forbidden to gamble and play loud music while visiting the dead.

text: Sa bahin sang Tanza Cemetery nga isa sa pinakadaku nga patyo sa syudad, ginpahayag ni Police Captain Michael Tuburan, officer in charge sang Iloilo City Police Station 7, nga preparado na ang ila contingency measures para sa pagdamo sang mga tawo buwas, Nobyembre 1 tubtub sa Domingo, Nobyembre 2.
english: Regarding the Tanza Cemetery, one of the largest cemeteries in the city, Police Captain Michael Tuburan, officer in charge of Iloilo City Police Station 7, said that their contingency measures are ready for the increase of people tomorrow, November 1 to Sunday, November 2.

text: Isa lang ang alagyan pasulod kag isa man pagguwa sa patyo.
english: There was only one way in and one way out of the courtyard.

text: Pahayag sang pulis, umpisa buwas, dumilian man nga makasulod ang mga salakyan sa entrada sang Tanza Cemetery.
english: Police said that starting tomorrow, vehicles will also be prohibited from entering the entrance of the Tanza Cemetery.

text: Ginapahanumdom sang pulis sa mga may edad na ukon may ginabatyag sa lawas nga magdala gid sang kaupod kun magkadto sa patyo agud nga may magbulig gilayon sa ila pananglitan maglain ang pamatyag.
english: The police remind those who are elderly or have illnesses to bring a companion when they go to the courtyard so that someone can help them immediately in case they feel unwell.

text: Ginapanugyan man nga magdala sang tubig ilabi na bangud sa mainit nga tyempo.
english: It is also recommended to bring water especially due to the hot weather.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos 4,000 ka mga uniformed personnel ang ipalapta sa bug-os nga Western Visayas kadungan sang Undas lakip na ang masobra 2,000 nga halin sa Philippine National Police (PNP).#
english: It is known that nearly 4,000 uniformed personnel will be deployed throughout Western Visayas during Undas including more than 2,000 from the Philippine National Police (PNP).#

text: 22 ka mga tawo ang napatay bangud sang sunog sa isa ka restaurant sa northeastern nga bahin sang China.
english: 22 people have been killed in a fire at a restaurant in northeastern China.

text: Wala pa ginbuyagyag sang Xinhua ang rason sang sunog, apang ginpahayag sini nga ginpatawag na ini ni President Xi Jinping nga “isa ka madalom nga leksyon” kag ginmanduan niya ang mga lokal nga opisyal nga dali-dalion ang pagbulig sa mga pilason, imbistigaran ang kabangdanan sang sunog, kag pasakaan sang kaso ang mga responsable.
english: Xinhua did not disclose the cause of the fire, but said President Xi Jinping had already summoned it as “a profound lesson” and that he had ordered local officials to rush to help the injured, investigate the cause of the fire, and prosecute those responsible.

text: Ang insidente ginakabig naman nga pinakaulihi nga serye sang mga trahedya nga may kapareho nga kahimtangan sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: The incident is considered the latest in a series of similar tragedies in different parts of the country.

text: Ginapaabot pa ang dugang nga impormasyon samtang ginapadayon ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad.
english: More information is expected as authorities continue their investigation.

text: Isang 19-anyos na lalaki ang binugbog ng magkapatid na lalaki habang nag-iinuman sa Ilagan City.
english: A 19-year-old man was beaten by two brothers while drinking in Ilagan City.

text:
Ayon sa ulat ng pulisya, nagsimula ang gulo nang insultuhin ng biktima ang isa sa mga suspek sa pamamagitan ng salitang “You’re so ugly.”

Dahil dito, agad na nag-init ang ulo ng magkapatid na may edad 21 at 16, at sabay nilang sinaktan ang biktima.
english:
According to police reports, the riot started when the victim insulted one of the suspects with the words “You’re so ugly.”

As a result, the brothers, aged 21 and 16, immediately became angry and assaulted the victim.

text: Dahil sa pananakit, nagtamo ng mga sugat at pasa sa katawan ang biktima.
english: Due to the injury, the victim sustained cuts and bruises on his body.

text: Kaagad namang rumesponde ang mga awtoridad at inaresto ang mga suspek.
english: Authorities immediately responded and arrested the suspects.

text: Nahaharap ngayon ang magkapatid sa posibleng kasong physical injury  habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The brothers are now facing possible charges of physical injury while the investigation into the incident continues.

text: Bilang sabat sa ginakabig nga trade war ni US President Donald Trump, nagpagwa ang Foreign Ministry sang China sang isa ka video nga nagapanawagan sa international community nga magtindog batok sa “bully” nga leader sang America.
english: In response to US President Donald Trump’s perceived trade war, China’s Foreign Ministry released a video calling on the international community to stand up to America’s “bully” leader.

text: Ginhambal sa video nga ang pagluhod sa isa ka bully ang kaangay lang sang pag-inom sang hilo agud mabulong ang kauhaw, kag sa sini, nagadalom lang ang krisis.
english: It was said in the video that taking a knee to a bully is just like drinking poison to quench your thirst, and with this, it only deepens the crisis.

text: Direkta man nga ginsiling sa video nga indi gid magluhod ang China.
english: It is also directly stated in the video that China will never kneel.

text: Ginasaysay man sa video ang history lesson sang kun ano ang ginakabig sang China nga American economic aggression.
english: The video also tells the history lesson of what China considers American economic aggression.

text: Diri naman ginpresentar sang China ang kaugalingon sini bilang free-trade haven sa diin hilway ang iban nga pungsod nga mag- invest kag mag- partner.
english: China has presented itself as a free-trade haven where other countries are free to invest and partner.

text: Sa video, ginsiling man nga padayon nga manindugan ang China kag gintawag ang America nga indi masaligan.
english: In the video, it also said that China will continue to stand its ground and called America unreliable.

text: Dugang pa, ginpahayag man sa video nga kun ang bilog nga kalibutan magtingob batok sa US, wala ini sang ibato kontra sa gintingob nga pwersa sang iban nga nasyon.
english: In addition, the video also stated that if the whole world unites against the US, it will have nothing against the combined forces of other countries.

text: Pareho na nga ginkumpirma nanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Daniel Padilla nga bulagay na sila nga duha.
english: Both Kathryn Bernardo and Daniel Padilla have confirmed that they are separated.

text: Una nga nagpaguwa sang statement ang 27-anyos nga aktres kun sa diin iya ginpahayag nga “chapter closed” na.
english: The 27-year-old actress first issued a statement saying she was “chapter closed”.

text: Nalakip diri ang daan nga laragway nila sang aktor.
english: It includes an old picture of the actor.

text: “I hope this finally helps all of us move forward.
english: “I hope this finally helps all of us move forward.

text: I won’t be entertaining questions regarding this anymore.
english: I won’t be entertaining questions regarding this anymore.

text:
Thank you for understanding.”

May malawig pa nga statement kun sa diin iya gin-apresyar ang 11 ka tuig nga relasyon kay Padilla.
english:
Thank you for understanding.”

There was a long statement in which he appreciated the 11-year relationship with Padilla.

text: “These are 11 years that brought me joy, adventure, and the feeling of being home….
english: “These are 11 years that brought me joy, adventure, and the feeling of being home….

text: He was my first boyfriend….
english: He was my first boyfriend….

text: I will always have love for him….
english: I will always have love for him….

text:
We’ve been drifting apart for a while now, and we ultimately had to accept that we can’t go back to where we used to be….”

Gintapos ang statement nga may direkta nga mensahe kay Daniel: “Deej, you gave me 11 beautiful years and the kind of love that I will forever cherish.
english:
We’ve been drifting apart for a while now, and we ultimately had to accept that we can’t go back to where we used to be….”

The statement ended with a direct message to Daniel: “Deej, you gave me 11 beautiful years and the kind of love that I will forever cherish.

text:
I will always be grateful for you.”

Sunod man nga nagpaguwa sang pahayag ang 28-anyos nga aktor lakip ang ila laragway ni Kathryn.
english:
I will always be grateful for you.”

The 28-year-old actor also released a statement including a picture of him and Kathryn.

text: “Our lives may drift away, but our love will still ride that tide,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “Our lives may drift away, but our love will still ride that tide,” the statement said.

text:
“Bal, ang pagmamamhal ko sa ‘yo ay walang hanggan at walang katapusan.”

Nagpasalamat man ini sa ila fans nga ila ginatawag nga Kathniels: “KathNiels, maraming salamat sa napakagandang pinagsamahan natin….
english:
“Bal, my love for you is forever and ever.”

He also thanked their fans whom they call Kathniels: “KathNiels, thank you very much for the wonderful relationship we had….

text:
Magiging mahirap pero kailangan nating yakapin ang kinabukasan….”

Wala-tuo ang proyekto sang duha halin sang nadiskubrehan ang ila chemistry kag isa sila sa ginatangla nga pinaka-popular nga loveteam sa Philippine showbiz.
english:
It will be difficult but we have to embrace the future….”

The two have been working together since their chemistry was discovered and they are one of the most popular loveteams in Philippine showbiz.

text: Una sila nga nag-updanay sa youth-oriented series nga Growing Up kag sunod nga nakit-an ang sparks sa primetime series nga Princess and I sang 2012.
english: They first worked together in the youth-oriented series Growing Up and next found sparks in the primetime series Princess and I in 2012.

text: Pagkatapos, nangin asud-asud na ang blockbuster projects halin sa She’s Dating the Gangster pakadto sa The Hows of Us.
english: After that, blockbuster projects from She's Dating the Gangster to The Hows of Us became a thing.

text: Ang katapusan nila nga daku nga proyekto sa telebisyon amo ang 2023 series nga 2 Good 2 Be True.
english: Their last big television project will be the 2023 series 2 Good 2 Be True.

text:
Diutay na lang ang mga pasahero sa Ceres Terminal sa Barangay Camalig, Jaro, Iloilo City subong nga gab-i.

Sa pag-check sang Bombo News Team, wala na sang malawig nga pila ipaanggid kahapon kun sa diin lab-ot ang pila sang mga pasahero sa exit area samtang nga nagahingagaw para sa obserbasyon sang Undas.
english:
There are few passengers at the Ceres Terminal in Barangay Camalig, Jaro, Iloilo City tonight.

When the Bombo News Team checked, there was no long queue compared to yesterday where the queue of passengers reached the exit area while waiting for the observation of Undas.

text: Tubtub alas nueve ang byahe subong nga gab-i kag wala na sang extension.
english: The flight is until 9 pm tonight and there will be no extension.

text: Kadam-an sa units nga nabilin ang may byahe nga Passi City kag sa Barotac.
english: Most of the remaining units have flights to Passi City and Barotac.

text: Base sa operators, nangin bastante man ang units sang Vallacar Transit Inc.
english: According to operators, the units of Vallacar Transit Inc.

text: (VTI) agud nga ma-cater ang mga pasahero nga magabalik sa ila probinsya para sa long weekend.
english: (VTI) to cater to passengers returning to their province for the long weekend.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo sa pasahero nga si Mary Jane Ibon nga naga-trabaho sa Banate sa masobra na duha ka tuig, iya ginpahayag nga ginpain gid niya ini nga adlaw agud nga makabalik sa Cebu kag makaupod ang iya nga pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, passenger Mary Jane Ibon, who has been working in Banate for more than two years, said she set aside this day to return to Cebu and be with her family.

text: Pahayag sini, duha ka beses siya nga nagapauli sa kada tuig.
english: He said he comes home twice a year.

text: Sa Lunes, magabalik naman ini diri sa Iloilo agud tapuson ang iya trabaho bilang mananahi.
english: On Monday, she will return to Iloilo to finish her job as a tailor.

text: Kaina sang aga, nanguna si Police Regional Office 6 Director BGen.
english: Yesterday morning, Police Regional Office 6 Director BGen.

text: Josefino Ligan sa pag-check sa major transport terminals sa Iloilo agud nga ma-check ang police deployment kag maghatag sang safety tips kag pahanumdom sa mga byahero kag drivers.#
english: Josefino Ligan to check the major transport terminals in Iloilo to check the police deployment and give safety tips and reminders to passengers and drivers.

text: Magataas ang balayran para sa liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products epektibo subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 1.
english: The fee for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products will increase effective today, July 1.

text: Suno sa Petron Corporation, may saka sa presyo nga P0.55 per kilogram halin 12:01 a.m. kaina sang kaagahon.
english: According to Petron Corporation, there was a price increase of P0.55 per kilogram from 12:01 a.m. this morning.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, may ginpatuman nga rollback ang amo nga kumpaniya nga P6.20 per kilogram para sa household LPG.
english: Last month, the company implemented a rollback of P6.20 per kilogram for household LPG.

text: Suno kay Regasco president Arnel Ty, president sang LPG Marketers Association, ang mayor nga rason para sa pagsaka sa presyo amo man ang kinagamo sa Middle East nga ginakahangaw-an sang international market bangud sa posible nga supply disruptions.
english: According to Regasco president Arnel Ty, president of the LPG Marketers Association, the main reason for the price increase is also the unrest in the Middle East which the international market is worried about due to possible supply disruptions.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang industriya sa mga konsumidor nga islan na sang bag-o ang dilapidated LPG cylinders bangud nagahilapit na ang deadline para sa confiscation sang substandard tanks.
english: The industry also reminded consumers to replace dilapidated LPG cylinders with new ones as the deadline for confiscation of substandard tanks approaches.

text: Ang dilapidated ukon substandard nga tangke sang LPG ang nagalakip sang mga wala sang visible brand kag permanent marking kag puno na sang tuktok.
english: Dilapidated or substandard LPG tanks include those without visible brand and permanent marking and are full of tops.

text: Suno kay Ty, mahimo bayluhan ini nga mga tangke sa pinakamalapit nga dealer nga wala na sang kinahanglan bayaran.
english: According to Ty, these tanks can be exchanged at the nearest dealer free of charge.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang layi, ang dilapidated kag indi safe nga tangke ang mahimo kumpiskaron epektibo sa Oktubre subong nga tuig nga tatlo ka tuig matapos nangin epektibo ang LPG Industry Regulations Act.
english: Under the law, dilapidated and unsafe tanks can be confiscated effective October this year, three years after the LPG Industry Regulations Act came into force.

text: ILOILO – Wala ginlauman ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: nga tuman ka daku ang abanse sang iya anak nga si Iloilo 3rd District Cong.
english: that his son, Iloilo 3rd District Cong.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: batok kay Iloilo 4th District Cong.
english: against Iloilo 4th District Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron sa pagka-gobernador sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Ferjenel Biron for governor of Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gov.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Gov.

text: Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga ginalauman na niya nga magadaug ang iya anak nga si Cong.
english: Defensor, he said he expects his son, Cong.

text: Toto sa pagka gobernador apang wala niya ginlauman nga tuman ka daku ang mangin abanse.
english: Toto for governor but he did not expect to be so big ahead.

text: Tuman ang pagpasalamat sang gobernador sa mga nagsakdag sa kandidatura sang iya anak.
english: The governor expressed his gratitude to those who supported his son's candidacy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Gov.
english: He said Gov.

text: Defensor nga sa pihak sang mga pagpakamalaot nga ila nabaton nga mag-amay gikan sa mga kasumpong sa pulitika, nagapabilin sa gihapon ang pagsalig sang mga pumuluyo sa ila.
english: Defensor said that despite the condemnation they received from their political opponents, the people still trust them.

text: Halos isa ka semana makaligad ginkoronahan ang bag-o nga Miss Universe sa El Salvador, gin-anunsyo sang organisasyon nga nakuha sang tiglawas sang Pilipinas ang Best National costume award!
english: Almost a week after crowning the new Miss Universe in El Salvador, the organization announced that the representative of the Philippines won the Best National costume award!

text: Ginpahayag nga nakuha ni Michelle Dee ang pinakamataas nga boto sa app nga gingamit sang MUO agud matumod ang winner sa amo nga kategorya.
english: Michelle Dee reportedly received the highest number of votes in the app used by MUO to determine the winner in the category.

text: Naga-promote sang turismo sang Pilipinas ang eroplano nga costume ni Michelle kag isa man ka tribute sa iya papel bilang Air Force Reservist.
english: Michelle's plane costume promotes Philippine tourism and is also a tribute to her role as an Air Force Reservist.

text:
Bida man diri ang mga duag sang hayahay sang Pilipinas kag sa likod naman amo ang mural sang tourist attractions sa pungsod kun sa diin ang sentro amo ang slogan sang DOT nga “Love the Philippines.”

Himo ini sang designer nga si Michael Barrasi.
english:
It also features the colors of the Philippine flag and behind it is a mural of tourist attractions in the country where the center is the DOT's slogan “Love the Philippines.”

It’s by designer Michael Barrasi.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas nga nakuha ang Best National Costume award, si Michelle man ang Voice for Change gold winner, Spirit of Carnival awardee, kag nangibabaw man sa Miss Universe’s fan vote, apang nagtapos lamang bilang Top 10 finalist.
english: It is known that besides winning the Best National Costume award, Michelle is also the Voice for Change gold winner, Spirit of Carnival awardee, and also topped the Miss Universe’s fan vote, but only finished as a Top 10 finalist.

text: Desidido ang Boston Celtics nga tapuson na ang serye batok sa Miami Heat kag mangin labing-una nga team halin sa Eastern conference nga maga-abanse sa second round sang National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs!
english: The Boston Celtics are determined to end the series against the Miami Heat and become the first team from the Eastern conference to advance to the second round of the National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs!

text: 7:30 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas patigayunon ang Game 5 sa tunga sang duha ka teams.
english: 7:30 this morning Philippine time will be held Game 5 between the two teams.

text: 3-1 na ang serye kag pananglitan malutos pa liwat ang Miami, mataktak na ini sa first round.
english: The series is 3-1 and if Miami loses again, it will fall into the first round.

text: Pananglitan mag-abanse ang Celtics, atubangon sini ang Orlando ukon ang Cleveland sa second round.
english: Should the Celtics advance, they will face either Orlando or Cleveland in the second round.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Western conference, tatlo na ka teams ang nag-abanse sa second round nga amo ang Thunder, Nuggets kag Timberwolves.
english: In the Western Conference, three teams have advanced to the second round, namely the Thunder, Nuggets and Timberwolves.

text: Ang nagapadayon lamang nga first-round series sa West amo ang Mavericks kag Clippers nga maga-atubangay man 10:00 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The only ongoing first-round series in the West is the Mavericks and Clippers who will also face each other at 10:00 this morning Philippine time.

text: Patas ang serye, 2-2.
english: The series was tied, 2-2.

text: Sa East, isa na lang man ka daog ang kinahanglan sang Cavaliers agud nga makaabanse sa bracket kasunod sang ila Game 5 win batok sa Magic sang Martes nga naghatag sa ila sang 3-2 series lead.
english: In the East, the Cavaliers also need one more win to advance in the bracket following their Game 5 win over the Magic on Tuesday that gave them a 3-2 series lead.

text: Suportado sang United Sugar Producers Federation (UNIFED) ang plano sang Department of Agriculture nga mag-import sang 200,000 metric tons sang refined sugar subong nga tuig.
english: The United Sugar Producers Federation (UNIFED) supports the Department of Agriculture's plan to import 200,000 metric tons of refined sugar this year.

text: Suno kay UNIFED President Manuel Lamata, ang imported nga kalamay amo anay ang magasabat sa kakulangan sa suplay antes mag-sugod ang harvest season sa Septyembre.
english: According to UNIFED President Manuel Lamata, imported sugarcane will first meet the supply shortage before the harvest season begins in September.

text: Maatrasar ang harvest suno sa natungdan bangud sa El Niño phenomenon — rason man nga sang ginkonsulta sila para sa sini nga importasyon, nagpasugot sila.
english: The harvest will be delayed, he said, due to the El Niño phenomenon — which is why when they were consulted for this importation, they agreed.

text: Sa separado nga statement, nagsiling naman ang National Federation of Sugarcane Planters ang nga plano sa pag-import sang kalamay amo na dapat ang “last resort” kag himuon lang kun tuman na gid ka kinahanglanon.
english: In a separate statement, the National Federation of Sugarcane Planters said the plan to import sugarcane should be the “last resort” and only done when absolutely necessary.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Earlier, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga maabot sa Septyembre ang at least 200,000 tons sang imported refined sugar.
english: that at least 200,000 tons of imported refined sugar will arrive in September.

text: Suno sa tiglikom, magakit-anay pa ang DA kag ang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) sa masunod nga bulan agud nga ma-formalize ini nga plano.
english: The secretary said the DA and the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) will meet next month to formalize the plan.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni SRA Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona nga Enero pa sang ginplano ang importasyon kag pormal nga ginpirmahan sang Marso 8, 2024 sa idalom sang Sugar Order No.
english: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona also confirmed that the importation was planned in January and formally signed on March 8, 2024 under Sugar Order No.

text: Sang Disyembre, matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Laurel nga ginakonsiderar sini nga limitahan lamang sa 200,000 metric tons ang importasyon sang kalamay subong nga tuig.
english: In December, Laurel said it was considering limiting sugarcane imports to 200,000 metric tons this year.

text: Liwat nga naglupok ang Bulkang Bulusan kagab-i kag nagbuga sang ashfall sa pila ka mga barangay sa Sorsogon.
english: Bulusan Volcano erupted again last night and emitted ashfall in several barangays in Sorsogon.

text: Suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (DOST-PHIVOLCS), ang phreatic eruption nagluntad 7:43 PM kag naglawig sang ginabanta 77 minutes base sa seismic kag infrasound monitoring.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (DOST-PHIVOLCS), the phreatic eruption occurred at 7:43 PM and lasted for approximately 77 minutes based on seismic and infrasound monitoring.

text: Pila sa mga lugar nga nalab-ot sang abo amo ang banwa sang Irosin, Juban, kag Bulan.
english: Some of the areas affected by the ash were the towns of Irosin, Juban, and Bulan.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakarecord ang PHIVOLCS sang indi magnubo sa 54 volcanic earthquakes sang Biyernes.
english: PHIVOLCS recorded at least 54 volcanic earthquakes on Friday.

text: Sa pihak sang paglupok, nagapabilin ang Alert Level 1 sa Bulusan nga indikasyon sang low-level unrest.
english: Despite the eruption, Alert Level 1 remains in Bulusan indicating low-level unrest.

text: Apang nagpaandam ang otoridad nga mahimo may masunod pa nga mas madamo nga phreatic eruptions.
english: But authorities warned that more phreatic eruptions could follow.

text: Ginadumilian naman ang pagsulod sa 4-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone (PDZ) kag ginapahalong ang mga tawo sa sulod sang 2-kilometer Extended Danger Zone (EDZ).
english: Entry into the 4-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone (PDZ) is prohibited and people are warned within the 2-kilometer Extended Danger Zone (EDZ).

text: Gin-alerto naman ang civil aviation authorities nga abisuhan ang mg piloto nga likawan ang paglupad malapit sa summit sang bulkan bangu sa peligro nga dala sang abo sa eroplano.
english: Civil aviation authorities have been alerted to advise pilots to avoid flying near the summit of the volcano due to the danger posed by ash on the plane.

text: Wala na ginhulat sang iban ang Nobyembre 1 agud nga makapanglimpyo sa mga patyo.
english: Some did not wait for November 1 to clean up the courtyards.

text: Sa Tigbauan Catholic Cemetery, isa si Jay Saul sa temprano pa nga nagpaninlo kag nagbalik liwat subong nga adlaw agud masiguro nga preparado na ang pantyon sang iya himata kadungan sang obserbasyon sang Undas.
english: At the Tigbauan Catholic Cemetery, Jay Saul was one of those who cleaned up early and returned again today to ensure that his relative's grave was ready during the observation of Undas.

text: Pahayag sini, ang Undas isa man sa ginahandaan nga tion sa kada tuig bangud tyempo ini sa pagtilipon sang magpamilya.
english: He said Undas is also one of the most anticipated times of the year because it is a time for family gatherings.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant John Palomo sang First Iloilo Provincial Mobile Force Company (IPMFC), iya ginpahayag nga tubtub sa Nobyembre 2 ang ila nga deployment sa amo nga patyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant John Palomo of the First Iloilo Provincial Mobile Force Company (IPMFC) said they will be deployed in the cemetery until November 2.

text: Ginpahanumdom sini nga istrikto gid nga ginadumilian ang pagdala sang mga deadly weapons kag mga ilimnon sa sulod sang patyo.
english: He reminded that it is strictly prohibited to carry deadly weapons and alcoholic beverages inside the courtyard.

text: Magluwas sa ila, may naka-deploy man nga mga force multipliers sa entrada sang patyo agud makabulig sa pagpabilin sang kalinong sa mga magabisita sa ila mga himata.
english: Besides them, there are also force multipliers deployed at the entrance of the courtyard to help maintain peace among those who will visit their relatives.

text:
PARA SA MALINONG UNDAS 2025

Kaina sang aga, ginlibot ni Police Regional Office (PRO-6) Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan ang major transport terminals kag mga patyo sa Iloilo.
english:
FOR A PEACEFUL UNDAS 2025

Yesterday morning, Police Regional Office (PRO-6) Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan toured the major transport terminals and courtyards in Iloilo.

text: Lakip sa iya ginkadtuan amo ang Parola Wharf, Tanza Public Cemetery, Molo Public Cemetery kag Forest Lake Memorial Parks.
english: Among the places he visited were Parola Wharf, Tanza Public Cemetery, Molo Public Cemetery and Forest Lake Memorial Parks.

text: Ginbisita man sini ang Mohon Ceres Terminal kag Ceres Terminal sa Camalig, Jaro; kag ang Dumangas Port sa Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: He also visited Mohon Ceres Terminal and Ceres Terminal in Camalig, Jaro; and the Dumangas Port in Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Tuyo sini nga ma-check ang police deployment agud masigurado ang safety sang publiko samtang naga-sinako ang tanan para sa obserbasyon sang tigkalalag.
english: The purpose of this is to check the police deployment to ensure the safety of the public while everyone is busy for the observation of the tigkalalag.

text: Nagsaka man ang director sa mga bus kag naghatag sang mga pahanumdom kag safety tips sa mga driver kag mga pasahero.
english: The director also climbed aboard buses and gave reminders and safety tips to drivers and passengers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ligan, iya ginpahayag under control ang security measures sandig sa iya nga assessment kag nakit-an may nga mataas ang police visibility sa convergence areas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ligan said the security measures are under control based on his assessment and found that there is high police visibility in the convergence areas.

text: Ginmensyonar man sini ang kooperasyon sang local government units kag transport operators nga nakabulig sa mga byahero.
english: He also mentioned the cooperation of local government units and transport operators that helped the passengers.

text: Nagpahanumdom ini sa mga pulis nga naka-deploy nga indi lang magpungko kundi mag-assist gid sa mga pasahero kag pati sa parking agud malikawan ang mga inaway ilabi na nga nagadali ang tanan.
english: He reminded the policemen deployed not only to sit but also to assist passengers and also in parking to avoid fights especially when everyone is in a hurry.

text: Halos 4,000 ka mga uniformed personnel ang iga-deploy sa bilog nga Western Visayas kadungan sang Undas lakip na ang masobra 2,700 ka nga kapulisan.#
english: Nearly 4,000 uniformed personnel will be deployed throughout Western Visayas during Undas including more than 2,700 policemen.

text: Patay ang isang lalaki matapos siyang saksakin ng kanyang stepfather dahil sa sobrang ingay habang naglalaro ng online casino game na “Scatter” sa Maramag, Bukidnon.
english: A man died after being stabbed by his stepfather due to excessive noise while playing online casino game “Scatter” in Maramag, Bukidnon.

text: Ayon sa Maramag Municipal Police Station, abala sa paglalaro ang biktima na si “Joseph,” 38 taong gulang, sa labas ng kanilang bahay at sumisigaw habang naglalaro.
english: According to the Maramag Municipal Police Station, the victim, “Joseph,” 38 years old, was busy playing outside their house and shouting while playing.

text: Dahil dito, nagulat at nagalit ang suspek na si “Felix,” 57 taong gulang, na humantong sa mainitang pagtatalo sa pagitan nilang dalawa.
english: As a result, the suspect, “Felix,” 57 years old, was shocked and angry, which led to a heated argument between the two.

text: Nauwi ito sa pananaksak ng suspek kay Joseph.
english: It was recovered when the suspect stabbed Joseph.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon, matagal nang may hindi pagkakaunawaan ang dalawa.
english: According to the investigation, the two had a long-standing misunderstanding.

text: Kasalukuyang nasa kustodiya ng Maramag Municipal Police ang suspek.
english: The suspect is currently in the custody of Maramag Municipal Police.

text: Duha ka do-or-die games sa National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs ang balantayan subong nga adlaw, Abril 30.
english: Two do-or-die games in the National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs are scheduled for today, April 30.

text: 8:30 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas), maga-atubangay ang top-seeded nga Oklahoma City Thunder kag ang eighth-seeded nga New Orleans Pelicans sa Game 4 sang Western Conference first-round matchup.
english: 8:30 this morning (Philippine time), the top-seeded Oklahoma City Thunder and the eighth-seeded New Orleans Pelicans will face off in Game 4 of the Western Conference first-round matchup.

text: 3-0 na subong ang serye kag tuyo sang Oklahoma nga ma-sweep ang New Orleans kaangay sang ginhimo nanday Anthony Edwards kag Minnesota Timberwolves sa team ni Kevin Durant nga Phoenix Suns kahapon, Abril 29, 4-0.
english: It’s now 3-0 in the series and Oklahoma is intent on sweeping New Orleans like Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota Timberwolves did to Kevin Durant’s Phoenix Suns team yesterday, April 29, 4-0.

text: Sang weekend, daog ang Thunders, 106-85.
english: Over the weekend, the Thunders won, 106-85.

text: Pananglitan magmadinalag-on sila karon, ini ang labing-una nga tion nga maka-abanse sila sa second round halin sang nakalab-ot sila sa conference finals sang 2015-2016.
english: Should they succeed today, it will be the first time they can advance to the second round since reaching the conference finals in 2015-2016.

text: Patigayunon ang hampang sa Smoothie King Center sa New Orleans, Louisiana nga home court sang Pelicans.
english: The game will be held at the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana the home court of the Pelicans.

text: LAKERS VS.
english: LAKERS VS.

text:
NUGGETS

Sa pihak nga bahin, ang pinaka-ginabantayan sang tanan amo ang hampang sang four-time NBA champion nga si LeBron James kag sang team sini nga Los Angeles Lakers batok sa defending champion nga Denver Nuggets 10:00 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas).
english:
NUGGETS

On the other hand, what everyone is watching the most is the game of four-time NBA champion LeBron James and his team Los Angeles Lakers against the defending champion Denver Nuggets 10:00 this morning (Philippine time).

text: Patigayunon ang Game 5 sa home court sang Nuggets.
english: Game 5 will be played on the Nuggets' home court.

text: 3-1 na ang serye matapos nga nagdaog ang Los Angeles sa Game 4, 119-108, nga amo ang nagsalbar sa ila sa first-round elimination kag sa isa na naman ka makahuluya nga sweep nga natabo sang nagligad nga Western Conference finals.
english: The series is now 3-1 after Los Angeles won Game 4, 119-108, saving them from first-round elimination and another embarrassing sweep that took place in the previous Western Conference finals.

text: Ang Game 4 sang Domingo amo ang labing-una nga tion nga nalutos sang Lakers ang Nuggets halin sang Disyembre 2022 kun sa diin may 11-game winning streak ang Denver sa pagpanguna sang two-time MVP nga si Nikola Jokic.#
english: Game 4 on Sunday was the first time the Lakers beat the Nuggets since December 2022 where Denver has an 11-game winning streak led by two-time MVP Nikola Jokic.#

text: Maid-id nga nagapatigayon sang inspeksyon ang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sa mga sakayang pandagat nga nagabyahe Parola Wharf pa-Guimaras and vice versa.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) is conducting thorough inspections of vessels sailing from Parola Wharf to Guimaras and vice versa.

text: Ginasulod sang mga personnel ang kada sakayan kag ginaisip ang mga pasahero agud masiguro nga wala nagasobra sa seating capacity.
english: Personnel enter each boat and count the passengers to ensure that no one exceeds the seating capacity.

text: Ini ang magluwas pa sa personnel mismo sang fiber vessel nga naga-check man sini.
english: This is in addition to the personnel of the fiber vessel itself who are also checking it.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka-heightened alert ang PCG District Western Visayas para sa Undas agud masiguro nga hilway kag komportable ang pagbyahe sang mga pasahero.
english: The PCG District Western Visayas is on heightened alert for Undas to ensure the safe and comfortable travel of passengers.

text: “The Philippine Coast Guard District Western Visayas (CGDWV) is on heightened alert status in line with OPLAN UNDAS 2025 to ensure the safety and security of travelers, port passengers, and visitors during the long weekend observance,” suno sa ahensya.
english: “The Philippine Coast Guard District Western Visayas (CGDWV) is on heightened alert status in line with OPLAN UNDAS 2025 to ensure the safety and security of travelers, port passengers, and visitors during the long weekend observance,” the agency said.

text: Tanan nga estasyon sa idalom sang CGDWV CGS Iloilo, CGS Capiz, CGS Antique, kag CGS Aklan ang ginmanduan nga pabaskugon ang ila nga monitoring kag mag-deploy sang mga personnel sa ports, terminals, kag coastal areas.
english: All stations under the CGDWV CGS Iloilo, CGS Capiz, CGS Antique, and CGS Aklan have been directed to strengthen their monitoring and deploy personnel in ports, terminals, and coastal areas.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Allan Delos Reyes, kapitan sang Jordan Ferry 1, ginpahayag sini nga indi pa tuman ka damo ang pasahero kaina.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Allan Delos Reyes, captain of Jordan Ferry 1, said there were not too many passengers yesterday.

text: 80 ang ila nga seating capacity, apang masulusobra pa lamang sa 50 ang ila sakay subong nga bisperas sang Undas.
english: 80 seating capacity, but they will only have more than 50 riders on the eve of Undas.

text: Ginpasiguro man sini ang pagsunod sang protocol sang awtoridad ilabi na sa subong nga obserbasyon sang Undas kag madamo ang nagabyahe sa probinsya.
english: He also assured the compliance of the protocol of the authorities especially in the current observation of Undas and many people traveling in the province.
