text: Naka-request na ang Pilipinas sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) nga magpaguwa sang red notice batok kay former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.
english: The Philippines has already requested the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) to issue a red notice against former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Winston Casio, spokesperson sang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC).
english: This was confirmed by Winston Casio, spokesperson of the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC).

text: Pahayag sini, ginapakita ni Roque nga biktima siya sang political persecution, apang indi man ini matuod bangud ang akusasyon batok sa iya ang nakasandig man sa mga ebidensya.
english: He said Roque is showing that he is a victim of political persecution, but this is not true because the accusation against him is also based on evidence.

text: Sang Mayo, matandaan nga may gindagdag nga arrest warrant batok kay Roque, Lucky South 99 representative Cassandra Ong, kag 48 ka iban pa bangud sa qualified human trafficking.
english: In May, it can be recalled that an arrest warrant was added against Roque, Lucky South 99 representative Cassandra Ong, and 48 others for qualified human trafficking.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa ginaalegar nga scam hub nga ginapadalagan sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) firm nga Lucky South 99 sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: This is in connection with the alleged scam hub run by the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) firm Lucky South 99 in Porac, Pampanga.

text: Base sa PAOCC, nakakita sila sang ebidensya nga may torture, kidnapping, kag sex trafficking sa site.
english: Based on the PAOCC, they found evidence of torture, kidnapping, and sex trafficking at the site.

text: Magluwas diri, may na-rescue ang awtoridad nga 158 nga foreign employees sa amo nga scam hub.
english: In addition, the authorities rescued 158 foreign employees from the scam hub.

text: Gina-akusahan si Roque nga amo ang nagbulig nga makakuha sang operating license ang amo nga POGO hub.
english: Roque is accused of helping the POGO hub obtain an operating license.

text: Natumod man siya nga head sang Lucky South 99 legal department sa license reapplication apang gin-deny ini sang ulihi sang Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR).
english: He was also identified as the head of the Lucky South 99 legal department in the license reapplication but was later denied by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR).

text: Ginpanginwala man ni Roque ang akusasyon apang wala na siya nagbalik diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Roque also denied the accusation but never returned to the Philippines.

text: Nagapangayo ini sang asylum sa Netherlands.#
english: He is seeking asylum in the Netherlands.

text: Nagalalain ang director sang marching band sang Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) matapos malakip ang band room sa mga nahalitan sang nagluntad ang sunog pasado alas nueve kaina sang aga, Oktubre 31.
english: The director of the marching band of the Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) is worried after the band room was included in the fire that broke out around 9 am yesterday, October 31.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jerry Alcallaga, iya ginpahayag nga halos indi ini makapati nga sa isa lang ka pisok, madula ang ila tanan nga ginpundar kag ginpangabudlayan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jerry Alcallaga said he can hardly believe that in one fell swoop, all their investments and hard work will be lost.

text: “Pagtawag sa akon, daw nagsalop ako sa lupa.
english: “When I got the call, I felt like I was sinking into the ground.

text: Wala ko gani kabalo nga nakalab-ot na ko di [sa ISAT-U].
english: I didn't even know I got here [at ISAT-U].

text: Kay tungod bala sa effort, foundation, mga ginpondar ko nga legacy [kag mga advocacy], pero madula man lang ang mga instrument ko,” suno pa kay Alcallaga.
english: Because because of the effort, foundation, legacy I founded [and advocacy], but my instruments will disappear,” Alcallaga said.

text: Ginbalikan pa sini ang mga handumanan sa amo nga hulot kaupod anay ang mga estudyante sang buluthuan nga nangin kabahin man sang marching band.
english: He also recalled the memories of the room with the former students of the school who were also part of the marching band.

text: “Daw indi ko gid mabaton dayon nga sa isang pisok lang madula na ang tanan dira,” pahayag sini.
english: “I can't accept that everything will disappear in the blink of an eye,” he said.

text: Sa pagbanta sini, nagalab-ot sa masobra P1-million ang balor sang mga instrumento nga nahalitan bangud sa sunog.
english: He estimated that more than P1-million worth of instruments were damaged due to the fire.

text: Nagpanawagan ini sa mga alumni sang marching band nga ulikdan man ang eskwelahan kag magbulig kasunod sang natabo nga fire incident.
english: He called on the alumni of the marching band to leave the school and help following the fire incident.

text: “Ginapanawagan ko lang sa mga band alumni, nagapanuktok gid ko sa inyo kabubut-on nga lantawon niyo man di aton nga sitwasyon.
english: “I just appeal to the band alumni, I really knock on your will to look at our situation.

text: Diri kamo nag-grow sa aton gamay nga band room.
english: You guys grew up here in our little band room.

text: Ginapangayo ko gid inyo hamili nga bulig,” kabahin sang panawagan sini.
english: I am asking for your precious help,” part of its appeal.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga pag-estimate sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), nagdangat sa P158,000 ang balor sang halit nga ginbilin sang sunog sa Cultural Office, Physical Education room, Faculty Office kag nalakip man ang marching band room.
english: According to the initial estimate of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), the fire caused P158,000 worth of damage to the Cultural Office, Physical Education room, Faculty Office and the marching band room.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark B. Macoco, acting chief sang Investigation and Intelligence Unit sang Iloilo City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga mahimo pa maglain ang balor sang halit kun magpasa ang eskwelahan sang affidavit of fire loss nga amo man ang iga-deklarar sang BFP.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark B. Macoco, acting chief of the Investigation and Intelligence Unit of the Iloilo City Fire Station, said the value of the damage could increase if the school submits an affidavit of fire loss which will also be declared by the BFP.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman ang BFP official sa publiko ilabi na sa mga magabisita sa patyo kadungan sang Undas nga i-check gid sang maayo ang mga appliances, kag i-unplug, i-switch off, ukon i-shut down ang kuryente antes maghalin sa balay.
english: The BFP official reminded the public especially those who will visit the cemetery during Undas to check their appliances carefully, and unplug, switch off, or shut down the electricity before leaving their homes.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini nga indi pagbayaan ang mga nakasindi nga kandila nga amo man ang masami nga ginahalinan sang kalayo.
english: He also urged people not to leave lit candles which are also a frequent source of fire.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sa ISAT-U, may duha pa ka sunod-sunod nga sunog nga nagluntad sa Iloilo City kagab-i partikular sa Veteran’s Village sa City Proper kag sa Barangay Calaparan sa Arevalo.#
english: Before the ISAT-U, there were two consecutive fires in Iloilo City last night particularly in the Veteran's Village in City Proper and in Barangay Calaparan in Arevalo.

english: Drs. Mariano is the first woman director of the White House Medical Unit and also the first Filipino-American in U.S. history to become a Navy Rear Admiral.
